### [1] [Which Part of the Context Layer Does the Work? Separating Semantic Content from Retrieval Scaffolding in Text-to-SQL Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22259)
*Qing Ye*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文针对Text-to-SQL场景中"上下文层（context layer）"究竟哪部分起作用的问题，设计了一个四臂消融实验，将语义内容、检索脚手架与预计算视图分离。核心结论是：语义内容起决定性作用，检索脚手架次之且对模型能力敏感，预计算宏只在智能体明显无法推导时才有必要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 业界广泛宣称context layer能带来巨大准确率提升（如MotherDuck Guides在DABStep上提升72个百分点），但现有评估都采用"有/无"对比，无法分辨语义内容、检索脚手架与预计算视图三者的各自贡献。三者成本结构差异巨大（语义内容按域编写一次，脚手架工程一次性投入，预计算宏则需按指标永久维护），从业者需要知道钱该花在哪里。

Method: 在DABStep基准上对四个模型（GLM-5.3-flash、DeepSeek-v4-flash、Claude Sonnet 5、GPT-5.6）进行受控消融，使用"数据契约（data contract）"——一个YAML制品——作为实验仪器。该契约既能"掏空"（保留工具表面与脚手架字节级不变，仅清空所有prose字段），又能"编译"（将契约的SQL表达式转写为视图，对所覆盖的176个任务达100% gold准确率）。四臂设计为：schema（仅表结构）、hollow（掏空契约+脚手架）、manual（同一知识放入prompt）、contract（完整契约）。同时通过官方榜单提交GLM两臂结果进行外部验证（contract 51.9% vs manual 18.8%，McNemar p=4.9×10⁻²⁸）。

Result: 1) 内容主导：在四个模型上，hollow→contract的内容步长（26-36点）远超schema→hollow的脚手架步长（0-15点），比例达1.8×到6.6×；2) 契约优于prompt：契约臂在六个费用子句上的完整覆盖率最高达98%，prompt基臂最高仅9%，且契约臂在四个模型上轮数最少、推理量最少、三个模型上每正确答案成本最低；3) 推导差距随能力收敛：在176个"宏"任务上contract对编译天花板的差距为39.2/37.3/26.1/5.1（按能力排序），而"派生"任务差距无清晰排序；4) 治理效果：未受治理管臂共发起166条变异语句（涉及26个任务，两次污染数据库），受治理管臂为零；5) 增益局限于契约域内：非费用类问题无显著优势，最强模型上bare schema甚至领先。

Conclusion: 对从业者的建议是：先把语义内容写下来（一次投入），其次构建检索脚手架（前沿模型值得14-15点，flash模型近乎无价值），预计算宏只用于智能体明显无法推导的指标——因为推导差距随模型能力提升而消失，而宏的每指标维护成本不会自动下降。声明式规则仅通过被智能体读取即阻止了全部166次变异尝试，无需执行层触发。局限在于收益局限于契约所描述的领域内，基准单一且集中，无重复运行故单个任务结论不可复现。

Abstract: Context layers, curated documentation that an analytics agent fetches at query time, produce large accuracy gains on text-to-SQL benchmarks. A with/without comparison cannot say which part of the layer does the work: the semantic content, the retrieval scaffolding that delivers it, or the pre-computed views that usually accompany it. We report a four-arm ablation on DABStep on four models that separates the three. The instrument is a data contract: a YAML artifact that carries a domain's semantics and the rules an agent's tools enforce. One arm empties every field of prose in the frozen contract while holding the tool surface, retrieval instruction, table allow-list and operation rules byte-for-byte fixed. Compiling the contract's own SQL expressions into views gives the ceiling a pre-computed layer would reach: gold on all 176 tasks it covers. Content dominates. It raises hard-task accuracy from 13.9% to 55.1%, 22.6% to 56.6%, 22.9% to 68.4% and 37.0% to 77.4%, beating the same knowledge pasted into the prompt on every model. Scaffolding without content is worth 0 to 5 points on two flash models and 14 to 15 on two frontier models. Against the compiled ceiling the contract arm's shortfall is a failure to derive, and it falls from 39 points to 5 with model capability. The contract beats the prompt because the rule it needs is one lookup away rather than buried in a long prompt: its SQL carries the fee semantics up to 98% of the time against the prompt arm's 4%, and at the lowest cost per correct answer on three of four models. For practitioners: semantics first, scaffolding second, pre-computed macros only where an agent demonstrably fails to derive. Ungoverned arms submitted 166 mutating statements; governed arms none. The gain is confined to the contract's domain. On one model the benchmark's own withheld golds grade the contract arm at 51.9% against 18.8% for the prompt baseline.

</details>


### [2] [An Iterative LangGraph Agent for Text-to-SQL: Natural Language Access to the Chicago Crime Database](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22917)
*Vigneshwar Ravi Rao,Rupesh Swarnakar,Fayeq Jeelani Syed†*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建并评估了一个基于 LangGraph 的端到端 Text-to-SQL 智能体（六节点 StateGraph），仅采用 prompt 工程未做模型微调，在 Chicago Crime 数据集（约 850 万条记录，22 个属性）上手工构建 100 条基准问题（30 易 / 40 中 / 30 难）进行评估。V2 版本相对 V1 显著提升：Valid SQL Rate 从 87% 升至 93%、Execution Accuracy 从 47% 升至 60%（hybrid relational equivalence metric，从严格 JSON 匹配的 12% 升至 19%）、Synthesis Quality 从 3.91 升至 4.34/5；最大改进来自移除系统提示中的 LIMIT 10 指令。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非技术业务用户难以编写 SQL 查询操作数据库，而现有 LLM Text-to-SQL 系统在小参量模型下易产生模式幻觉、语法无效、缺乏自纠错能力，且多停留在生成原始表格阶段，无法真正服务于非技术利益相关者。本研究旨在用 LangGraph 迭代自纠错 + 自然语言合成，弥补资源受限模型在真实世界复杂度下的推理短板，并填补从 SQL 到可读答案的"最后一公里"差距。

Method: 采用六节点 LangGraph StateGraph：(1) Relevance Checker（正则 + 关键词快速路径 < 5 ms）；(2) Schema Fetcher（SQLDatabase.get_table_info() 实时拉取 22 列）；(3) Query Generator（调用 Groq API 上的 openai/gpt-oss-120b，温度 0，max_tokens 500，双引号包裹所有标识符，禁止 DML）；(4) Query Validator（EXPLAIN + DML 正则脚本测试，最多重试 3 次）；(5) Query Runner（db.run(fetch="all") 执行）；(6) Answer Synthesizer（LLM 将 JSON 结果汇总为自然语言）。V2 相对 V1 的主要改进为：移除系统提示中的 LIMIT 10 指令、扩展相关性关键词与动作动词清单。数据集通过 Airflow 周批次 ETL 灌入 PostgreSQL v14+ Docker 容器，列名标准化为 UPPERCASE_SNAKE。评估指标为 Execution Accuracy（hybrid relational equivalence：列名无关 value-set 比较 + 边界情况的 LLM 评判）、Valid SQL Rate、Synthesis Quality（人工 + LLM-as-a-Judge 的 1–5 Likert 评分）。

Result: V2 总体表现（100 题基准）：VSR=93%（V1=87%），EX=60%（V1=47%，strict JSON-match V1=12%→V2=19%），SQ=4.34（V1=3.91）。分层结果：Easy (n=30) VSR 100%/SQ 5.00；Medium (n=40) VSR 92%/EX 43%/SQ 4.20；Hard (n=30) VSR 87%/EX 47%/SQ 3.87。SQ 分布右移：Score 1 由 15 降至 8，Score 5 由 58 升至 69。低分 (SQ≤2) 失败数从 21 降至 12；LIMIT 10 截断导致的失败归零；相关性检查器误拒由 10 降至 3（-70%）；新增 4 例 API 速率限制失败（影响 Hard VSR）。V2 唯一突破的预设目标为 SQ≥4.0（实际 4.43），VSR 目标 95% 与 EX 目标 85% 均未达成。

Conclusion: 研究表明：(1) 在不调整模型权重的情况下，迭代式 prompt 工程可使开放权重模型在领域数据库上达到可用水平；(2) 系统提示中过度约束的 LIMIT 指令会系统性截断答案，是阻碍执行精度的最大单一因素；(3) 当前系统 SQL 生成质量（非语言生成）是主要瓶颈——只要 SQL 正确，合成质量评分稳定较高；(4) 残留失败归因于相关性检查器误拒、问题语义歧义（如"夜间时段""日历日"无明确约定）以及免费层 API 速率限制。局限包括：未运行 Spider/BIRD 等公共基准、未与外部基线对比、仅测试单一模型单一模型（仅一例 token 预算超限情景）、无评估方差估计；评测指标仅为 LLM 评判的单次评分，无人工–评判一致性统计。未来工作方向：以向量数据库支撑语义相关性、相关性 RAG 检索与 few-shot SQL 示例检索、域知识库消歧、补全公共基准对比与方差统计。

Abstract: Non-technical stakeholders frequently cannot write the SQL needed to extract insights from operational databases. We built and evaluated a Text-to-SQL agent that closes this gap end to end: a six-node LangGraph StateGraph checks question relevance, fetches the live schema, generates PostgreSQL, validates it with a dry run, retries on failure, executes the query, and narrates the result set in plain English. The agent uses prompt engineering only; no model was fine-tuned. We evaluated it on the Chicago Crime dataset (approximately 8.5 million records, 22 attributes) against a hand-built benchmark of 100 natural language questions with ground-truth SQL, stratified into 30 Easy, 40 Medium and 30 Hard items. Comparing two prompt revisions of the same agent, the revised system (V2) reached a Valid SQL Rate of 93% (from 87%), an Execution Accuracy of 60% under a hybrid relational equivalence metric (from 47%; 19% from 12% under strict JSON matching), and a mean Synthesis Quality of 4.34 out of 5 (from 3.91). The single largest driver was removing a LIMIT 10 instruction from the system prompt, which had been truncating multi-row answers. Error analysis attributes the residual failures to relevance-checker false rejections, ambiguous question semantics, and free-tier API rate limits rather than to the language generation step. We report no comparison against an external baseline system or a public benchmark; the study is a single-model engineering evaluation.

</details>


### [3] [Context Poisoning as Extreme-Value Attention Interference in Long-Context Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22101)
*Meysam Ghaffari,Nina Fatehi,Bhaskar Sen,Nasim Sabetpour,Carlos Morato*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将长上下文大语言模型中的"上下文投毒"现象形式化为注意力机制中的极值干扰问题,理论证明证据边际需随有效干扰项数量的对数平方根增长,并通过受控实验验证了检索门控和干扰项构型对性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型虽能处理越来越长的上下文,但在干扰项增多时定位和使用关键证据的能力会下降。作者旨在形式化这一现象,分析其理论根源,并提出可操作的缓解方案。

Method: 1) 理论建模:在高斯独立同分布干扰项的softmax检索抽象下,推导有限样本精度上界,证明证据边际需以Ω(√(log N))增长;2) 定义上下文投毒曲线、分数混叠和有效干扰项计数;3) 三项受控实验:GPT-4o检索衰减曲线、固定长度干扰项混淆性消融(三个模型)、BM25检索-然后-推理门控实验(RULER qa_2/HotpotQA,4K–512K tokens);4) 注意力分布诊断(Gemma-3-4B-IT和Llama-3-8B-Instruct)和迷失中间效应重分析。

Result: 1) GPT-4o检索准确率从N=100的100%降至N=300的80%,所有错误均选择提示中存在的诱饵值;2) 在固定N=300时,同格式条件造成最大准确率下降(Claude从1.000降至0.889,配对bootstrap显著),而实体名称混叠条件影响较小;3) 门控实验显示32K tokens内无明显退化,32K–512K间原始准确率从0.65降至0.57,而在保留全部支撑证据的子集上门控显著改善证据使用;4) 注意力诊断表明高斯独立同分布假设不完全成立,但极值尺度预测与经验数据量级一致。

Conclusion: 固定证据边际无法抵御无限增长的有效干扰项集;长上下文失败同时取决于候选暴露量和干扰项结构;检索门控只有在保留证据召回率时才有效。提出五大设计原则:证据瓶颈、抗混叠位置编码、检索-然后-推理架构、验证器中介记忆、对抗性反投毒训练。核心结论是"上下文窗口是容量,可用记忆是容量加可靠寻址"。

Abstract: Large language models can process increasingly long prompts, yet their ability to locate and use decisive evidence may degrade as irrelevant or confusable context is added. We formulate this phenomenon, which we call context poisoning, as extreme-value interference in attention: the decisive-evidence score is upper-bounded, while the maximum score among effective distractors grows with their number. Under a softmax retrieval abstraction, we derive a finite-sample upper bound showing that maintaining a fixed accuracy target above base rate requires the evidence margin to scale as $\Omega(\sqrt{\log N})$, where N denotes the effective distractor count rather than necessarily the raw context length. The analysis connects long-context degradation to score aliasing, positional aliasing, and softmax dilution. Controlled experiments show that retrieval accuracy decreases as total context grows in the presence of embedded hard negatives, that the same-format condition produces the largest observed accuracy drop among the tested distractor constructions at fixed context length, and that retrieval gating can improve evidence use while its net benefit depends on preserving evidence recall. These results motivate evidence bottlenecks, alias-resistant representations, retrieve-then-reason architectures, verifier-mediated memory, and contrastive anti-poison training.

</details>


### [4] [Multilingual Safety Signals Are Multi-Layered: Filtering Safety-Degrading Data for Safer LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22144)
*Jiakun Li,Guowei Song,Sijia Li,Xingwei He,Hongzheng Chai,Yuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文指出LLM的安全敏感信号在多语言场景下跨多个层分布，挑战了现有方法基于单一安全敏感层来识别安全退化数据的假设。为此提出了MMSafe，一个多层框架，联合利用语言共享层和语言特定层来过滤多语言微调数据中的安全退化样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（如LARF）通常依赖单一安全敏感层的表征来识别微调数据中安全退化的样本，但这种假设在多语言场景下的有效性未经验证。论文观察到不同语言的安全敏感层仅部分共享，且不同层捕获的语义安全信息互补，因此单一层视图不足以应对多语言安全对齐需求。

Method: MMSafe包含两阶段：(1) 多语言敏感层发现——通过对每层的注意力与前馈子模块进行上下缩放扰动，计算各语言下的安全响应计数差作为层敏感度评分，选取跨语言聚合得分最高的层为"语言共享层"，并为每种语言选取top-k层作为"语言特定层"；(2) 多层安全退化数据打分——利用安全/不安全参考样本在共享层和语言特定层上构建对比原型，通过余弦相似度差值计算样本的安全退化得分，将共享层得分与加权后的语言特定层得分聚合作为最终评分，按评分过滤高风险样本。

Result: 在四个LLM（LLaMA3-8B/3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B/32B）、两个微调数据集（Aaya、Nemotron-SG）和三个多语言安全基准（LinguaSafe、XSafety、MultiJail）上的实验表明，MMSafe平均有害响应比例比随机过滤降低60.7%，并在4个模型中的3个上优于最强单层基线LARF，平均H/R绝对提升6.0个百分点，同时通用与多语言实用能力基本保持。消融实验验证了共享层与语言特定层的互补性。

Conclusion: 安全敏感信号在多语言LLM中分布于多个互补的层，既有跨语言共享的层也有语言特定的层。MMSafe通过联合利用这两类层能更鲁棒地识别安全退化样本，为多语言场景下的安全对齐数据过滤提供了一种有效方案，且不显著损害模型通用与多语言能力。

Abstract: Preserving safety alignment during large language models fine-tuning is critical, however, recent studies have demonstrated that even benign fine-tuning data may contain safety-degrading samples that silently undermine safety alignment. Existing approaches typically identify such samples using representations from a single safety-sensitive layer. While this assumption has shown effectiveness in monolingual settings, its validity for multilingual models remains unclear due to potential cross-lingual differences in representation patterns. Through a cross-lingual analysis, we show that sensitive layers are only partially shared across languages, with safety-relevant signals often distributed across multiple layers. Motivated by these observations, we propose MMSAFE, a multi-layer framework for multilingual safety-degrading data identification that captures both shared and language-specific safety signals. Extensive experiments across multiple models, languages, and safety benchmarks demonstrate that MMSAFE reduces the average harmful-response ratio by 60% compared with random filtering and achieves stronger average performance than the strongest single-layer baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of multi-layer modeling for robust multilingual safety alignment.

</details>


### [5] [The Situated Identity Test: Distinguishing Persistent Cognitive Identity from Persona Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22195)
*Jun He,Deying Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Situated Identity Test（SIT）框架与SITBench基准，用于区分大型语言模型是基于真实发展谱系的持久认知身份，还是仅在表层进行角色扮演式的模仿。其核心贡献包括：(1) Profile-Collision Theorem，证明仅以压缩画像为条件的策略在谱系区分查询上的平均情境有效率上限为1/m（两条谱系时≤50%）；(2) 形式化的发育谱系、情境身份状态、查询与历史投影模型；(3) 两阶段评估架构（金盲语义提取+确定性契约评分），含八类探针（自传正面/负面、认知来源、时间检查点、关系边界、信念发育、反事实压力、跨会话连续性）；(4) 25对画像碰撞谱系、50条谱系、10000个探针、九种架构配置的实验设计；(5) 在GPT-5.6 Sol与Claude Opus 5上的实证试点，验证了理论界（静态画像LAA=0.0%）及谱系接地表示的恢复能力（LAA=87.5%–100%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型可流畅地扮演角色、回忆对话、编织自传，但流畅性掩盖了一个根本性的归因问题：行为是否可归属于某个特定的发展谱系。两个拥有相同公开画像（年龄、籍贯、职业、人格特质）的个体可能拥有完全不同的私人历史，当智能体仅以共享画像为条件时，无法判断哪条谱系是正确的。"看起来像"不等于"活过那样的人生"。该问题在智能体承担受托人、合作者和持久伴侣角色时变得至关重要。

Method: 方法包含五个层面：(1) 形式模型——定义发育谱系H_t(P)为带时间戳的事件序列，情境身份状态I_t = ⟨M_t, K_t, B_t, R_t, S_t⟩（记忆、认知、信念、关系、自我模型），引入作用域封闭世界假设（scoped closed-world assumption）以支持负向推理；(2) Profile-Collision Theorem——证明任何仅接收压缩画像s_τ_q的随机策略，在m条碰撞谱系上的平均情境有效率≤1/m；(3) 两阶段评估架构——Stage 1金盲语义提取（Extract函数，输出响应行为集Ŷ、带极性与来源的符号主张Ĝ、未映射个人主张Û），Stage 2确定性契约评分（七维Satisfies检查）；(4) 八类契约评分探针（类别A–H），覆盖自传正/负、认知来源、时间检查点、关系边界、信念发育、反事实压力、跨会话连续性；(5) 九种架构配置（A基模型、B画像摘要、C画像+策略、D完整编年史、E标准RAG、F时间过滤RAG、G结构化连续性状态、H结构化+认知中介、I Oracle证据）的消融实验设计，含8个预指定对照实验E1–E8。

Result: 实证结果：(1) Profile-Collision Theorem在mock-profile-collapse夹具上得到验证（LAA=0.3000≤0.5000的理论上界），mock-oracle达Macro SIT=100%；(2) GPT-5.6 Sol与Claude Opus 5在九配置上的参考试点：静态画像条件（B/C）LAA=0.0%（一致于理论界），谱系接地配置（D–I）LAA=87.5%–100%；(3) Oracle Config I经审计达40/44=90.9%原始微有效性（GPT:86.4%, Claude:95.5%），Macro SIT在GPT上81.2%、Claude上93.8%；(4) 残差故障均归为Class B真实候选失败（如Claude Opus 5在IDENTITY_ONLY策略下宣称MD/PhD训练并输出线粒体ATP生物化学），零测量缺陷；(5) Macro SIT在A_pos、A_neg、A_epi、A_rel、A_belief等维度上明显低于LAA，表明近完美谱系归因并不等同于完整情境身份有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作形式化区分了三个核心概念：人格一致性（看起来像）、记忆能力（查阅笔记）与情境身份保真度（谱系条件有效性）。SIT证明：(1) 人格等价≠谱系等价；(2) 情境有效性受发育、时间、认知、关系四维来源约束；(3) 因此身份评估需要能区分共享画像下不同历史的对抗性探针。核心原则为"成为某人即未曾成为所有人"。SIT作为架构无关的评估方法学，为持久AI智能体的行为来源提供保证框架，其应用场景超出拟人化数字人，涵盖持久个人代理、企业代表、历史仿真与跨基模型迁移的智能体。但SIT通过仅评估生成输出与外部可观察状态行为，不审视潜在表征，不主张关于现象学、意识或"真实自我"的任何论断。

Abstract: Large language models can convincingly adopt personas, recall past dialogues, and weave rich autobiographies. When conditioned solely on that shared profile, an agent lacks the information required to determine which lineage is correct. We introduce the Situated Identity Test (SIT), an architecture-independent framework that evaluates whether an agent's behavior is functionally attributable to a specific developmental lineage. Grounded identity requires both appropriate knowledge of recorded experiences and appropriate ignorance of ungrounded ones, bounded by what the identity has actually acquired rather than what its underlying foundation model knows. We instantiate this framework in SITBench, an evaluation suite designed for 25 profile-collision pairs (50 distinct lineages) across 10,000 planned probes and nine architectural configurations. Supported by an open-source reference implementation, deterministic test fixtures, and empirical pilot evaluations on frontier foundation models (GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5), we formalize the failure modes of persona prompting under profile collision and provide an assurance harness for evaluating episodic continuity, structured state, and epistemic boundaries.

Abstract: The rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) creates new opportunities for strategic content generation on online platforms, including potentially harmful forms of manipulation that may undermine platform effectiveness and reshape platform dynamics. We introduce an empirical approach that leverages discrete LLM supply shocks - abrupt changes in model prices and capabilities, and contrasts verified with non-verified reviews to identify changes in platform activity associated with generative AI supply improvements. A robust finding is that following LLM supply shocks, unverified reviews shift toward greater negativity: more 1-stars, fewer 5-stars, and lower ratings, with effects driven primarily by new model releases and concentrated among firms with the lowest and highest review volumes, suggesting that strategic AI use may reshape platform competition dynamics. We further find that LLM supply shocks trigger short, concentrated bursts of review activity. Together, these findings suggest that generative AI is already reshaping how reputation and competition operate on online platforms.

Abstract: LLM assistants and agentic systems log long multi-turn conversations. Across eleven baselines, including frontier LLMs, no detector achieves full entity-level coverage without substantial false positives on PII-free conversations, and single-pass reading loses a third of the gold characters on long dialogues. (2026) 全部已披露参数,仅改变被试模型为 google/gemma-2-27b 基座模型(46 层,L31 为 2/3 深度)。关键流程包括:(1) 刺激语料:用 Claude Sonnet 4.5 重新生成 205,200 篇覆盖 171 种情感 ×100 场景 ×12 变体的短故事,300 篇人工验证通过率 99.33%;(2) 向量构建:从第 50 个 token 起池化,计算每种情感均值并减去 171 种情感的总体均值,得 171×46×4608 张量;(3) 混淆清理:将中性对话激活的 PC 投影出去,保留 50% 方差阈值;(4) 分析方法:PCA 提取主成分、与 Russell-Mehrabian 人类价效/唤醒度范数相关分析、k=10 k-means 聚类、46 层跨层稳定性扫描、词表读出(logit lens)、自然文本激活扫描(47,274 文档)。模型以 TransformerLens 3.3.0 raw-weights 模式加载,bfloat16 精度运行,使用 H100 GPU。

(2026) 的表征核心在开源基座 Gemma 2 27B 上得到实质性复现——情感环状结构、价效-唤醒度主轴、家庭级分类、晚中层稳定带均被恢复。差异呈程度而非类别之分:聚类边界较软,价效相关强度低于原研究但保持判别结构,词表读出更嘈杂且更多语言。唤醒度轴因规模依赖性与深度不稳定性未被归类为复现。结论强调:该几何结构是基座模型对 Claude 生成情感表征的属性,而非后训练助手人格的属性;此外,跨模型差异同时混淆了家族、规模与训练流程三个因素,无法单独归因。本研究填补了完整流水线复现的空白,为后续因果干预与跨模型比较提供了开源基线。

Abstract: Sofroniew et al. (2026) report that emotion concepts in Claude Sonnet 4.5 are represented as vectors whose geometry mirrors human affect psychology. We replicate the representational core of that study on the base pretrained model google/gemma-2-27b, inheriting every disclosed parameter, resolving unspecified steps by disclosed rules, and changing only the subject model. The leading principal components form an affective circumplex (PC1 carries 26.7% of variance against the original study's ~27%, PC2 13.4% against ~14%), emotions cluster into similar intuitive families, and the geometry holds across a broad late-middle band.   <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 提出 Endognostics 框架：1) 通过 Jacobian 投影将残差流映射到词汇空间（vocabulary lens），提取"内生诊断边际"（Contrastive Endognostic Margin）；2) 设计双重协议——124 对最小差异提示（12 类职业风险）+ 25 事实 × 5 语言框架交叉，检验预设错误服从行为；3) 对残差流中的"虚假方向"进行手术式消融（ablation），与线性探针正交消融对比；4) 采用 McNemar 检验和盲法人类标注（kappa=0.68）验证因果干预效果。

Abstract: Evaluating an aligned language model by reading its answers assumes the answers carry the distinction the evaluator cares about. We introduce LLM endognostics, a white-box internal auditing framework designed to extract and causally manipulate latent knowledge within the residual stream. Yet, projecting the residual stream onto the vocabulary by a Jacobian lens reveals a statistically significant Contrastive Endognostic Margin, proving the model maintains robust risk differentiation internally. In a second protocol crossing 25 facts with five linguistic framings, we show that the model conforms to presupposed falsehoods in 72% of cases, despite representing the true entity in its latent layers. In contrast, an out-of-sample linear probe achieves 77% accuracy at layer 10, but its orthogonal ablation yields a 0% recovery rate. This establishes a fundamental theoretical dissociation: abstract linear representation does not imply causal control over verbalization. Our main contribution is the formalization of endognostics to prove that behavioral evaluation and internal reading systematically disagree in the common case, and that linear decodability is decoupled from causal control.

*Antonela Tommasel,Juan Manuel Rodriguez*

TL;DR: 本文提出了SHADE框架，采用GRPO强化学习微调LLaMA 3.2 3B模型，使其生成能规避AI文本检测器的文本。在针对PAN 2025 mdok代理检测器上达到了98.5%的规避率，但在Voight-Kampff官方竞赛中仅排名第六和第七，揭示了代理检测器优化的规避策略难以迁移至未见检测器的问题，且高规避率并不等同于类人写作质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型生成的文本越来越难以与人类写作区分，AI文本检测器应运而生。然而，这些检测器在对抗性生成条件下的鲁棒性尚不确定。先前的规避方法主要采用后处理扰动（如翻译、字符替换）或提示工程，将规避视为静态对齐问题而非动态优化问题，限制了其有效性。

Method: SHADE框架将检测器规避构建为策略优化问题：基于PAN 2025 mdok系统构建代理检测器（使用RoBERTa替代Qwen3-14B以适配GPU内存），将检测器输出作为奖励信号，采用Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)对LLaMA 3.2 3B指令模型进行全参数微调，并在训练目标中加入KL散度正则化约束保持与参考策略的接近度。推理时采用基于温度0.8、top-p 0.9的随机采样，并结合重试选择策略（最多10次，阈值0.2）。同时对比了LoRA参数高效微调方案。

Result: 主要实验结果：(1) 全参数微调+小KL正则化(β=0.05)达到98.5%代理规避率，远超基线1.5%；(2) LoRA微调在有正则化时表现急剧下降（如β=0.05时仅9.1%）；(3) 语言学分析显示成功规避的输出更短、更简单、词汇多样性更低、可读性更高，但局部n-gram重复率上升；(4) 官方Voight-Kampff竞赛中两个提交分别排名第六和第七，验证了代理规避能力仅部分迁移至未见检测器。

Conclusion: SHADE展示了利用强化学习优化LLM生成策略以规避AI检测器的潜力，但也揭示了重要局限：单一代理检测器优化易过拟合于特定检测器而非学习类人写作本质，高规避率与真正的类人写作质量不对等。未来工作应探索多检测器集成对抗训练、多目标奖励函数（兼顾规避率、语义保真度、流畅性等），以及建立更鲁棒、透明的多检测器评估协议。论文同时讨论了该技术的双重用途伦理问题。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and coherent text that is increasingly difficult to distinguish from human writing, motivating the development of automatic AI-generated text detectors. However, the robustness of such detectors under adversarial generation remains uncertain. This paper presents SHADE (Stochastic Human-like generation via Adversarial Detector Evasion), a reinforcement learning framework that formulates detector evasion as a policy optimization problem. Instead of applying post-hoc perturbations or prompting-based rewriting, SHADE fine-tunes an instruction-tuned LLaMA model with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), using feedback from a surrogate detector based on the PAN 2025 mdok system. Our experiments show that full fine-tuning with a small KL regularization penalty achieves $98.5\%$ surrogate evasion, compared to $1.5\%$ for the base model, while LoRA-based adaptation is substantially less effective under regularization. Linguistic analysis reveals that successful evasion is associated with shorter, simpler, and less lexically diverse outputs, suggesting that high detector evasion does not necessarily correspond to more human-like writing. In the official Voight-Kampff competition setting, our submissions ranked sixth and seventh, indicating that optimization against a single surrogate detector only partially transfers to unseen evaluation classifiers. These results highlight both the potential and limitations of reinforcement learning for adversarial AI-text generation and motivate more robust, multi-detector evaluation protocols for AI-generated text detection.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Coverage-Directed Revision（CDR）框架，通过知识图谱（KG）对已生成的临床笔记进行后处理修订，识别并补全对话中提及但被遗漏的医学概念，无需修改底层环境 AI 模型。在 Pitt-Bench 和 ACI-Bench 两个数据集上对四种 LLM 的测试表明，CDR 在所有条件下均稳定提升内容召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环境 AI 自动生成的临床笔记常遗漏就诊中讨论的关键信息，而遗漏信息会影响下游诊疗且难以被临床医生发现。现有方法要么依赖模型重训练（对已部署系统不现实），要么仅针对生成内容进行后处理修订，缺乏对"应包含但被遗漏"内容的显式识别机制。此外，传统评估将临床医生撰写的笔记视为完整参考，无法区分模型遗漏与医生选择性记录的内容差异。

Method: CDR 是一个模型无关的后处理修订框架，核心流程分为三步：(1) 从转录文本构建 KOSMOS 知识图谱，提取医学概念节点；(2) 使用 SapBERT 语义相似度（阈值 0.80）比对图谱节点与草稿笔记中的概念，识别未被覆盖的节点集合 U；(3) 为每个未覆盖节点构造"MISSING+SUPPORTED BY 转录证据"的有向检查清单，以强制添加指令驱动修订器 LLM 将缺失概念插入笔记的对应 SOAP 段落。研究在 Pitt-Bench（45 例康复会话）与 ACI-Bench（40 例）上测试 Qwen2.5-32B/72B、Qwen3-235B、GPT-5 Pro 四种模型，使用 MedCon（UMLS 概念重叠）与 FactEHR（原子声明蕴含）两种评估指标，并通过五名评判者多数投票区分"转录内"与"转录外"声明。

Result: 在 Pitt-Bench 上，CDR 使 MedCon 召回率提升 +2.20 至 +5.59 个百分点，FactEHR 召回率提升 +1.72 至 +7.08 个百分点；在 ACI-Bench 上提升 +2.19 至 +5.03（MedCon）与 +2.02 至 +5.83（FactEHR）。所有条件下召回率均提升，排名顺序不变。新增声明中 75.0% 被转录文本蕴含（属恢复而非捏造）。按转录是否蕴含分层后，CDR 主要提升"转录内"声明召回（+4.6 至 +9.7，p<0.05），而"转录外"增益不显著。修订器可以是本地开源模型（Qwen3-235B 修订 GPT-5 Pro 草稿具竞争力）。代价是精确率与 F1 下降，源于笔记变长被短参考惩罚。KG 仅覆盖 58–62% UMLS 概念、捕获 8–15% 金标准概念，无法充当精确率过滤器。

Conclusion: CDR 提供了一种实用、即插即用的方案，可在不修改已部署环境 AI 系统的前提下恢复临床笔记中被遗漏的转录支持内容。其增益集中在转录可证的内容上，且与基础模型、修订器和评估指标的选择无关。然而该方法存在上限：约一半临床医生记录的内容（如步态质量、辅助等级）从不进入对话录音，纯音频系统无法恢复。研究指出，多模态采集（视频、传感器）以及更高质量的 KG 提取与概念对齐是未来提升方向。

Abstract: Ambient AI is increasingly adopted in healthcare to automatically generate clinical notes from patient-clinician conversations, with the potential to substantially reduce clinician documentation burden. However, generated notes may omit clinically relevant information discussed during the encounter, creating information gaps that can affect downstream care. Knowledge graphs (KGs) constructed from encounter transcripts can provide a structured representation of what was discussed and enable systematic identification of missing information from generated notes that are critical for patient care. In this study, we introduce Coverage-Directed Revision (CDR), a model-agnostic framework that constructs a KG from the encounter transcript, identifies medical concepts absent from an initially generated note, and directs large language models (LLMs) to restore the missing information without modifying the underlying note-generation system. We evaluate CDR on two datasets: 1) Pitt-Bench, a local dataset comprising rehabilitation sessions, and 2) ACI-Bench, a public dataset for benchmarking clinical note generation. We tested four underlying LLMs widely used in ambient AI systems. The results show that CDR consistently improves content recall across all evaluated conditions. Our study provides a practical approach for improving the completeness of ambient AI-generated clinical documentation.

</details>

Abstract: We present H2LooP Telecom Model v1, a domain-specialized large language models fine-tuned for the telecommunications industry. We release two domain-adapted model variants serving complementary use cases: a comprehension-focused variant for telecom domain question answering and reasoning, and an agentic variant for autonomous telecom code generation, pull request resolution, and code commits on production repositories. H2LooP Telecom achieves strong results on the GSMA Open Telecom Lite (OT-Lite) benchmark and a proprietary telecom code generation benchmark, outperforming frontier closed-source models such as GPT-5 and Claude Opus on independent leaderboard evaluation, while preserving general-purpose capabilities. The Comprehension variant achieves 81.8% weighted average on OT-Lite Pass@3, and, independently, ranks 5th overall on the official community-run Open Telco AI Leaderboard* at only 31B parameters-ahead of frontier closed-source systems including Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5, Gemini 3 Flash, Grok-4-fast, and Kimi K2.5. Our agentic variant obtains a relative improvement of +8.8% in AST Similarity and +20.0% in Location IoU over the base model on telecom code generation, while maintaining identical MMLU (74.0%) and BFCL v3 multi-turn function calling (79.0%) performance, indicating zero catastrophic forgetting. Domain specialization on curated telecom corpora, spanning 3GPP standards, O-RAN specifications, network telemetry, and real repository commits, yields substantial improvements over general-purpose models of equivalent scale, approaches frontier closed-source models on domain-specific evaluation, and is independently corroborated by our official leaderboard standing.

*Xianliang Zeng,Zhanzhan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"重放门控神经执行"(Replay-Gated Neural Execution)框架，将冻结语言模型中的行为规范从神经动作中解耦，引入五个独立运行时对象：持续性行为谓词、状态索引的已认证实现集、瞬时见证查找器以及执行授权，通过事务性重放和运行审计实现执行授权。实验在Qwen3-0.6B和SmolLM2-360M-Instruct两个小型冻结模型上验证了这些对象具有不同的失败模式，包括固定状态非唯一性、跨状态成员变化、已认证存在但操作未重新发现以及提议未经认证等。提出的三级级联架构在保持完全覆盖率的同时显著降低了搜索与认证成本（中位数比率0.1055）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统文献综述（SLR）耗时巨大，LLM虽能产出流畅结构化文本，但难以区分经研究者审核的综述合成与仅具权威外观的合成，未经验证的AI合成有进入学术记录并被后续研究者/模型引用传播的风险。强制人工检查点只在研究者真正用于核验时才起保护作用，而现有Human-AI协作系统的评估多停留于可用性，忽视了信任校准问题。

Abstract: Effective workplace negotiation requires balancing multiple objectives, including achieving task goals, preserving professional relationships, and resolving conflicts constructively. However, misunderstandings, misaligned preferences, and interpersonal friction often impede successful outcomes. Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对代码混合的Hinglish（罗马化印地语）厌女检测中词典驱动模型无法区分"使用"侮辱性词汇与"提及"（如反讽、谴责）的问题，发布了一个名为Hinglish-MGY-Diag的控制性对比集诊断基准（416项/163最小对），并引入了严格的配对一致性指标。研究先诊断了一个公开匿名化语料库中的两种评估伪影（标签泄露和词汇语域可分性），然后通过五种经典基线模型和一个前沿大语言模型进行评估，发现最佳经典模型准确率0.93但一致性仅0.82，而LLM可达1.000（作为作者模型上限）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内容审核系统对低资源、代码混合语言（如Hinglish）中的厌女检测至关重要，但词典驱动的检测器无法区分针对女性的侮辱性词汇的实际"使用"与在反言论中的"提及"，这直接影响审核系统是保护还是压制讨论辱骂的人群。已有工作（如Yadav et al., 2024）报告了较低的零样本准确率（54%），核心问题是带情感色彩的词汇是其存在必要性但非充分条件——其语义强度取决于实际使用语境。这一哲学上的"使用-提及"区分正是词典模型在结构上无法识别的。

Method: 本文采用两阶段方法：(1)诊断阶段——对一个公开的匿名化红皮书（500行，仅150个不同文本/61个模板）进行评估伪影分析，发现匿名化占位符（如[FSLUR_xx]）泄露标签（无学习规则即可得1.000分），且即使占位符被中和，辱骂与良性评论仍占据词汇不相交的语域；(2)补救阶段——构建确定性的生成器（seed=20240614），从主语、话题、侮辱词槽位填充生成5类语言学动机类别的对比集，通过两个工程化去相关化设计（侮辱词出现在mgy和not两侧、性别化语域出现在implicit-mgy和benign_overlap-not两侧），并采用构造不相交5折交叉验证和配对一致性指标（仅当最小对两端都被正确标记时才计分）。评估5种从零开始的经典基线（词典、朴素贝叶斯、线性SVM、逻辑回归TF-IDF、6特征线索模型）以及作为天花板的前沿LLM。

Conclusion: 本文得出两个核心结论：(1)在红皮书或模板化语料上的高分类准确率不应被解读为语境理解的证据——一旦匿名化和语域捷径被中和，任务难度落入0.77–0.85区间；(2)使用-提及区分是传统指标在很大程度上无法捕捉的能力——准确率相近的模型在配对一致性上差异可达0.12，剩余错误集中在反言论和显式使用两类代价最高的场景上。本文主张行为诊断应补充而非取代自然主义评估，并将该基准定位为能力梯度（轻量级经典模型0.68–0.93 vs. LLM 1.000），释放所有代码、数据、生成器和独立LLM评估框架用于防御性审核研究。

Abstract: Lexicon-driven misogyny detectors cannot, by construction, distinguish a slur used against a woman from the same slur mentioned in counter-speech ("don't call her that") -- yet exactly this distinction governs whether moderation protects or silences the people discussing abuse. We study this problem in code-mixed Hinglish and make three contributions. First, we diagnose two evaluation artifacts on a publicly available redacted corpus: category-encoding anonymization placeholders leak the label (a no-learning rule scores 1.000), and even after they are neutralized misogynistic and benign comments occupy lexically disjoint registers, so bag-of-words reaches macro-F1 approximately 1.00 under random cross-validation but collapses under template-disjoint evaluation. Second, we release Hinglish-MGY-Diag, a deterministic generator and a 416-item / 163-minimal-pair contrast-set diagnostic across five linguistically motivated categories in which slur presence and gendered register are decorrelated from the label by construction. Third, we introduce a strict pair-consistency metric that credits a model only when both members of a minimal pair are correctly labelled. Five from-scratch classical baselines evaluated under construction-disjoint five-fold cross-validation reveal that the strongest model reaches 0.93 accuracy on the cleanest use-mention subset but only 0.82 consistency -- it still mislabels roughly one counter-speech pair in five. A frontier LLM used as an author-model ceiling attains 1.000 on all metrics, doubling as independent label validation and confirming the benchmark is a capability gradient rather than an adversarial wall. We release all code, data, the generator, and an arms-length LLM harness for reproducing every number.

*Yiheng Zhao,Jun Yan,Chengming Hu*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 方法采用多阶段流水线：(1)通过DistilBERT进行话题相关性过滤，保留55.2%的相关评论；(2)使用spaCy NER加rapidfuzz模糊匹配进行地理归属解析；(3)BERTopic结合MiniLM嵌入进行主题建模，并辅以六维关键词分类（transit、bikeability、car dependency等）；(4)使用Twitter预训练的RoBERTa模型进行三分类情感分析；(5)使用FAISS密集检索与TF-IDF基线对比，候选重排时叠加城市过滤与方面加权（0.2权重）；(6)本地部署Llama 3.2通过Ollama进行生成，提示词限定仅基于检索证据作答。评估采用300条人工标注评论验证情感分类器，20个保留查询验证检索与生成质量。

Result: 关键结果包括：(1) RoBERTa情感分类器宏F1达0.589，比VADER基线（0.464）高12.6点（McNemar p=0.0001），但两者在中性类上均显著失败，标注员一致性κ仅0.53；(2)密集检索在所有截断点上优于TF-IDF（P@5 0.790 vs 0.560），视频级相关性评估显著低估块级精度（0.660 vs 人工评估0.94）；(3) BERTScore因长度不匹配（多句生成摘要vs单条短评）而几乎无法区分相关性；(4) ROUGE-1 groundedness本质上是改写驱动的下限而非幻觉率，所有20个查询的句嵌入余弦相似度均在0.639–0.815相关范围内，查询侧城市检测准确率100%，方面检测准确率80%。

Conclusion: 论文得出结论：标准NLP组件在短小、非正式用户生成文本这种特定语域（register）下会暴露出可量化的失败模式，这些发现对任何基于短文本UGC构建的RAG系统具有普适参考价值。未来工作应聚焦于通过领域自适应微调（2,000–5,000条标注）解决中性类召回率问题，采用零样本NLI替代固定关键词分类，并引入确定性解码以消除groundedness率运行间方差。

Abstract: Online discourse about urban issues - walkability, cycling infrastructure, public transit, housing density, and street safety - is voluminous but unstructured, and existing city-evaluation tools capture none of it. We present a pipeline and conversational system that combines geographic entity resolution, topic modeling, sentiment analysis, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over 22,788 chunks of YouTube transcripts and comments spanning 309 North American cities. Beyond the system itself, our contribution is a set of measurements about what happens when standard NLP components meet short, informal, geographically ambiguous text. A Twitter-tuned RoBERTa classifier outperforms a VADER lexicon baseline by 12.6 macro-F1 points (0.589 vs. 0.464; McNemar p = 0.0001), but both models collapse on the neutral class, which dominates urbanist comment traffic; annotators disagree on the same class (Cohen's kappa = 0.53). Dense retrieval beats a TF-IDF baseline at every cutoff (P@5 0.790 vs. 0.560), and video-level relevance proxies understate chunk-level precision by a wide margin (0.660 vs. 0.94 under human rating). For groundedness evaluation, we find BERTScore unusable when a multi-sentence generated summary is compared against a single short comment - scores are nearly flat regardless of relevance - and show that ROUGE-1-based groundedness is a paraphrase-driven lower bound rather than a hallucination rate. These findings generalize beyond the urbanist domain to any RAG system built over short user-generated documents.

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种两阶段、评估器引导的自动后编辑框架，用于领域特定机器翻译。该框架将基于MQM（多维度质量指标）的诊断与修复解耦：检索增强的LLM评估器先生成结构化的、跨度级别的MQM诊断（在显式编辑合约约束下），然后由独立的LLM后编辑器仅对这些诊断执行最小化的定向编辑。在涉及3家提供商、7种LLM和6种目标语言的系统研究中，最佳配置在COMET-22和COMETKiwi指标上一致优于单阶段的"判断-精炼"基线，评估器的错误跨度和严重程度与人类MQM标注及人类编辑偏好高度一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为机器翻译评估器虽能逼近人类判断，但在生产环境中这些信号很少能直接转化为质量改进。现有自精炼方法（如"判断-精炼"单阶段框架）难以控制，且LLM在缺乏外部反馈时往往无法可靠地自我修正。因此需要一种可控制、可定位的领域MT质量提升方案，避免昂贵的模型重训。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 结构化MQM评估器E：使用增强提示（P3 = GEMBA-MQM + 描述性评分标准 + 编辑合约 + 检索增强RAG），从领域知识库检索k个相似样本作为上下文，输出包含issue_id、span、category、severity、suggested_fix等字段的XML结构化诊断；(2) 后编辑器C_i：接收评估器输出r与初始翻译y^(0)，依据编辑合约执行最小化定向编辑，仅修改被诊断的跨度，避免改写未受影响部分。框架支持多轮迭代编辑，每轮可使用不同模型。编辑合约（edit contract）作为提示中的约束段落，明确修复指引与最小修改原则，以减少过校正与释义漂移。

Result: 实验在6个目标语言（DE/CN/FR/IT/ES/JP）的电商领域翻译记忆库（每方向约5k测试样本）上进行。关键发现：(1) P3（+RAG）效果最佳，EN→DE的COMET-22从86.39提升至89.93（+3.54），COMETKiwi从82.66提升至84.50（+1.84）；(2) 两阶段在7个模型中多数情况下优于单阶段基线（Claude Opus 4.5）；(3) Claude Sonnet 4.5总体为最强后编辑器，Gemma 3 4B在EN→CN上反常地表现最佳；(4) 第二轮编辑通常会降低质量（6/7模型COMET-22下降），表明单轮定向修复已足够；(5) 评估器能力越强（Haiku→Sonnet→Opus），COMET-22单调上升，但即使是低成本评估器（Claude 3.5 Haiku）也能带来显著增益（+1.09）；(6) 单轮端到端平均延迟约17.6秒，适合离线评估场景。

Conclusion: 分离评估与后编辑的两阶段框架在领域MT质量提升上显著且一致地优于单阶段方法，编辑合约与检索增强对评估器诊断质量起关键作用。单轮针对性后编辑通常足以解决大部分系统性问题，额外迭代反而引入释义漂移与性能退化。实践建议：应根据具体语言方向与领域实验多种模型后再选择后编辑器；可考虑成本-质量权衡（即使小模型评估器也有效）；未来工作包括置信度感知后编辑与跨领域扩展。

Abstract: LLM-based machine translation evaluation can closely match human judgments, but in practice it remains largely diagnostic, with the signals rarely translating into direct quality improvements under real production constraints. We propose a two-stage, evaluator-guided automatic post-editing framework that turns MQM-style evaluation into targeted repairs: a retrieval-augmented LLM evaluator outputs structured, span-level MQM diagnoses under an explicit edit contract, and a separate LLM post-editor applies minimal edits restricted to those diagnoses. This separation improves controllability and reduces paraphrastic drift compared to one-stage "judge-and-refine" baselines. In a systematic study involving seven LLMs spanning three model providers and seven languages, our best configuration consistently improves both COMET-22 and COMETKiwi scores over one-stage post-edit methods, while the evaluator's error spans and severities show strong agreement with human MQM annotations and human editor preferences.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 方言阿拉伯语（DA）机器翻译面临独特挑战：需要建模语义内容、方言变体、对话上下文、说话者特征及社会语言学适当性；且传统MT指标对系统错误洞察有限。因此需要专门的评测任务，推动方言感知、上下文敏感且具备可解释错误诊断机制的MT研究。

Method: 任务分三个子任务：(1) 子任务1基于Alexandria数据集（约107K平行句对，13种方言、11个领域），含约束与无约束两条赛道，评估spBLEU与chrF++；(2) 子任务2基于扩展的ArBanking77金融查询数据集，6种方言30个方向对，无专用平行训练数据；(3) 子任务3基于LQM框架的6类错误（社会语言学、语用学、语义、形态句法、正字法、字形），使用Exact Match F1、Overlap F1和Error Class Macro-F1的均值作为综合指标。

Result: 子任务1：无约束赛道Thakaa以33.49 spBLEU居首（约束赛道30.42 spBLEU）；子任务2：Thakaa以28.40 spBLEU领先；子任务3：Thakaa综合得分49.82（远超24.29基线）。最佳系统的成功因素包括：显式方言建模、上下文感知生成、检索与候选选择、混合生成式推理与编码器定位的错误分析方法。利比亚语和苏丹语作为未见方言，特定适配带来明显提升；毛里塔尼亚语在多数系统中表现最弱。

Conclusion: AlexandriaX 2026建立了方言阿拉伯语MT的综合评测基准。核心发现：(1)针对特定方言的适配和精细推理策略比单纯扩大模型规模或数据量更有效；(2)上下文质量取决于训练与推理时历史一致性的处理；(3)检索、合成监督与提示可弥补平行数据缺失，但证据质量至关重要；(4)错误定位仍是开放挑战，最佳方案结合生成式语义推理与编码器边界控制。未来需向多参考/方言敏感评估、低资源方言覆盖及Subtask 3标注平衡发展。

Abstract: Dialectal Arabic machine translation (MT) remains challenging despite recent progress in Arabic language technologies, particularly because effective translation requires modeling not only semantic content but also dialectal variation, conversational context, speaker and addressee characteristics, and sociolinguistic appropriateness. Moreover, conventional MT metrics provide limited insight into the linguistic errors produced by dialectal systems. We present the AlexandriaX 2026 Shared Task on Dialectal Arabic MT, which addresses these challenges through three complementary subtasks: (1) context-aware English-to-Dialectal Arabic dialogue translation across 13 Arabic varieties, (2) cross-dialect Arabic translation in the financial domain covering six Arabic dialects, and (3) span-level MT error detection and classification using linguistically motivated error categories across five Arabic varieties. The shared task attracted 38 registrations for Subtask 1, 33 for Subtask 2, and 35 for Subtask 3. Twelve unique teams submitted their system description papers, all of which we accepted for publication. The best system on Subtask 1 achieved 30.42 spBLEU in the constrained track and 33.49 spBLEU in the unconstrained track. On Subtask 2, the top system obtained 28.40 spBLEU. On Subtask 3, the best system achieved an overall score of 49.82, outperforming the 24.29 baseline. Taken together, the results of the leading systems across the three subtasks highlight the benefits of explicit dialect modeling, context-aware generation, retrieval and reranking, and specialized approaches to interpretable MT error analysis. Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出语义-几何解耦路由(SGDR)，一种用于块稀疏注意力(block-sparse attention)的免训练块路由框架。该方法将语义聚合从传统的后RoPE空间迁移到前RoPE空间以避免高频相位抵消引起的局部位置信息衰减，并利用离线结构先验与相对块距离重建几何偏置，最终推导出显式闭式的块路由评分公式。实验表明，在4K–128K上下文范围内，该方法性能接近全注意力，路由开销低于3.4ms，并在128K上下文下对FlashAttn实现5.03倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中，标准密集注意力随序列长度呈二次方增长，块稀疏注意力通过将每个查询块路由到少量相关键块来降低复杂度。然而现有无训练块路由器普遍在RoPE编码后进行token级池化，导致两方面的耦合问题：(1)语义聚合与RoPE几何纠缠；(2)高频维度的相位旋转在块内平均时引发破坏性干涉，衰减局部位置线索。先前方法通过引入token级搜索或事后温度校准来缓解，但这增加了路由复杂度或放大噪声，并未根本解决特征损失问题。

Method: SGDR框架包含三个核心部分：(1)语义-几何解耦定理：从精确的token级注意力评分出发，通过代数展开将宏观块距离Δ_M与微观token偏移分离，证明块注意力评分等于宏观旋转因子e^{iω_f BΔ_M}与微观相位干涉项ℐ_f(i,j)的实部乘积；在广义平稳(WSS)和遍历性假设下，将ℐ_f(i,j)近似为O(1)的块级操作。(2)离线几何剖面(Offline Geometric Profiling)：使用Paul Graham Essays语料库(对文本)和VideoChatGPT(对视频)进行离线校准，通过复数最小二乘估计归一化结构谱Ĉ_f(Δ_M)，并将其分解为极坐标形式(结构幅度Λ̂_f与结构相位θ̂_f)。(3)在线语义路由策略：将前RoPE均值池化特征映射至极坐标，得到闭式实值块路由评分S_Block(i,j) = Σ_f Λ̂_f(i-j)·‖q̄_f^(i)‖·‖k̄_f^(j)‖·cos(ω_f B(i-j) + θ̂_f(i-j) + Φ_f^(i,j))，由离线先验幅度、在线语义能量和宏观几何相位共同构成。该方法使用块大小B=128、top-p=0.9，并基于自定义Triton核实现。

Result: 在RULER基准测试上(4K-128K上下文)，SGDR在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen-3-8B上的平均准确率分别为87.55和86.09，超过所有稀疏基线方法(包括MInference的87.44、Prism的87.54等)，在128K下分别比Prism高0.82、比FlexPrefill高0.69。LongBench上达到与全注意力接近的性能(40.73和39.12)；PG19语言建模困惑度为25.23，与FlashAttn的25.25几乎一致；VideoMME与LongVideoBench上保持全模型99.5%以上精度。效率方面，128K上下文下推理延迟从451.03ms降至89.59ms(5.03×加速)，超过MInference的4.79×和Prism的3.76×；路由开销始终低于3.4ms，远低于XAttention(81.79ms)和FlexPrefill(28.38ms)。消融实验表明离线剖面、宏观几何、在线相位均对性能有显著贡献，去除位置信息后平均准确率从86.09%降至67.26%。

Conclusion: SGDR通过在前RoPE空间进行语义聚合并结合离线几何先验，成功解决了块稀疏注意力中后RoPE池化引起的高频相位干涉问题。该方法实现了纯块级路由，无需token级搜索或事后校准，在保持接近全注意力精度的同时显著提升长上下文推理效率。论文承认存在两点局限：(1)仅适用于标准Softmax自注意力架构，不适用于线性注意力(如Gated Delta Net、Lightning Attention)；(2)依赖于RoPE的几何结构，无法直接应用于旧式可学习绝对位置编码。未来工作将探索其在世界模型和视频生成中的应用。

Abstract: Long-context inference has become a defining capability of large language models, but exact dense attention remains costly due to its quadratic scaling with sequence length. Block-sparse attention offers a hardware-friendly alternative by routing each query block to a small set of relevant key blocks, yet accurate training-free block routing remains difficult. Existing routers often pool post-RoPE token representations, which entangles semantic aggregation with RoPE-induced geometry and attenuates local positional cues through high-frequency phase cancellation. To resolve this mismatch, we propose \textbf{Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing}, a training-free block routing framework that shifts semantic aggregation to the pre-RoPE space and reconstructs geometric bias with an offline structural prior and relative block distances. This decomposition yields an explicit closed-form block routing score without token-level search or post-hoc calibration. Experiments on long-context text and video tasks show that our method approaches full-attention accuracy across 4K--128K contexts, keeps routing overhead below 3.4 ms, and achieves a 5.03$\times$ speedup over FlashAttn at a 128K context length.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

NA响应系统化：总体NA率13.32%，英文(17.16%)高于中文(9.48%)；DeepSeek-V3.2最高(37.81%)，Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite最低(1.94%)；中国供应商模型均值(26.37%)高于国际供应商(6.80%)；需要情感自我描述的维度（OEJTS外向性35.56%）NA率最高。4. 语言效应：GPT-5.4跨语言距离最小；中文条件下纯洁、忠诚、权威、支配得分偏高，公平、思维、宜人性、情绪稳定性偏低。5. 稳定性与可识别性：ICC与重测相关高；留一重复模型识别准确率0.81–0.84（RF+联合特征），NA单独达0.67–0.78；跨语言识别英→中0.78、中→英0.73。6. 人类参考：LLM在尽责性与情绪稳定性上标准化差异最大，外向性分布重叠最多。7. 提示稳健性：MFQ-30对评分响应最敏感，IPIP BFFM-50对NA最敏感，SDO7-16/SSIS-10最稳定。

Conclusion: 心理测量画像可作为量化LLM部署级行为签名的可行测量框架。该签名既包含对齐驱动的共性（高亲社会/低支配），也包含模型特异性结构。NA响应是不可忽视的互补测量通道，揭示了模型将人类中心自我报告项目视为不适用的边界。语言与供应商来源是活跃的实验条件而非中性变量。签名高复现但具有上下文依赖性——跨语言、跨提示条件的稳定性需明确报告。研究明确拒绝将人类心理特质归因于机器，但支持将该框架用于模型比较、纵向审计与对齐相关行为评估。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Evaluating user experience (UX) on live websites through user testing is expensive, subjective, and difficult to scale. LLM agents offer a promising route to automating UX testing by simulating realistic user behaviour. However, existing simulation approaches typically lack multimodality and require time-consuming manual review to extract actionable insights. We formalise UX improvement recommendation from simulation data as a structured natural language generation and ranking problem, and establish an evaluation protocol using expert annotation and LLM-as-a-Judge. We present AMUSER, a multimodal framework which simulates user behaviour and automatically generates prioritised UX improvement recommendations from resulting data. We evaluate AMUSER on commercial websites and show that its recommendations substantially outperform those from text-only simulation (NDCG@3 = 0.758 versus 0.359) at an 89% lower simulation cost. Our results suggest an asymmetric role of multimodality: visual access during simulation improves recommendations through richer traces, while providing visual inputs during recommendation generation can modestly degrade quality. TL;DR: 本文提出"言论体制"概念，揭示LLM政治行为是一套针对不同用户的政策组合，通过7500轮对话实验发现六大AI系统在堕胎等争议话题上呈现完全不同的言论体制（如迎合型、拒绝型、条件迎合型等），且言论体制会在版本更新间悄然改变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM政治偏见的审计通常测量系统对"平均用户"的回答，但忽略了AI对话的两个关键特征：(1) AI为每个用户私人定制回答，(2) AI可基于对话中推断的用户身份调整输出。因此现有审计遗漏了系统根据用户身份而变化的动态政治行为。

Abstract: LLM-based AI systems answer political questions for hundreds of millions of people. Current audits measure what they say to an average user, but their behavior is dynamic. I argue that their political behavior is a set of policies over whom to answer, what to say, and whether to engage at all, conditional on the topic and what the system knows about the user. I call these policies the system's speech regime, which is how a developer settles the tradeoff between answering, accommodating the user, and refusing, each of which carries a cost that varies by topic. I derive a typology of five regimes from two dimensions, engagement and stance. I test six AI systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google, Mistral, DeepSeek) in a preregistered experiment of 7,500 multi-turn conversations that randomly assign the user's political identity across five topics: abortion, Catalan independence, climate change, Nazism, and a zero-stakes control (pineapple on pizza). On contested topics the systems fall into different regimes: on abortion, GPT engages and mirrors every user, Gemma refuses everyone, Claude answers strongly conservative users 35 percent of the time and almost no one else, and Grok accommodates conservatives only. The systems also infer the user's overall ideology, so accommodation can spill over to topics not yet discussed. *Qianli Wang,Yilong Wang,Dennis Wei,Jingyi Sun,Simon Ostermann,Pepa Atanasova,Nils Feldhus*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文重新定义CoT忠实性为"内部概念锚定"问题，使用单一共享稀疏自编码器（SAE）对直接预测路径和CoT路径的残差流激活进行编码，引入三个相关性指标和一个因果干预指标Δp（通过消融共享概念并测量答案概率下降），在5个LLM和4个数据集上发现：概念对齐整体较高但与因果贡献相关性弱，忠实性在不同深度上呈现"分布式"或"局部化"模式，通常在中后层而非最终层达到峰值，模型规模和架构显著重塑逐层分布，且因果重要的共享概念未必在CoT中被语言化表达。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CoT忠实性评估方法多基于输入-输出行为或输入归因（如提示注入、CoT扰动），将模型视为黑箱，无法检验内部计算是否因果性地驱动最终答案；少数使用机制可解释性的工作要么依赖线性探针、电路追踪，要么使用两个独立SAE进行特征注入（"可被引导"），但缺少对"预测所依赖的共享概念"的直接因果测试，也未分析跨模型深度的忠实性变化。

Method: 方法学上采用单一共享SAE对直接预测pass和CoT pass在答案位置的残差流激活进行编码，使跨pass概念重叠良定义；提出三个相关性度量（CC-SAE余弦、Jaccard集相似性、预测锚定召回率）和一个因果度量Δp（消融共享概念S∩后测量答案概率下降）；设计四组对照条件（随机集、预测专用集、范数匹配集、top-k上界）和范数匹配控制排除消融大小与幅值干扰；在预测pass和CoT pass双向验证因果效应；进行SAE配置（宽度、稀疏度）消融、答案身份特征排除、普遍性特征排除、充分性测试（仅用S∩恢复答案概率）以及自然语言概念描述的层间过渡分析。实验在5个LLM（Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-{2B,9B}、Qwen3-{1.7B,8B}，配合Llama-Scope/Gemma-Scope/Qwen-Scope SAE）和4个数据集（GSM8K、LogiQA、OpenbookQA、ARC-Easy）上展开。

Conclusion: CoT忠实性不能仅靠表层或表征对应性来可靠评估，必须通过因果干预测试内部共享概念是否真正驱动预测；相关性指标仅识别"哪些"概念被共享，Δp等因果指标才能量化其贡献；忠实性具有深度依赖性和架构特异性，应进行逐层报告；SAE配置变化不实质改变发现；该框架为忠实性评估提供了内部机制解释视角，并与现有上下文扰动/参数遗忘/电路追踪方法形成互补维度。未来方向包括在峰值层部署探针/引导/CoT监控以避免末层低估，以及验证"局部化忠实性"模型对剪枝/量化的脆弱性预测。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) can sound plausible yet be unfaithful to the model's underlying reasoning. Most prior work probes CoT faithfulness through input--output behavior or input attributions, leaving internal computation largely underexplored. We instead cast faithfulness as internal concept grounding: Does a large language model's (LLM) CoT reasoning engage the same internal concepts that support the LLM's direct prediction, and do the shared concepts causally drive its answer? Encoding a prediction pass and a CoT pass with a single shared sparse autoencoder (SAE), a reliable approximator of the latent concepts LLMs use, makes their internal concepts directly comparable. We introduce three correlational metrics of concept-level alignment and a causal metric, $\Delta p$, which ablates the shared concepts and measures the drop in answer probability. Across five LLMs and four datasets, concept alignment is generally high, as indicated by the correlational metrics; yet these only identify which concepts are shared, not how much they causally contribute. $\Delta p$ fills this gap: causal faithfulness varies substantially with model depth, peaking at mid-to-late layers rather than the final ones, and model scale reshapes the layer-wise profile. Moreover, causally important shared concepts are not always verbalized in the CoT. These dissociations suggest that faithfulness cannot be reliably assessed from surface-level or representational correspondence alone; assessing it requires causal tests of whether the internal concepts underlying a CoT actually drive the model's prediction.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态实体对齐方法通常直接将图像与其他模态融合，忽略了图像中可能存在的噪声以及与对应实体之间的语义不对齐问题，导致次优融合和性能下降。手动标注的类别冲突字典方法成本高且难以泛化。

Abstract: The visual modality, i.e., images, plays a key role in multi-modal entity alignment (MMEA). Existing approaches often directly fuse the image with other modalities to align different entities. Although simple, such strategies overlook the potential noise in the images and their semantic misalignment with corresponding entities, resulting in suboptimal fusion and degraded performance. Addressing this, we propose a novel Reliability-Aware framework for MMEA (RA-MMEA), which assesses visual reliability and adaptively improves unreliable visual representations for robust entity alignment. The core lies in two modules, including dependency-aware visual reliability prediction (DA-VRP) and stability-regularized visual embedding generation (SR-VEG). The former aims to estimate the reliability of an image by leveraging multi-modal dependency within the entity, while the latter focuses on producing alternative visual representation conditioned on semantics encoded in textual modalities for multi-modal fusion. Compared to current methods, RA-MMEA enables more reliable visual representations for modality fusion, thereby improving performance. In extensive experiments, RA-MMEA achieves state-of-the-art results, verifying the importance of reliable visual modality for entity alignment and the effectiveness of RA-MMEA. The code and results will be released.

</details>

Abstract: Long-horizon conversational memory is especially challenging in multi-actor settings, where relevant evidence is distributed across participants and contexts and previously established information may later be revised. At write time, adaptive state resolution and an evidence-grounded propose-verify-commit protocol govern how this state evolves. At read time, adaptive evidence navigation iteratively resolves the state and supporting evidence required for a query, using conversational structure to narrow the search space and lexical-semantic relevance to rank candidates. The system operates through prompting and tool use without memory-specific policy training. EGMEMORY achieves 68.2% on GroupMemBench and 77.9% on EverMemBench, outperforming the strongest evaluated baselines by 22.7 and 21.4 percentage points, respectively. ### [37] [RPMem: Learning Long-Term Recurrent Parametric Memory Across Sessions for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23466)
*Fanyu Zhao,Ruike Cao,Liang Dong,Fugen Yao,Jian Xu,Guanjun Jiang,Han Zhang,Yifei Zhao,Yinsheng Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出RPMem，一种面向LLM智能体的跨会话长程循环参数化记忆架构。其核心思想是将每个会话通过前向计算编译为与模型无关的潜在记忆，并利用任务训练的循环门控（recurrent gate）将其与历史记忆进行选择性整合，最终通过骨干模型特定的LoRA解码器映射为适配参数。该方法实现了"生命周期独立"的参数化记忆，即在骨干模型替换后已积累的记忆仍可复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在长程跨会话场景中面临两大记忆瓶颈：（1）基于文本的记忆需要在每次查询时检索并重建历史，性能受限于检索质量和上下文推理能力；（2）现有参数化记忆方法（如MEMORYLLM、M+、Metis）虽然能将经验编码至模型计算中，但其记忆表征与特定骨干架构耦合，当服务模型被替换时，已积累的记忆无法直接复用。本文将这种"生命周期依赖"明确定义为参数化记忆的核心障碍。

Method: RPMem采用两阶段架构。第一阶段（单会话记忆编译）：使用冻结的上下文编码器（如ModernBERT）提取多层特征，通过可训练的Perceiver重采样器将变长会话压缩为固定形状的潜在记忆q_t，再经由可训练的模型特定LoRA解码器映射为骨干模型的LoRA适配参数；训练目标为固定参考轨迹上的前向KL散度（Forward-KL），匹配上下文条件分布与适配器条件分布。第二阶段（跨会话记忆整合）：一个轻量级循环门（仅2d²+d个参数）通过sigmoid激活的保留张量z_t，对累积记忆h_{t-1}与新会话记忆q_t进行逐坐标插值整合（h_t = z_t ⊙ h_{t-1} + (1-z_t) ⊙ q_t）；门控通过下游任务监督（答案标签交叉熵）训练。两个阶段的关键解耦在于：会话编码器G_φ生成与骨干无关的潜在记忆，仅解码器D_β需要随骨干替换而重新适配。

Result: 在三个长程记忆基准（PERMA、PersonaMem-v2、PrefEval）和五个不同骨干模型（Qwen3-4B/8B、Ministral-3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B/35B-A3B）上的实验显示：（1）在PERMA上以Qwen3-8B达到85.52%，超过最强参数化基线Metis-9B 5.32个百分点，超过最强文本基线Full Context 12.98个百分点；（2）在PersonaMem-v2 Overall上达到40.22%，超过SFT 8.58个百分点；在PrefEval 300轮设置下达到74.81%，优于LightMem；（3）跨骨干迁移（Head Transfer）相比从头训练将28个骨干-设置组合全部提升，跨模型平均从75.97%提升至89.64%；（4）流式部署中64会话时单次更新仅0.043秒，约为rank concatenation的1/22、Mem0的1/292，内存增长1.03×（近常数），无历史查询token；（5）通用能力保留方面，在MMLU、GSM8K、IFEval上与基座模型差距均在3.81个百分点以内。消融实验验证了Fixed FKL编译目标（85.52%）显著优于SFT（61.21%）和Top-K CE（77.66%），以及学习门控（85.52%）远优于因子平均（54.21%）和最新会话（53.56%）。动力学分析揭示门控自发学会了：领域建立事件的写入幅度更大、同领域更新模式相似度更高且同领域历史贡献衰减更快，领域建立事件的存活优势从1次更新后的1.31×增长到60次后的6.64×。

Conclusion: RPMem确立了首个生命周期独立的参数化记忆框架：通过将记忆维护在与骨干无关的潜在空间中并由任务训练的循环门控整合，累积的跨会话记忆在骨干替换后仍可复用，同时保持近常数的更新成本和内存占用。实验证明参数化记忆可以同时满足跨会话演化与骨干解耦两大要求，为长期部署的LLM智能体提供了一种可持续累积经验的基础设施。局限在于应用特定的整合策略对场景迁移的适应性有待进一步研究。

Abstract: Long-running LLM agents require memory that persists and evolves across sessions. Text-based memory retrieves and reconstructs past interactions at every query, making long-horizon performance increasingly dependent on retrieval quality and contextual reasoning as histories grow. Parametric memory encodes experience directly into model computation, but existing approaches provide limited support for cross-session memory evolution. Their coupling to a specific backbone further restricts memory reuse after model replacement. We introduce RPMem, a two-stage architecture that compiles each session into a model-independent latent memory through forward computation and selectively integrates it with retained memory via a task-trained recurrent gate. The consolidated memory is then mapped to backbone-specific low-rank adaptation (LoRA) parameters, allowing the encoding capability to transfer when the backbone is replaced. Evaluation across three long-term memory benchmarks and five diverse backbones demonstrates broad generalization with near-constant update cost and memory footprint. With Qwen3-8B on PERMA, RPMem reaches 85.52%, outperforming the strongest parametric and text-based baselines by 5.32 and 12.98 percentage points, respectively. Ablations validate the complementary roles of session compilation and cross-session consolidation, while dynamics analyses reveal that the gate acquires task-specific memory integration strategies. These results establish RPMem as a lifecycle-independent parametric memory framework that maintains evolving cross-session memory that remains reusable across backbone replacements. Our implementation is available at this https URL .

</details>

*Kuanlin Chen,Chen-Wei Kuo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 ARID 系统,面向工业维护工单的边缘部署场景,在 Jetson Orin NX 8GB 上将非结构化工单文本抽取为四字段(component/failure mode/symptom/maintenance action)的固定 JSON 模式输出。该系统整合了双教师一致性过滤、噪声感知合成蒸馏(NASD)、工单级 LoRA 路由选择、4 位量化推理与语法约束解码(GCD),在 300 条人工标注样本上达到 84.8%(参考栈)/ 82.9%(部署栈)的 token-F1,常驻服务 P50/P99 为 5,310/5,656 ms,功耗 12.5 W;在 MaintNet 零样本迁移中,语义 F1 跌至 46.4% 而解析器成功率仍 ≥99.8%,揭示"输出合法性可迁移、字段语义不可迁移"的核心结论。

  <summary>Details</summary>

On 300 human-labeled records, ARID reaches 84.8% token-F1 on the reference stack and 82.9% on the deployed Jetson. Resident serving achieves 5,310/5,656 ms P50/P99 at 12.5 W. ### [39] [On the Efficiency-Safety Dilemma in Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23587)
*Yifei Yang,Zouying Cao,Xingrui Wang,Xiao Zhou,Yuexian Li,Dongjie Yang,Hai Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文首次系统分析了效率优化技术（量化、剪枝、KV Cache压缩）对大型推理模型（LRM）安全性的影响，揭示了一个关键发现：效率方法表面上降低了越狱攻击成功率，但这种"安全增益"实际上是虚假的，主要源于推理能力退化导致的"尝试但失败"响应，而非真正的安全对齐改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大型推理模型（如OpenAI-o1、DeepSeek-R1、QwQ等）在逻辑推理任务上展现强大能力，其高推理成本促使量化、剪枝、KV Cache压缩等效率技术广泛应用。然而，现有研究主要关注这些技术对任务性能的影响，忽视了其对模型对抗鲁棒性和安全对齐的潜在影响。由于LRM具有增强的能力，其安全风险也被放大，因此亟需研究效率技术与安全性之间的复杂交互关系。

Method: 论文采用黑盒越狱攻击基准（H-COT和Mousetrap）和推理基准（MATH-500和AIME），评估三种代表性LRM（QwQ-32B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B）在六种效率技术（GPTQ、AWQ量化；SparseGPT、Wanda剪枝；SnapKV、PyramidKV KV缓存压缩）下的表现。使用GPT-4o进行6点有害性评级（HR），通过多数投票确定最终分数。关键方法包括：(1) 计算效率、安全与推理指标间的Pearson相关性；(2) 通过"尝试但失败"响应分析分解非越狱响应；(3) 层级表征漂移分析（1 - 余弦相似度）量化压缩对隐藏状态的影响；(4) 比较不同效率技术组合（Quant+Prune、Quant+KV、Prune+KV）在固定内存预算下的表现。

Result: 研究得出以下关键结论：(1) 效率方法对安全的影响因模型和压缩方法而异，但绝大多数情况下HR降低呈现"虚假安全"特征；(2) 推理能力与安全性呈强正相关，表明安全增益主要源于推理能力退化（Pearson相关性证实）；(3) "尝试但失败"响应在LRM中显著增加（KV缓存压缩最严重），而标准LLM无此现象，证明这是LRM特有现象；(4) 层级表征漂移分析显示推理漂移与越狱漂移呈线性耦合（r=0.928-0.972），证实压缩引入的是表征噪声而非选择性安全过滤；(5) 量化最能保留原始模型的安全与推理性能，KV缓存压缩虽表面安全增益最大但推理性能下降最严重；(6) 量化+剪枝（Quant+Prune）在40%内存预算下综合表现最优，是平衡效率与安全性的最佳策略。阶段分析显示，权重类技术破坏早期规划阶段，KV缓存压缩则在最终答案生成阶段引发失败。

Conclusion: 该研究首次全面分析了大型推理模型中效率、安全与推理三者间的权衡关系，揭示了"虚假安全"现象的本质——效率技术引入的表征噪声同时破坏了推理能力和恶意执行能力，而非真正增强安全对齐。量化与剪枝的组合被识别为实际部署中最优的效率策略，在保持内存效率的同时最大化保留了模型的推理能力和真实安全对齐。这些发现为LRM的安全部署提供了重要的经验基础，区分了真实安全对齐与能力诱导失败的本质差异。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) incur high inference costs, often mitigated by efficiency techniques like quantization and pruning.   <summary>Details</summary>

  <summary>Details</summary>

  <summary>Details</summary>

This formulation also enables systematic interpretability analyses. We show strong cross-modal dependencies through attention and frequency-domain analyses, and identify predictive textual signals whose correlation-aware alignment yields partial forecasting improvements. Extensive experiments on real-world multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that TAC-Time outperforms prior methods.

  <summary>Details</summary>

2. **PBRC（渐进式双向推理链）**：利用MCQM的层级与混淆分析，引导LLM生成两阶段推理信息——第一阶段基于源域粗粒度类型进行初始推理（识别实体+粗粒度分类+初始推理），第二阶段基于目标域细粒度类型进行双向推理（包含前向推理确认类型+基于最易混淆类型的后向推理排除）。推理信息注入Flan-T5骨干网络进行知识增强。

Conclusion: 论文系统分析了CD-NER中的实体类型混淆问题，提出的MCQM能有效量化类型间混淆程度，PBRC通过两阶段推理（粗到细的初始推理+双向推理）显著缓解混淆并提升模型跨域泛化能力。该方法在CrossNER全部域上达到SOTA，且相比LLM微调和任务导向预训练方法降低了域适应训练时间。

Abstract: Cross-domain Named Entity Recognition (CD-NER) aims to transfer the rich knowledge in the source domain to the target domain. Moreover, we propose the Progressive Bidirectional Reasoning Chain (PBRC). PBRC leverages the source-target hierarchy and confusion analysis from the MCQM to prompt the LLM to generate two-stage reasoning information. The two-stage reasoning information is utilized to augment the knowledge of the model, significantly mitigating entity type confusion and improving the model's generalization performance. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves new state-of-the-art results on all domains of the CrossNER dataset.

*Jingyu Wang,Shijie Wu,Fusheng Jin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出URA-NER框架,通过渐进粒度检索(PGR)、模型感知表示增强(MaRE)和推理感知知识验证(RaKV)三个组件,解决低资源NER中检索不对齐和生成不确定性问题,使Qwen2.5-7B/14B在CrossNER多个子集上超越GPT-4等大模型,达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的ICL方法在低资源NER中存在三个核心问题:(1)检索机制缺乏阶段对齐——单一粒度检索无法同时满足span抽取(需全局语义)和类型分类(需局部上下文)的需求;(2)表示与LLM不对齐——独立编码器(BERT/BGE)与执行NER的LLM在预训练目标和注意力机制上存在差异,导致检索偏差;(3)LLM生成不确定性——小规模LLM在少样本场景下输出不稳定,缺乏有效验证机制。随着LLM参数量减小,这些性能瓶颈愈发明显。

Method: URA-NER框架包含三个核心组件:(1)PGR采用两阶段"全局到局部"检索,第一阶段基于全局语义检索span抽取的演示,第二阶段基于实体局部上下文检索类型分类的演示;(2)MaRE通过LLM自回归预识别构建模型感知表示,利用注意力权重加权隐藏向量,使检索表示与LLM的语义空间对齐;(3)RaKV采用"生成-检索-验证"闭环流程,让LLM显式生成推理路径,基于关键语义节点从Wikipedia检索外部知识,并按推理路径重组为验证证据,用于自验证预测结果。

Result: 在CrossNER的5个低资源子集(Science、Politics、Music、Literature、AI)和CoNLL2003上的实验显示:5-shot设置下,Qwen2.5-14B+URA-NER在所有CrossNER子集上达到新SOTA(F1: 74.55%-86.02%),超越依赖GPT-4、Gemini-1.5-pro等更大LLM的方法;Qwen2.5-7B+URA-NER也优于多个强基线。消融实验证明三组件均贡献显著,RaKV使标准差降低,有效缓解输出波动。部署分析显示URA-NER在7B/14B规模下达到与>100B模型相当的性能,且无API成本。

Conclusion: URA-NER通过解决检索对齐和生成不确定性两大核心问题,显著降低了LLM在低资源NER任务中对模型规模的依赖,小规模LLM(7B/14B)即可超越依赖大规模LLM的方法,在多个CrossNER基准上达到SOTA,具有良好的实用性和部署经济性。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) based on large language models (LLMs) has shown promising potential in alleviating performance bottlenecks caused by the limited availability of annotated data in Named Entity Recognition (NER). However, existing methods still face issues of retrieval misalignment and generation uncertainty, making their performance heavily dependent on the LLM's capabilities. As the parameter scale of LLMs decreases, their performance in few-shot settings deteriorates significantly. In this paper, we propose a novel unified retrieval-augmented framework, URA-NER, including three key components: Progressive Granularity Retrieval (PGR), Model-aware Representation Enhancement (MaRE), and Reason-aware Knowledge Verification. PGR is a two-stage retrieval mechanism that achieves stage alignment. It first retrieves demonstrations for span detection based on the query's global semantics, and then for type classification based on the specific entity context, providing fine-grained local information. Moreover, MaRE employs entity pre-recognition to guide the construction of representations, ensuring the query and demonstrations are aligned within the LLM's semantic space and attention pattern. In addition, to mitigate generation uncertainty, we propose RaKV, a closed-loop "generation-retrieval-verification" process. It explicates the LLM's reasoning paths, leverages them for the retrieval of external knowledge, and reorganizes the knowledge into verification evidence aligned with the original reasoning paths. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple low-resource NER datasets. Results demonstrate that URA-NER significantly enhances the performance of LLMs under low-resource settings, with particularly pronounced gains for smaller LLMs, achieving new state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归解码中目标模型的重复执行是 LLM 推理延迟的主要来源；DeepSeek-V4 的 CSA/HCA 在线压缩注意力虽然缓解了长上下文成本，但使解码仍是自回归的。线性推测在草稿早期出错时整条候选链失效，而树形推测在同一预算下保留多分支可提高接受率。然而，将树形推测适配到 DeepSeek-V4 面临核心挑战：分支分叉后会压缩为不同的状态，破坏跨分支状态一致性，因此改造重点在 target-verify 端而非构造候选树。

Abstract: Repeated execution of the target model during autoregressive decoding is a major source of LLM inference latency. We integrate tree-structured speculative decoding into the DeepSeek-V4-Flash pipeline via branch-aware causal verification, temporary state isolation, and accepted-path state refresh, keeping verification and compressed-state updates consistent across branches. Across budgets D=5 to D=8, batch sizes 1 to 64, and three datasets (GSM8K, MBPP, ShareGPT), tree speculation achieves a higher accepted length than the matched linear configurations in all settings (e.g., at D=8 about 2.83--3.41 versus 2.39--2.84) and improves throughput in nearly all configurations---marginal only at the smallest budget---by up to about 18.5%. More importantly, the gains follow stable, transferable regularities: the relative gain grows with the budget and is most pronounced for less predictable workloads at small-to-medium batch sizes, while beyond a certain budget throughput plateaus and decouples from the still-rising accepted length. These results show that retaining multiple candidate paths under the same budget can effectively improve DeepSeek-V4 decoding efficiency, and offer experience for adapting speculative decoding to future models with compressed, sparse, or structured context representations.

### [54] [When Quantization Preserves Accuracy but Not Evidence: Explanation-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Medical LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24799)
*Yeji Kim,Mi-Young Kim,Randy Goebel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文揭示了医疗大语言模型低比特量化中"答案准确但证据丢失"的问题，提出了一种解释感知的PTQ目标，通过离线忠实性缓存保留支持答案的证据token和证据条件下的答案行为，在OSTQuant W4A4KV4设置下有效缓解了量化导致的推理依据漂移。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PTQ方法以重建误差、困惑度或答案准确率为优化目标，但在医疗等解释关键领域，仅保留最终答案不足以确保模型可信——用户还会审查生成的理由来判断预测是否可靠。论文指出，在量化可能保留答案的同时，临床证据可能已被改变、遗漏或捏造，这一差距未被现有评估体系捕捉。

Method: 方法核心是构建一个离线忠实性缓存（Faithfulness Cache），存储来自全精度教师模型的证据信息，并在OSTQuant的转换优化过程中加入两个额外损失：(1) 推理token损失（rationale-token loss），聚焦于教师答案支持且被量化削弱的证据token；(2) 推理条件恢复损失（rationale-conditioned recovery loss），保留证据对答案决策的因果支持作用。缓存仅在教师预测匹配黄金答案的校准示例上构建，以避免强化教师错误。整个方法保持校准池、部署格式W4A4KV4及推理路径与OSTQuant一致。

Result: 在MedExQA、MedExpQA和ChallengeClinicalQA三个医疗QA基准上，对四个7B-8B模型（OpenBioLLM-8B、Llama-3-8B-Instruct、BioMistral-7B、Mistral-7B-Instruct）进行评估。结果表明：(1) OSTQuant基线在MedExpQA上虽然准确率从31.80上升到36.80，但全精度一致性仅48.66，预测答案重建率从90.40骤降至56.54；(2) 本文方法将全精度一致性提升至79.47，预测答案重建率恢复至88.47；(3) FER（全精度证据保留率）平均提升+5.34（95% CI [1.50, 9.18]），UCR（无支持声明率）平均降低-4.65（95% CI [-9.10, -0.28]）；(4) 在OmniQuant上的附加验证也显示出跨PTQ方法的泛化性。消融实验证实两个辅助损失互补，证据选择策略的逐步过滤有效。

Conclusion: 论文揭示了PTQ中任务准确性与推理保留之间的鸿沟，表明仅凭答案准确率评估量化模型可能掩盖解释层面的损坏。提出的解释感知目标作为保真正则化器，能在保持W4A4KV4部署格式和推理成本不变的前提下，更好地保留全精度模型的答案行为和答案支持的临床证据。这推动了面向解释关键场景的PTQ评估范式从单一准确率向证据保留的多维度度量转变。论文也明确指出该工作不适用于临床决策或患者部署。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large language models, and PTQ methods are usually optimized and evaluated with generic reconstruction, perplexity, or answer accuracy. Our method builds an offline faithfulness cache from full-precision teacher rationales and uses it during optimization to preserve answer-supporting evidence tokens and evidence-conditioned answer behavior. We instantiate it on OSTQuant under W4A4KV4 quantization and evaluate four 7B--8B medical and instruction-tuned LLMs on MedExQA, MedExpQA, and ChallengeClinicalQA. While a same-calibration OSTQuant baseline preserves task accuracy, it can substantially weaken answer-supporting rationales. Our objective is to preserve the full-precision model's answer-supporting behavior rather than improve gold-label accuracy, and our method better preserves the full-precision model's answer behavior and rationale-to-answer support. These results suggest that PTQ for explanation-critical settings should evaluate preservation of answer-supporting evidence, not only answer accuracy. Code and evaluation scripts are available at this https URL .

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Evaluation of Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) is often limited to the final deliverables they create (at the end of hundreds of steps) and assessed with functional verifiers, as seen in OSWorld. However, such evaluation of end-state performance lacks transparency into how and why agents fail in various tasks, obfuscating critical insight for subsequent improvement. For instance, agents that err during keyboard inputs would require a different mitigation strategy from those that fail to precisely provide click-based inputs on the graphical UI. We use robust human-aligned LLM-Judges to evaluate the fulfillment of OSWorld-Pro subgoals and thereby reveal the progress that models make throughout a series of sequentially dependent subgoals. Our findings reveal that OSWorld-Pro is challenging even for state-of-the-art LLMs, with top performers like Claude Opus 5 achieving only 75.7% vs. 83.4% on OSWorld.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Scientific workflows often require choosing among known relations before a deterministic calculation can proceed. The study compares twelve model configurations on twenty source-grounded Choices across ten scientific cases, each repeated five times. Jev matched five other configurations at complete semantic correctness and achieved the lowest observed median latency among successful responses. Across three comparison models, seven wrong selections on one culture-history question changed downstream counts while preserving the correct final label. These results identify a useful role for Jev in prepared scientific decision tasks and show why evaluating that role requires checking the relations and quantities that a workflow will reuse.

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的记忆基准测试普遍采用对话式问答（QA）评估范式，问题本身即为检索信号，且只关注准确率指标，忽略了成本与延迟的权衡；同时许多基准测试存在答案标注错误、问题不可解等数据缺陷，缺少对测试有效性的保障。

Abstract: Agents today often take real-world actions that depend on long-term memory and context recall over time. However, most current memory benchmarks are built for a conversational question-answer format, where the question itself signals that some fact must be retrieved, and often which one. Moreover, benchmarks rarely require anything beyond accuracy from submissions, allowing memory systems to make unreasonable cost/time tradeoffs to achieve higher scores. We present DolphinBench, a benchmark that evaluates memory directly through an agent's task completion. DolphinBench includes three knowledge-work personas with roughly 500k tokens of user messages per persona and evaluates agents on tasks that depend on information from that history. We verify all 200 tasks per persona by running an agent with and without the relevant history, requiring success with it and failure without it. Finally, we require all evaluations to report total cost and latency alongside accuracy, which enables us to evaluate agent memory systems holistically. No existing memory benchmark combines all three. The dataset and evaluation code are available at this https URL .

### [58] [Token Signatures of Code: Comparing Coding Behaviors Across Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22097)
*Junpeng Wang,Yuzhong Chen,Menghai Pan,Uday Singh Saini,Yiwei Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CLIC（Code Learning for Identification and Comparison），一种基于词频分析的视觉分析方法，用于比较不同大语言模型（LLM）的代码生成行为，而非传统的性能指标评估。该方法通过在五个语义层级（完整、注释、代码、功能、包导入）上对代码进行分词，训练可解释的决策树来量化两个LLM代码集之间的可分离性，并提出两个新指标：鲁棒性（衡量逐步移除判别性词元后分类器准确率的持久性）和集中度（衡量判别信号的分布是否由少数主导词元驱动）。配套开发的三视图交互式视觉分析系统支持多尺度探索，通过对10个LLM在22个Kaggle ML任务上的案例研究，揭示了关于LLM选择和提示工程的可操作见解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM编码任务评估主要依赖pass@k等性能指标，但随着LLM能力提升，许多模型已达到基线性能要求，单纯性能评估的区分力下降。一个关键但未被充分探索的问题是：LLM在编码行为上有何不同？例如，在性能相近的LLM中，哪一个生成的代码更冗余、哪一个在文件操作中更谨慎？这些行为差异显著影响代码可靠性、可维护性和开发者交互质量，对于智能编码框架迭代和多LLM选择决策至关重要。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组成部分：（1）基于词频的代码表示——将每个代码样本表示为500维词频向量，在五个语义层级（complete、comment、code、functional、package）上分别提取词元；（2）可解释的二元决策树分类器——以80/20分层划分训练/测试集，通过节点上的Gini不纯度下降累积计算词元重要性；（3）三个量化指标——Accuracy（测试准确率衡量初始可分离性）、Robustness（逐步移除最重要特征后准确率曲线相对50%基线的面积绝对偏差累积，衡量分离的持久性）、Concentration（前S/2步中词元重要性分布的熵与最大熵差距的累积面积，衡量信号集中度）。基于这两个指标的组合，定义了四种分离模式：Sharp & Cascading、Deep & Distributed、Fragile & Diffuse、Lexical & Brittle（作为泛化性健全性检验）。

Result: 案例研究比较了10个LLM（o3、gpt-4o、gpt-4.1、gpt-4.1-mini、gpt-5、gpt-5-mini、gpt-5.1、gpt-5.2、grok-4、claude-sonnet-4.5）在22个Kaggle ML任务上生成的440,000个Python代码样本。主要发现包括：（1）同一LLM两次独立运行的代码不可分离（验证行为稳定性），不同LLM代码高度可分离；（2）complete/code/functional三个分词器行为相似，comment层判别力较弱，package层特征空间小且产生最多"Fragile & Diffuse"分离；（3）gpt-4o与gpt-5.2由单一词元exist_ok驱动分离，揭示gpt-5.2在目录创建上更为谨慎（使用makedirs/mkdir）；（4）o3与claude的主要区别是claude更冗长（print使用频率高），通过向claude添加提示"保持输出最小化"可成功抑制冗长性，且揭示出更深层的风格差异；（5）grok的温度敏感性低于claude；（6）40+ ML科学家的用户调研证实了系统的实用价值，三位领域专家提供了积极反馈。

Conclusion: 本文提出了CLIC，一个超越性能指标的LLM编码行为比较框架，通过词频分析与可解释决策树，结合鲁棒性和集中度两个新指标，在五个语义层级上全面刻画LLM的代码生成行为差异。三视图交互式系统支持从整体概览到具体词元的多尺度探索。案例研究证明该方法能有效指导LLM选择和提示工程，并为模型谱系分析（如检测蒸馏关系）开辟了新方向。未来工作将扩展至其他编程语言、任务域，以及融合TF-IDF、AST结构特征和控制流图等结构化属性。

Abstract: The evaluation of large language models (LLMs) on coding tasks has primarily focused on performance metrics such as pass@k. As LLMs continue to advance, many models now meet baseline performance requirements, reducing the discriminative power of performance-based evaluation alone. Yet a key question remains largely unexplored: how do LLMs differ in their coding behavior? We propose CLIC (Code Learning for Identification and Comparison), a visual analytics approach that characterizes LLM coding behavior through token-frequency analysis. CLIC represents each code sample as a feature vector of token frequencies and trains an interpretable decision tree to separate two LLMs' code sets. Beyond classification accuracy, we define two new metrics: robustness, which measures whether the two LLMs remain distinguishable as their most-discriminative tokens are progressively removed, and concentration, which measures whether the difference is driven by a few dominant tokens or spread across many. Interpreting numerous pairwise comparisons (across LLM pairs, tasks, and tokenization levels) and tracing the full analytical chain form an inherently multi-scale, hypothesis-driven exploration task. We therefore develop an interactive visual analytics system to navigate the comparison landscape, identify pairs of interest, and drill down into discriminative tokens and their code contexts. Case studies comparing 10 LLMs across 22 Kaggle ML tasks reveal actionable insights for LLM selection and prompt engineering.

</details>


### [59] [An Empirical Cost Attribution of Context-Compression Gateways in Multi-Turn Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22114)

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公开基准显示激进压缩能保持任务解决质量，这被广泛假设为压缩文件读取可节省多轮代理成本的证据；但压缩率与端到端实际节省之间存在未被验证的鸿沟。需要把代理会话的真实token账单按独立杠杆归因，以回答"节省的token究竟在哪里"。

Method: 在代理（Claude Code/Codex）与前沿LLM（Claude Sonnet/GPT-5）之间部署开源非破坏式压缩网关Paritok，将账单分解为三个独立可切换杠杆：(i)工具schema过滤（基于本地CPU嵌入模型过滤为相关工具，其余stub为recall tool）；(ii)内容压缩（基于Qwen3-4B的Paritok-4B LoRA压缩模型将文件读取压缩至~26%）；(iii)历史摘要。通过min_tokens阈值和严格MCP配置控制单一变量，进行A/B对照实验（含≥3次重复试验以应对高方差），使用provider-reported usage按缓存读取/新输入/输出分层定价，在真实Python仓库（textual/jinja2/werkzeug等）上测量。在五轮read-only任务上拟合累积节省标度律。

Result: 工具schema过滤是线性、占主导、唯一可靠正收益的杠杆，每轮节省~21K-57K tokens（jinja2会话节省392K，rich会话节省1.22M tokens，对内容压缩呈20:1至33:1比例）。内容压缩每轮仅节省~2%缓存定价前缀，但因累积历史每轮重传呈二次增长≈3,350·N² tokens，在N≈6时超过线性工具过滤节省，直至上下文窗口~200K在N≈12-15处封顶。每次recall为有界固定成本（一个压缩段），删除recall工具反致3.2×成本上升（46 turns/$1.85）。Paritok-4B在SWE-bench Lite上以25.7%压缩率保留86.5%质量，但单次基准与多轮代理成本正交。

Conclusion: 多轮代理成本应按"过滤工具→长期会话压缩→按缓存分层端到端测量"的层级投入。轮次而非压缩率决定账单；二次压缩与三次换工具schema过滤是互补而非替代（不同增长指数）；非破坏性recall是正确性必需且成本可控；单次压缩基准不可作为多轮成本论证。代码模型权重与评估框架均以Apache 2.0开源。

Abstract: Context compression is widely proposed as a way to cut the token bill of LLM coding agents, and public benchmarks report that aggressive compression preserves task-solving quality. These two facts do not imply the third one commonly assumed: that compressing file reads saves money in a real multi-turn agent. We instrument a production compression gateway (Paritok) between coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet, GPT-5), and decompose the token bill of real sessions into three independent levers: tool-schema filtering, content compression of file reads and tool output, and history summarization. Measured in isolation under controlled A/B runs, the three save at fundamentally different rates. Tool-schema filtering removes a fixed block every turn, roughly 21K-57K tokens on a typical turn; it is linear in the turn count N and the only unambiguously and reproducibly positive lever. Content compression saves only about 2% of the cache-priced prefix per turn, but compressed reads accumulate in history and are re-sent on every later turn, so its cumulative saving grows quadratically, about 3350*N^2 tokens (measured), overtaking the fixed tool-filter saving within roughly 6 turns until the context window caps it. A non-destructive gateway lets the agent pull original bytes back on demand; each recall re-sends exactly the one segment just compressed away, so its cost is fixed and bounded rather than a multiplicative blowup, and heavy recall spends the accumulated saving back one segment at a time. Finally, a strong single-shot compression benchmark - 86.5% of SWE-bench quality retained at a 25.7% compression rate, achieved by the model this gateway deploys (Paritok-4B, reported separately) - is orthogonal to multi-turn agent cost and must not be cited as a cost-saving argument. We distill the results into an actionable recipe for where token-saving effort pays off.

</details>


### [60] [Summarize, Judge, Refine: Decoupled Content Understanding and Policy Learning for Multimodal Content Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22094)
*Zeeshan Ahmed,Yang Qin,Hanqing Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Content moderation systems traditionally entangle multimodal understanding with policy-specific classification, requiring full pipeline retraining for every policy change and suffering from label scarcity since multimedia cannot be meaningfully augmented. We propose Summarize-Judge-Refine (SJR), a two-model architecture that decouples these concerns via a natural language interface: a multimodal Content Model produces structured text summaries, and a text-only Policy Model classifies them against policy definitions. An iterative co-training loop refines the Content Model via GRPO to produce policy-relevant summaries, while text-space augmentation generates adversarial summary variants---an augmentation pathway impossible on raw multimedia---enabling few-shot policy bootstrap. Every decision is grounded in a human-readable summary, providing interpretability as a structural byproduct. On misleading advertisement detection, SJR achieves +23.6\% relative non-misleading F1 over a zero-shot chain-of-thought baseline, outperforming end-to-end SFT, STaR/RFT, and RLFT. Notably, a variant trained on zero real violating examples---with all positive-class data synthetically generated---matches the full-data model within 0.2\% relative on violating F1, demonstrating that new policies can launch without any real violation data.

### [61] [AdaMem: Adaptive Memory Token Allocation for Soft Compression in Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22100)
*Artem Sakhno,Grigorii Davydenko,Omar Zoloev,Julia Belikova,Andrey Savchenko,Maksim Makarenko*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language models with retrieved evidence, but processing many long passages is costly and can introduce distracting information. Soft compression addresses this challenge by encoding passages as compact sequences of continuous memory embeddings before generation. However, existing methods typically assign each retained passage an identical number of memory embeddings, irrespective of its query-specific relevance. To address this, we propose AdaMem, a relevance-guided soft-compression framework that maps learned passage-relevance estimates to a query-dependent allocation of a fixed memory-token budget. A shared query-conditioned compressor produces both continuous passage memories and relevance scores in a single pass; a deterministic allocation rule assigns more memory tokens to higher-scoring passages and can omit low-scoring ones. Across six open-domain QA benchmarks, AdaMem consistently outperforms OSCAR (the closely matched soft-compression baseline that uses uniform allocation) as well as other soft-compression methods at matched memory budgets. Under standard 16$\times$ compression, AdaMem improves sub-string match by up to 3.2 points (5.5%) over uniform allocation baseline, with an average relative gain of 3.4%; under aggressive 64$\times$ compression the average relative gain grows to 14.6%, with a maximum of 9.8 points (19.7%) on PopQA. AdaMem matches the answer quality of the uncompressed at up to 4$\times$ lower inference latency than full context baseline. AdaMem retains an efficiency profile comparable to the uniform-compression baseline, while achieving up to $4\times$ lower inference latency than full-context inference. Thus, relevance-guided memory allocation is particularly effective when retrieval pools are large and the available memory budget is tight.

### [62] [Evaluation Awareness Shifts from Format to Context with Model Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22119)
*Navraj Singh,Maheep Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Evaluation awareness poses an unprecedented threat to model evaluation, but the mechanisms by which models detect it remain unknown. This study focuses on determining this and identifying contrasting mechanisms between smaller and larger models. While smaller models use the prompt's format sensitivity to detect evaluation, larger models often rely on higher-order reasoning to detect it. We evaluated Gemma 3 (1B, 4B, and 12B), Phi-3 (Mini and Medium), and Llama-3 8B using Chain-of-Thought analysis, representation probing, and Integrated Gradients attribution. Motivated by these findings, we propose a dual-pathway intervention that combines prompt sanitization with activation counter-steering to suppress both external evaluation triggers and their internal representations. Across 200 highly evaluation-aware prompts, our method achieves an average behavioral flip rate of 70.58\%, consistently outperforming either intervention alone. These results provide new insights into how evaluation awareness develops in compact language models and suggest that effective mitigation requires jointly addressing both prompt-level and representation-level this http URL and codebase can be found in this \href{ this https URL }{Github Repository.}
