### [197] [Co-occurrence Patterns of LoRA Adapters in Production Diffusion Model Inference Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23321)
*Tao Zhang,Bin Liao,Tao Zhou,Yanping Liu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 基于阿里GenTD26生产数据集，本文首次系统量化分析了扩散模型推理服务中LoRA适配器的共现（co-occurrence）模式，构建适配器共现网络并揭示其极度稀疏性、模型驱动的聚类特性、核心-边缘双极结构以及三层时间演化规律，并据此提出基于共现的预加载策略（k=3时覆盖81.0%测试对）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA推理服务中"一基模多适配器"架构给GPU缓存、调度和内存管理带来挑战，而现有LoRA系统设计（Punica、S-LoRA等）缺乏对真实工作负载中适配器共现拓扑结构的理解，普遍采用LRU等通用策略或假设访问模式已知，未回答"哪些适配器会同时被请求"这一前置问题。

Method: 采用图论框架，基于共现计数矩阵构建LoRA适配器共现网络（Gτ），结合连接分量分析、社区检测（贪心模块度最大化）、Jaccard相似度（含置换检验）、基模-适配器二部图分析，从静态结构（频率分布、网络拓扑、基模关联）和动态演化（请求级昼夜模式、模型级演化、跨模型扩散）三个维度进行表征，并设计基于top-k共现统计的预加载策略进行离线验证和灵敏度分析。

Result: （1）共现网络极度稀疏（边密度仅0.18%，274节点68边，81.4%节点度为0），频率分布呈显著重尾（基尼系数0.749，幂律假设被KS检验拒绝，仅高频尾部兼容α=2.04的幂律）；（2）首个适配器带来66.1%延迟开销，后续边际成本递减（4.4秒加载延迟仅占无LoRA基线的18.6%）；（3）共现关系由基模驱动：90.6%多适配器请求共享同一主导基模，66.2%显著共现边连接同模适配器对（同随机期望的2.6×），85.8%多适配器请求中所有对形成显著共现边；（4）适配器生态呈核心-边缘双极结构：仅5个适配器跨≥18基模（核心），89.8%仅依附≤2基模（边缘），模型级周Jaccard相似度0.696，12小时内top-10热门模型流失率54.5%；（5）top-k预加载策略在k=3时覆盖81.0%测试共现对（k=10达94.3%，k=20饱和），频率-中心性中等正相关（Pearson r=0.447），建议两级缓存（核心永久驻留+长尾按需加载）和中心性加权LRU替换策略。

Conclusion: 该研究填补了LoRA推理服务中适配器共现结构表征的空白，提供了数据驱动的缓存预加载、自适应调度和GPU内存管理设计依据；核心结论（稀疏性、模型驱动聚类、核心-边缘结构）在频率阈值τ_min∈{5,10,20,50}和时间窗口的灵敏度分析中均稳健；局限性包括两个数据文件无法关联导致无法分析适配器级时间序列、适配器语义匿名化限制功能分析、以及单集群24天观测数据的泛化性限制。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become a key technology for serving large-scale personalized large language models and diffusion models in the cloud. However, the co-occurrence patterns, resource contention relationships, and evolutionary regularities of adapters under production inference workloads have not been systematically or quantitatively studied. Based on GenTD26, Alibaba's production diffusion model inference dataset, this paper adopts a graph-theoretic framework to construct an adapter co-occurrence network and conducts a characterization from both static structure and dynamic evolution. Our main findings are as follows. (1) The co-occurrence network is extremely sparse, and adapter usage frequency follows a significant heavy-tailed distribution. (2) Introducing the first adapter incurs a 66.1% execution-latency overhead, with diminishing marginal costs afterwards. (3) Co-occurrence relationships are driven by base models: in 90.6% of multi-adapter requests, all adapters share the same dominant base model; 66.2% of significant co-occurrence edges connect same-model adapter pairs; and in 85.8% of multi-adapter requests, all adapter pairs form significant co-occurrence edges. (4) The adapter ecosystem exhibits a core-periphery bipolar structure, with a weekly Jaccard similarity of 0.696 at the model level and a churn rate of 54.5% for the top-10 hottest models within a 12-hour window. Based on these findings, we propose a preloading strategy built on top-k co-occurrence statistics; offline experiments show that it covers 81.0% of test-set co-occurrence pairs at k=3, and sensitivity analyses across frequency thresholds and time windows verify the robustness of the conclusions. These results provide a data-driven basis for cache preloading, adaptive scheduling, and GPU memory management in LoRA inference services.

</details>


### [198] [MCP-GRANITE Benchmark: GRANularity Interface TEsting for MCP-Based LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24161)
*Demetris Paschalides,Moysis Symeonides,George Pallis,Marios D. Dikaiakos*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出MCP-GRANITE基准框架，将工具接口粒度作为受控变量，系统评估边缘/IoT场景下基于MCP的LLM智能体性能。通过8748次实验发现：4工具接口(L3)在任务完成率(+16.4%)和参数精度(+99.5%)上最优；模型规模与延迟强相关(ρ=0.946)但与任务完成率弱相关(ρ=0.285)；3.2B模型在最优粒度下可超越20.9B模型在不匹配粒度下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MCP基准测试将工具接口视为固定前提，仅评估模型能否正确使用工具，忽视了工具接口设计（功能分解方式）对智能体性能的影响。在边缘部署场景下，由于硬件资源限制无法通过扩大模型规模提升性能，工具接口粒度成为关键的设计参数，但缺乏系统性的评估框架。

Method: 构建MCP-GRANITE基准框架，包含81个多步场景、9个边缘/IoT领域、4个粒度级别（从8-10个细粒度原子工具到1个单体工具）；在NVIDIA T4边缘工作站上部署9个本地模型（268M-20.9B参数）；通过YAML配置驱动全因子实验设计（9模型×9领域×4粒度×9场景×3重复=8748次试验）；评估指标包括任务完成率、工具选择F1、参数精度、延迟、GPU利用率和能耗；采用自助法检验显著性。

Result: L3（4工具，任务类分组）在8/9个模型上达到最高任务完成率(0.49)，比L4提升16.4%、比L1提升33.6%；参数精度从L4的0.20提升到L3的0.40（+99.5%）；L1过度整合导致28.2%的运行不调用任何工具；模型规模与延迟强相关(ρ=0.946)但与任务完成率弱相关(ρ=0.285)；Llama3.2（3.2B）在L3下能耗仅为Qwen3（14.8B）的1/23；工具选择F1与任务完成率脱钩，表明参数构造是主要瓶颈；GPT-OSS和xLAM-2错误率超过50%，显示大型或函数调用专用模型在动态工具接口下表现不佳。

Conclusion: 工具接口粒度是MCP智能体的关键设计参数；中等粒度整合（4个任务类工具）提供最佳性能-效率权衡；接口设计可以弥补模型规模的不足，3.2B模型在最优粒度下超越20.9B模型在错误粒度下的表现；参数构造而非工具选择是当前主要性能瓶颈；建议在部署前评估粒度替代方案。

Abstract: As LLM agents increasingly interact with external tools through standardized protocols such as MCP, tool-interface design becomes a critical yet underexplored factor. How fun{\psi}tionality is decomposed into tools affects whether an agent can select the right tool and construct valid arguments. This choice is especially consequential at the edge, where resource constraints limit which models can run locally and scaling up is often not an option. We present MCP-GRANITE, an open-source extensible benchmark framework that treats tool-interface granularity as a controlled variable for MCP-based agents, evaluated under edge and IoT scenarios. It comprises 81 multi-step scenarios across 9 domains, instantiated at 4 granularity levels from fine-grained primitive tools to a single tool. We evaluate 9 locally deployed models (268M-20.9B parameters) across 8,748 trials using task completion, tool selection F1, argument accuracy, latency, and resource-usage metrics. Results show that a 4-tool interface offers the best trade-off, improving task completion by 16.4% over fine-grained primitives and 33.6% over a single monolithic tool, while nearly doubling argument accuracy. Model size is only weakly correlated with task completion and strongly with latency, while its association with argument accuracy is less robust, and a 3.2B model at the optimal granularity outperforms a 20.9B model at a mismatched one. These findings identify tool-interface granularity as a key design parameter for MCP-based agents.

</details>


### [199] [Conduit: An Experience Data Plane for Distributed Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24456)
*Sitong Zhang,Tuo Shi,Mario Di Francesco,Zeke Wang,Bo Zhao*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Conduit提出了一种框架无关的运行时系统，将分布式强化学习中的经验数据路径抽象为"经验数据平面"（EDP），通过容量受限的带宽感知放置和延迟感知调度来显著降低经验路径延迟和端到端迭代延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式强化学习中，经验缓冲区（Experience Buffer）不仅是重放队列，更成为大容量、低延迟关键的经验数据路径。实验显示经验路径处理占DQN迭代时间的50.2%和PPO的26.2%，但现有系统要么将其嵌入框架控制流，要么将其暴露为请求驱动的缓冲区服务，导致经验放置固定、经验路径工作难以独立调度优化。

Method: 核心方法是经验数据平面（EDP）抽象，将经验管理分为三个显式控制点：经验摄取（ingestion）、经验放置（placement）和经验交付（delivery）。在此基础上引入两个关键机制：(1)容量受限、带宽感知的放置机制，根据测量的互连带宽和设备内存约束，将经验缓冲区分布到CPU/GPU内存层级和节点上；(2)延迟感知调度机制，通过控制执行时机（重叠vs顺序）和执行粒度（批量vs流水线）来减少暴露的经验路径延迟。通过摄取粒度$g_{ing}$和交付粒度$g_{del}$参数统一建模离策略（off-policy）批处理和在线策略（on-policy）流水线语义。

Result: Conduit集成到RLlib中（不修改框架执行逻辑），可降低暴露的经验路径延迟高达97%，端到端迭代延迟高达38%，可扩展至1,024个GPU，同时保持收敛性。在带宽受限和容量受限两种场景下均优于CPU常驻方案（比Reverb快127-130倍，比Gear快2.9-4.1倍）。此外还集成到SRL（DQN-Qbert降低31%端到端延迟）和Verl（LLM后训练GRPO降低52%暴露延迟）等框架中验证通用性。

Conclusion: Conduit将经验数据平面确立为分布式强化学习中的实用优化层面，通过运行时抽象将容量、放置和调度决策与框架执行逻辑解耦，在保持RL语义的同时显著提升训练效率。该工作表明经验路径本身应被视为独立可优化的运行时组件，而非框架内部的副作用。

Abstract: Distributed reinforcement learning (RL) scales training by parallelizing actors and learners around an Experience Buffer. As RL workloads grow, however, the buffer becomes more than a replay queue: it is the storage substrate of a large-capacity, latency-critical experience path that every iteration traverses to move, transform, sample, and batch experiences before learner updates can begin. Existing RL systems embed this path inside framework control flow or expose it as a request-driven buffer service, leaving experience placement fixed and experience-path work difficult to schedule independently as a runtime-level optimization target. We present Conduit, a framework-agnostic runtime that exposes RL experience management as an explicit systems optimization problem. At its core is the Experience Data Plane (EDP), a runtime abstraction that separates RL experience-handling semantics from framework-specific execution logic by exposing experience ingestion, experience placement, and experience delivery as explicit control points. Built on EDP, Conduit introduces capacity-constrained, bandwidth-aware placement, which distributes experience state across CPU/GPU memory tiers and nodes under heterogeneous interconnect and device-memory constraints, and latency-aware scheduling, which controls when experience-path handling runs to reduce exposed experience-path latency while preserving RL semantics. Integrated with RLlib without changing its framework execution logic, Conduit reduces exposed experience-path latency by up to 97% and end-to-end iteration latency by up to 38%, scales to 1,024 GPUs, and preserves convergence.

</details>


### [200] [When Does Learning Beat Heuristics? A Case Study in Kubernetes Scheduler Score Plugins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22142)
*Wang Xuying,Zhibek Sarypbekova*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文针对Kubernetes调度器中评分插件能否通过学习替代手工启发式这一核心问题，基于阿里生产集群追踪数据（Alibaba Cluster Trace v2018）对两种学习模型（Random Forest与GraphSAGE GNN）进行了系统性的实证比较研究。研究发现了一个具有方法论意义的负向结论：尽管学习模型在标准回归指标R²上呈现单调改进（最终达到约0.042），但在真正反映调度质量的Top-1排序准确率指标上，两者均显著劣于仅基于"空闲CPU排序"的单特征启发式（学习模型65-66% vs. 启发式74-84%）。作者将此现象归因于"目标失配"，即采用了点对回归损失（MSE）而非排序特定的优化目标，并以此与学习排序（Learning-to-Rank）领域的经典观点及Decima/DeepRM等RL调度器的成功经验建立联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kubernetes生产环境中节点评分依赖手工调优的启发式插件（如NodeResourcesBalancedAllocation），这些规则在插件编写时即被固化，无法捕获特定工作负载或集群的个性化模式。这一长期存在的"学习vs.启发式"问题在系统研究中被反复探讨（如Firmament的最优流调度、Decima的DAG感知RL调度器），但缺乏针对评分插件这一特定决策粒度的、在真实历史放置决策上直接验证监督学习可行性的实证研究。此外，作者还强调了一个潜在的方法论隐患——基于回归指标（R²）的训练评估可能与实际的排序型部署目标不一致，这一隐患在ML-for-systems领域尚未被显式地揭示和量化。

Method: 1. 实验平台搭建：在kube-scheduler-simulator中实现AIScore——一个通过同步HTTP POST调用外部FastAPI推理服务的可插拔ScorePlugin；2. 数据准备：基于Alibaba Cluster Trace v2018（~4000台机器，8天窗口）构建训练集，通过扫描线算法（sweep-line）按时间点精确重构节点并发占用状态，以避免离线追踪数据的静态快照带来的特征失真；3. 标签构造：以被选中的机器作为正例（标签100），同时刻、同故障域内其他资源可行的机器作为负例（标签20），构建学习排序框架；4. 模型训练：(a) Random Forest（150棵树，最大深度10）配合11维工程化特征（含故障域、DAG衍生特征如in/out-degree、job_width等），训练于~2.9M正例；(b) GraphSAGE GNN（2层）配合每job-DAG编码，训练于72,734正例（数据量远少于RF）；5. 评估设计：双重评估——R²回归拟合度与Top-1排序准确率（模型是否将组内被选机器打分最高），并与"按空闲CPU排序"启发式和随机基线对比；6. 敏感性分析：系统性地考察推理延迟（0-1500ms注入）、服务容器内存约束（120-400MB）以及负载同质化对均衡性的影响。

Result: 1. 工作流验证：合成负载基准确认插件框架可正确影响调度结果；2. RF特征消融实验（4轮迭代）：从Variant A的R²=0.025逐步提升至Variant D（含DAG特征）的0.042；3. 关键发现——排序性能逆转：当切换至Top-1准确率评估时，RF为65.4%（n=2.9M），GNN为65.8%（n=72.7K），均显著低于空闲CPU启发式的74.0%（RF数据集）和84.3%（GNN数据集），差距分别为8.6和18.5个百分点；4. 架构对比再校准：在控制数据量与特征不对称的混淆后，RF与GNN的Top-1准确率实质相当，表明GNN的R²劣势很大程度上源于资源不对等而非架构劣势；5. 特征意外洞察：free的结构特征job_width在特征重要性中排名第二（0.170），超过节点空闲内存（0.112），提示无需复杂占用重构的廉价结构信号可能比资源状态更值得优先探索；6. 生产稳健性：延迟注入高达1.5秒、内存压缩至低于空闲基线（120MB vs. 160.8MB）均未触发崩溃或OOM，表现为优雅降级。

Conclusion: 论文得出核心负面但具教学价值的结论：监督学习评分函数在当前形式下尚无法超越"按空闲CPU排序"这一简单启发式，根本原因并非模型架构（RF vs. GNN差异有限），而是目标失配——点对MSE回归损失与Top-1排序优化目标之间存在系统性偏离。这一发现：(1)将经典学习排序文献（RankNet/LambdaMART）中的目标对齐原则首次具体呈现在ML-for-scheduling场景中；(2)为Decima/DeepRM等RL调度器相对启发式的成功优势提供了间接解释——它们通过RL奖励直接对齐部署目标，绕开了点对回归陷阱；(3)为该领域后续研究指明了具体路径——应采用pairwise margin loss或排序特定损失重训练，并辅以事后最优放置（oracle）、makespan指标、多随机种子置信区间及跨数据集（如Google Cluster Trace）验证。论文同时贡献了完整的可复现实验流水线（包括不可或缺的扫描线占用重构算法），强调在调度相关的ML工作中，目标对齐的评估指标应作为首要设计准则，而非事后补救。

Abstract: Kubernetes scheduler plugins that score candidate nodes are, in production, hand-tuned heuristics. We ask whether a learned scoring function - trained on real placement decisions from a production cluster trace - can match or exceed these heuristics, and if not, why. We implement an external, HTTP-backed scoring plugin for a widely used scheduler simulator and evaluate two learned models (a Random Forest over engineered features, and a graph neural network encoder over per-job task-dependency graphs) trained on a large-scale production cluster trace. Under standard regression fit (R^2), both models improve modestly but monotonically across four feature-engineering iterations, reaching R^2 of about 0.042. However, on the metric that actually matters for scheduling - Top-1 ranking accuracy, whether the model scores the machine the production scheduler actually chose highest - both learned models are outperformed by a trivial single-feature heuristic (rank by free CPU: 74-84% vs. 65-66% for either model). We show this gap is best explained by objective mismatch: both models were trained with pointwise regression (MSE) rather than a ranking-specific objective, echoing a long-standing distinction in the learning-to-rank literature. This parallels prior evidence that RL-trained schedulers can outperform heuristics when the training objective is aligned with the deployment task, suggesting objective misalignment, not architecture, is the primary obstacle here. We further report an ablation of the occupancy reconstruction required to make offline trace data usable (naive features yield R^2 near 0), a controlled comparison isolating feature richness and data volume between the two model families, and a sensitivity analysis of inference latency and serving-container memory constraints. Code, data pipelines, and experiment scripts are released for reproducibility.

</details>


### [201] [The Tethys Dataset: Seven Years of Hourly Smart Water Metering and a Pipeline for Making It Usable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22358)
*Dimitrios Amaxilatis,Themistoklis Sarantakos,Georgios Mylonas,Ioannis Chatzigiannakis*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Tethys 是一个开源的智慧水务计量数据集，包含91个月（2019年1月至2026年8月）来自市政供水网络中24栋建筑的902,396条小时级用水量数据，附带完整的数据质量评估和基于Airflow的数据清洗管道。核心贡献在于公开了一个报告原始缺陷而非隐藏缺陷的真实部署数据：原始数据可用率仅59.4%，包含4次共595天的全网停机事件；发现并修复了因聚合累积水表读数错误导致的205,200条不可能下降值；最终75.9%的小时数据基于真实测量，24.1%明确标记为未知而非插值填充。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水务领域（用水预测、漏损检测等）的公开数据集稀缺、时间跨度短，且通常在未文档化的清洗过程后才发布，隐藏了部署本身的真实缺陷。这导致缺失值插补方法的评估通常基于随机掩码，无法反映真实部署中系统级、相关性的数据缺失模式。此外，电力计量领域有长达数年的公开语料库（如Building Data Genome Project 2），而水务领域缺乏同等时间跨度的公开数据。

Method: 1) 数据采集：通过wM-Bus和LoRaWAN（868MHz）从45个计量端点收集24栋非住宅建筑的累积水表读数；2) 数据质量表征：对比观测读数与各端点自有小时网格，分析完整性（56.1%）、缺失结构（分为G1短时缺失≤24h、G2端点级长期缺失、B3全网停机4次共595天）、计数器异常（停滞计数器、不合理量级）；3) Apache Airflow清洗管道（medallion架构）：(a) 修复聚合缺陷——将缺失端点的累积值向前递推后再求和，消除205,200条虚假下降；(b) 利用累积编码特性，将短缺失（≤7天）两端读数差按建筑自身小时-星期轮廓分配到缺失时段；(c) 拒绝不可信的插值（跨越计数器重置、超出建筑中位数20×的缺失、超过7天的缺失）；4) 提供每条记录的溯源（observed/imputed/unrecoverable）及缺失长度。

Result: 1) 数据集：91个月、24栋建筑、902,396条建筑-小时记录，约67MB CSV；2) 数据质量：原始可用率59.4%，可用消费区间覆盖率仅36.1%（中位数），二者之间24个百分点的差距来自聚合缺陷；3) 修复效果：聚合函数一处一行修改消除了205,200条不可能下降，修复后聚合保留总水量的0.998倍且序列单调非递减；4) 最终分层：53.6%直接观测、22.3%跨缺失总量推算（缺失≤7天）、24.1%标记为不可恢复；5) 聚类发现：10个尺度无关描述符的k-means聚类分离出2簇（轮廓系数0.389），但因每建筑均观测充分（最少单元格188次观测），跨建筑形状借用从未被激活。

Conclusion: Tethys的价值在于如实记录而非美化清洗后的数据，其结构化缺失（4次全网停机导致无同时刻供体序列）使其成为插补研究的真实测试场景，能揭示基于随机掩码评估的方法在实际部署中的失效。该数据集支持多年期真实运营环境下的需求预测和无监督异常检测。基于此数据集有两点普适性结论：(1) 聚合操作本身是数据集的一部分，应与传感器测量同等严格审查——一处将累积索引当作独立值求和的错误引入了比7年所有传感器故障总和还多的缺陷；(2) 累积计数器在缺失期间保留了总量但丢失了分布，这一特性值得利用但应在分布本身成为问题而非答案时停止，作者将这条线划在7天。论文鼓励使用该数据的研究明确声明所采纳的数据溯源标准，并针对全网停机而非随机掩码进行插补测试。

Abstract: Methods for water demand forecasting and leak detection are based on public datasets, and for water those are scarce, short, or released only after an undocumented cleaning process, hiding defects of the deployment they came from. We present Tethys: 91 months of hourly water consumption data from 24 buildings of a municipal water network, published with a quantitative account of its quality, rather than in place of one. Raw availability is 59.4%, while loss is not random: 4 fleet-wide outages totalling 595 days interrupt the entire estate at once. We show that the aggregation producing the released files silently introduced 205,200 impossible decreases in a cumulative index, and that correcting it is a one-line change. Because the meters are cumulative, the readings bracketing a short gap fix the volume that passed through it, so 75.9% of hours rest on a measurement, while 24.1% are reported as unknown. We release the dataset, its per-hour provenance, and the pipeline that produces it.

</details>


### [202] [Trust-Aware Output Management for Physical Neural Network in Cloud-Continuum Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22443)
*Maliheh Hariri,Stefan Fischer*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对云连续体（cloud continuum）系统中物理神经网络（PNN）输出的信任感知（trust-aware）输出管理框架。该框架通过统一的证据记录表示、边缘层轻量级信任评分、以及雾层（fog）的兼容性与一致性检查与融合机制，解决PNN输出可能受噪声、漂移、延迟等因素影响而不可靠的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PNN利用物理基底动力学实现推理，但其结果受物理条件制约，已有的基底管理方法（如CP²N²、NIR、BioCRNpyler等）侧重于发现、调用和监控，但忽略了调用后输出本身的可靠性判断——一个被成功调用的PNN仍可能返回不可靠的结果，这在分布式决策中会带来风险。

Method: 框架包含五个阶段：(1) 证据构造，将PNN输出表示为包含值、置信度、不确定性、漂移、时间戳、模态和来源的证据记录；(2) 边缘层信任评分，采用加权和形式 $T_i = \alpha c_i + \beta(1-\sigma_i) + \gamma(1-d_i) + \delta f_i$；(3) 三路决策策略（接受/转发/拒绝），基于两个阈值 $\theta_{accept}$ 和 $\theta_{reject}$；(4) 雾层融合，先进行兼容性检查（任务、模态、时间窗口、上下文），再基于中位数进行归一化不一致性评估，最后使用正交化的可靠性-不确定性权重 $R_i/\sigma_i^2$ 进行加权融合；(5) 自适应历史信任更新（指数移动平均）和重校准触发机制。

Result: 在20个随机种子下的评估显示：完整信任策略将不安全接受率从原始CP²N²处理的约61.5%降至约5.0%，被接受输出的MAE从0.504降至0.242；风险-覆盖分析表明该改进并非仅由降低本地接受率所致；所提雾层融合方法在聚合平均误差上取得最低值，略优于强不确定性感知基线；边缘层每条证据记录增加约2μs处理时间。

Conclusion: 该框架证明调用后（post-invocation）可靠性管理能够显著改善云连续体系统中PNN输出的安全使用。未来工作将聚焦于基于轨迹和真实PNN的实验、自适应阈值、不一致性敏感度，以及与重校准和数字孪生管理的更紧密集成。

Abstract: Physical Neural Networks (PNNs) introduce new opportunities for cloud continuum computing, but their outputs may be affected by noise, drift, delay, and incomplete reliability information. Existing substrate-management approaches mainly focus on discovery, invocation, and monitoring, while the reliability of the returned output is often left unaddressed. This paper proposes a trust-aware output management framework for heterogeneous PNNs. Each output is represented with quality and context information, and a lightweight edge-level trust score decides whether it should be accepted, rejected, or forwarded to the fog. At the fog layer, compatible outputs are checked for disagreement and combined using reliability- and uncertainty-aware fusion. Historical trust is also tracked to detect sustained degradation and support recalibration requests. The framework is evaluated using controlled and randomized PNN output models. Across 20 random seeds, the proposed full-trust policy reduces unsafe acceptance from approximately 61.5\% for raw output handling to about 5.0\%, while accepted-output MAE decreases from 0.504 to 0.242. Risk coverage analysis shows that this improvement is not explained only by lower local acceptance. The proposed fog fusion method also achieves the lowest aggregate mean error among the evaluated methods, with a small but consistent advantage over strong uncertainty-aware baselines. The prototype adds about $2~\mu\text{s}$ of edge processing per evidence record. These results show that post-invocation reliability management can improve the safe use of PNN outputs across edge--fog--cloud systems.

</details>


### [203] [Mask-Aware Execution for Efficient JEPA Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22674)
*Md Musfiqur Rahman Sanim,Zhihao Shu,Bahram Afsharmanesh,Amirali Mirian,Wei Niu,Gagan Agrawal*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文提出M-JEPA，一种面向JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）训练的掩码感知执行架构。它在不改变学习目标的前提下，通过分离掩码无关计算与掩码相关路由，实现共享上下文编码器执行、融合式token路由与切片（支持反向传播）、目标编码器在目标token并集上的稀疏执行，以及面向稀疏输入的掩码patch embedding，从而显著降低JEPA训练的计算量、内存流量与同步开销。在NVIDIA A100 GPU上，针对5种JEPA变体进行评测，相比最优基线最多可实现1.7倍端到端训练加速（2-10个掩码），并实现4.75倍的patch embedding加速（高稀疏度下）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA正成为跨视觉、视频、音频、脑动力学、时间序列等领域表征学习和潜在世界模型的核心模块。然而现有JEPA训练流水线效率低下：每个输入需通过多条掩码特定分支执行，目标侧存在冗余计算，且掩码token路由受内存带宽限制，这些开销随掩码数量线性增长，严重限制了GPU效率。已有工作（SALT、LeJEPA、DMT-JEPA）通过修改模型公式（教师设计、正则化方案、掩码策略）提升效率，而FlashAttention、DeepSpeed等通用算子优化无法解决JEPA特有的多分支执行结构问题。

Method: 核心思想是将掩码无关计算与掩码相关路由分离。具体包括：（1）共享Patch Embedding——对每个输入只执行一次patch嵌入，通过统一路由图和融合路由内核将嵌入分发到各掩码；（2）共享上下文编码器执行——LayerNorm、QKV线性投影等可跨掩码融合调用，自注意力仍按掩码独立执行，并设计融合的带反向支持的切片算子以减少梯度路由开销；（3）优化的掩码路由与预测器执行——构建路由映射后，融合的内核单次扫描编码token张量，直接写入预分配的预测器缓冲区；（4）掩码Patch Embedding——通过masked im2col变换仅提取被掩码选中的patch，配合单次GEMM投影，节省算术与内存访问；（5）稀疏目标编码器执行——先计算所有掩码目标token索引的并集，仅对该并集执行一次目标编码器，再通过索引映射分发到各掩码。所有优化均不改变JEPA的学习目标，训练损失收敛保持一致。

Result: 在NVIDIA A100 GPU（80GB HBM，CUDA 12.8.0）上，针对V-JEPA、eeg-JEPA、T-JEPA、TS-JEPA、Brain-JEPA五种变体进行评估（BF16精度，每批10个输入，掩码数2-10）：（1）端到端加速随掩码数增加而提升，V-JEPA从1.1×（2掩码）提升到1.7×（10掩码）；多GPU（2/4卡）设置下10掩码仍保持约1.5×加速；（2）组件级加速：上下文编码器最高1.7×、预测器最高1.65×、目标编码器1.1–1.18×；（3）掩码patch embedding在70%稀疏度下实现4.75×加速；（4）消融研究显示共享执行（SE）贡献约88.7%的延迟降低，优化路由（OR）贡献6.6%，稀疏计算（SC）贡献4.7%；（5）训练损失在100个epoch内与基线几乎完全一致，验证语义保持性；（6）峰值GPU内存随掩码数增加而增加（10掩码时增加10%）；（7）相比torch.compile（Triton+序列打包）1.04–1.08×加速且随掩码数增加而下降，M-JEPA的优势随掩码数增加而扩大。

Conclusion: M-JEPA证明了执行流重组（而非修改JEPA学习目标）是提升JEPA训练效率的关键杠杆。通过系统级的数据流重构、融合式掩码路由内核以及稀疏目标编码器和patch embedding设计，可在不改变训练语义的前提下显著降低冗余计算、内存流量与同步开销，且优化在多种JEPA变体、掩码配置和多GPU环境下均具备泛化能力。未来工作将把融合掩码路由与稀疏目标执行扩展到多节点低比特训练，并应用于基于JEPA的世界模型推理。

Abstract: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are becoming a core representation-learning primitive and a building block for latent world models across vision, video, audio, brain dynamics, and time series. Despite (potential of) wide deployment, current JEPA training pipelines are inefficient: each input is executed through multiple mask-specific branches, with redundant target-side work, and memory-bound token routing. These costs grow with the number of masks and limit GPU efficiency. We present M-JEPA, a mask-aware execution architecture that restructures JEPA training without changing the learning objective. M-JEPA separates mask-independent computation from mask-dependent routing, enabling shared context encoder execution, fused token routing and slicing with backward support, sparse target encoder execution over the union of target tokens, and masked patch embedding for sparse inputs. The resulting pipeline preserves training semantics while reducing computation, memory traffic, and synchronization overhead. We implement M-JEPA for five JEPA variants and evaluate it on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. Compared against the state-of-the-art baselines, M-JEPA achieves up to 1.7x end-to-end training speedup for 2-10 masks. Separately, with masked patch embedding, 4.75x patch-embedding speedup at high sparsity. These results show that execution restructuring, rather than changes to the JEPA objective, is a key lever for efficient JEPA training.

</details>


### [204] [Replacing Large Language Models with Jev Decision Models for Low-Latency Edge Service Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22753)
*Delong Li,Xu Wang,Haochen Gong,Rui Lang,Guangsheng Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文将Jev决策模型集成到边缘服务编排（edge service orchestration）的准入路径中，替代用于自然语言意图解析的大语言模型（LLM），在保持服务完成正确性的同时降低决策延迟和API费用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在边缘计算中，自然语言服务请求在被调度执行前需要语言模型进行意图解析，该步骤占用请求的延迟预算，可能导致请求错过截止时间。本文旨在探索用专门的决策模型（decision model）替代生成式LLM（large language model），以降低准入阶段的决策开销，同时保证服务在截止时间内正确完成。

Method: 1. 集成Jev决策模型API，构建一个四字段意图契约（service、locality、quality floor、urgency），配合共享验证器、缓存、准入策略和调度器，决策等待时间纳入请求时间线。2. 在Study A中，使用216条合成英文请求（覆盖全部108种字段组合），对比Jev与配置为简洁结构化输出的DeepSeek，通过实时API测量结合建模执行，评估三个连续测量块的决策延迟和API费用。3. 在Study B中，部署真实的两节点OCR服务（基于Tesseract + IIIT5K数据集），对比Jev、DeepSeek、自托管Qwen2.5-7B和基于规则的解析器，评估八种配对条件（稳态/突发 × 变化/重复文本 × 缓存开/关）下的正确完成率、端到端延迟和API费用。

Result: 1. Study A三个测量块中，Jev将客户端决策中位延迟降低15.9%–26.5%；p95延迟降低9.1%–36.7%。DeepSeek的严格语义准确率略高（215–216/216 vs. Jev的212–214/216），但Jev的语义错误多为无操作影响的等价映射。2. Study A的24个配对条件中，Jev在22个条件中达到与DeepSeek相同的运营完成数，在2个条件中超越。3. Study B的真实OCR服务中，Jev在八个配对条件中的七个与DeepSeek的正确准时完成数持平，在一个条件下超越（168/288 vs. 166/288）。4. 在无缓存条件下，共同成功请求的中位端到端延迟降低11.1%–25.3%（节省70.6–135.7 ms）。5. API费用方面，Study A中Jev每完成一次运营任务费用降低69.15%–72.57%；Study B中每正确完成一次OCR任务费用降低68.97%–70.61%。6. 启用重复请求缓存后，延迟差异几乎消失（中位配对节省为-0.37至-0.49 ms），表明延迟节省主要来自全新解析（fresh interpretation）。7. Qwen2.5-7B自托管模型的正确完成率显著较低（105/288），模型调用中位耗时1.408 s；基于规则的解析器完全拒绝不支持请求但也损失了大量支持的请求。

Conclusion: 在所测试的边缘服务准入工作负载中，Jev决策模型可作为简洁生成式LLM解释器的有效替代方案：在保持或超越正确完成数的同时，将中位决策延迟降低15.9%–26.5%，将端到端延迟降低11.1%–25.3%，并将API费用降低约69%–71%。延迟节省主要来自全新解析场景；重复请求缓存可使两类后端的延迟差异基本消除。因此，更快的决策模型适用于请求变化频繁的场景，而缓存则是重复描述场景的主要优化手段。该研究为边缘服务编排中解释器后端的选择提供了量化依据。

Abstract: Natural-language service requests can require a language-model decision before execution starts, consuming part of the request's latency budget. We integrate Jev's decision-oriented application programming interface (API) into edge service orchestration to reduce this overhead while retaining service completion. The integration extracts four bounded intent fields and applies a shared validator, admission policy, and scheduler, accounting for decision waiting throughout the request timeline. We compare Jev with a short, structured-output DeepSeek deployment using live API measurements followed by modeled execution, and then a real two-node optical character recognition (OCR) service with self-hosted Qwen and rule-based references. Across three consecutive measurement blocks, Jev reduces median client decision latency by 15.9-26.5%. In eight paired OCR conditions, Jev matches DeepSeek's correct, on-time completion count in seven and exceeds it in one. Without caching, median end-to-end latency on requests completed correctly by both systems is 11.1-25.3% lower; API fees per correct completion are 69.0-70.6% lower. Repeated-request caching largely removes the latency difference. The results demonstrate that decision-model substitution can lower both response latency and API fees in the tested service path, and identify fresh interpretation as the main opportunity for latency savings.

</details>


### [205] [NSP: Accelerating Variable-Length LLM Training via Nested Sequence Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22755)
*Yi'ou Wang,Xiaoyang Li,Yijie Zheng,Shouda Liu,Yuxuan Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: NSP是一种序列并行训练系统，通过在同一训练迭代中嵌套不同大小的SP组来解决长文本LLM训练中通信-平衡权衡问题，在长尾数据集上显著提升了训练吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长文本LLM训练面临序列长度长尾分布带来的通信-平衡权衡问题：单一SP程度对小批量的长序列导致负载不均，对占主导的短序列则造成过度通信开销；现有的动态SP系统通过将GPU划分为不相交的SP组来混合不同SP程度，重新引入了组间负载不均问题。

Method: NSP提出在同一GPU上嵌套不同大小的SP组的方法，包含三个核心组件：(1)树形结构路由规划器，在内存约束下为序列分配SP组；(2)利用层次结构的执行器，通过层间阶段流式处理（inter-level phase streaming）实现流水线执行；(3)树级重计算（tree-level recomputation）以降低内存占用。系统支持常见SP后端且无需修改模型。

Result: 在内部生产集群上对Qwen3-MoE工作负载（最长384K token上下文）评估，跨多个长尾数据集，NSP在端到端训练吞吐量上一致优于基线：相对Static SP最高提速1.48倍，相对FlexSP最高提速1.16倍。

Conclusion: NSP通过嵌套SP组的设计有效解决了长文本训练中通信与负载平衡的权衡问题，无需模型修改即可兼容多种SP后端，在长尾语料训练场景下实现了显著的吞吐量提升。

Abstract: Long-context LLM training on long-tailed corpora faces a central communication--balance tradeoff. Such sequence-length heterogeneity makes any single sequence-parallelism (SP) degree a poor fit for the workload: a small degree leaves the few long sequences badly imbalanced, while a large degree forces the many short sequences that dominate the workload to pay excessive communication. Existing dynamic-SP systems mix SP degrees within a batch, but to run several groups at once they partition the GPUs into disjoint groups, which reintroduces imbalance across groups and forces costly micro-batch workarounds. We present NSP, a sequence-parallel training system that resolves this tradeoff by nesting differently sized SP groups on shared GPUs within a single training iteration. This lets long sequences use larger SP groups while keeping short sequences on smaller ones, so communication is incurred only where needed and load is balanced per GPU rather than per group. NSP realizes this idea with a tree-structured routing planner that assigns sequences under memory constraints and an executor that exploits the resulting hierarchy through inter-level phase streaming and tree-level recomputation. NSP supports common SP backends and requires no model changes. We evaluate NSP on Qwen3-MoE workloads with up to 384K-token contexts across multiple long-tail datasets on an internal production GPU cluster. Across these settings, NSP consistently improves end-to-end training throughput, outperforming Static SP by up to 1.48x and FlexSP by up to 1.16x.

</details>


### [206] [From Idle to Urgent: A Resource-Harvested HPC Workflow for High-Fidelity Seismic Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22814)
*Tsuyoshi Ichimura,Kohei Fujita,Hideaki Ito,Wataru Sakurai,Muneo Hori,Lalith Maddegedara*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了一种面向大型地震紧急决策的"紧迫交互式HPC工作流"，通过将高保真3D非线性分析与代理神经网络(NN)动态耦合，在非紧急期利用空闲算力（"资源采集"）生成训练数据，在紧急期快速估计高保真时空地震动分布。开发了两个专用HPC内核CPUGPU-Harvest和EBEGPU-Urgent，分别优化能效和时效，使能耗降低76%、吞吐提升3.7倍，紧急期计算成本降低超97.9%，可在震后30分钟内完成地震动分布估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大地震后需要在30分钟内对密集城区进行高保真、高分辨率的时空地震动估计以支持应急决策。地表观测点稀疏使得从稀疏观测反推全域时空地震动分布成为挑战；纯物理模拟需10^{2-3}次正向分析，计算代价巨大；纯端到端NN存在物理不一致和可解释性差的风险，难以满足生命安全级别的可靠性要求。因此需要一种兼顾物理一致性、计算效率和紧急响应时效的工作流。

Method: 提出"资源采集+紧急计算"统一工作流：(1) 震前阶段使用CPUGPU-Harvest内核在异构CPU-GPU环境中通过内存/计算解耦、Element-by-Element (EBE)稀疏矩阵-向量乘法、多重网格预条件、多case并发执行等技术高效生成NN训练数据集；(2) 震后紧急阶段先以预训练CNN-LSTM代理NN从地表观测快速反演基岩输入波，再调用EBEGPU-Urgent内核执行一次高保真3D非线性正向分析；若波形误差超阈值则启动动态微调-再分析交互式精化循环。采用multi-spring本构模型实现高保真土壤非线性响应。在Miyabi-G超算(GH200节点)上验证。

Result: 在Miyabi-G超算上：CPUGPU-Harvest(m=4,4节点)相比CRSGPU基线，能耗降低76%(22.2MJ→5.40MJ)，吞吐提升3.7倍，100个训练case仅需263节点小时；EBEGPU-Urgent在128节点上771秒(12.1分钟)完成14500步分析，相比4节点CRSGPU加速11.4倍。神户和新潟中越冲两种地震场景验证：仅基于单点P2地表观测，30分钟内可估计全域地震动分布，一阶估计SI值相对误差3-7%，经一轮动态精化后降至3%；P1处未学习验证点波形L1相对误差从0.128/0.119降至0.073/0.084，基岩输入波误差从0.110/0.113降至0.066/0.081。整体相比传统方法计算资源消耗降低97.9%以上。

Conclusion: 所提出的耦合高保真物理模拟与代理NN的统一HPC工作流成功实现了日常运行期的资源采集与紧急期的快速响应：CPUGPU-Harvest使能耗降低76%、吞吐提升3.7倍，EBEGPU-Urgent配合NN实现紧急决策时空内的12分钟以上扰动一阶估计和25.3分钟内精化估计，相比传统方法节省超97.9%计算资源。该框架建立了连接日常HPC利用效率与紧急决策的范式，可推广至多种非线性时间演化问题的实时反演与辨识分析。

Abstract: We propose an Urgent Interactive HPC workflow that dynamically integrates high-fidelity 3D nonlinear analysis with surrogate neural networks (NNs) to enable rapid decision-making during large-scale earthquakes. This approach achieves both "Resource Harvesting", which utilizes idle computing capacity during non-emergency periods, and immediate response during crises. By developing two specialized HPC kernels, the proposed method reduces energy-to-solution by 76% and improves throughput by 3.7-fold during normal operations to efficiently construct training datasets, while during emergencies, it couples NN-based inverse analysis with physics-based simulations and dynamic refinement to reduce conventional computational costs by over 97.9%, enabling the generation of highly reliable spatial time-history ground motion distributions within 30 minutes post-earthquake.

</details>


### [207] [DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec): A Sandbox Infrastructure for Effective Agentic Training at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22978)
*Jialiang Huang,Hongxuan Tang,Jingchang Chen,Yuxuan Liu,Yixiao Chen,Yuan Cheng,Yi Tao,Jingli Zhou,Yupeng Chen,Haoyu Chen,Jiarui Wang,Shengkai Lin,Chuqi Zhang,Bryan Lee Teng,Lian Guo,Zhe Fu,Wenjun Gao,Yisong Wang,Liang Zhao,Zehao Wang,Ziwei Xie,Yongqiang Guo,Peixin Cong,Ziyi Gao,Shuiping Yu,Hanwei Xu,Zuofan Wu,Zhizhou Ren,Yuyang Zhou,Bowei Zhang,Zhihuan Huang,Qihao Zhu,Lei Wang,Tianle Lin,Han Yu,Jiewen Hu,Dejian Yang,Shuo Yang,Shanghao Lu,Shaoyuan Chen,Junjie Qiu,Zhangli Sha,Yinmin Zhong,Yongtong Wu,Shiyu Wang,Wei Liu,Bingzheng Xu,Longhao Chen,Qiushi Du,Yuzhen Huang,Shirong Ma,Yaohui Wang,Mingshu Chen,Tongrui Xiong,Y.C. Yan,Haowen Luo,Haofen Liang,Xiaokang Zhang,Weihao Zeng,Runxin Xu,Peiyi Wang,Jinhua Zhu,Ruoyu Zhang,Wenkai Yang,Qi Tang,Jiping Yu,Tian Ye,Ruizhe Pan,Honghui Ding,Xiaodong Liu,Lingxiao Luo,Zhihong Shao,Yuhan Wu,Jibai Lu,Wen Liu,Haoling Zhang,Jingcheng Hu,Yaoyang Ye,Chaofan Lin,Zhaochen Zhang,Jianan Tong,Hengxu Wu,Zhihao Li,Yicheng Wang,Luyao Wang,Yuzhuo Bai,Lingyue Fu,Ruifan Xu,Y.Z. Wang,Zonglin Li,Mingqi Wei,Haiyang Shen,Chengyuan Zhang,Chao Jin,Zili Zhang,R.H. Yang,Xinbo Xu,Jian Zhou,Ruidong Zhu,Yuzhe Guo,Zelun Pan,Shaoheng Nie,Erhang Li,Shuhan Lin,Zheng Liu,Anshuo Chen,Zilong Lyu,Sinuo Cao,Rui Yu,Chuhao Wang,Junyi Guo,Junxiao Song,Kaifeng Chen,Menghao Ye,Junxian Li,Di Wu,Haiyang Ma,Yilun Wang,Haoran Yang,Yizai Cai,Shichun Liu,Yiping Wang,Junbo Sun,Shicheng Xu,Xiao Bi,Ying He,Yichao Zhang,Mingxing Zhang,Liyue Zhang,Panpan Huang,Wenfeng Liang,et al. (31 additional authors not shown)*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: DSec是DeepSeek构建的生产级沙箱基础设施平台，专为大规模LLM智能体训练与评测设计。它通过统一SDK暴露多种沙箱后端（FnCall、容器、microVM、全VM），结合可组合环境层、内存共享/回收、QoS感知的CPU调度及按需镜像加载机制，单个生产单元约160节点可承载380K并发沙箱、5,000+创建/秒、日均3百万沙箱实例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体训练和评测需要大量隔离、有状态、可长时交互的执行沙箱，呈现突发式创建、高密度部署、长生命周期、镜像多样性高、运行环境不可信等特点。单一沙箱运行时难以满足这些需求，因此需要一套弹性执行平台来支撑大规模智能体强化学习训练。

Method: DSec采用四方面核心技术机制：(1)基于EROFS+overlayfs的可组合环境层，独立版本化管理base image、workspace和toolkit，将O(m·N)/O(k·N)重建成本降至O(m)/O(k)；(2)高密度资源管理，microVM通过virtio-pmem+DAX消除页缓存冗余，结合DAMON+balloon free-page reporting回收空闲内存，并通过SCHED_IDLE+core scheduling实现QoS感知的CPU调度；(3)基于3FS分布式文件系统的按需镜像加载，将元数据本地化、数据按需批量读取、写操作保留本地；(4)与RL框架协同设计，将rollout执行从可抢占的GPU训练中解耦，实现基于暂停/恢复的资源回收，并通过AppArmor与eBPF实现细粒度访问控制以缓解智能体作弊行为。

Result: 生产规模：单个scale unit约160节点、30K核心、250TB DRAM，单日服务约3百万沙箱实例，峰值并发380K，持续5,000+创建/秒。评估结果：按需EROFS镜像加载较eager Docker pull完成时间提速1.71倍，累计磁盘写入减少57%；EROFS可组合层较tar.gz解压方案提速1.76倍；virtio-pmem+DAX降低峰值主机内存40.2%，DAMON+FPR降低时间积分内存消耗21.2%；SCHED_IDLE+core scheduling在50% BE负载下将SMT延迟膨胀从45.2%降至17.3%。

Conclusion: DSec通过集成多种沙箱后端、可组合环境层、内存优化、QoS感知调度、按需镜像加载及与RL框架的协同设计，为大规模LLM智能体训练和评测提供了可扩展、可抢占安全的执行基础，是智能体RL基础设施的关键组成部分。

Abstract: Large-scale agentic training and evaluation with large language models (LLMs) rely on isolated, stateful execution environments in which models inspect repositories, invoke tools, execute commands, and interact with task-specific services. These workloads create sandboxes in large bursts, span heterogeneous functionality and isolation requirements, retain state across long interactions, and draw from large image corpora with limited reuse. Supporting them therefore requires an elastic execution platform rather than a single sandbox runtime. This report presents DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec), a production sandbox platform that exposes FnCall, container, microVM, and full-VM sandbox backends through a unified SDK. DSec coordinates placement and lifecycle management across the cluster, composes environments from independently versioned layers, combines memory sharing, reclamation, and CPU scheduling for high-density execution, and loads image data on demand from Fire-Flyer File System (3FS), a cluster-wide distributed filesystem. DSec is co-designed with the reinforcement learning (RL) framework, decouples stateful rollout execution from preemptible GPU training, coordinates sandbox lifecycle with training to preserve rollout state while reclaiming idle resources, and mitigates agent misbehavior such as reward hacking. A single production-scale unit of DSec spans around 160 nodes, serving about 3 million sandboxes per day; in production, it supports over 380,000 concurrent sandboxes and sustains over 5,000 sandbox creations per second. Our evaluation and deployment experience show that these mechanisms reduce environment setup and image-distribution overhead, improve memory efficiency, and preserve latency-sensitive performance under high-density overcommit.

</details>


### [208] [Silent Failures at the $2^{32}$ Boundary: A Technical Report on Large-Tensor Matrix Multiplication in PyTorch's Apple MPS Backend](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22991)
*Junichiro Niimi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文是关于PyTorch在Apple Silicon MPS后端上，针对元素数量超过2^32的大张量进行批量矩阵乘法（bmm）时存在静默失败（silent failure）的技术报告。报告系统性地测量了从PyTorch 2.4.1到2.14.0共11个版本中的错误行为，提出了三条规则解释所有错误结果，并在真实情感分类任务中验证了影响，同时发布了一个防护工具来阻止涉及2^32及以上元素的MPS操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着Apple Silicon统一内存达到192GB及以上，将超过2^32个元素的张量放置在桌面GPU上变得常规。然而，PyTorch的MPS后端在处理这种规模时存在静默失败：升级到macOS 27.0后，原本会产生显式错误的bmm操作现在会返回错误结果而不引发任何异常或警告。这类静默错误在深度学习框架中尤其危险，因为它们不会被任何机制标记，且会对模型训练和推理造成难以察觉的损害。

Method: 作者在单台Mac Studio (M2 Ultra, 192GB, macOS 27.0)上进行系统性边界扫描测试bmm操作。具体方法包括：(1) 在PyTorch 2.14.0上进行完整扫描（1584次运行），覆盖两种dtype（fp32、fp16）、四种内存布局（contiguous、a或b转置、切片）、六种形状、42个批次大小（4096至65538）；(2) 在10个早期版本上进行简化扫描；(3) 使用索引编码输入来精确定位错误来源（从输出元素解码出实际读取的输入元素）；(4) 候选边界包括2^31个元素、2^32个元素和2^32字节；(5) 以CPU float64计算为参考；(6) 26个测试用例的一轮测试套件覆盖多种操作和11个版本；(7) 在CUDA（A100, TF32禁用）上进行对照实验；(8) 使用Hugging Face的cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest模型在TweetEval数据集上进行案例研究；(9) 开发并评估一个TorchDispatchMode防护工具，阻止涉及2^32及以上元素的MPS操作。

Result: PyTorch 2.14.0完整扫描的1584次运行中，1273次正确，214次抛错，97次静默错误。三条规则解释了1088次随机输入运行的所有结果：(1) 当输出超过2^32元素且操作数是转置视图时，整个输出错误，等同于忽略该操作数步长的计算；(2) 当连续输入超过2^32元素时，仅超出部分之后的批次错误，其索引在2^32处环绕；(3) 视图操作数达到2^31元素时抛错，更大的问题反而会使显式错误变成静默错误。错误元素的最大相对误差在1.4-2.2之间。在情感分类案例中，批次大小为2048时，1365之后的683个文本全部损坏，其中661个被预测为neutral（中性类），总体准确率从0.713降至0.639，负面和正面类的召回率降至几乎为零。所有11个版本中都存在静默失败问题。在CUDA上bmm正确，但torch.arange在2^32元素之上也出现静默错误。防护工具在所有5240次运行中阻止了所有481次静默错误，运行开销在大张量工作负载中可忽略不计。

Conclusion: 本研究系统性地记录了PyTorch MPS后端在大张量（≥2^32元素）bmm操作上的静默失败行为，证明了该问题在11个PyTorch版本中持续存在，会在实际工作负载中产生严重影响（如情感分类中三分之一的输出损坏并坍缩到单一类别）。三条规则能够准确预测所有观察到的结果，错误源自32位索引溢出和步长忽略。防护工具（阻止涉及2^32及以上元素的MPS操作并在到达设备前分块）可以有效消除所有静默错误。局限性包括：所有MPS结果来自单台机器、单种操作系统版本，扫描仅覆盖bmm而其他操作为抽样测试，规则是基于有限配置的事后拟合，未测试梯度计算。该报告为使用大内存Apple Silicon机器的研究者提供了可重现的问题记录和实用缓解方案。

Abstract: Apple Silicon machines with 192GB or more of unified memory make it routine to place tensors with more than $2^{32}$ elements on a desktop GPU. We show that PyTorch's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend silently returns wrong results for batched matrix multiplication at this scale. On macOS 27.0, this http URL , and therefore this http URL and eager attention, returns relative errors above 1 without an exception or a warning, in every PyTorch release from 2.4.1 to 2.14.0 that we tested. On one machine, we sweep bmm over two dtypes, four memory layouts, six shapes and 42 batch sizes between 4096 and 65538 (1584 runs on PyTorch 2.14.0, and a reduced sweep on ten earlier releases), and judge every result against a float64 computation on the CPU. Three rules account for every outcome on 2.14.0. When the output exceeds $2^{32}$ elements and an operand is a transposed view, the entire output is wrong and equals a computation that ignores the strides of that operand. When a contiguous input exceeds $2^{32}$ elements, only the batches beyond that point are wrong, and they equal a computation whose index wraps around at $2^{32}$. Operands that are views with at least $2^{31}$ elements raise an exception instead, so a larger problem can turn an explicit error into a silent failure. A control on CUDA is correct for bmm, although this http URL is silently wrong above $2^{32}$ elements there as well. In a public sentiment classifier, one oversized batch corrupts a third of the outputs and collapses them onto a single class. The study is black-box: we report what the backend returns, compared with reference results. We release the sweep harness, the raw results and a guard that stops any MPS operation touching $2^{32}$ or more elements at this https URL .

</details>


### [209] [Accurate Simulation of Distributed Training Jobs with Network Contention Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23278)
*Yeonho Yoo,Hyunho Lee,Hyunmok Choi,Chuck Yoo,Gyeongsik Yang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: MoSim 是一种 GPU 集群模拟器，通过无 GPU 特征化（GPU-free characterization）和动态网络竞争模型，准确模拟分布式训练作业在不同调度策略下的执行时间，显著降低了相比现有模拟器（Tiresias、Pollux）的 JCT 和 makespan 仿真误差，并大幅降低了输入构建开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GPU 集群模拟器在处理网络竞争时存在两类局限：无竞争模拟器（如 Tiresias、Gavel）完全忽略共运行作业间的网络竞争；静态竞争模拟器（如 Pollux、Muri）则使用固定的惩罚系数（如统一增加 10% 训练时间）。实验表明，网络竞争可使训练时间增加最高 114%（平均 33%），导致现有模拟器在 JCT 上产生最高达 73.64% 的 MAPE 误差，无法准确支持调度策略的 what-if 分析。

Method: MoSim 结合两大核心技术：1) **无 GPU 特征化**：使用作业级模拟器（如 ASTRA-sim）替代真实 GPU profiling，获取每个作业的 compute time、networking time 和 networking volume；2) **动态网络竞争模型**：根据调度器产生的 worker assignment，将每个作业的 networking volume 转换为各 server NIC 的带宽需求，结合 ring all-reduce 通信模式计算带宽分配比例，得出每作业每时刻的 contention factor S_J(t)；3) **离散事件仿真**：在每个 arrive/complete 事件时更新竞争因子，将迭代时间建模为 τ_J(t) = T_comp + T_net · S_J(t)，逐事件推进模拟。

Result: 在 13 小时、60 个作业（来自 Philly trace）的 trace 上，使用 4 台 8-GPU V100 服务器（32 GPU）作为 ground truth 进行评估：相比 Tiresias 和 Pollux，MoSim 将平均 JCT 仿真误差最高降低 3.28×、P99 JCT 最高降低 7.79×、makespan 最高降低 8.48×；NIC 竞争因子估计误差仅 8.63% MAPE（优于 Tiresias 的 29.69% 和 Pollux 的 21.05%）；在 JCT 分布层面，KS 距离和 Wasserstein 距离均显著优于基线；输入构建开销从 41.2 GPU 小时降至 2.7 CPU 小时，成本降低 44.6×。

Conclusion: MoSim 通过将网络竞争从"忽略或固定惩罚"提升为"由调度决策和作业通信特征动态推导"，实现了对分布式训练作业执行时间的高保真模拟。其无 GPU 特征化方法消除了对真实硬件 profiling 的依赖，大幅降低输入构建成本。该工作表明，网络竞争建模是实现忠实 GPU 集群仿真的关键因素，为调度策略评估和集群效率分析提供了更可靠的工具。

Abstract: Trace-driven simulation is widely used to evaluate distributed training (DT) jobs in GPU clusters, but existing simulators either ignore network contention or approximate it with a fixed penalty. This misses how scheduling decisions determine which jobs share server network interfaces and inter-server links, thereby changing networking time during training. As a result, our motivating experiments demonstrate that they incur large errors, reaching up to 73.64% mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) in average job completion time (JCT). This paper introduces MoSim, a GPU-cluster simulator that models DT job execution under dynamic network contention. MoSim combines GPU-free characterization with network contention model: it obtains each job's compute time, networking time, and networking volume without GPUs, then uses the current worker assignment to estimate how shared network interfaces affect each job's iteration time. Our evaluation shows that, compared with existing simulators, MoSim reduces simulation error for average JCT by up to 3.28$\times$, tail (99th-percentile) JCT by up to 7.79$\times$, and makespan by up to 8.48$\times$, while modeling NIC contention factors with only 8.63% error on average. By avoiding real-GPU profiling, MoSim also reduces input construction overhead by 44.6$\times$.

</details>


### [210] [Accurate Distributed Tracing for Large-Scale AI Infrastructure: Time Synchronization as a Foundation for Reliable Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23301)
*Hesham Elbakoury,Ankur Sharma*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: TempoTrace通过协同设计IEEE 1588v2 PTP时间同步与分布式追踪，解决大规模AI基础设施中因时钟精度不足导致的分布式追踪静默失败问题，在异构多租户GPU集群中保持因果顺序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模AI基础设施中分布式追踪因时钟精度不足而静默失败：因果事件被错误排序，故障归因被破坏，性能诊断不可靠。NTP级别时钟在WAN/云条件下导致25-30%的有向操作对出现因果反转。

Method: 1) 基于Laplace重尾噪声模型分析因果反转率；2) 通过GPUDirect RDMA硬件时间戳将GPU到主机时间戳不确定性从2.1 us降至0.056 us；3) 使用sub-100 ns PTP同步；4) 有界Sketch Vector Clock跟踪因果关系（四方参与者假阳性率<10^-5）；5) 基于规则与XGBoost的混合诊断引擎；6) 形式化证明的多租户隔离逻辑时钟域模型；7) RoCEv2/ECMP中基于P4的带内网络遥测纠正路径延迟不对称；8) 应用置信度策略允许工作负载指定精度需求及降级模式回退。

Result: NTP反转率44.978%（实测）；Laplace拟合在拥塞下优于高斯拟合（AIC比较）；多租户隔离逻辑时钟域；宏F1分数0.974（1,800事件语料库，McNemar p=1.25e-23）；路径延迟不对称纠正后归因准确率99.1%；512至16,384 H100 GPU规模评估（InfiniBand与RoCEv2）。

Conclusion: TempoTrace通过PTP同步、硬件时间戳、有界向量时钟和带内遥测的协同设计，为大规模异构多租户GPU集群提供高精度的分布式追踪能力，能显著减少因果反转并保持因果顺序。

Abstract: Distributed tracing in large-scale AI infrastructure fails silently when clock accuracy is insufficient: causal events are misordered, fault attribution is corrupted, and performance diagnoses are unreliable. We present TempoTrace, a system that co-designs IEEE 1588v2 PTP time synchronization with distributed tracing to preserve causal ordering across heterogeneous, multi-tenant GPU clusters. We formally prove that NTP-grade clocks produce causal inversions at 25-30% of directed operation pairs under WAN/cloud conditions (11.3% under LAN NTP). A Laplace heavy-tail noise model extends the analysis beyond Gaussian assumptions, giving a weighted expected misorder rate of 27.76% vs. 29.37% Gaussian, confirming robustness to tail shape. TempoTrace reduces GPU-to-host timestamp uncertainty from 2.1 us to a design target of 0.056 us residual standard deviation via GPUDirect RDMA hardware timestamping, with sub-100 ns PTP synchronization. A bounded Sketch Vector Clock tracks causal relationships with false-positive rate below 10^-5 for up to four participants. A hybrid rule-based and XGBoost diagnosis engine achieves macro-F1 0.974 in controlled validation (1,800-incident corpus; McNemar p=1.25e-23). A formally proven multi-tenant model provides isolated logical clock domains. For RoCEv2/ECMP fabrics, P4-based in-band network telemetry corrects path-delay asymmetry, yielding 99.1% attribution accuracy. Application Confidence Policies let workloads specify precision requirements and degraded-mode fallback. Evaluation combines physical five-node measurements (NTP inversion rate 44.978%, Laplace fit preferred over Gaussian by AIC under congestion) and controlled synthetic validation with illustrative configurations from 512 to 16,384 H100 GPUs across InfiniBand and RoCEv2 fabrics.

</details>


### [211] [Economical and efficient big data sharing with i-Cloud](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23438)
*Thepparit Banditwattanawong,Masawee Masdisornchote,Putchong Uthayopas*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为i-Cloud的云缓存淘汰策略，针对混合云环境中大数据共享所面临的非均匀数据输出成本问题。该方法利用多层感知器（MLP）自动调整窗口大小参数，综合考虑对象的大小、数据传输费用、延迟、访问频率和TTL来计算利润值，并优先淘汰利润最低的对象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大数据分布式共享通过云服务进行，但会导致网络拥塞、服务延迟和公共云数据输出费用增加。现有缓存淘汰方法未针对大数据和云计算场景优化，缺乏对混合云中非均匀数据输出费用的感知能力。

Method: i-Cloud算法核心是基于"同时邻近性"原则，当需要缓存淘汰时，从LRU对象集群中计算每个对象的利润（profit = size × cost × latency × frequency × TTL），淘汰利润最低的对象。关键参数窗口大小由MLP神经网络（结构为10,002/2/2/1）根据当前缓存状态和所需缓存空间自动预测。

Result: 基于31天的BO和NY追踪数据进行仿真，i-Cloud在成本节约方面最高可节省14.78%（年节省4425美元），在byte-hit率上比LRU、GDSF和LFU-DA高出17.24%，延迟节省高出17.96%，缓存命中率高出29.33%。即使仅基于均匀成本模式训练的数据集学习，在非均匀成本环境（混合云）中仍表现良好。

Conclusion: i-Cloud是高效且经济的大数据共享缓存淘汰方案。其基于MLP的自调优窗口大小机制使其能适应不同工作负载，且在从单一私有云扩展到混合云时仍能保持优良性能，证明了其泛化能力和长期部署可行性。

Abstract: Big data can be hosted on cloud and being shared distributedly through cloud services in an unprecedented volume, variety and velocity. This causes not only cloud network congestions and delayed cloud services but also increases in public cloud data-out charges. Client-side cloud cache alleviates these problems. Furthermore, cloud cache must be aware of nonuniform data-out costs when big data is stored in hybrid clouds built with different public cloud providers. Deploying i-Cloud approach as the core mechanism of cloud cache could save data-out cost up to 14.78% or 4,425 USD saved per annum based on our representative scenario, and delivered 17.24% byte-hit, 17.96% delay-saving and 29.33% cache hit outperforming LRU, GDSF and LFU-DA approaches. A main finding is that i-Cloud, learning uniform cost patterns, could perform well against nonuniform cost environment.

</details>


### [212] [Conflicting Pattern Formation by Teams of Anonymous, Fully Disoriented Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23454)
*Animesh Maiti,Prakhar Shukla,Subhash Bhagat*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究了两组匿名、无记忆、完全丧失方向感的移动机器人在二维欧几里得平面上同时解决两个相互冲突的模式形成问题：一组执行聚集(gathering)，另一组执行圆形成(circle formation)。机器人在不知道队友身份的情况下，必须同时完成任务。作者针对半同步(semi-synchronous)、非刚性运动(non-rigid movement)的完全无方向机器人，提出了一种分布式算法PatternFormation()，解决了此前需方向一致性假设才能解决的问题。算法仅要求聚集组具备全局弱多重检测能力，圆形成组具备局部弱多重检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的冲突模式形成问题研究[Bhagat et al.]要求机器人具备"仅方向轴一致性(direction-only axis agreement)"，即所有机器人的坐标轴方向(但不一定朝向)一致。该假设在完全无方向(disoriented)场景下不成立。本文旨在探索在更弱的模型——完全无方向、无共同手性(chirality)的机器人下，该问题的可行性，从而扩展冲突任务研究的适用边界。

Method: 提出三阶段算法：(1) 多重点创建阶段(multiplicity creation phase)——将配置从Non-Dense归约至Dense(|Sout|≤4)，利用中心轴对称性选取"枢轴集(pivotal set) P'(t)|维持最小包围圆SEC不变；通过StepIn/StepAside/StepOut三种运动原语(参考点为O(t)或准正则中心cq)，将聚集组机器人汇集至唯一稳定多重点pm。(2) 聚集阶段——ℛg向pm做direct/step-aside运动。(3) 圆形成阶段——ℛf在|R(t)|≤Nf+1时触发，按径向顺序向S(t)边界做step-out运动。引入准正则性(quasi-regularity)定义系统处理无方向下的对称性分类(非对称、单对称轴、准正则)，并设计碰撞规避的运动规则集(Table 1)。

Result: 主定理(Theorem 1)：在SSYNC调度、非刚性运动、完全无方向的匿名无记忆机器人集合R=Rg∪Rf下，若|Rg|≥6, |Rf|≥2，初态各机器人位置互异，Rg具有全局弱多重检测能力，Rf具有局部弱多重检测能力并知晓|Rf|值，则PatternFormation()在有限时间内终止，实现Rg全部聚集至一点、Rf全部位于同一圆上互异位置。算法共建立7条引理，分别证明无碰撞运动、多重点唯一性与稳定性、聚集有限时收敛、圆形成有限时收敛等性质。Observation 1还证明了n≥8时线性配置是准正则但非自由路径准正则的。

Conclusion: 成功将冲突模式形成问题从"方向一致性"模型扩展至"完全无方向"模型，消除了轴一致性假设。算法的关键创新在于：(i) 利用准正则中心cq与SEC中心O(t)作为参考点协调对称/非对称配置；(ii) 通过枢轴集保持SEC稳定；(iii) 区分聚集组与圆形成组的多重检测强度需求。局限：仍需|Rg|≥6、|Rf|知识，算法为半同步(未达完全异步)，且在多重点含Rf机器人时聚集与圆形成阶段可能交叠产生临时不稳定多重点。未来工作包括：扩展至完全异步无方向机器人，以及移除|Rg|≥6与|Rf|已知两项假设。

Abstract: Two groups of autonomous, anonymous, and oblivious mobile robots are deployed in the two-dimensional Euclidean plane, each assigned a distinct task. We study a setting where the two groups must simultaneously solve two conflicting pattern formation problems: the \textit{gathering problem}, where robots gather at a point not known to them a priori, and the \textit{circle formation problem}, where robots occupy distinct positions on the boundary of a circle. Although each robot knows its own task, it cannot identify other members of its group. A prior solution~\cite{Conflict-1} addressed this problem for asynchronous robots having {\it direction-only axis agreement} and {\it global weak multiplicity detection} capability available to all robots in both groups. In contrast, in this work, we consider fully {\it disoriented robots} without any axis agreement or common \textit{chirality}. We study the feasibility of a solution to this problem for {\it disoriented robots}. We propose a distributed algorithm that solves the problem for semi-synchronous disoriented robots with non-rigid movements. Our proposed algorithm assumes global weak multiplicity detection only for the gathering group, while for the circle formation group, it requires local weak multiplicity detection.

</details>


### [213] [Explicit State and Resource Contracts for Low-Precision Pipeline Parallel Training under Captured Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23536)
*Genlang Chen,Junyi Zhu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: QEffect 是一个面向 FP8 低精度流水线并行训练的运行时契约系统，通过形式化四个核心不变量（状态时序、生成代所有权、缓存版本、双向流同步），解决了 CUDA Graph 重放与延迟缩放、分离反向（split-backward，如 1F1B、Zero-Bubble）调度之间的语义冲突，避免了跨流数据竞争和静默数值损坏，并在 H800 上实现 1.82–2.79× 的图捕获加速及额外的 1.132× 直接梯度放置加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CUDA Graph 通过固定虚拟地址重放张量操作来消除启动开销，但 FP8 流水线训练中延迟缩放状态、微批次和延迟反向任务不断变化；split-backward 调度打破传统 LIFO 生命周期；标准数据流图无法表达隐藏数值更新、非 LIFO 工作所有权和缓存有效性，导致跨流静默数据损坏。已有方案（编译器 IR token、TE CUDA Graph、Megatron、GraCE 等）均未统一处理这些关系。

Method: 设计 QEffect 显式状态与资源契约，形式化四个不变量：(1) 隐藏缩放更新的时序序列化（设备 token + 持久 FP8 状态）；(2) 保留反向资源的生成代所有权（逻辑 action 标识 TapeKey/物理引用 TapeRef，generation-checked）；(3) 跨优化器边界的缓存有效性版本（weight epoch 与 cache epoch 分离，首个 microbatch 强制刷新）；(4) 调用方-图流的双向完成同步（caller-to-graph wait + graph-to-caller event）。另外提出仿射直接梯度放置机制，预绑定 main_grad 消除中间副本。基于 TorchTitan GraphPP 与 NVIDIA TE 2.18 实现，支持 1F1B 与 ZB-V 调度。

Result: 在 H800 PCIe 与 RTX 5880 Ada 上：捕获路径较 native eager TE 加速 1.82–2.79×（Interleaved 1.82–2.79×，ZB-V 1.82–2.70×）；直接梯度放置消除每 rank-step 96 次矩阵拷贝，带来额外 1.132×（H800）/1.138×（Ada）加速。正确性：与 native TE full-backward 在延迟缩放滚动、跨 amax-history 等条件下逐张量比特级匹配（20 步 28 类检查零失配）；600 次跨流单向同步在 3 进程中 100% 触发陈旧读，双向协议消除全部数据竞争；7 类合同违规注入在首次非法操作处被拒绝；DCP checkpoint 在步骤 3 保存后从步骤 8 继续恢复，与未中断执行完全一致；C4 5,000 步预训练满足 5% 困惑度非劣性准则。固定工作量下 PP=2→PP=4 强扩展效率 68.28–68.49%。

Conclusion: CUDA Graph 仅保留地址与张量操作，不保留隐藏状态或保留反向工作的语义。QEffect 通过显式化状态顺序、资源所有权、权重版本和设备完成这四个缺失关系，使急切执行与捕获图执行都能匹配 native TE 完整反向（跨越延迟缩放滚动），确定性地拦截跨流排序异常，并保证冷启动恢复正确。一旦这四个关系被显式化，图捕获即可在避免混淆地址与状态的前提下保持流水线并发性。

Abstract: CUDA Graphs eliminate launch overheads by replaying tensor operations over static virtual addresses. However, FP8 pipeline training continuously alters the scaling states, microbatches, and deferred backward tasks that those fixed addresses represent. Split-backward schedules (e.g., 1F1B, Zero-Bubble) decouple input-gradient ($dI$) and weight-gradient ($dW$) computations to minimize bubbles, breaking traditional LIFO lifecycles. Standard dataflow graphs cannot inform the runtime of hidden numerical updates, non-LIFO work ownership, or cache validity, leading to silent cross-stream data corruption. We present QEffect, an explicit state and resource contract runtime for low-precision pipeline training. QEffect formalizes four foundational invariants: (1) temporal serialization of hidden scaling updates, (2) generational ownership of retained backward resources, (3) validity versioning for cached weights across optimizer boundaries, and (4) bidirectional caller-graph stream completion synchronization. These invariants uniformly govern eager and captured execution, allowing ephemeral graph resources to be cleanly rebuilt across process restarts. Leveraging work-ownership semantics, we also introduce an affine direct-gradient placement mechanism that eliminates redundant memory copies. Integrated with TorchTitan and NVIDIA Transformer Engine, QEffect maintains strict bitwise parity with native baselines across delayed-scaling rollovers, deterministically traps cross-stream ordering violations, and enables flawless cold-start resumption. On NVIDIA H800 GPUs, captured Transformer layers achieve 1.82--2.79x speedup over eager execution, while direct gradient placement delivers an additional 1.132x gain by eliminating 96 matrix copies per rank-step.

</details>


### [214] [SAGE: Optimal-Stopping Peer Selection for Decentralised Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23773)
*Ke Xiao,Qiyuan Wang,Christos Anagnostopoulos*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE（Sequential Anchor-Gated Exchange），将去中心化联邦学习中的对等节点选择问题重新建模为有限阶段最优停止问题。接收方利用其持有的锚点数据对候选邻居打分，仅在统计置信度证书满足时提交选择，否则回退到随机gossip。论文给出了锚点数量的阶最优上下界、保证所选节点不差于gossip的策略级保证，并实验证明"总是选择经验最优节点"的策略在所有配置下都输给随机gossip，而SAGE-OS以约25%的证据消耗达到与gossip相当的性能，通信开销约为两个已有方法的一半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化联邦学习中，无中心聚合器，每个客户端必须从本地邻居中选择一个进行模型交换。在非IID条件下，错误选择会提升本地损失。然而探查（评分）成本远低于模型交换成本（前者只涉及少量预测，后者需要完整参数负载），现有方法采用固定探查预算，对"易选"场景浪费探查、对"难选"场景又证据不足。核心问题不是"哪个对等节点排第一"，而是"现有证据是否足以支撑排序"。

Method: 1. 问题建模：接收方在每轮需做三选一决策——选定某个邻居、获取更多证据、或放弃回退到随机gossip。该问题被建模为"一模型交换预算下的有限阶段最优停止问题"，外选项为随机gossip。2. 置信度门控：使用嵌套锚点调度M={m1<…<mL=mmax}，基于Hoeffding不等式构造阶段统一置信半径rℓ，当经验最优与次优的经验风险差>2rℓ时证书触发。3. 最优停止：定义归一化探查成本λ=c0/χ，将探查成本折算为风险等价单位；构造Bellman递推J^sel、J^RG、J^cont，当C_{ℓ+1}^probe≥[Aℓ+2rℓ]+时停止（继续探查连完美信息也无法收回成本）。4. 理论分析：证明锚点数量上下界Θ(M²Δk⁻²log(1/δ))；证明总是提交策略无法获得策略级保证；证明存在可分性阈值，低于该阈值任意探查预算均无法优于gossip；证明稠密邻居应早于稀疏邻居停止。5. 算法：SAGE-OS（带成本感知停止）、Vanilla SAGE（仅置信门控，到mmax才放弃）、SAGE-NF（不放弃，总选择经验最优）、AQ-128（固定预算控制）。

Result: 实验覆盖2个图像基准（FMNIST、CIFAR-10）×2种图（ER≈7.35度、BA≈5.64度）×3个异质性水平（αDir∈{0.05,0.1,0.3}）共12配置×8方法。主要发现：（1）总是提交策略AQ-128和SAGE-NF在所有12个配置上都输给随机gossip，均值精度0.3509/0.3531 vs RG的0.3782；（2）可放弃的Vanilla SAGE和SAGE-OS恢复至gossip水平（均值0.3763/0.3750）；（3）SAGE-OS消耗24.5%固定预算 vs Vanilla SAGE的49.5%和AQ-128的52.3%，节省75.5%证据；（4）SAGE-OS模型交换通信开销为1.000，PENS为1.784，PFedDST为1.980（约为后两者的一半）；（5）SAGE-OS在7/12配置上超过gossip，4/12配置上是8方法中最优；（6）可分性阈值理论预测得到验证：随异质性降低（αDir增大），邻居趋同，gossip回退率升至>95%。

Conclusion: 本文重新定义了去中心化联邦学习对等节点选择的研究问题：从"如何排序"转向"证据是否足以排序"。SAGE将置信度门控与成本感知的最优停止相结合，理论上证明了锚点调度的阶最优性和不劣于gossip的策略级保证，并揭示出总是提交策略内在的不安全性。实验表明该方法以一半通信开销与两个已发表选择器竞争或胜出，并节省四分之三的探查证据。主要局限：锚点风险是混合后效用的有噪声代理；λ为固定值、δ和调度未做扫描；运行时间为评估次数而非秒数；CIFAR-10/ER/α=0.05下过度早停导致单一配置性能下降；未量化跨种子离散度。

Abstract: Decentralised federated learning replaces server aggregation with peer-to-peer model exchange, making collaborator selection a local decision under uncertainty. Fixed probe budgets waste effort on easy choices yet fall short when peers are hard to distinguish. We propose SAGE (Sequential Anchor-Gated Exchange), an optimal-stopping peer selector under a one-model-bearing-exchange budget. A receiver scores candidate neighbours on receiver-owned anchor evidence and selects once an advantage is certified. It continues probing only while further evidence repays its cost, and otherwise falls back to random gossip. We show that the stopping problem admits an optimal rule attained at a finite stage, and that the anchor schedule is order-optimal in the peer-risk gap and the confidence level. We further show that the selector never returns a peer worse than random gossip with high probability, and prove that no such guarantee holds for selectors that commit without a certificate. A separability threshold follows, below which no probing budget improves on gossip. Experiments span two image benchmarks, two graph families and three heterogeneity levels. Selectors that always act on their evidence lose to gossip in every configuration tested. SAGE-OS matches gossip on 75.5% less evidence than a fixed budget, at half the communication overhead of two published selectors. The operative decision is not which peer to rank first, but whether the evidence justifies ranking at all.

</details>


### [215] [Byzantine Causal Reliable Broadcast (BCRB) with Constant-Size Message Metadata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24018)
*Purv Patel,Ajay D. Kshemkalyani*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种异步拜占庭因果可靠广播（BCRB）协议，通过将因果排序逻辑从底层BRB中解耦，实现了常数大小O(1)的消息元数据开销和O(n²)的通信字复杂度（优于现有协议的O(n³)）。论文给出了密码学版本（基于门限加密）和非密码学版本，通过ACK捎带解密份额防止抢跑，并基于独立指数链路延迟模型概率化地分析了弱安全性和强安全性违反概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的拜占庭因果可靠广播（BCRB）协议要么依赖于向量时钟等线性O(n)大小的元数据，要么通过昂贵的全序广播（O(n³)复杂度）来保证因果顺序，吞吐量受限且难以扩展到大网络。同时，在异步拜占庭系统下，不使用密码学就无法同时确定性地保证强因果安全性和活性，这促使作者寻找轻量级的概率性解耦方案。

Method: 将因果排序层叠加在标准O(n²)的Bracha拜占庭可靠广播（BRB）之上。发送方将加密载荷立即通过BRB广播，并将解密份额捎带在带外点对点ACK中传播。接收方维护一个依赖图G=(N,E)，通过FIFO检查、解密份额法定集合（n-f个份额）以及无出边条件来释放消息。序列门控（sequence gating）技术通过局部物理时钟时间戳避免依赖图成环。同时提出了算法3/4的变体，将ACK通过BRB广播以获得100%弱安全性保证。安全性违反概率通过Rényi表示和Gumbel渐近近似对指数链路延迟随机变量路径进行分析。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 算法1和2实现O(1)消息元数据开销和O(n²)通信字复杂度，且吞吐量可扩展；(2) 在f<n/3的容错条件下，弱安全性违反概率上界为O(f^{-3}·ln³f)，强安全性违反概率（密码学版本）上界为O(f^{-1}·ln²f)；(3) 算法3和4通过将ACK通过BRB广播实现100%弱安全性保证，但通信字复杂度升至O(n³)。表格1给出了与Auvolat等人和Cachin等人的协议的详细比较，证明该工作在消息大小、吞吐量可扩展性和概率安全性边界方面均具有优势。

Conclusion: 论文首次提出了具有O(1)元数据开销和O(n²)通信字复杂度的BCRB算法，并严格证明了弱安全性和强安全性违反的概率边界。这些低开销方案特别适用于社交网络等非关键应用，相比现有O(n³)通信复杂度的算法具有显著优势，同时通过提供BRB门控ACK的变体算法，在强一致性和性能之间提供了灵活的权衡选择。

Abstract: Asynchronous Byzantine Reliable Broadcast (BRB) is a fundamental primitive that guarantees agreement and validity in distributed systems subject to Byzantine faults, but it lacks ordering guarantees. In this paper, we address Byzantine Causal Reliable Broadcast (BCRB), which builds on BRB to enforce causal message ordering. We present a novel BCRB protocol that decouples causal ordering from the BRB layer, achieving constant-size $\mathcal{O}(1)$ message metadata overhead and $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ communication word complexity as against $\mathcal{O}(n^3)$ communication word complexity of existing protocols; here $n$ is the number of processes. We present two variants of our protocol: a cryptographic version using a threshold encryption scheme and sequence gating, and its non-cryptographic version. In the cryptographic version, senders broadcast ciphertexts immediately, and decryption shares are piggybacked on out-of-band ACKs, preventing early decryption and front-running. In both versions, causal safety is achieved probabilistically. We evaluate the probability of causal safety violations using a random variable path analysis under independent exponential link delay distributions. We show that both variants satisfy liveness and the probability of weak safety violation is bounded by $\mathcal{O}(f^{-3}\cdot\ln^3 f)$, where $f$ is the upper bound on the number of Byzantine processes, and $f < n/3$ and $f=\mathcal{O}(n)$. Further, for the crypto version, we show that the probability of strong safety violation is bounded by $\mathcal{O}(f^{-1} \cdot \ln^2 f)$. We also show how to modify our two protocols to guarantee 100\% weak safety keeping $\mathcal{O}(1)$ message space overhead but with $\mathcal{O}(n^3)$ messages and $\mathcal{O}(n^3)$ communication word complexity.

</details>


### [216] [A principled approach for energy-efficient training via phase-aware GPU frequency tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24205)
*Miguel Braga,Júlio Pinto,Rahma Nouaji,Olivier Michaud,Bettina Kemme,Oana Balmau,Cláudia Brito,Ricardo Macedo*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 PAFT，一种面向 AI 模型训练任务、基于阶段感知（phase-aware）与运行时自适应机制的 GPU 动态频率调优系统。其核心思想是将训练流水线中由各类瓶颈导致的 GPU 停顿视为能耗优化机会，而非纯粹的性能问题：当 GPU 因数据加载、预处理或计算不均衡等原因被迫空转时，PAFT 通过持续监控与细粒度调频，将 GPU 时钟频率降低至与瓶颈设备相匹配的节奏，从而在几乎不影响训练时延的前提下显著降低能耗。系统在 12 个常用模型上验证，能耗最高降低 46%，平均性能开销仅 4%，全面优于 Max Freq、GEEPAFS、Zeus 等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 AI 训练对算力的需求急剧增长，数据中心能耗与可持续性问题日益突出。训练流水线中由于数据加载、预处理、计算不均衡、同步等待及共享基础设施的资源争用，普遍存在 GPU 停顿与空转现象，导致大量能耗未转化为有效计算。现有的 GPU 动态电压频率调节（DVFS）方案（如 Zeus、GEEPAFS 等）通常依赖离线 profiling、忽略阶段差异、采用全局统一频率，或不感知流水线结构，难以在异构且易变的基础设施环境下取得良好的能耗–性能平衡。

Method: PAFT 以守护进程方式部署于每个计算节点，主要包含四个组件：（1）Probing 模块：通过在训练脚本与 NCCL 集合通信层中注入轻量级探针，精确测量每个流水线阶段（数据加载/预处理、内存传输、前向、反向、同步、权重更新）的起止时间与持续时长；（2）Hardware Profiler：基于 LATEST 工具刻画 GPU 频率切换延迟矩阵，识别足够长、可承受切换开销的阶段；（3）Profiling and Merging：先以最大频率进行在线 profiling 建立基线，再将过短阶段合并到相邻阶段，并检测外部瓶颈（GPU 间空闲）与内部瓶颈（GPU 间计算不均衡）；（4）Frequency Enforcer：基于 Algorithm 1，对每个 GPU 单独决策，对最慢 GPU 提速、对非最慢 GPU 按 σ 阈值逐步降频，并通过滑动窗口与基线对比检测基础设施变化，触发重新 profiling。核心策略是：当 GPU 注定空转时，主动延长其 GPU-active 阶段的执行时间以匹配瓶颈节奏。

Result: 实验平台为 4×A100 SXM 80GB 服务器（PyTorch 2.6.0 + NCCL 2.21.5），涵盖 12 个模型（图像分类、分割检测、NLP）。关键结果：（1）整体训练中，PAFT 平均相对最大频率降低 EDP 17%（峰值 37%），平均性能开销 4%（最差 11%），全面优于 GEEPAFS（5%）和 Zeus（7%）；（2）瓶颈场景下，慢数据加载时 ShuffleNet 上 EDP 提升达 46%，ResNet-101 达 26%；计算不均衡时 BLOOM 提升 24%、Llama 16%，开销均 ≤6%；（3）分布式训练（2/4 节点）下，I/O 密集型模型 EDP 提升最高 33%，计算密集型能耗节省最高 22%，开销 ≤4.6%；（4）探针开销近乎为零（<1%），频率切换开销隔离验证；（5）σ 敏感度实验显示，PAFT 在 σ=5%–15% 范围内均能遵守性能边界，而 GEEPAFS 频繁超出预设阈值。

Conclusion: PAFT 通过阶段感知 + 在线 profiling + 每 GPU 独立调频三位一体的设计，突破了传统 DVFS 方案在粒度、适应性与瓶颈感知方面的局限，在异构、易变的基础设施上实现了能耗与训练时延的良好权衡。该系统对训练语义与模型收敛无影响，可推广至分布式训练及其他可分解为阶段的并行训练场景，架构上通过驱动抽象还可支持 AMD 等非 NVIDIA GPU。论文同时讨论了向推理负载与阶段预测等方向的扩展可能。

Abstract: Modern AI model training imposes unprecedented computational demands, making it a key contributor to datacenter energy consumption. Yet a significant fraction of the energy consumed during training does not translate to useful computation due to bottlenecks throughout the training pipeline. We present PAFT, a phase-aware, dynamically adaptable GPU frequency tuning system that reduces energy consumption of training workloads with minimal performance overhead. The key insight behind PAFT is that bottlenecks represent an energy optimization opportunity, rather than purely a performance problem: when GPUs are bound to stall, PAFT opportunistically reduces their clock frequencies to match the pace of bottlenecked devices, saving energy without impacting execution time. PAFT achieves this by continuously monitoring pipeline behavior and applying fine-grained frequency adjustments, adapting to workload and system changes. Experiments conducted on twelve widely used models show that PAFT consistently outperforms all baselines, achieving energy savings of up to 46% with an average overhead of 4%.

</details>


### [217] [Toward GPU-Resident Climate Models: A Feasibility Study on Lossy Compression for the Spherical Harmonic Transform's Communication Bottleneck](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24294)
*Lorenzo Breschi,Flavio Vella*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文研究了GPU常驻有损压缩作为减少球谐变换(SHT)中MPI全局pencil转置开销的方案，使用ZFP固定率压缩替代简单的float16截断。结果表明ZFP rate-16在相同通信开销下精度比float16高1600倍，而ZFP rate-8在更高加速比下精度仍优于float16。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前ECMWF IFS等业务伪谱大气模型仍运行在CPU上，GPU移植正在进行中。SHT每时间步需要两次全局all-to-all通信（pencil转置），在大规模节点时通信主导墙钟时间，成为GPU加速的瓶颈。简单的float16截断虽然能减半消息大小，但误差不可控，可能随时间步累积影响预报精度。需要一种原则性的替代方案。

Method: 1)使用DYAMOND高分辨率数据集中的温度和臭氧场作为代表性输入；2)在NVIDIA A100 GPU上使用cuZFP后端测量ZFP固定率压缩吞吐量；3)使用SimGrid网络模拟器在Dragonfly拓扑（4-121节点）上建模端到端通信时间；4)在CRESCO8集群CPU分区进行真实硬件验证通信趋势；5)对比ZFP rate-16、rate-8与float16截断在精度和通信时间上的差异。

Result: ZFP rate-16（16位/值）在相同存储预算下达到与float16相当的通信加速（~1.95倍），但平均相对误差为2.5×10⁻⁷，比float16的4×10⁻⁴低1600倍。ZFP rate-8（8位/值）实现3.97倍加速，是float16的约1.93倍，平均相对误差为10⁻⁴，仍比float16好4倍。CPU压缩在大规模NWP弱可扩展场景下不可行。CRESCO8真实硬件测量验证了模拟趋势。

Conclusion: ZFP固定率压缩的精度-性能权衡严格优于float16截断。GPU常驻压缩是必要的（CPU压缩不可行）。随着伪谱气候/NWP代码向GPU迁移，这种压缩通信方案值得社区考虑。建议未来探索自定义大气场压缩器、第二列转置的压缩以及端到端预报精度评估。

Abstract: Operational pseudospectral atmospheric models such as the ECMWF Integrated Forecasting System (IFS) run today almost exclusively on CPUs; GPU ports are under active development but not yet used in production. These models rely on the Spherical Harmonic Transform (SHT). Each time-step requires forward and inverse SHTs, and both passes depend on global pencil transposition that redistribute multi-dimensional arrays across compute nodes. At large node counts these global collectives dominate wall-clock time. We investigate GPU-resident lossy compression, using representative fields from the DYAMOND high-resolution operational dataset as input, and combining measured GPU compression throughput with SimGrid network simulation, we show that ZFP at 16 bits per value (rate-16), about the same storage budget as float16, matches the communication-time reduction of float16 truncation while delivering approximately $\mathbf{1600\times}$ lower mean relative error. ZFP at 8 bits per value (rate-8) achieves approximately $\mathbf{1.93\times}$ the speedup of float16 while retaining $\mathbf{4\times}$ lower mean relative error.

</details>


### [218] [Bridging the Vendor Gap: Enabling AMD GPU Support for Awkward Array via ROCm/HIP for the HL-LHC Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24628)
*Ianna Osborne,Maxym Naumchyk,Tai Sakuma,Andres Rios-Tascon,Peter Elmer*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了为Awkward Array添加AMD ROCm/HIP GPU后端的工作，通过Rust内核引擎rawkward实现。作者发现简单的CUDA到HIP源码移植会在不规则内核上损失5–10倍性能，并提出了一套优化模式（循环平坦化、128位向量化加载、拆分融合内核、性能分析驱动的启动配置）来恢复CUDA级别的性能。在MI210上实现了相对128核EPYC CPU最高12.5倍的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HL-LHC时代需要数量级的分析吞吐量提升，而当前的Scikit-HEP/Awkward Array栈以CUDA为主，在El Capitan、Frontier、LUMI等AMD加速器系统上无法运行。论文动机是弥合这一"厂商差距"，实现跨供应商的性能可移植性。

Method: 1) 用Rust实现rawkward内核引擎，提供ROCm/HIP后端；2) 使用macro-and-match模式实现后端无关的单一调用点，分派到供应商特定的内核策略；3) 应用四种关键优化：循环平坦化（消除波前内分支发散）、float4 128位向量化加载（提升内存吞吐）、拆分融合内核（HIP上反其道而行）、性能分析驱动的启动配置；4) 利用Rust类型系统在编译期保证缓冲区大小和生命周期的正确性；5) 使用Criterion框架进行统计学驱动的基准测试（每个配置100个样本）。

Result: 在双插槽AMD Instinct MI210节点（della-milan）上，HIP后端相对128核EPYC 7763 CPU的加速比为1.03×（带宽受限的sum）到12.5×（count）不等。countnonzero达9.5×，argmax/argmin/max/min/prod在4.8–5.6×区间。GPU启动延迟约35–36μs。Rust CPU内核在十二个测试内核上对C++基线的几何均速比为0.37×，总体上明显更快。

Conclusion: HIP内核与CUDA内核的"厂商差距"源于架构差异（64通道波前 vs 32线程束，分散代价更高等），而非工具链成熟度问题。通过一套可复用的小型优化模式以及Rust宏分派层，可恢复CUDA级别的性能同时保持API不变和内存安全。这为HL-LHC时代实现真正硬件无关的HEP分析栈提供了一条可行路径。

Abstract: The High-Luminosity LHC (HL-LHC) will demand order-of-magnitude gains in analysis throughput, and increasingly those gains must come from GPUs that are not made by a single vendor. Leadership-class systems such as El Capitan, Frontier and LUMI are built on AMD accelerators, yet the Scikit-HEP analysis stack---and Awkward Array in particular---has grown up CUDA-first. We report on $rawkward$, a Rust-backed kernel engine that adds a ROCm/HIP backend for Awkward Array's nested, jagged, variable-length data structures. Our central finding is that a naive source-level port of CUDA kernels to HIP loses $5$--$10\times$ in performance on irregular kernels, because AMD's $64$-lane wavefronts, higher register pressure and more expensive divergence behave fundamentally differently from NVIDIA's $32$-thread warps. We show that a small, reusable set of optimization patterns---loop flattening, $128$-bit vectorized loads, splitting fused kernels, and profile-guided launch configuration---recovers CUDA-class performance without changing the public API. A Rust macro-and-match dispatch layer keeps a single, backend-agnostic call site while emitting vendor-specific kernel strategies, and the type system enforces buffer-size and lifetime correctness at compile time. On a two-socket AMD Instinct MI210 node we measure GPU speedups from $1.03\times$ (bandwidth-bound $sum$) up to $12.5\times$ ($count$) over $128$ EPYC~7763 CPU cores, and the Rust CPU kernels match or beat on aggregate the incumbent C++ kernels (geometric-mean runtime ratio $0.37\times$ across twelve kernels). We argue that these patterns constitute a practical recipe for performance-portable, vendor-agnostic HEP analysis kernels.

</details>


### [219] [Analytical Power-Aware Provisioning for Prefill-Decode Disaggregated AI Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24639)
*Mingyuan Yan,Haiyu Wang,Linxuan Biao,H. Jonathan Chao,Sai Qian Zhang,Wenqi Cui*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对预填充-解码（PD）分离式AI推理架构，提出了一套解析建模框架，用于在给定工作负载与硬件条件下联合评估服务容量与功耗，从而实现面向功耗感知（power-aware）的实例配置（provisioning）决策。该框架推导了耦合KV-cache预留机制下的解析服务容量模型（刻画prefill与decode池的耦合及排队影响），并建立了基于归一化服务吞吐量的负载相关功耗模型；两者结合可生成候选部署下的"服务容量–功耗"帕累托前沿，支持最小功耗部署选择及在受电网功率约束下的灵活调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心电力供应日益紧张，AI推理负载（尤其是LLM推理）成为电力消耗的重要来源。现有的PD分离式推理资源配置方法主要依赖仿真或经验测量，缺乏解析模型来刻画资源配置（prefill/decode实例数量）如何决定服务容量与功耗之间的权衡，也无法解析地捕获KV-cache预留引起的prefill与decode之间的耦合关系。

Method: 1) 基于roofline原理分别为prefill（计算受限，依赖FLOPS与MFU）和decode（带宽受限，依赖内存带宽与MBU）建立单实例服务容量解析模型；2) 建立KV-cache内存平衡方程，显式建模decode池中三类占用（prefill预留、active decode占用、剩余容量），其中prefill侧占用通过Little定律及Kingman排队近似获得等待时间，从而解出受KV-cache约束的运行batch大小B（形成关于B的三次方程，存在唯一解）；3) 建立功耗模型，将每实例功耗建模为关于归一化服务吞吐量（实际/容量）的截顶线性（capped-ramp）函数；4) 将上述模型组合生成离散"服务容量-功耗"帕累托前沿，将整数规划式资源provisioning问题转化为在Pareto前沿上的几何搜索。

Result: 在Qwen3-32B + H200 + SGLang 0.5.9实验平台上进行验证：固定长度工作负载下服务容量MAPE仅1.2%、功耗MAPE 2.3%；在Mooncake与Azure生产trace衍生工作负载上（不重新校准模型参数），服务容量MAPE分别为3.0%与1.6%，功耗MAPE为2.7%与2.6%；模型与实测Pareto前沿上对最小功耗可行部署的选择一致率达85%-90%，不一致均发生在可行边界附近；案例研究展示了请求率下降时缩减实例（3p2d→3p1d）节省~560W，以及在固定请求率下临时移除decode实例可在短时间内节省~620W但带来TTFT显著上升，揭示了效率与灵活性的边界。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了PD分离式推理系统中通过解析方法刻画"服务容量-功耗"权衡的可行性，所建模型可在不同工作负载分布与硬件平台间通用，无需重复profile；其生成的Pareto前沿为面向电网响应的高效推理provisioning提供了可解释且计算简便的决策依据，能够支撑最小功耗部署选择以及电网受限场景下的灵活降容运行。

Abstract: Power availability increasingly constrains the operation of AI inference fleets, creating a need for provisioning methods that jointly consider serving capacity and power consumption. Prefill--decode (PD) disaggregation has emerged as a prevalent architecture for large-scale inference serving. However, determining the appropriate numbers of prefill and decode instances is challenging because serving capacity depends jointly on workload characteristics, hardware constraints, queueing, and KV-cache reservations. Existing approaches largely rely on profiling and simulation, providing limited analytical insight into how provisioning decisions shape the tradeoff between serving capacity and power consumption. This paper develops an analytical framework for power-aware provisioning of PD-disaggregated AI inference. Given an inference workload and hardware, the framework models the serving capacity and average power consumption of a provisioned deployment. The serving-capacity model is derived from the joint distribution of input--output lengths and hardware compute and memory limits. In particular, it explicitly captures the coupling between prefill and decode induced by KV-cache reservations, as well as the impact of request queueing. On this basis, the power model determines per-instance power consumption as a function of normalized serving throughput. Together, the models determine the serving capacity--power Pareto front among candidate provisioned deployments, enabling the service provider to choose a provisioned deployment as the workload or available power changes.

</details>


### [220] [Mitigating Front-Running Attacks through Fair and Resilient Transaction Dissemination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24713)
*Wassim Yahyaoui,Joachim Bruneau-Queyreix,Jérémie Decouchant,Marcus Völp*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出HERMES，一种新型的区块链mempool信息传播协议，通过使用健壮的最小化（robust minimal）覆盖结构来优化数据传播、负载均衡，并在存在故障和拜占庭节点的情况下保证公平性，从而防御front-running攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代区块链的交易生命周期（包括交易创建、传播以及共识层区块传播）需要高效、公平且容错的信息传播机制。现有的mempool协议（如L{Ø}）虽能缓解部分安全威胁，但如果公平性未在最底层的传播层中根本性地嵌入，仍然无法应对front-running等攻击。

Method: HERMES的核心方法是：1）随机化选择overlay（覆盖网络）结构，使得信息传播路径不可预测；2）利用robust minimal structures（健壮最小化结构）来优化数据传播并均衡负载；3）要求节点证明其遵守mempool传播策略以及服从随机选择结果，从而抵御拜占庭行为者。

Result: 实验结果表明，相比传统的广播协议，HERMES在许可链（permissioned）和非许可链（permissionless）场景下均实现了显著的性能提升（包括传播效率和公平性）。

Conclusion: HERMES通过在传播层嵌入公平性保障机制，能够有效防御front-running等攻击，同时提升区块链mempool的数据传播性能，适用于多种区块链架构。

Abstract: In modern blockchains, efficient, fair, and faulttolerant information dissemination is critical for performance and security. Several stages of the transaction lifecycle are affected, from the creation and dissemination of transactions to the dissemination of blocks in the consensus layer. Mempool protocols, such as L{Ø}, already address some of modern blockchains' security threats. However, others remain unless fairness is embedded most fundamentally in the dissemination layer used by these protocols to share transactions and blocks and to reconcile mempools. This paper introduces HERMES, a novel dissemination protocol for mempools that leverages robust minimal structures to optimize data propagation, balance load, and ensure fairness despite faults and Byzantine actors. Specifically, we address front-running attacks by randomizing the choice of an overlay structure while forcing nodes to prove adherence to the mempools' dissemination policies and the random choice made. Experimental results show significant performance improvements compared to traditional broadcast protocols for both permissioned and permissionless blockchains.

</details>


### [221] [Tiga: Compiling Graph Message Passing at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24802)
*Mingyuan Chi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Tiga 是一个面向图消息传递程序的即时编译器，通过多层 IR 分离程序语义与执行细节，支持 CPU/GPU 后端、分页超出设备内存的图执行以及分布式运行，在生成式关系工作负载上相比 PyTorch/PyG 实现了更低的运行时和显存占用，并支持十亿边规模的单 GPU 前向计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图消息传递是学习算法、物理仿真和数值求解器的通用表达方式，但当程序被写成一系列张量操作时，交互结构和数据移动会被掩盖；在内存受限设备上物化连接和中间消息也容易耗尽显存。现有系统要么是算子库，要么在表达能力或容量上存在局限，缺乏一个能统一处理稠密/稀疏/动态生成关系并兼顾内存分层与分布执行的公共编译基底。

Method: 设计基于 MLIR 的多层中间表示（Domain / Iter / Kernel / Task-Storage / Tensor），分别保留关系结构、reducer 代数、坐标遍历、内核调度以及存储与依赖关系；提供 JIT 编译、relation-aware 遍历特化、关系生成与聚合融合、反向模式自动微分；后端通过 NVIDIA provider 调用 Triton，CPU 通过 LLVM；运行时通过分页 CSR、页大小的设备暂存缓冲区实现超出显存容量的执行，并通过 partition ownership 与 halo exchange 扩展到分布式执行；Python 接口与 PyTorch tensor 及 autograd 互操作。

Result: 在匹配 PyTorch/PyG 的 forward 对比中，存储 CSR 实现 1.49–1.97× 加速，动态 radius 在 131,072 点上对 PyG 达 ~44×（1.84 ms vs 80.24 ms）且分配仅为 PyG 的约 1/17；exact kNN 在 131,072 点速度为 PyG 的 2.28×、分配 13.50 vs 121.13 MiB，跨六个规模对 PyG 加速 2.28–12.06×；十亿边单 GPU（16 GiB）分页 forward 中位数 414.25 s，原生 GPU 峰值 10.27 GiB；Stanford Bunny EdgeNN 在特征宽度 8 时总耗时从 2.71 ms 降至 1.54 ms、峰值从 172.25 MiB 降至 32.34 MiB，但宽度 32 时反向重计算使其总耗时高于 Torch eager；两 GPU NCCL 分布式测试中均分行分割下 paired-rank 关键路径比单卡慢端更慢（44.22 ms vs 23.00 ms），负载均衡仍是开放问题。

Conclusion: 将关系、reducer 代数与微分需求作为编译器可见信息保留下来，能够在 CPU/GPU 上进行目标无关的 lowering，并显式控制存储驻留与分布式所有权；在测量范围内生成式关系减少了中间存储和运行时间，分页使十亿边图可在显存受限单卡上 forward 计算；但小 halo 与异构负载平衡尚不足以自动带来分布式加速，且某些路径（如宽特征 EdgeNN 反向、CUDA 分页反向、kNN 生成反向）仍存在性能或能力缺口，端到端训练吞吐与超主机内存容量仍是未来工作。

Abstract: Graph message passing offers a common way to express learning algorithms, physical simulations, and numerical solvers. Efficient execution depends on interaction structure and data movement, which can be obscured when a program is expressed as a sequence of tensor operations. On memory-constrained systems such as laptops, materializing connectivity and intermediate messages can also exhaust device memory. We present Tiga, a just-in-time compiler that separates the definition of a message-passing program from how its interactions are traversed, computed, and stored. Tiga preserves graph relations and reducer algebra in a multi-level intermediate representation, enabling traversal specialization, fusion of relation generation with aggregation, and reverse-mode automatic differentiation. Backend-specific lowering targets CPUs and GPUs. Its runtime extends execution beyond device-memory capacity by streaming graph partitions from disk through host memory with page-sized device staging buffers; partition ownership and halo exchange extend the same programming model to distributed execution. A Python interface interoperates with ordinary PyTorch tensors and autograd for forward and backward computation. Numerical checks validate outputs and gradients for differentiable workloads. A differentiated geometric workload characterizes the memory--time tradeoff of fused forward and backward execution. Evaluation against matched Torch and PyTorch Geometric baselines demonstrates reduced runtime and device-memory use for generated-relation workloads, while offloaded forward execution processes billion-edge graphs on a single memory-limited GPU. Measurements on heterogeneous devices further characterize the communication and load-balance costs of distributed execution.

</details>


### [222] [Who Pays for the KV Cache? Attributing Shared AI Inference Spend Across Kubernetes and LLM Provider Bills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24991)
*Timothy Urista*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个开源工具 unalloc，它能将 Kubernetes 分配的 OpenCost 数据、网关日志以及 OpenAI/Anthropic 等 API 厂商的账单合并到统一账本中，并量化"无人认领"的支出比例。通过五个案例研究，揭示了 AI 基础设施成本归因在不同系统边界处存在的系统性失真与统计陷阱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业在自托管推理（Kubernetes）与外部 API（按 token 计费）之间存在割裂的账本系统，难以统一核算 AI 成本归属。当前缺乏工具和方法来识别和量化跨系统边界处的成本归因失败，特别是"无主支出"（unallocated spend）的真实规模。

Method: 1. 工具设计：开发 unalloc 工具，连接 OpenCost（K8s 资源分配）、LiteLLM（网关日志）、OpenAI/Anthropic（API 账单）三个数据源，生成精确统一账本并报告无主份额。2. 五个案例研究：(a) 类 vLLM 服务模拟器（分页 KV 内存 + 前缀缓存）；(b) PyTorch transformer 多租户追踪（真实 KV 缓存）；(c) 张量并行与流水线并行推理；(d) CLI 对接模拟 API；(e) 四个下游用例。3. 对比计量规则：token 计量 vs. 时间均摊计量在 H100 GPU 上的归因差异。4. 与近期基于 Shapley 值的能源归因方法对比定位。

Result: 1. **Pod 标签陷阱**：多 Pod 部署中，若仅在 LeaderWorkerSet 的 leader pod 上设置 owner 标签，则该部署 66% 的 GPU 账单无主；当回退到 Helm chart 名称作为自然键时，61% 被归到该 Helm chart，而表观无主份额降至 4%。2. **重复计数问题**：启用所有数据源会使网关支出被双重计算。3. **账单 API 采样偏差**：仅读取账单 API 一页即报告四分之一的支出。4. **内部计量规则决定成本分配**：在 H100 上运行 vLLM 时，token 计量器比均分时间计量器向检索密集型租户多分配 12-14 个百分点的账单（在所有测试负载下）。5. **GPU 利用率与负载**：配置负载 2-16 req/s（完成 3.7-26.9 req/s）时，GPU 利用率 97-99%，功耗随负载变化。6. 两种计量器均非"真值"，需结合上下文解读。

Conclusion: unalloc 是一个可复现的开源工具，能精确统一跨系统的 AI 支出账本。案例研究表明，AI 成本归因在系统边界处存在多种系统性陷阱（标签缺失、回退键掩盖问题、双重计数、采样偏差），且内部计量规则的选择会显著影响租户间成本分配。研究呼吁对归因方法保持透明，代码与数据完全可复现。

Abstract: Organizations pay for AI through disconnected ledgers: Kubernetes allocations for self-hosted inference, gateway logs, and per-token bills from API providers. We present unalloc, an open-source tool that joins OpenCost, LiteLLM, OpenAI and Anthropic cost data into one exact ledger and reports the share of spend with no owner, and use it to study where attribution breaks at the seams between these systems. Five case studies run inference for real or simulate it: a vLLM-style serving simulator with paged KV memory and prefix caching; a PyTorch transformer serving a multi-tenant trace with a real KV cache; tensor- and pipeline-parallel inference on this http URL ; the unmodified CLI against mock provider APIs; and four downstream use cases. At the seams, in a constructed multi-pod deployment scenario -- one month of synthetic OpenCost allocations, not observed billing data -- owner labels set only on LeaderWorkerSet leader pods leave 66% of that deployment's GPU bill unowned, and the natural fallback key assigns 61% of it to a Helm chart name while the headline unallocated share falls to 4%; enabling every source double counts all gateway spend; and reading one page of a billing API reports a quarter of spend. Inside a shared inference server the metering rule decides who pays: on an NVIDIA H100 running vLLM, a token meter assigns a retrieval-heavy tenant 12-14 percentage points more of the bill than an equal time-share meter at every load tested, while GPU utilization reads 97-99% across configured loads of 2 to 16 requests per second (3.7 to 26.9 completed requests per second; the configured rate counts session-initial arrivals only) and power draw tracks load. Neither meter is a ground truth; we position these results against recent Shapley-based energy attribution. Code, raw data, captured evidence, figures and the paper regenerate from the repository.

</details>
