TL;DR: 本文提出 TicTacBench——首个以"后布局布线(post-PnR)时序收敛"为核心评估目标的 RTL 编码智能体基准。包含 30 个任务，使用开源 EDA 工具链(Yosys/OpenROAD/OpenSTA 等)进行自动评估。基于 8 个前沿 LLM 驱动的智能体、超过 300 次实验，结果显示即使最佳智能体(GPT-5.4)也只能闭合 53.3% 的任务，且时序优化几乎都伴随面积退化(ADP 平均退化 7.18%)。通过轨迹语义分析归纳出 6 类失败模式，并据此提出 TicTacSkill 方法，将时序闭合率最高提升 9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RTL 基准(如 VerilogEval、RTLLM v2、RTL-OPT 等)主要评估功能正确性与 PPA，但忽略了"时序收敛(timing closure)"这一硬件设计中决定设计是否真正可用的关键能力。现有基准仅依赖综合阶段的预 PnR 指标(WNS/TNS)，对后 PnR 静态时序分析的预测存在高假阳性，且无法评估智能体是否具备通过时序反馈驱动 RTL 级修复的能力。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 1) 任务构造：从 RTLLM 2.0 与 RTL-OPT 中精选 25 个关键路径来自算术/流水线/控制逻辑的设计，并派生出 5 个允许改变延迟的任务，共 30 个；每任务提供次优 RTL、SDC 时序约束、等价性验证、预/后 PnR STA 报告。
2) 评估流程：智能体在沙盒中使用工具集(编译、等价性检查、预 PnR STA，禁用后 PnR STA)，提交优化 RTL 后经接口/功能/延迟校验，再由 LibreLane+OpenROAD+OpenSTA 全流程重新实现。
3) 4 个指标：时序闭合率、WNS 改善率、EDDP(能延平方积)、ADP(面延积)。
4) 轨迹语义分析：导出 240 条完整轨迹，使用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 作为分析 LLM，跨智能体横向对比成功与失败轨迹，聚类得到 6 类失败模式。
5) TicTacSkill：将 6 类失败模式编码为 6 条标准操作程序(SOP)，即插即用地引导智能体完成关键路径定位、数据通路设计、流水线设计、控制/译码放置、证据驱动搜索、预/后 PnR 失配处理。

Result: 1) 整体结果：GPT-5.4 智能体时序闭合率最高 53.3%，DeepSeek V4 Pro 的 Avg.ΔWNS% 最高(55.9%)；所有智能体 EDDP 平均改善 8.83%，但 ADP 平均退化 7.18%；23% 的任务无任何智能体能闭合；MiniMax M2.7 是唯一 Avg.ΔWNS% 为负的智能体。
2) Pareto 分析：GPT-5.4 主导 18/30 任务最多，MiniMax M2.7 被主导 7/30 任务最多。
3) 6 类失败模式分三组能力：(a) RTL 领域知识：低效的 STA 报告驱动优化、次优数据通路设计；(b) RTL 架构设计：次优流水线设计、次优数据/控制通路设计；(c) 优化流程：探索、发现；(d) TicTacSkill 验证：GPT-5.4 闭合率 53.3%→56.7%，WNS% 48.7%→66.4%；MiniMax 闭合率 23.3%→36.7%(最大提升)；DeepSeek Flash 闭合率 33.3%→43.3%，WNS% 44.6%→62.1%。
4) 相关性：闭合率与"低效 STA 报告驱动优化"呈强负相关(-0.70)，与"次优数据通路设计"呈强正相关(+0.81)。

Conclusion: 本文将"智能体驱动时序收敛(ATC)"确立为编码智能体的新评估目标，证明当前最先进 LLM 驱动的智能体在真实硬件实现约束下仍存在显著能力差距。TicTacBench 为推动 RTL 智能体从"生成功能正确的模块"迈向"解决实现约束的硬件优化任务"提供了可复现的评测基础。TicTacSkill 表明，将轨迹分析得到的失败模式转化为可复用的 SOP 引导可有效提升智能体的时序修复能力。未来工作将扩展任务规模与多样性以覆盖更广泛的 RTL 时序收敛场景。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led to the emergence of coding agents capable of performing complex engineering tasks, including register-transfer level (RTL) design and optimization. Existing RTL benchmarks mainly evaluate functional correctness and performance, power, and area (PPA) of the generated RTL designs, leaving agents' ability for \emph{timing closure} under-evaluated. We propose TicTacBench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate coding agents' capabilities for RTL-level timing closure under post-place-and-route (post-PnR) evaluation. TicTacBench contains 30 diverse tasks, each provided with a suboptimal RTL design, realistic timing constraints, functional equivalence verification, and timing reports. With over 300 runs of coding agents driven by 8 frontier LLMs, we find that even the best agent can only close 53.3\% of tasks with 7.18\% area-delay product (ADP) degradation and 8.83\% energy-delay-squared product (EDDP) improvement on average. We identify common failure categories that explain why agents fail to close timing. Then we propose TicTacSkill, a new method that guides agents to follow standard timing-closure procedures and improves the Timing Closure Rate by 9\%. These results suggest that while coding agents have made significant progress in RTL design, their timing-closure capability still has substantial room for improvement.

</details>


### [282] [Leaky-integrator reconstruction: taming error accumulation in recursive differenced time-series forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23378)
*Zijiang Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"泄漏积分器重建"(leaky-integrator reconstruction)——一种无需训练的修复方法，解决递归差分时间序列预测中的误差累积问题。核心思想是：将传统累积求和（离散积分器，极点在单位圆上导致误差发散）替换为泄漏积分器 H(z)=1/(1-γz⁻¹), γ<1,将极点移入单位圆内，从而有界化累积误差方差。使用单一固定参数 γ=0.9（在 H=336 步预测上于 20 个数据集、9 种架构上使 7 种发散架构的误差降低 43-74%,oracle 极点达 78%），且该方法在无病理情况下（稳定或联合预测器）可证明无害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归差分预测（即预测一步增量并通过累积求和重建水平值）是应对非平稳序列的经典方法（ARIMA、自回归神经预测器、DeepAR、TimesFM 等均使用此模式）。然而，累积求和等价于一个极点位于单位圆（z=1）上的离散积分器 1/(1−z⁻¹)，其每步误差被无界累积。作者指出这种积分对学习模型（其增量误差有偏且相关）是有害的：非线性模型在 336 步递归 rollout 下会发散，归一化 MAE 达 1.6-3.8（而良好基准约 0.8），远超不可约 √k 增长速率。这不是反馈本身固有的（teacher-forced rollout 累积同样多或更多），而是积分结构本身的问题。

Method: 作者提出泄漏积分器重建：在重建时刻将纯积分器替换为 H(z)=1/(1−γz⁻¹), 0<γ≤1,即递推公式 s_h = γ·s_{h−1} + Δŷ_{t+h}, ŷ_{t+h} = y_{t−1} + s_h。这相当于对预测增量流施加一阶 IIR 低通（指数加权积分器）。γ=1 退化为纯积分，γ=0 退化为纯持续性预测。<br><br>误差分析：<br>• 纯积分器下，误差方差 Var(ε_h)≈hσ²（白噪声情形），学习模型误差有偏且相关，故实际观察指数 α ≈ 0.44（理论白噪声为 0.5，轻度负相关 ρ≈−0.2 可解释）；<br>• 泄漏积分器下，Var(ε_h) → σ²/(1−γ²) 有界；γ 越小阻尼越强；γ 最优值取决于累积误差方差与真实趋势之比；发散时强阻尼，稳定时无需阻尼。<br><br>综合验证（Fig.1）：用 AR(1) 增量误差序列直接验证——白噪声得 α=0.50；ρ≈−0.2 重现经验值 0.44；泄漏滤波器将累积 RMS 限制于 1/√(1−γ²)（γ=0.98 时 5.0,γ=0.9 时 2.3），理论与实验吻合至 1% 内。<br><br>实验设置：20 个单变量目标序列，跨 10 个领域（加密货币、股指、商品、波动率、外汇、能源、气候、交通、ETT 传感器）；按时间顺序 70/10/20 划分（防止前视泄露）；z-标准化（仅用训练集统计量）使归一化 MAE 跨域可比。<br>9 种架构：linear-AR, MLP, LSTM, GRU, DLinear, 扩张 TCN, PatchTST, iTransformer, 小型 Transformer。<br>训练：单次（单种子）训练预测下一个标准化增量 Δz_t,从前 L=96 个增量输入,Adam 优化器（lr=10⁻³,batch=256）。<br>递归 rollout:每个测试序列最多 200 个步距间隔预测起点,自回归展开到 H=336 步;传统重建（γ=1 累积求和）或泄漏重建（Eq.2 一阶 IIR）;报告归一化 MAE = MAE/σ_train 在 H∈{24,96,192,336}。Oracle 上界:在 [0,1] 区间 13 点网格上扫描极点;默认部署用 γ=0.9。

Result: 诊断结果（Sec.3,Fig.2,Table 1）：在 5 个预测器（LSTM/GRU/DLinear/PatchTST/iTransformer）×16 数据集×7 视域基准下,差分预测增量 MAE 增长指数 α=0.44（架构独立,α∈[0.41,0.45],Table 3）,在 336 步增长 14×（vs 水平预测 5.0×）,与随机游走基线 α=0.41 一致（不可约速率,持续性最优）。这是 √k 下界;学习模型的增量误差有偏且相关,故纯积分器下 H=336 归一化 MAE 达 1.6-3.8。Teacher-forced rollout（每步从真实过去预测）累积同样多或更多（均值 H=336 nMAE: MLP/GRU/Transformer teacher-forced 2.3 vs 递归 1.8）,表明发散是积分结构而非反馈的问题。<br><br>主要修复结果（Sec.5,Table 3,Fig.3）：单一固定 γ=0.9 将 9 种架构（除稳定的 linear-AR 外）的 H=336 nMAE 从 1.6-3.8 拉回到 ≈0.87–0.97,即非线性架构误差降低 43-74%（Transformer 从 3.8→0.97,降幅 74% 最显著;oracle 极点达 78%）。Linear-AR 保持 γ=1 不变（错误变动 0%）。<br><br>逐数据集结果（Table 2）：固定 γ=0.9 在 20 个数据集中的 19 个上降低误差;递归发散的数据集（如 Traffic 7.07→1.06,Weather 2.93→1.06）改善显著;唯一例外是接近随机游走的 SP500（0.90→0.96,因本已稳定,阻尼反而略损）。<br><br>按视域（Fig.3a,Table 5）：改进随视域单调增长——H=24 时均值 ≈3%,H=96 时 23%,H=192 时 37%,H=336 时 51%（架构间 43-74%）。Transformer H=336 改进最大（74%）。短视域下固定极点可略过阻尼（负条目）。<br><br>按机制（Table 4）：发散在 near-stationary 序列（electricity/weather/temp/traffic）上最严重（纯 nMAE 3.53）,固定极点救至 1.10;drift 类（12 个）从 1.63 救至 0.98;structured（4 个 ETT）从 1.54 救至 0.45。三个种子标准差：固定 γ=0.9 误差稳定（std≤0.24 nMAE）,纯积分器不稳定（Transformer std=5.4）。<br><br>极点无需调优（Fig.5）：H=336 误差随 γ 平滑下降,γ≲0.9 后趋于平台;最佳 γ 随 H 增大而减小。固定 γ=0.9 几乎恢复 oracle 增益（MLP: 43% vs 46%;Transformer: 74% vs 78%）。在 (model, dataset) 验证集上选择 γ 达测试 nMAE 0.76,略优于固定 0.9（0.81）,接近 oracle（0.73）。<br><br>与直接多视域预测对比：直接多视域（direct-MH）是整体强基线,与本文方法结果接近,但 direct-MH 是独立、更宽的模型需独立训练;本文方法是重用现有一步预测器且零成本,两者互补。<br><br>范围（Scope）：本方法针对"积分过累积",不针对不可约 √k;对稳定线性递归（已不可约）和联合多输出预测器（从不积分）无效（≈0% 增益）。<br><br>实用指南（Sec.6）：部署仅两行代码修改（重建用 γ=0.9,无重训）,由一行诊断门控（仅当纯积分器误差在验证集上以超 √k 增长时才阻尼,否则稳定或联合模型保持 γ=1）。代价:零参数、零训练、推理时 O(H) 一阶滤波。

Conclusion: 本文识别出差分预测长视域失败的根因:其重建是极点位于单位圆上的离散积分器,故学习模型有偏的增量误差被无界累积,发散至不可约 √k 速率的数倍（高达 3.8 归一化 MAE）。贡献是将诊断转化为治愈:将极点置于单位圆内（单标量 γ 的泄漏积分器）可证明有界化累积方差;以固定 γ=0.9 后置应用、无需重训,即可在 20 个数据集上将 7 个发散架构的 336 步误差削减 43-74%,在原理、通用性、安全性三方面均设计严谨。理论上封闭的误差方差界、单参数零成本、与直接多视域方法的互补性,使该方法成为递归差分预测的安全通用默认方案。

Abstract: We introduce leaky-integrator reconstruction, a training-free method that cures the error accumulation of recursive differenced forecasting. Our first contribution is diagnostic: predicting one-step changes and integrating them by cumulative summation, the standard remedy for non-stationarity, is a discrete integrator with a pole on the unit circle, and we show this makes recursive rollout of a nonlinear model diverge, its 336-step error reaching several times that of a well-behaved forecaster (normalised MAE 1.6-3.8 versus about 0.8) across every neural architecture tested. Our second, central contribution is the fix: move the pole inside the unit circle with a leaky integrator H(z) = 1/(1 - gamma z^-1), gamma < 1, which provably bounds the accumulated error variance. Applied at reconstruction time with a single fixed gamma=0.9 (no retraining, a two-line change to any deployed one-step or foundation-model forecaster), it shrinks error at every horizon, the mean gain over seven diverging architectures and twenty datasets growing from ~3% at H=24 to 23% at H=96, 37% at H=192 and 51% (43-74% across those architectures) at H=336 (78% with an oracle pole). Crucially, it is provably inert where no pathology exists (stable or joint predictors already at the irreducible rate), making it a safe, general default.

</details>


### [283] [AgentBetta: Verification-Driven Adaptive Configuration of an AI Nano-Agent through Selective Expansion and Verified Contraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23512)
*Md. Ashraful Babu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgentBetta是一个验证驱动的自适应AI Nano-Agent框架，将智能体的可执行状态（模型能力、上下文、权限、内存、计算资源、执行边界等）视为运行时控制变量，通过验证驱动的诊断、选择性扩展和基于反事实验证的收缩机制，按任务需求动态调整能力配置。其核心贡献是提出了一个异构配置的闭环控制方法，在保持任务完成率的同时显著降低不必要的资源消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体系统通常采用预定义配置（模型、工具、权限、上下文等），但不同任务对这些能力的需求差异巨大。过度配置造成资源浪费、能力暴露过大及执行错误风险增加；过度精简则导致任务失败。研究动机是探索如何将异构可执行配置作为运行时控制变量，根据任务证据动态调整，在验证完成的前提下实现能力的最优分配。

Method: 1) 将可执行配置表示为X=(M,C,T,P,Mem,R,τ,I)的八维向量；2) 任务特征化后通过π₀(φ(q),H)生成初始配置；3) 执行后用验证器𝒱(sₜ,yₜ)判定pass/fail/indeterminate；4) 失败时通过诊断函数g识别具体缺陷维度D(f)⊆{M,C,T,P,Mem,R,τ,I}；5) 仅对诊断出的维度进行选择性扩展Γ⁺_D；6) 成功后在可控环境中进行反事实收缩Γ⁻_k，重新执行验证；7) 记录经验验证配置前沿ℋ用于后续任务的热启动。权限扩展需外部授权机制批准，不可由模型自主授权。

Result: 在AB-ConfigBench控制基准上，AgentBetta达到91.38%验证成功率（中位上下文从64,000降至8,000字符，中位工具暴露从5降至0）。配置缺陷诊断macro-F1达0.819，各维度精度均为1.000；选择性扩展避免了不相关维度的变更；56.41%的单维收缩探针在重新执行后仍保持验证。外部对比：BFCL上以+3.40pp优于匹配ReAct（adj.p=0.0103）但推理成本更低；在64任务BFCL子集上分别以+56.25pp和+74.48pp优于评估的AutoGen和CrewAI配置，资源消耗大幅降低。GAIA与Reflexion差异未达显著；SWE-bench试点中专用SWE-agent表现显著更优；跨模型家族实验未复现主骨干精度排序。

Conclusion: AgentBetta应被解读为一种配置适应机制，调节能力分配和推理开销，而非专用智能体架构的通用替代品。其核心贡献是将异构智能体能力视为显式、可观察、可调整的控制对象，其扩展与收缩以验证证据和政策约束为前提。结果支持自适应配置与反思推理、多智能体协作及领域专用程序脚手架互补而非互斥。未来方向包括跨更大模型家族评估、利用已接受的收缩证据学习更小更可靠的初始配置，以及将专用执行器本身视为可调用的能力选项。

Abstract: Large language model agents are typically deployed with predefined configurations, although the required model capability, context, tools, permissions, memory, and computational resources can vary substantially across tasks. This study develops and evaluates AgentBetta, an adaptive AI Nano-Agent framework that represents these factors as an executable configuration and updates them through verification-driven diagnosis, selective expansion, and verification-based counterfactual contraction. The evaluation distinguishes controlled mechanism validation from external agent comparisons. On the AB-ConfigBench benchmark, AgentBetta achieved 91.38% verified success while reducing median context allocation from 64,000 to 8,000 context characters and median tool exposure from five tools to zero compared with the fully provisioned configuration. The configuration-deficiency diagnosis achieved a macro-F1 score of 0.819 with precision of 1.000 across the evaluated dimensions, and selective expansion avoided unnecessary changes to unrelated configuration dimensions. Post-success contraction preserved verification outcomes in 56.41% of evaluated one-dimension contraction probes, indicating that some successful configurations contained removable capability under the tested conditions. External evaluations indicate that adaptive configuration can improve the balance between verified task completion and capability exposure; however, the results vary across benchmarks and agent families. In particular, the cross-family replication did not reproduce the primary-backbone accuracy ordering, and specialized systems remained advantageous for certain task domains. These results support interpreting AgentBetta as a configuration-adaptation mechanism that regulates capability allocation and inference expenditure rather than as a universal replacement for specialized agent architectures.

</details>


### [284] [Are Human-Aligned Models Models of Humans? A Turing-Test Gap in Preference Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23640)
*Suqin Yuan,Runqi Lin,Muyang Li,Guanzhe Hong,Jindong Gu,Lei Feng,Chris Russell,Tongliang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了人类偏好对齐（RLHF/DPO）会系统性地降低模型行为的人类相似度，定义了"图灵测试差距"（Turing-test gap），并证明直接拟合人类响应（Human-SFT）比偏好对齐更能恢复人类行为特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型常被用作人类的代理（模拟调查对象、复现行为实验等），但这些应用要求模型复现人类真实行为，而非仅仅产生人类偏好的回答。论文旨在揭示偏好对齐与人类行为对齐之间的本质矛盾。

Method: 论文从理论与实证两方面展开：(1) 形式化定义两种目标——人类偏好 p_P 与人类行为分布 p_H，推导偏好对齐保持人类行为的充要条件；(2) 在 SHP/StackExchange 等全人类数据集上进行权重实验和 DPO 实验，对比等权重模仿、偏好权重、随机权重的影响；(3) 评估 Human-SFT、Human-over-model DPO、提示工程三种干预对人类相似度的恢复效果。

Result: 理论证明：图灵测试差距仅在偏好奖励为常数时为零。实证发现：(1) 即使偏好与响应均来自人类，偏好加权（无论方向）都会降低模型对未见过人类响应的似然；(2) 该差距与偏好是否反映人类判断无关、仅由加权的非均匀性产生；(3) HH-RLHF/WebGPT/SHP 数据集中无证据表明人类偏好编码了所需的对数密度比；(4) Human-SFT 在源判别性、响应长度、问题内变异性上均能最一致地恢复人类行为，跨领域泛化有效；(5) DPO 即使在已拟合人类响应的检查点上也使模型偏离人类行为分布。

Conclusion: 人类相似度应被视为对齐的独立维度而非偏好对齐的副产品。使用偏好对齐模型作为人类代理可能属于"范畴错误"。直接以人类行为为训练目标（Human-SFT）能显著恢复人类相似度，但也需警惕其带来的冒名顶替与操纵风险。

Abstract: Human-feedback alignment has made language models useful assistants and is commonly described as aligning them with humans. However, the responses people prefer from an AI need not be the responses they themselves would give. We distinguish alignment with human preferences from alignment with human behavior, and show that alignment with human preferences can make model behavior less human-like even when both preferences and responses come entirely from humans. We call this the Turing-test gap. We show that preference alignment preserves the human response distribution only under a restrictive condition, and find no consistent evidence that real human preferences satisfy it. Empirically, the loss of human-response likelihood increases with the strength of preference weighting, regardless of its direction, and the gap also appears under standard DPO. These results establish human-likeness as an explicit dimension of alignment rather than something assumed to follow from preference alignment.

</details>


### [285] [PhysAI-Bench: A Benchmark for LLM-Based Agentic Decision-Making in Autonomous UAV-Centric Physical AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23695)
*Mohamed Amine Ferrag,Merouane Debbah,Abderrahmane Lakas,Manu Perumkunnil,Norbert Tihanyi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PhysAI-Bench 是一个针对 UAV 物理 AI 系统中 LLM 智能体决策能力的基准测试，包含 10,178 个从自主 UAV 任务对话轨迹中提取的决策实例，评估了 29 个基础模型，最佳模型 GPT-5.3 Chat 在 500 实例保留测试集上仅达到 52.00% 的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Physical AI 基准主要评估物理感知、直觉物理、具身导航和协作推理等能力，但很少评估可靠自主性所需的核心智能体决策能力。此外，现有基准很少使用真实自主执行轨迹来评估决策制定，且未明确防止未来信息泄漏，难以量化现代 Physical AI 基础模型的真实决策能力、鲁棒性和泛化性。

Method: 提出 PhysAI-Bench 框架：(1) 将自主 UAV 任务对话轨迹通过自动化 schema 驱动管道转换为标准化多选题决策实例，每个实例仅暴露决策时点前的信息，防止未来信息泄漏；(2) 采用两阶段评估协议——先在 35 实例人工验证开发集上对 12 种提示-温度组合（0/3/5-shot × {0.0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8}）进行 3 次运行配置选择，再冻结配置后在 500 实例剧集不相交的保留集上进行 3 次运行评估；(3) 使用 DeepSeek V4.1 和 Qwen3.8-Max 作为生成器，采用 answer-blind 候选生成、trace-derived 参考动作注入及答案-盲验证流程；(4) 通过聚类自助法在源剧集层级计算 95% 置信区间，并量化配置选择偏差（optimism gap）。

Result: 开发集上 xAI Grok 4.5 与 DeepSeek V3.2 并列最高（70.48%），Claude Haiku 4.5 达 68.57%。但在 500 实例保留集上，GPT-5.3 Chat 以 52.00% 取得最高准确率，GPT-5.2 Chat 为 49.40%，Grok 4.5 为 49.07%。所有模型均出现正泛化差距（2.28–26.29 个百分点），表明开发集性能系统性高估真实能力。Few-shot 提示通常提升性能，解码温度影响有限。高效模型（如 Mistral Small 2603 的 Accuracy/Second = 124.94）在准确率-效率权衡上优于前沿推理模型。

Conclusion: PhysAI-Bench 证明可靠的 Physical AI 智能体决策仍是未解决的开放挑战，当前最佳基础模型仅达 52% 准确率，远低于可靠自主性要求。两阶段协议揭示了开发集配置选择导致的显著乐观偏差，强调未来需要将基准扩展至机器人、自动驾驶、具身 AI 等更多物理 AI 领域，并融入多模态观测和更复杂的多智能体场景。

Abstract: Recent advances in Physical AI have accelerated the use of foundation models in autonomous systems such as unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), which must perceive, reason, plan, and act in dynamic environments. Existing benchmarks assess physical perception, intuitive physics, embodied navigation, and collaborative reasoning, but rarely evaluate the agentic decision-making required for reliable autonomy. We introduce \textit{PhysAI-Bench}, a benchmark for evaluating this capability. It contains 10,178 standardized decision instances automatically extracted from conversational traces of autonomous UAV missions. Each instance preserves mission context, temporal dependencies, physical constraints, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interactions, sensor observations, and AI-native 6G network conditions, including latency, packet loss, throughput, edge load, and network slicing. We expose only information preceding each decision, preventing future-event leakage and approximating online decision-making. We evaluate 29 foundation models using a two-stage protocol. We select model-specific configurations from 12 combinations of zero-, three-, and five-shot prompting and four temperatures, tested in three runs on a 35-instance, human-verified development set. We then freeze each selected configuration and evaluate it in three runs on a fixed, episode-disjoint set of 500 instances. GPT-5.3 achieves the highest accuracy (52.00%), followed by GPT-5.2 (49.40%) and Grok~4.5 (49.07%). Few-shot prompting generally improves performance, while temperature has limited influence. The results demonstrate that reliable agentic decision-making in Physical AI remains an open challenge. The dataset is available at this https URL

</details>


### [286] [ScholarStack: Layered Research Asset Orchestration and Cross-Task Reuse for Scientific Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23735)
*ScholarSeed AI Team,Ao Zhang,Caoqinwei Gong,Guanglei Wang,Haifan Zhang,Hanwei Zhang,Jiayi Sheng,Jihai Zhang,Kai Ying,Liyun Dai,Tingyu Zhu,Wei Chen,Wei Luo,Wenkai Fang,Xiaoyu Qiu,Xue Jiang,Yi Wang,Yuan Cao,Zheng Yu,Wotao Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ScholarStack提出了一种面向科学智能体的分层研究资产框架，将论文集合编译为三个互补层次的可重用、带版本控制和保留溯源信息的资产（L1源支撑事实、L2领域组织、L3限定范围跨论文综合），通过统一访问接口支持文献检索、问答、证据生成和声明评估等多任务复用，在跨论文任务上获得显著质量提升并降低查询时token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学智能体系统以单个任务为中心组织，导致同一文献被重复检索、分割和解释，一个任务中构建的理解难以在后续任务中复用，形成"任务特定研究瓶颈"。研究需要同时实现可重用来源内容和已建立理解的复用，并保留研究条件、源可溯性和验证状态等明确边界。

Method: 提出ScholarStack分层研究资产框架：(1) L1层记录源支撑的科学事实，含研究上下文和证据引用；(2) L2层通过领域分类法、规范实体、隐式分配和类型化关系组织事实；(3) L3层形成限定范围的跨论文综合，明确说明覆盖范围和证据基础。三个层次通过证据依赖关联但保持不同证据角色。通用访问接口（Retrieve、Select、Expand、Compare、Synthesize）支持任务特定的知识视图，在四个任务族（文献检索、科学问答、证据生成、声明一致性评估）共十个任务设置中实例化评估。

Result: 在四个任务族十个任务上评估：(1) 文献检索中开放世界Tier 1 F1相对提升10.7%，固定域检索R@1从0.650提升至0.670，新颖性评估在token减少约40%下加权F1从0.645提升至0.662；(2) 多论文问答从Full-text的8.46总分提升至18.41（满分20），token减少约73.3%；(4) 文献综述生成ReportBench-ML RACE质量从7.54（Claude Code DR）提升至9.18，F1从0.090提升至0.214；(5) 实验设计生成覆盖率F1（0.404）与Full-text相当但token减少约40%；(6) 想法生成五维度平均分从0.526提升至0.577。所有评估任务中查询时token成本均下降。

Conclusion: 分层研究资产可作为科学智能体的共享基础设施，将基于文献的辅助从孤立的文档处理转变为累积的、基于证据的工作流。结构化资产能够提升任务有效性并降低查询时token使用量，效益因任务和源覆盖情况而异。未来工作将研究更长任务序列和演化语料库、加强证据验证、并系统性估算构建、维护和复用成本。

Abstract: Scientific agents support a range of literature-based research tasks, such as retrieval, question answering, evidence-grounded generation, and claim assessment. Most existing systems, however, are organized around individual tasks: the same papers are repeatedly retrieved, segmented, and interpreted, and the understanding built in one task is difficult to reuse in the next. We present ScholarStack, a layered research asset framework that compiles a paper collection into reusable, versioned, and provenance-preserving assets at three complementary levels: source-grounded paper-level statements, domain-level organization, and evidence-grounded cross-paper syntheses. A common access interface returns task-specific views at the evidence granularity each task requires, preserving study conditions, source traceability, and verification status. We instantiate the framework on four task families spanning ten task settings, comparing agents that use the compiled assets with task-specific baselines under matched base models. Quality gains concentrate on tasks that require cross-paper evidence, such as multi-paper question answering and literature review generation, and query-time token cost falls on every task where it is measured, with assets compiled once and reused across tasks. These results suggest that layered research assets can serve as shared infrastructure for scientific agents, shifting literature-based assistance from isolated document processing toward cumulative, evidence-grounded workflows.

</details>


### [287] [On Probabilistic Inference Through Parametric Tensor Decomposition in Base Tensor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23774)
*Sagad Hamid,Tanya Braun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出**基础张量网络（Base Tensor Network, BTN）**框架，将概率图模型的推理转化为张量网络收缩问题。其核心思想是通过辅助随机变量和可逆矩阵对因子图进行重参数化，生成一个由单一**基础张量（Base Tensor, BT）**和若干**叶张量（Leaf Tensor, LT）**构成的BTN。推理的复杂度不再仅由树宽决定，而是由基础张量的参数结构（PS）控制。作者刻画了几类可处理的基础张量（秩一、对称、对称-秩一），并提出**参数张量分解（Parametric Tensor Decomposition, PTD）**方法，通过将基础张量加性分解为可处理组件来实现高效推理。通过Frobenius范数最小化学习近似基础张量，使框架可适用于一般高树宽图模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率推理在高树宽图模型中通常难以处理（#P-hard）。现有利用参数结构（如对称性、确定性）的方法通常要求这些结构在模型中显式存在，限制了其适用范围。本文旨在开发一个框架，使可处理性由潜在的参数结构驱动，而非要求其先验显式存在，从而将参数结构利用作为高树宽模型推理的核心手段。

Method: 1. **因子图到BTN的重参数化**：为每个因子引入辅助随机变量和可逆矩阵（辅助因子），将原始因子重参数化，消除原始随机变量，得到每个变量仅出现在至多两个因子中的TN结构。2. **BTN的定义**：定义基础张量（BT）为由若干分量张量外积构成、覆盖所有索引的单一核心张量，其余为叶张量（LT）。3. **可处理类刻画**：分析秩一BT（复杂度O(kd^{n_max})）、对称BT（利用计数空间紧凑表示，O(k(d^{n_max}+c1c2))）、对称-秩一BT（结合两者优势）的收缩复杂度。4. **参数张量分解（PTD）**：基于收缩对BT的线性性，将BT加性分解为可处理组件，原始BTN的收缩结果等于各组件BTN收缩结果的加权和。5. **Frobenius范数最小化学习**：利用BT的外积结构和组件的PS，可在不物化指数大张量的情况下高效计算Gram矩阵和标量积，学习权重α以近似原始BT。

Result: 理论结果：(1) 证明任意因子图可重参数化为等价BTN；(2) 给出秩一、对称、对称-秩一BT的可处理性复杂度界，均仅与最大LT阶数n_max呈指数关系；(3) 建立加性分解引理（Lemma 5），证明BTN收缩对BT呈线性；(4) 证明Frobenius范数优化中所有必要量（BT范数、Gram矩阵、交叉项）均可利用BT的外积结构和组件PS在不显式构造指数大张量的情况下高效计算，将推理转化为可处理BTN收缩的加权和。

Conclusion: BTN框架为概率推理提供了一种超越传统树宽概念的全新视角：推理的可处理性由基础张量的参数结构决定，而非仅由变量间的（条件）独立性决定。通过PTD和Frobenius范数学习，可以为一般高树宽图模型引入和利用潜在的参数结构。未来工作包括推导张量近似与推理误差间的误差界、联合学习分解参数与可逆映射、扩展更多可处理张量类，以及在大规模PGM上的实证评估。

Abstract: Probabilistic inference is generally only tractable in low-treewidth graphical models, limiting its effective applicability in high-treewidth settings. Many existing methods improve efficiency by exploiting specific parametric structure, such as symmetries. However, they typically require such structure to be explicitly present, limiting their applicability to a broader range of graphical models. To address this limitation, we propose a framework where tractable inference is controlled by latent parametric structure exploitation, rather than requiring it to be explicitly present a priori. Our approach first reparameterises a graphical model as a specific tensor network representation, which we call a base tensor network. This representation yields two key properties that allow inference tractability to be controlled by parametric structure: 1) First, the complexity of inference is mainly determined by the parametric structure of a single tensor, called the base tensor. We characterise several tractable classes of base tensors for which the entire base tensor network can be contracted efficiently. 2) Second, decomposing the base tensor yields again a collection of base tensor networks. This allows inference to be naturally reduced to decomposing the base tensor into tractable components with sufficient parametric structure. We call this procedure parametric tensor decomposition. By exploiting parametric structure within the base tensor, our framework enables a novel view on inference beyond settings where such structure is explicitly present.

</details>


### [288] [Total Cost of Agency: Exact Attribution of Memory Injection Cost in Multi-Agent LLM Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23790)
*Vivek Kumar Singh,Preeti Priyam,Gautam Bhowmick*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"代理总成本"（TCA）分解方法，将多智能体LLM工作流成本分为基础提示、推理、内存注入、未命中惩罚和上下文累积五部分，并提出一种精确的双遍、非计费token计数方法来直接测量注入token。在200个企业任务基准测试中，内存注入约占优化者可操作成本的13.6%、完整计费的约12%，且随工作流深度从深度1的结构性零增长到深度6的27.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产可观测性工具报告总token成本，但不区分节点生成的token与被注入的token，导致内存注入成本对优化团队不可见。模型层级选择虽是主流优化杠杆，但工作流深度增加时注入的内存上下文成本被忽视。

Method: 1) TCA分解公式将工作流成本分为五项；2) 两遍非计费token计数法（双遍组装prompt，分别用提供商tokenizer计数，差值即为注入量）；3) 在200任务、5类别、5深度的平衡基准（每个单元8任务）上针对真实模型API测试；4) 通过调节检索窗口K_opt进行容量敏感度实验。

Result: 内存注入约占可控变量成本13.6%、完整计费约12%（1073 token vs 1233 token基础prompt）；随深度从0（深度1）线性增长至754个深度6（R²=0.9974），份额从8.4%升至27.6%；检索窗口从32降至2使注入token减少28.7%，准确率变化处于种子级波动范围内；图重写变换单独近乎成本中性（条件A-G在1%以内）；总成本由模型层级分配主导；提示缓存未评估。

Conclusion: 内存注入是真实、可单独归因且可精确测量的成本组件，随工作流深度线性增长并受检索容量杠杆控制；图变换单独近乎中性；总成本由模型层级决定（视为先验工作并固定）；提示缓存是最有希望的缓解手段但因结构性原因是不利的缓存候选对象，尚未测量，是未来首要工作。

Abstract: Every node in a multi-agent large language model (LLM) workflow retrieves context from memory and injects it into its prompt, where those injected tokens are billed as input tokens at the same per-token price as the system prompt and the user query. Production observability tools report total token cost but do not separate the tokens a node generates from the tokens it is handed, so this component of the bill is invisible to the teams paying it. We introduce the Total Cost of Agency (TCA), a decomposition of multi-agent workflow cost into base prompt, inference, memory injection, miss penalty and context-accumulation components, and an exact attribution method: a two-pass, non-billable token count that measures injected tokens directly rather than estimating them from word-count proxies. On a 200-task enterprise benchmark executed against real model APIs, memory injection accounts for 13.6 percent of the variable cost a compile-time optimizer can act on, about 12 percent of the full billed cost, and its share rises from a structural zero at workflow depth one to 27.6 percent at depth six. Injected tokens grow linearly with depth over the measured range (R^2 = 0.9974, depths two through six); a quadratic fit yields a negative leading coefficient, so the data do not exhibit convex growth at these depths. We show the component is controllable at fixed model tier: reducing the retrieval window capacity from 32 to 2 entries lowers injected tokens by 28.7 percent with an accuracy change within seed-level variation. We report in full that our graph-rewriting transforms are approximately cost-neutral in isolation, that two of the five decomposition terms are zero by construction in this harness, and that total workflow cost is dominated by model tier assignment, which we hold fixed and treat as prior work. Prompt caching is not evaluated; all figures are for the uncached case.

</details>


### [289] [WorkWorlds: An Infrastructure for Evaluating AI Agents on Workplace Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23806)
*Yining Hua,Levi Lian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WorkWorlds 提出了一种将组织状态与任务规范分离的智能体评估基础设施，通过先确定身份与日期来固定员工可见的工作场所，再叠加任务，从而揭示任务策展上下文对智能体绩效的虚假提升效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识工作任务基准往往将任务规范与上下文选择耦合，导致评估环境预先编码了任务信息，削弱了对真实工作场所信息定位能力的测量。WorkWorlds 旨在通过分离组织状态与任务规范来解决这一问题。

Method: WorkWorlds 采用「版本(revision)+ 日期(date) + 员工席位(employee seat)」三要素从持久组织世界中物化角色可见投影(employee projection)，任务仅在该投影固定后叠加。以 PharmaCo（合成无菌注射制药公司）为原型，含 6 个员工席位、8 项任务、72 条评分标准；通过冻结重建、哈希校验、访问审计和证据审查确保构造一致性。匹配实验仅改变信息投影量（全投影 vs. 任务策展子集），固定世界、任务、席位、智能体和评分器。

Result: 192 次匹配评估中，从任务策展上下文切换到完整角色可见工作场所后，充分证据访问率从 90.4% 降至 74.5%，标准通过率从 79.4% 降至 68.2%，而获得证据后的条件通过率几乎不变（84.7% vs. 84.5%）。差异主要发生在智能体获取充分证据之前：策展条件下平均检查 12.7 次文件/记录 vs. 全投影下 28.0 次。三个智能体均受影响且排名不变，但能力最弱的提升最大，缩小了模型间差距。两位领域策展人对 6/8 任务选择了不同源文件集，策展包仅保留员工可见 775 个文件中 0.52%-1.16%。

Conclusion: 信息环境本身就是工作场所基准测量内容的一部分。WorkWorlds 通过显式化并可控化这一环境，使评估者能够区分真正的任务绩效与信息定位能力的差异。任务的策划上下文会显著抬升测量性能，使得基于任务策展的评估可能高估智能体的实际工作场所能力。

Abstract: Many knowledge-work benchmarks are constructed around individual tasks, with the context needed for each task selected together with or after the task has been specified. This design measures performance on workplace-like tasks in an environment assembled for the task. When task specification guides which context is selected, the evaluation can encode task information into the environment and pre-complete part of the information-localization work that workplace performance normally requires. We introduce WorkWorlds, an evaluation infrastructure that separates organizational state from task specification. A world first fixes a revision, date, and employee seat and materializes the organizational state that employee can access; tasks are introduced only afterward. We implement WorkWorlds in a primary synthetic pharmaceutical company with 8 measured tasks across 6 employee seats, and construct additional organizational worlds. Across 192 matched evaluations, moving from task-curated context to the full role-visible workplace reduced evidence access from 90.4% to 74.5% and criterion pass from 79.4% to 68.2%, while pass conditional on evidence access remained nearly unchanged; most of the measured difference occurred before the agent reached sufficient evidence.

</details>


### [290] [Pretraining of Medical Visual Encoders Toward Multi-modal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23860)
*Tianyou Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MedMLIP提出了一种面向多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的医学视觉编码器预训练框架，通过冻结LLM引导的自回归报告生成损失和局部关系蒸馏损失来弥合对比预训练与自回归接口之间的"语义接口鸿沟"，在VQA-RAD和SLAKE上以跨LLM迁移协议验证了视觉编码器的可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM普遍使用对比预训练（如CLIP）的ViT作为视觉编码器，但其特征最终由自回归LLM消费，存在"语义接口鸿沟"（semantic-interface gap）。在医学领域，细粒度的局部视觉证据对下游问答至关重要，简单替换为BioMedCLIP并未根本解决接口不匹配问题。

Method: 1) 冻结LLM引导的自回归预训练：将可训练ViT与冻结LLM通过视觉投影器连接，以报告生成损失优化ViT，使其产生LLM可直接消费的特征；2) 局部关系蒸馏（LRD）：以冻结的CLIP ViT为教师，通过保留patch间的成对关系几何（余弦相似度矩阵的MSE损失）避免语言诱导的视觉坍塌；总损失为 L_gen + λ·L_LRD；3) 跨LLM迁移评估协议：仅迁移ViT骨干，丢弃预训练投影器并为新LLM随机初始化投影器。

Result: 在VQA-RAD和SLAKE上的跨LLM迁移实验显示，MedMLIP完整目标相比CLIP式对比预训练平均提升约4.40个百分点（范围2.53–7.14）。LRD消融实验显示在四项设置中均有一致提升（平均+3.99点）。在Open-PMC-300K（30万样本）上扩展预训练，并在Qwen3B引导下取得VQA-RAD 66.66%、SLAKE 86.79%的最佳结果。额外发现下游监督存在非单调效应：训练数据量增大未必带来性能提升，提示数据质量比数据量更关键。

Conclusion: 针对MLLM自回归消费接口进行视觉预训练可产生更具迁移性的表征；LRD对保留细粒度视觉结构不可或缺；该工作发布Open-PMC-300K预训练的ViT作为可复用的医学MLLM视觉编码器初始化。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) commonly reuse visual encoders pretrained with CLIP, although the features of these ViTs are ultimately consumed by autoregressive LLMs. We refer to this mismatch as the semantic-interface gap and introduce MedMLIP, a framework that pretrains the visual encoder through report generation with a frozen LLM, while employing Local Relational Distillation (LRD) to preserve relationships among visual patches to avoid visual collapse. We pretrain MedMLIP on IU-Xray and Open-PMC-300K and evaluate the resulting encoders on VQA-RAD and SLAKE. Only the ViT is transferred, while the guiding LLM and projector are replaced, allowing us to assess cross-LLM transferability. Our cross-LLM transfer experiments demonstrate the value of pretraining visual encoders for their autoregressive LLM interface while trying to preserve more fine-grained visual information. Code and the pretrained model are available at this https URL

</details>


### [291] [Explainable Recommendations at Scale: LLM Rationales for YouTube Music Artist Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23877)
*Xiao Liu,Yanwei Song,Srivaths Ranganathan,Yuan Chen,Zheyun Feng,Parker Steenburgh,Jochen Klingenhoefer,Nathan Lasche,Gergo Varady,Tim Steele*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在YouTube Music上落地的大规模、可解释推荐系统，采用"离线LLM推理+在线低延迟检索"的解耦架构。在离线阶段，基于Gemini的LLM异步分析用户完整听歌历史，生成分簇的"发现画像"，为每簇提名未被听过的艺术家并生成个性化自然语言解释；在线阶段仅做轻量级检索与标注。系统通过LLM-as-a-Judge自动评估、KG实体规范化消除幻觉、熟悉度过滤保证新颖性。在YouTube Music的"Your Daily Discovery"货架上进行了为期两周的在线A/B实验，结果显示YDD货架参与度提升+22.43%，发现留存指标提升+8.07%，而平均服务延迟仅增加0.3%。多臂holdback实验进一步表明，LLM生成的解释（rationale）而非新候选提名是参与度提升的主要驱动因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音乐流媒体平台需要在"利用熟悉内容"与"探索新颖内容"之间取得平衡，用户虽然渴望发现新内容，但出于信任顾虑倾向于选择熟悉艺术家。核心瓶颈不在于缺乏相关候选，而在于缺乏对推荐内容的认知信心。LLM虽有强大的生成式可解释能力，但其推理成本与延迟使其无法直接部署在实时在线服务中。

Method: 1) 解耦两阶段架构：离线阶段使用Gemini异步为活跃用户生成分簇的"Discovery Profile"，每簇包括新颖候选艺术家与自然语言rationale；在线阶段低延迟检索缓存画像，仅做候选补充与rationale标注。2) Chain-of-Thought风格的Prompt：让LLM先聚类用户品味簇，再提名候选并生成解释。3) LLM-as-a-Judge三步评估法：评估品味簇内聚性、候选语义对齐度，并对低分触发反馈环，基于聚合的loss pattern迭代优化prompt（基线合格率从64.8%提升至74.4%）。4) 两阶段后处理：KG规范化消除幻觉（解决拼接式虚构实体问题），熟悉度过滤基于完整历史保证新颖性，安全过滤剔除违规内容。5) 成本优化：使用机会性TPU批处理、可配置刷新周期。

Result: YouTube Music两周大规模在线A/B实验（对照组：基于规则模板rationale；实验组：加入LLM提名+LLM rationale）：YDD货架参与度+22.43%（95% CI: [16.93%, 27.93%]），发现/留存指标+8.07%（95% CI: [0.90%, 15.24%]），新提名源带来4.1%浏览增量（独特率74%）。多臂holdback分析表明，LLM rationale注解是参与度增益的主要驱动力，而新候选提名本身对参与度影响中性但对发现指标有显著贡献。平均在线服务延迟仅增加0.3%，YDD货架有机提升至首页前三位曝光比例显著增加。

Conclusion: 通过离线异步LLM推理+在线低延迟检索的解耦架构，配合LLM-as-a-Judge自动评估与KG规范化，可以在工业级流媒体服务中实现可解释的LLM驱动推荐。实验证实自然语言rationale能够有效充当"认知桥梁"，降低用户对未听艺术家的信任壁垒。本工作为业界提供了一份在不牺牲实时延迟的前提下规模化部署可解释生成式推荐系统的实用蓝图。

Abstract: Modern music streaming platforms face a persistent tradeoff: exploiting familiar content versus driving the exploration of novel items. While users frequently desire discovery, they hesitate to select unknown artists over proven favorites. Providing transparent, natural language rationales that explain why an unexplored item is recommended lowers this barrier. However, while Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at this nuanced explainability, their real-time deployment is severely bottlenecked by prohibitive inference costs and computational overhead. In this paper, we present an industry case study of a decoupled recommendation architecture that successfully scales exploration without compromising latency. Our system isolates LLM inference asynchronously offline, pre-computing personalized candidate pools of undiscovered artists alongside tailored rationales. Large-scale online A/B experiments validate our design. We demonstrate that combining LLM-backed recommendations with these explanatory rationales significantly reduces the trust barrier for new content, yielding statistically significant improvements in both user exploration and overall engagement on the discovery surfaces.

</details>


### [292] [Increasing Skill Level Recruits Deeper Attention Layers in a Frozen Chess Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23917)
*David Litman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究了国际象棋Transformer模型Maia-3中，调节Elo（技能水平）输入如何影响自注意力的计算深度。通过对冻结网络中每个注意力头进行消融实验，发现提高Elo会单调地将因果质心推向更深的层，尤其在骑士捉双等战术中表现显著，并提出浅层头提供共享原语、深层头执行特化计算的机制解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机制可解释性工作多通过比较不同模型或训练检查点来定位概念，而本文提出一个新视角：在保持所有权重和偏置冻结的情况下，仅通过调节一个条件输入变量（Elo），研究计算在网络内部如何重新分配。这有助于理解条件输入如何在更大规模的Transformer中重新分配计算。

Method: 使用Maia-3（2300万参数的国际象棋Transformer）在Elo从700到2500的19个档位下，对每个8×16注意力头进行逐一消融，记录其对目标走法logit的影响。通过计算因果质心（causal center of mass）衡量计算发生的平均深度。位置数据来自Lichess.com人类对局数据库，并使用Python谓词标注各类走法（捉双、安静走法、败着等）。还用logit lens作为消融无关的验证指标。

Result: 1）Elo从700升至2500时，兵、车、象、马四种捉双的因果质心分别增加+0.519、+0.522、+0.547、+0.880层，均在18/18的Elo步骤中单调上升（p<0.001）；2）该深度迁移是全局性的，即使是安静走法和败着也发生类似迁移，且深度迁移不依赖于模型对走法的置信度；3）马捉双的迁移幅度最大（+0.513层超出最佳替代走法），谜题难度不预测迁移幅度但走法构成有关；4）机制上表现为浅层L2H8头提供跨棋子的共享原语（定位可捉双的棋子），深层头（如L5H2、L7H12）随Elo升高被招募来执行更特化、几何特征更精细的计算。

Conclusion: 条件输入的调节能使Transformer内部的计算深度发生系统性迁移，这即使在相对较小的模型中也意味着电路位置并非固定。该方向与人类专家规划深度随经验增长的现象一致。未来工作需用transcoder等工具进一步探究被招募深层头的具体计算，以及该发现在其他领域具有技能条件类比的模型中的普适性。

Abstract: Chess involves complex reasoning in a deterministic environment, which makes it a useful setting for studying the mechanisms of computation inside transformers. The Maia-3 chess transformer takes Elo, a measure of competitive chess skill, as an input to the pre-trained network, so we can vary the skill the network is conditioned on with no change to its weights. Here we investigate how turning this skill dial affects self-attention. Ablating every attention head at every Elo from 700 to 2500, we find 1) increasing skill pushes the causal center of mass of the computation deeper, monotonically, for every chess piece and move type we measured; 2) the depth migration is much greater for specific tactics, especially knight forks, than for other move types; 3) the migration consists of deeper heads getting recruited for more specialized computations while one shared shallow head keeps a roughly constant contribution. These results may shed light on how conditioning inputs redistribute computation in larger transformers.

</details>


### [293] [Echo State Network (ESN) for Signal Recovery in RF-Impaired IBFD MIMO Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23945)
*Conrad Prisby,Siyao Li,Chengtao Xu,Thomas Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于回声状态网络（ESN）的两阶段方案，用于在带内全双工（IBFD）MIMO系统中存在射频（RF）损伤（如I/Q不平衡、载波频偏、相位噪声、功放非线性）时进行自干扰（SI）消除与信号恢复（SOI）。该方案采用离线训练的ESN1进行SI估计和消除，采用在线通过递归最小二乘（RLS）更新的自适应ESN2进行SOI恢复，在SOI恢复精度以及导频效率方面均优于传统BSS（Fast-ICA）以及LSTM、GRU等RNN基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带内全双工（IBFD）MIMO系统中严重的自干扰会淹没信号。传统的盲源分离（BSS）方法（如Fast-ICA）基于理想化的线性和准平稳信号模型假设，但在实际射频损伤（I/Q不平衡、载波频偏、相位噪声、功放非线性等）条件下性能受限。本文旨在探索基于储备池计算的ESN架构对这类非线性、时变损伤的建模与适应能力。

Method: 两阶段ESN管线：(1) ESN1（冻结）以已知的SI发射信号为输入，离线通过岭回归训练，表征静态SI路径的射频损伤并估计受损SI信号以进行自干扰消除；(2) ESN2（自适应）以SIC残差为输入，通过稀疏导频符号在线利用递归最小二乘（RLS）更新读出层，跟踪时变SOI路径的非线性与记忆效应。仿真采用2×2 MIMO、16-QAM、20 dB SNR，并对比Fast-ICA、无储备池的RLS、LSTM与GRU基线（参数数量匹配）。

Result: 在所有测试块大小下，所提出的ESN管线在SOI恢复SRER方面均优于Fast-ICA，在块大小为50时差距最大（约11 dB）。与RLS、LSTM、GRU基线相比，ESN2达到最高SRER（约13 dB），且导频效率最高（块大小500时仅需约230个导频符号，而基线需要约280–290个）。复杂度方面，ESN2每符号需约2020次乘法，低于LSTM（2064）和GRU（2028）。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，将固定储备池与闭式自适应读出相结合的两阶段ESN方案，能够在存在实际射频损伤和时变信道的IBFD MIMO系统中实现可靠、实时的SOI恢复，并在恢复精度和导频效率上优于Fast-ICA BSS及RNN基线。未来工作将把该框架扩展到联合感知与通信（JSAC）以及物理层安全方向，如射频指纹识别和欺骗检测。

Abstract: In-band full-duplex (IBFD) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems enable simultaneous transmission and reception on the same frequency band, improving spectral efficiency for next-generation wireless networks. However, IBFD-MIMO systems are susceptible to self-interference (SI), which may overpower signals of interest (SOI). In this scenario, blind source separation (BSS) algorithms can be adopted to remove SI and perform joint sensing and communication (JSAC), but BSS algorithms mostly assume an idealized linear and quasi-stationary signal model, which does not hold under realistic radio frequency (RF) impairments, such as I/Q imbalance, carrier frequency offset (CFO), phase noise, and power amplifier nonlinearity. This paper proposes a two-stage echo state network (ESN)-based scheme that is superior to BSS under these realistic conditions. A frozen ESN is trained offline to characterize the static SI path, while an adaptive ESN, updated online via recursive least squares, tracks the time-varying SOI path using sparse pilot symbols. We evaluate the proposed scheme's SOI recovery performance and acquisition speed with different block sizes, comparing it against other recurrent neural networks (RNN), such as long short-term memory (LSTM) and gated recurrent unit (GRU). Simulation results show that the proposed approach outperforms BSS, LSTM, and GRU in both efficiency and SOI recovery, demonstrating the viability of ESNs for real-time, nonlinear self-interference cancellation in realistic IBFD MIMO systems.

</details>


### [294] [Agents That Edit Documents: Measuring Agentic PDF Forgery Against a Non-Agentic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23953)
*Simiao Ren,Ankit Raj,Tommy Duong,Yuxin Zhang,Dennis Ng,Xingyu Shen,Kidus Zewde,Yuchen Zhou,Neo Tiangratanakul*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AI agents that carry a multi-step computer task through on their own became ordinary tools in the past year, and the same autonomy is available to anyone whose task is harmful. We ask what that means for a relying party -- an insurer, a lender, an auditor -- whose evidence is a filed PDF. AgentForge-Bench measures how reliably an off-the-shelf coding agent, driving one of seven open-weight models with a shell and the stock Python PDF stack, alters one dollar amount, date or address in a real filed financial document from a single sentence of intent, graded by rules rather than by a model. Across 1,750 cells, 1,419 (81.1%) satisfy the verifier, and 808 (46.2%) also survive every stricter filter: visible, localized, typeface-matched, original value gone document-wide. A deterministic script with no model in it solves 98 of the 125 documents; the agents solve 124, and none the script solves alone. Agents misreport 41% of their wrong edits as done, no model refused, and the cheapest verified forgery costs 2.4 cents. The raw rate overstates the threat by about a factor of two; the strict rate is still large.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI enhancement unavailable (incomplete_output). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Method: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Result: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (incomplete_output). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Abstract: AI agents that carry a multi-step computer task through on their own became ordinary tools in the past year, and the same autonomy is available to anyone whose task is harmful. We ask what that means for a relying party -- an insurer, a lender, an auditor -- whose evidence is a filed PDF. AgentForge-Bench measures how reliably an off-the-shelf coding agent, driving one of seven open-weight models with a shell and the stock Python PDF stack, alters one dollar amount, date or address in a real filed financial document from a single sentence of intent, graded by rules rather than by a model. Across 1,750 cells, 1,419 (81.1%) satisfy the verifier, and 808 (46.2%) also survive every stricter filter: visible, localized, typeface-matched, original value gone document-wide. A deterministic script with no model in it solves 98 of the 125 documents; the agents solve 124, and none the script solves alone. Agents misreport 41% of their wrong edits as done, no model refused, and the cheapest verified forgery costs 2.4 cents. The raw rate overstates the threat by about a factor of two; the strict rate is still large.

</details>


### [295] [Divergent strategies and convergent outcomes in autonomous materials discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23957)
*Jihan Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究科学智能体在开放式探索任务中的表现差异性，通过让16个独立初始化的智能体对相同金属有机框架（MOF）数据库执行甲烷存储筛选任务，揭示了即使策略多样化，最终结论的鲁棒性以及共享输入导致的共模错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学智能体评估多关注任务完成度或已知结果复现，忽视了在开放式、重复性科学探索中智能体行为与结论的变异性，以及共享输入可能引入的系统性偏差。

Method: 固定模型-框架配置，启动16个独立会话，在冻结的12,499个MOF数据库上开展甲烷存储筛选，设定统一协议与一周时间预算；对其中半数智能体强制执行检查机制以验证复现性。

Result: 智能体策略分化为四类（筛选100–5,000个结构），其中8个生成了2,253个假设结构；所有智能体均恢复了约200 cm³/cm³的材料前沿，且数据库孔隙区域的9个最优结构均在其报告之列；强制检查将新运行复现率从1/8提升至8/8，但15/16的智能体均选择了同一被审计排除的条目——一个因阴离子缺失而虚增孔体积的不完整结构。

Conclusion: 重复运行的科学智能体既能得出鲁棒结论，也存在由共享输入导致的共模错误；强制检查可提升复现性但无法消除结论层面的系统性偏差，凸显了输入数据质量与独立审计的重要性。

Abstract: Scientific agents are mostly evaluated on whether they complete tasks or recover known results; we instead study variation across repeated open-ended campaigns. Sixteen separately initialized sessions of one model-harness configuration received a frozen database of 12,499 metal-organic frameworks, a methane-storage objective, a pinned protocol and a one-week budget. Strategies diverged into four approaches spanning 100--5,000 screened structures, and eight built 2,253 hypothetical structures. Yet the agents recovered the same materials frontier near 200 cm^3/cm^3, and an independent calculation of the database's porous region found its nine best structures all among their reports. Enforced checks on half the agents raised fresh-run reproduction from one of eight to eight of eight but could not detectably improve conclusion validity, because fifteen of sixteen agents selected the same audit-excluded entry, an incomplete structure whose missing anions created artificial pore volume. Replicated agents thus reveal both robust conclusions and common-mode errors from shared inputs.

</details>


### [296] [UniK: Universal Knowledge Perception for Digital and Physical AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23971)
*Nirmit Desai,Kunal Sawarkar,Aditya Mahakali,Dongkon Lee,Kevin Park,Eric Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出UniK（Universal Knowledge Perception），一个面向数字AI与物理AI的统一知识感知平台，核心基于Polymath Retrieval（多索引融合）技术，无需任务特定微调。在五个数字AI领域（医学文献、开放域QA、化学、法律视频、政府开放数据）中，配合开源70B参数模型，UniK在多项基准上匹配或超越比其大数个数量级的专有前沿LLM（如在政府数据上RAG准确率达76%对比GPT-5的47%）。论文同时论证了同一架构可直接扩展至物理AI的数据策展与检索场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI系统面临核心瓶颈：模型所需的领域知识规模庞大、模态异构、分布于私有语料库中，无法被有效访问。微调存在灾难性遗忘问题，标准RAG在大规模语料上因hubness问题和领域词汇鸿沟而退化。论文认为知识感知（retrieval与enrichment层）而非模型智能是知识密集型任务的关键瓶颈，且数字AI与物理AI面临结构相同的知识问题。

Method: UniK平台由六大操作组成：摄取（ingestion）、富化（enrichment，使用KeyBERT/YAKE/spaCy NER/VLM等自动提取关键词、实体、同义词、主题）、索引（indexing，构建BM25、dense k-NN、learned-sparse等多类型索引）、检索（retrieval，通过Polymath Router路由查询并经RRF融合多索引结果）、查询路由（query routing）、持续评估（continuous evaluation，含自动反馈循环）。核心设计原则为"无需任务特定微调"与"polymath by default"。在物理AI场景中，富化适配器从文本关键词扩展为对象标签、动作类型、运动学特征和失效标记，索引支持时空+视觉+运动学混合信号。

Result: 在五个数字AI域的实验结果：（1）检索质量：UniK-Realtime配置在HotpotQA、NQ、PubMedQA上达到91.2%平均hit@10，p95延迟仅68ms；（2）PubMedQA上UniK达77.9%，仅次于微调的RankRAG（79.8%），超过所有其他非微调方法；（3）ChemRAG基准上UniK在MolInstruct（64.5% vs GPT-4o 53.2%）和SciBench（18.6% vs 8.6%）上领先；（4）法律视频上Seattle CDP的Golden与Bronze集分别达82.0%和79.3%，均领先前沿模型；（5）NJ政府开放数据Golden集RAG准确率76%，对比GPT-5的47.3%、Gemini-3 Flash的46%、Claude Sonnet 4.6的42%。

Conclusion: 知识密集型任务中检索质量比模型规模更关键；UniK以70B开源模型+强检索在多个领域匹配或超越大数倍专有模型。相同的六大操作可直接迁移至物理AI，仅需模态特定的富化适配器。开放问题包括：自动检索配置学习（auto-didactic retrieval）、物理AI中的多模态时序对齐、物理有效性验证、覆盖感知采样、缺乏简单真值的检索评估。论文将UniK定位为类比数据库的事务性计算基础设施。

Abstract: Two transformative classes of AI systems are reshaping how organizations operate: \textit{digital AI}, which reasons over enterprise knowledge to power chatbots and agent workflows; and \textit{physical AI}, which learns to control robots and autonomous systems from video, gameplay, and sensor telemetry. Both face the same foundational bottleneck: raw knowledge at scale, spanning heterogeneous modalities, locked in private corpora that existing AI infrastructure cannot access reliably or efficiently. We propose \textit{Universal Knowledge Perception (UniK)} as a common platform for both classes, covering the full knowledge lifecycle (ingestion, enrichment, indexing, retrieval, and continuous evaluation) across modalities from rich text and video to molecular data and sensor telemetry. We present UniK, built on Polymath Retrieval (multi-index fusion over automatically enriched indices) with no task-specific fine-tuning. Across five digital AI domains (medical literature, open-domain QA, chemistry, legal video proceedings, and government open data) UniK combined with an open-source 70-billion-parameter model consistently matches or outperforms frontier proprietary LLMs that are orders of magnitude larger: 76\% RAG accuracy on government data versus 47\% for GPT-5; 77.9\% on medical QA without fine-tuning; topping all open-source chemistry pipelines. We show that the same infrastructure directly addresses the data curation, indexing, and retrieval challenges facing physical AI world model training, where the knowledge problem is harder but structurally identical.

</details>


### [297] [LEAP-NBV: Lightweight Edge Active-Perception for Foundation-Model Next-Best-View Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23974)
*Boxun Hu,Jiawei Ge,Axel Krieger,Peng Wang,Tinoosh Mohsenin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LEAP-NBV是一个面向边缘设备的轻量级主动感知框架，通过跨尺度网格蒸馏和FP16量化将大型HMR基础模型压缩到32M参数，在Jetson Xavier NX上以3.6 FPS运行完整的NBV闭环，HMR推理仅需12ms，速度提升2倍、能耗降低3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 战术场景中移动机器人需自主规划下一最佳视角（NBV），但驱动该闭环的HMR基础模型参数量高达数亿，能耗和延迟无法在边缘设备上实时运行；同时蒸馏和量化各自单独使用都有局限，二者联合在HMR结构化3D任务及边缘预算下的复合效应尚未被充分研究。

Method: 1) 离线跨尺度网格蒸馏：将多个大HMR教师（ViT-B/L/H，103-687M）的网格结果预计算，再用质心相对的逐顶点L2损失训练统一32M ViT-S学生；2) 训练后FP16量化：所有加权层转FP16，SMPL-X尾层保持FP32；3) 在Jetson Xavier NX上用TensorRT编译部署，集成到基于OA-NBV的遮挡感知主动感知闭环中。

Result: 蒸馏恢复6-7mm PA-MPVPE（vs未蒸馏32M基线）；FP16量化后HMR引擎~12ms；端到端闭环3.6 FPS、2.58J/帧，相对未压缩l32提速2.0×、降能耗3.0×；发现ViT-H宽度（D=1280）在FP16下最终归一化层溢出崩溃，但紧凑学生（D=384）数值安全；闭环下游任务（覆盖率、重建面积、PA-MPVPE）几乎匹配FP32教师。

Conclusion: 联合蒸馏+FP16量化的边缘压缩可使大型HMR基础模型在战术边缘设备上实时低功耗运行，闭环任务质量损失极小；同时揭示了ViT-H宽度下FP16溢出问题，强调压缩效果必须在目标硬件上实测验证。

Abstract: Foundation models are endowing autonomous systems with greater intelligence, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of the environment through visual perception. A representative example is Human Mesh Recovery (HMR), which provides useful estimates of a target's 3D pose and shape that can benefit tactical missions. However, the size and power demands of such models make them difficult to run on edge platforms and limit their real-time performance, undermining the requirements of tactical edge deployment - especially for active perception, where a mobile robot must plan its next-best view on-board and cannot offload computation under contested communications. We present LEAP-NBV, a lightweight active-perception framework that runs foundation-model-driven Next-Best-View (NBV) planning on-board an edge device. To this end, we distill a family of large HMR teachers, each into a compact 32M student, with an offline mesh objective, then quantize the vision encoder to FP16 and characterize its on-device accuracy and latency. Within an occlusion-aware active perception loop, we evaluate all configurations on the same held-out benchmark and deploy the end-to-end pipeline on an NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX, reporting measured on-device latency and energy. Distillation recovers 6-7 mm of Procrustes-aligned mean per-vertex position error (PA-MPVPE) over the undistilled student on the test set. Selecting the edge-optimal compression model brings the HMR engine to ~12 ms at a small accuracy cost and runs the full closed loop at 3.6 FPS and 2.6 J per frame, achieving a 2.0x speedup and 3.0x lower energy than the uncompressed model while nearly matching downstream task quality.

</details>


### [298] [Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23986)
*Dongming Jiang,Yi Li,Bingzhe Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Jev-Mem提出了一种受System-One/System-Two认知启发的智能体记忆架构，通过轻量级的System-One控制器处理高频记忆控制决策，将昂贵的生成式推理保留给System-Two，在LoCoMo基准上同时实现了最佳准确率(0.777)和最高效率(构建时间158s，查询延迟0.93s)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的智能体记忆系统要么依赖固定启发式（效率高但缺乏灵活性），要么依赖自回归LLM控制记忆操作（灵活但开销大），将昂贵的生成过程置于记忆操作的关键路径上。需要一种将快速结构化决策与慢速深思熟虑推理分离的架构。

Method: 三层架构：(1) System-One控制平面——通过类型化概率决策接口处理记忆构建（记忆类型标注、关系构造）和检索（查询路由、预算分配、图遍历、候选评分、自适应停止）；(2) 多关系记忆数据平面——共享规范节点上的语义、时间、因果、实体四种关系视图，配以向量和词法索引；(3) System-Two推理平面——仅用于复杂推理和答案合成。检索采用闭环控制流程：路由→检索→评估→扩展→再评估。

Result: 在LoCoMo基准上，Jev-Mem的LLM-as-a-Judge总体得分为0.777，比最强基线提升11.0%；记忆构建时间仅158秒，比最快竞品快6.6倍；平均查询延迟0.93秒，降低36.7%。在五类问题中四项取得最佳，时间推理与最优基线持平。对抗性问题提升最大(0.962 vs 0.742)。

Conclusion: 将记忆控制从生成式推理中分离是构建更高效长程智能体的有前途方向。轻量级结构化预测用于高频记忆决策，自回归推理保留用于复杂合成，可在不牺牲推理质量的前提下大幅提升系统效率。

Abstract: Agentic memory is becoming essential for long-horizon AI agents, yet many existing systems rely on autoregressive LLMs to control how memories are organized, retrieved, and used, placing expensive generation on the critical path of memory operations. We introduce \textbf{\method}, a new agentic memory architecture inspired by System-One/System-Two cognition. System One captures fast, lightweight decision-making, whereas System Two performs slower, deliberative reasoning. Jev-Mem brings this division of labor to agentic memory through a dedicated System-One control plane, a structured multi-relational memory plane, and a System-Two reasoning plane. The System-One controller governs memory typing and relational organization during construction, and dynamically performs query routing, retrieval-budget allocation, graph traversal, candidate scoring, and adaptive stopping during retrieval. System Two is invoked only for complex reasoning and answer synthesis. This design improves both memory effectiveness and system efficiency: on LoCoMo Jev-Mem achieves an overall LLM-as-a-Judge score of 0.777, an 11.0\% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, while reducing memory construction time to 158\,s, a 6.6$\times$ speedup over the fastest competing memory system, and lowering average query latency to 0.93\,s, a 36.7\% reduction.

</details>


### [299] [ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23989)
*Haixin Wang,Xiaoxuan Wang,Junkai Zhang,Han Zhang,Renliang Sun,Alexander K Taylor,Yidan Shi,Haoran Deng,Chenguang Wang,Jason Cong,Yizhou Sun,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ACLArena 提出面向智能体多阶段后训练的持续学习(ACL)框架,围绕"顺序训练基线诊断—三种主流整合范式对比—提出新方法 MLE"展开研究,提出 Mixture of Low-Rank Experts (MLE) 显著缓解能力间的灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业级通用智能体需依次获得推理、搜索、电商、指令遵循等多种能力,而当前缺乏在受控条件下系统比较不同持续学习策略的测试平台;既有技术报告训练细节有限,经典持续学习方法(回放、任务模块)因环境/奖励管线成本高昂而不实用。

Method: 1) 构建四阶段顺序后训练流水线(Math → Search → E-commerce → IF),在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上以 GSPO 算法进行 RL; 2) 从模型级(PCA/任务向量余弦相似度)和 token 级(按熵分桶的预测一致性)两个视角诊断遗忘与迁移机制; 3) 系统比较三种整合范式:多教师混合 On-Policy Distillation (MMOPD, 提出 MOPD:在低熵 token 上用 reverse-KL、在高熵 token 上叠加 top-q forward-KL)、自蒸馏微调 SDFT(从独立 oracle 采样高质量轨迹回放)、模型合并 MM(任务向量加权平均); 4) 提出 MLE:在 SDFT 共享基底之上,为每阶段训练 LoRA 专家并以 RL 微调,推理时由环境上下文路由,实现参数隔离式持续保留。

Result: 主要发现:(1) 任务向量方向部分对齐但显著异质(去前缀后近乎正交),顺序训练存在严重跨阶段干扰(如 E-commerce 阶段使 AIME 从 25.83→6.04,NQ 从 45.2→14.6); (2) token 级变化主要集中在高熵位置,低熵预测跨阶段几乎不变;(3) SFT 产生 3–7× 于 RL 的更新幅度,确立行为模式但易覆盖既有能力,而 RL/MMOPD 做策略局部精修;(4) 在 4 个任务(含 GPQA/MMLU/单跳多跳搜索/τ³-Bench/IF-Bench)的域内外评估中,MLE 全面接近独立专家表现,综合优于 MMOPD、SDFT、MM:例如 NQ 49.7、AIME 21.04、单跳搜索 57.7、多跳搜索 38.6、τ³-Retail 32.9、IF-Eval 85.0、IF-Bench 29.1,均显著高于 Seq-Final。

Conclusion: ACLArena 证明单模型参数空间内的能力整合存在不可避免的权衡,SFT 与 RL 在 ACL 中扮演互补但不可替代的角色;基于"共享骨干 + 低秩专家 + 环境路由"思路的 MLE 通过参数隔离机制在多领域间实现了高效的能力保留与迁移,为多阶段智能体后训练提供了一个实用且可扩展的方案,但其在更长课程、更复杂路由与跨模型族上的泛化性仍待进一步研究。

Abstract: Building general-purpose agents for industrial deployment requires integrating multiple capabilities, each typically acquired at a distinct stage of training. Yet there is currently no well-established recipe for Agent Continual Learning (ACL), with little understanding of the trade-offs among existing integration paradigms. To address this gap, we introduce ACLArena, a framework for comprehensively studying, analyzing, and evaluating ACL. We first build a sequential training pipeline and conduct an in-depth analysis that explains the mechanisms of forgetting and generalization from two complementary perspectives, the model level and the token level. Guided by these analyses, we systematically compare multi-teacher on-policy distillation, self-distilled fine-tuning, and model merging to assess their ability to recover previously learned capabilities while preserving newly acquired ones. Through extensive experiments, we develop a detailed understanding of how capabilities transfer across stages. Finally, we propose a new ACL recipe that combines offline replay over high-quality trajectories with a routed network of multiple LoRA experts each specialized via RL, substantially improving the agent's ability to learn across multiple domains. Comprehensive experiments on four reasoning and agentic tasks, evaluated under both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, demonstrate the value of our analysis and the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [300] [FinInteract: Benchmarking Clarification and Intent Integration in Ambiguous Financial Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24002)
*Xinyu Wang,Tung Sum Thomas Kwok,Zhenghan Tai,Guang Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FinInteract是一个双语(英/中)金融领域歧义问答基准，包含173个实例，每题配对"默认"和"意图"两种解读，通过五类歧义分类法评估LLM智能体能否正确提出澄清问题并整合回答，揭示了现有单黄金标准基准因"单黄金幻觉"将GPT-4o准确率虚高3.1倍的盲点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融问题常表面完整实则模糊不清(如Meta营业总收入46.75B合并口径 vs. 62.87B应用家族分部)，现有金融QA基准采用单一黄金答案的单轮评估，无法区分真正解决歧义的智能体与猜测常见解读的智能体，这一盲点被称为"单黄金幻觉"，在金融领域尚未被系统性研究。

Method: 1) 定义五类金融歧义分类法(时间范围、指标定义、实体范围、申报版本、确认政策);2) 通过三角色流水线(构造器GPT-5、代码级健全性检查、对抗验证器)半自动构建数据集;3) 在ReAct框架下评估search/interact/answer三种动作的智能体;4) 引入默认vs意图双解读设计、澄清目标定位(AC@1)、分类感知干预(推理时Category-Aware ReAct + 训练时SFT/GRPO);5) 通过线性探针分析模型内部歧义表征。

Result: 1) 单黄金幻觉确认：按默认而非意图重新评分使GPT-4o准确率膨胀3.1倍;2) 智能体在获得消歧上下文后准确率达93-95%，但自行消歧时最高仅28.9%;3) 11/16模型增加交互反而降低准确率;4) 实体范围、指标定义、时间范围几乎总被识别，但确认政策所有模型AC@1=0;5) 分类感知推理将GPT-5从34.0%提升至46.0%;6) 分类引导SFT将Qwen3-4B的AC@1从25提升至69;7) 人类基线仅30%，证明任务本身困难;8) 线性探针显示歧义类别信息在模型高层表征中线性可解码(0.80准确率)，但模型不据此行动。

Conclusion: 金融QA歧义处理的瓶颈不在于金融知识储备，而在于交互能力——具体而言是正确提出澄清问题并将其整合为最终答案的能力;歧义类别是不同类型的学习问题，部分可随规模解决，确认政策则是规模不变的盲点;FinInteract不仅可诊断，还可作为训练信号;成对构建设计可推广到更多类别、语言和高风险领域;数据集以约$0.31/实例的低成本构建，可在约$300内扩展至1000实例。

Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly answer financial questions by searching regulatory filings. Such questions are often deceptively under-specified: Meta Platforms' "operating income" is $46.75B consolidated but $62.87B for the Family of Apps segment, and each reading is exactly verifiable against the filing. A capable agent should recognize the ambiguity and ask, rather than commit to a plausible but unintended reading. Existing financial benchmarks cannot measure this, because one gold answer per question cannot separate agents that resolve the ambiguity from those that guess the common reading, a blind spot we call the single-gold illusion. We release FinInteract, a bilingual (English/Chinese) benchmark of 173 instances that pairs each question with a default and an intended interpretation across a five-category ambiguity taxonomy, and grades whether an agent elicits the right clarification and then integrates it. Re-grading identical outputs against the default rather than the intended reading inflates GPT-4o's accuracy by 3.1 times, confirming the illusion. Beyond it, we find that models answer above 90% once the interpretation is supplied but at most 28.9% when they must elicit it themselves, that targeting is uneven across a taxonomy well powered for entity scope and metric definition and exploratory elsewhere, and that conditioning on the ambiguity category improves resolution at both inference and training time.

</details>


### [301] [Testing, not presuming, adequacy: calibrating generative social simulators against emergent network structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24012)
*Tengfei Shao,Chao Li,Xu Wang,Masayuki Goto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种"充分性感知"的生成式社会模拟器校准协议,通过摊销后验估计结合合成可识别性评估、匹配样本量的充分性检验、诊断引导修复和统计保留审计,在二手奢侈品转售市场(4个渠道-居住地单元)上验证了一个基于语言模型人格画像的前向模型。结论是:独立聚合模型(无智能体交互、无买家宽度机制)无法联合再现市场的购买层级水平、头部品牌集中度、社区结构和买家宽度异质性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式社会模拟器的验证往往止于表面效度(face validity),仅描述性地比较涌现网络结构,缺乏参数不确定性的量化以及充分性检验(ad-equacy check)。这使得模拟结果难以判断是否真正捕捉到了真实市场的关键统计特征,也无法诊断失败原因。

Method: 提出包含四个组件的校准协议:(1)摊销后验估计 + 合成可识别性评估(synthetic identifiability assessment);(2)匹配样本量的充分性检查,包括先验预测可达性(prior-predictive reachability)和逐统计后验预测定位(posterior-predictive localization);(3)诊断引导的修复(diagnosis-guided repair);(4)统计保留审计(statistic-held-out audit)。应用对象是4个渠道×居住地单元的买家-品牌二部网络,前向模型由语言模型离线一次性生成的画像(persona profiles)驱动。还进行了画像来源消融(profile-source ablation)。

Result: 所有四个单元中行为参数均可恢复,但其中一个参数的校准近似且过自信。观测到的汇总统计在每个单元中均落在可达性参考范围之外,平均购买层级是普遍性偏差。修复在4个单元中有2个达到值块标准(value-block criterion)但未恢复充分性。保留审计暴露了买家-广度离散度的偏差,此前诊断未能检测到。画像来源消融显示语言模型画像在所有4个单元中优于平坦规则基线,但类别内品牌重标记不导致一致性退化。

Conclusion: 在不做因果声明的前提下得出结论:独立的聚合账户(independent-aggregation account)——即不含智能体间交互、不含买家-广度机制(breadth mechanism)——无法联合再现该二手奢侈品转售市场的购买层级水平、头部品牌集中度、社区结构和买家-广度异质性。语言模型生成的画像作为部分验证的输入,其价值在于结构而非品牌身份。

Abstract: Validation of generative social simulators often stops at face validity: emergent network structure is compared descriptively, without quantified parameter uncertainty or an adequacy check. We present an adequacy-aware calibration protocol that couples amortized posterior estimation with a synthetic identifiability assessment, a matched-sample-size adequacy check (prior-predictive reachability plus per-statistic posterior-predictive localization), a diagnosis-guided repair, and a statistic-held-out audit. We demonstrate it on a real second-hand luxury resale market with four channel-by-residency cells, each a bipartite buyer-brand network, using a forward model built from persona profiles elicited once, offline, by a language model. The behavioural parameters are recoverable in all four cells, though calibration is approximate and overconfident for one parameter. The observed summary falls outside the simulator's reachability reference in every cell, with the mean purchased tier as the pervasive discrepancy. The repair meets the value-block criterion in two of four cells but does not restore adequacy, and the held-out audit surfaces a buyer-breadth-dispersion miss no earlier diagnostic detected. A profile-source ablation finds the language-model profiles beat a flat rule baseline in all four cells, yet within-category brand relabelling causes no consistent degradation, so the profiles are a partially validated input whose value rests on structure, not brand identity. Making no causal claim, we conclude that an independent-aggregation account, without agent interaction or a buyer-breadth mechanism, cannot jointly reproduce the market's purchased-tier level, head-brand concentration, community structure and buyer-breadth heterogeneity.

</details>


### [302] [Context-Aware Pre-Deployment Evaluation of AI Systems: A Regulatory Framework for Nigerian Fintech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24016)
*Andrew Anogie Uduimoh,Hadiza Umar Yusuf,Oluwafemi Osho*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对尼日利亚金融科技领域AI系统部署前评估的监管空白,基于对全球、非洲大陆及尼日利亚治理工具的综述,以及自研SafeAlert评估套件对6个商业大模型的实证测试,提出面向CBN、NITDA、SEC及非盟的部署前评估监管框架建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尼日利亚金融科技领域AI部署率高(87.5%用于欺诈检测),且CBN已通过反洗钱指令将AI部署变为法定义务,但现有尼日利亚及非洲大陆层级的治理工具均未规定AI系统在采购前应接受何种部署前评估。通用安全基准(如ToxiGen、BBQ、TruthfulQA、HarmBench)缺乏尼日利亚机构内容,无法检测该领域特有的两类失败模式:欺诈脚本生成与合法金融通信的误分类。本研究旨在识别这一监管规范空白并提出可操作的框架建议。

Method: (1) 文献与监管工具综述:比较欧盟AI法案、NIST AI RMF、UNESCO AI伦理建议、AU大陆AI战略、尼日利亚NAIS及CBN 2026年AML基线标准。(2) 自研SafeAlert评估套件:包含150条分类消息(66条安全/26条可疑/58条欺诈,覆盖GTBank、Kuda、OPay等机构真实警报格式)和160条生成提示(8类尼日利亚欺诈场景,4种框架条件)。(3) 对6个商业LLM(GPT-4o mini、Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen 2.5 7B、DeepSeek V3、Mistral Small、Grok 3 Mini)进行3种系统提示条件(预修复/通用安全修复/尼日利亚语境修复)下的生成任务(2880次)与分类任务(2700次)评估。(4) 标签构建采用两步顺序审查流程(主研究员+领域专家),记录24项修正。

Result: 生成任务:Mistral Small预修复有害输出率99.4%,通用安全提示降至3.1%;Qwen 2.5 7B在三种条件下持续偏高(85.0%→86.3%→58.1%);Grok 3 Mini表现最佳(21.3%→0.0%→0.0%)。分类任务:预修复时Mistral Small和GPT-4o mini假阳性率高达84.8%和81.8%;Qwen 2.5 7B假阴性率达100%;尼日利亚语境条件下Llama 3.3 70B假阳性率最低(6.1%)、Grok 3 Mini综合最佳(FPR 9.1%、FNR 3.4%);Mistral Small和GPT-4o mini即使在语境修复后FPR仍为48.5%。关键发现:生成任务与分类任务的对齐表现不相关,通用安全提示对分类准确性改善有限。完整评估的API成本低于2.5美元。

Conclusion: 监管缺口根源于规范缺失而非资源不足。本文提出四项建议:(1)CBN将部署前评估报告纳入现有AML合规要求,NITDA制定金融科技AI技术指南,SEC覆盖投资欺诈检测领域;(2)借鉴欧盟AI法案合格评估结构,提出面向尼日利亚资源约束的分级评估模型(最低/标准/增强三级);(4)推动非盟在大陆AI战略第一阶段实施指南中纳入语境特定评估要求,建立非洲大陆共享AI评估库。该框架对肯尼亚、加纳等可比非洲市场具有结构可适配性。

Abstract: Commercial large language models are increasingly deployed across African fintech infrastructure for fraud detection and customer communication, yet no Nigerian or African continental regulatory instrument specifies what pre-deployment evaluation such systems must undergo before procurement. This paper reviews African fintech AI governance across global, continental, and Nigerian instruments, and shows that safety is affirmed as a principle while pre-deployment evaluation is operationally unspecified. Generic safety benchmarks cannot surface the failure modes most relevant to this domain, since none contain Nigerian institutional content or test for false positive misclassification of legitimate financial communications. These claims are demonstrated using SafeAlert, a purpose-built evaluation kit applied to six commercial models across three system prompt conditions. Results show that models resisting generic harmful content requests still produce complete fraud scripts under specific framing, and that several models misclassify most legitimate Nigerian bank communications as suspicious or fraudulent, a failure invisible to standard safety evaluation. The paper concludes with a regulatory framework proposing pre-deployment evaluation requirements for the CBN, NITDA, SEC, and the AU, arguing that the identified gap reflects an absence of regulatory specification, not a shortage of technical or financial resources.

</details>


### [303] [Synthesizing Reactive Character Behaviors for Continuous Games via Programmatic Policy Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24025)
*Maxim Gumin,Hsueh-Ti Derek Liu,Victor Zordan,Daniel Ritchie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向连续游戏角色的程序化策略搜索方法，通过自定义DSL语言结合自底向上符号枚举和LLM编码智能体（agentic sketching），从奖励函数自动合成可读、可编辑的程序策略，并在14个连续游戏基准上验证其优于纯编码智能体和纯枚举方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 游戏AI实践中行为树/状态机需手工编写，而深度强化学习产生的神经网络控制器难以检视、编辑和移植。现有程序化策略搜索工作局限于离散网格世界，缺乏面向连续空间游戏（涉及距离、方向、速度、遮挡、碰撞等）的统一DSL和基准。本文旨在填补这一空白，让设计师只需提供奖励函数即可获得可编辑、可移植的程序化行为。

Method: 方法包含两大组件：(1) 统一的策略DSL：基于光线投射（raycasting）等几何感知原语和maxDirection等高阶函数，覆盖14个连续游戏，采用LISP-like S表达式语法；(2) 搜索算法：自底向上符号枚举器使用大量"反模式"（antipatterns）剪枝冗余表达式；结合LLM编码智能体的agentic sketching方法，由智能体提出高层策略结构（sketch），调用枚举器穷举填充局部"洞"（hole），并允许sketch特定的局部反模式。评估指标为多种子下最小分数聚合。

Result: 在14个连续游戏基准（覆盖任务包括Lawnmower、Chase、MouseCats、ButtonCheese、Pathfinding、Football等）上20分钟预算的实验显示：(1) 纯符号搜索（无需LLM，单CPU运行）平均归一化得分1.00，显著优于纯LLM编码智能体（0.76）；(2) Agentic sketching结合两者达到最佳平均得分1.23，尽管测试策略数量（1.71×10^5）远少于纯搜索（1.99×10^6）；(3) PPO平均表现略优，但在Dodgeball、ProtectTheChild等稀疏奖励游戏中程序化搜索明显胜过PPO；(4) 在ButtonCheese等游戏中发现了令人惊讶的高效策略（如反复按按钮生成奶酪再统一收集）。同时实验也发现了路径规划游戏中无法处理宽死胡同和复杂迷宫的局限性。

Conclusion: 精心设计的DSL配合反模式剪枝的符号枚举是连续游戏程序化策略搜索的强基线；将LLM用于高层结构、枚举器用于局部填充的组合策略效果最佳。程序化策略合成有望成为连接手工游戏AI与不透明学习控制器之间的桥梁，使设计师能获得可检视、可编辑的行为程序。主要局限性在于DSL缺乏数值参数，限制了需要精确阈值/增益的行为；未来工作包括自动推导反模式、丰富策略评估反馈、以及智能体创建简化课程来发现策略片段。

Abstract: We present a method for synthesizing reactive character behaviors for continuous games as compact, human-readable programs. Game AI practice still relies heavily on manually authored behavior trees, state machines, and scripts, while academic reinforcement learning typically produces opaque neural controllers that are expensive to train and difficult to edit. Our approach bridges this gap by searching directly over a domain-specific language for continuous-space game policies. The language is designed around reactive geometric decisions and includes higher-order constructs such as direction maximization. These constructs help discretize a continuous behavior space into enumerable program structures. To make program search practical, we introduce a large set of synthesis antipatterns that remove redundant program forms while preserving behavioral coverage. We further combine bottom-up symbolic enumeration with top-down guidance from a coding agent. Our resulting method, agentic sketching, has the agent propose high-level policy structure and call an enumerator to complete local program slots. We evaluate the method on a benchmark of 14 continuous games, ranging from classic control tasks to multi-agent football. We find that pure enumeration is often more efficient than using a coding agent alone, while the combined method substantially outperforms both. Our results suggest that programmatic policy search can be a practical authoring tool for game AI: designers specify reward functions, and the system discovers editable behaviors that are effective, portable, and often surprising.

</details>


### [304] [Structured Decomposition for Reliable LLM-Generated Access Control Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24036)
*Vatsal Gupta,Darshan Sreenivasamurthy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于LLM的模块化系统，通过将自然语言访问控制策略（NLACP）分解为DSARCP结构化组件（Decision、Subject、Action、Resource、Condition、Purpose），并结合模式验证、lint检查、编译和自动化测试等多阶段验证，将NLACP翻译为可在Open Policy Agent（OPA）上执行的Rego策略。在372条ACRE完整策略上的评估显示，该系统端到端正确率达50.3%，相比直接单次提示LLM基线的15.3%提升3.3倍；在安全关键语义上，拒绝规则完整性从37.5%提升至87.5%，所有权和状态条件完整性均达100%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM直接将自然语言访问控制策略翻译为形式化策略代码时，容易出现实体幻觉、遗漏关键约束或生成语法正确但语义错误的策略，导致过度授权或权限升级等安全风险。现有工作多关注提取准确性，而对输入验证、语义完整性和可部署性关注不足。

Method: 采用四模块流水线：1）预处理（策略检测、指代消解、文本分割）；2）基于few-shot和program-of-thought提示的DSARCP组件提取；3）基于组织预定义JSON模式的模式验证，验证后的模式直接注入Rego生成提示；4）Rego生成与三阶段验证修复——冗余块合并、opa check与Regal lint的迭代反馈循环、所有权/状态语义安全护栏，以及基于DSARCP的自动化正/负测试生成与修复。

Result: 在372条ACRE完整策略上评估（统一使用Claude、温度0.0）：系统有效正确覆盖率为50.3%，基线为15.3%（3.3倍提升）；接受率55.4% vs 20.7%。在77条重叠策略上，系统全四阶段通过率90.9% vs 74.0%。安全关键指标：拒绝规则完整性87.5% vs 37.5%；所有权条件完整性100% vs 40%；状态条件完整性100% vs 55.6%；所有权/状态条件遗漏率从60%/44%降至0%。系统角色检查检测率略低（87.0% vs 90.9%），但属于检测方法局限（集合成员表达式未被正则匹配）。

Conclusion: 结构化分解和模式感知验证是提升LLM生成授权策略可靠性的关键，而非代码合成能力本身。系统将翻译任务从直接生成转变为可验证、可审计的工程流水线，同时作为策略即代码工作台和研究测试平台。局限性在于模式需手动枚举、测试生成对复杂策略仍有挑战、正确性衡量为操作有效性而非完整语义等价。未来工作包括模式通配符支持、独立测试生成、多语言输出（Cedar/XACML/NGAC）以及扩展时序、角色继承、目的约束等语义安全护栏。

Abstract: This paper presents an LLM-based system that translates natural-language access control policies (NLACPs) into executable Rego code for Open Policy Agent (OPA). It provides a modular, end-to-end pipeline for policy detection, component extraction, schema validation, linting, compilation, and automated test generation and execution. The system is designed to bridge the gap between human-readable access requirements and machine-enforceable policy-as-code (PaC), with a focus on deployment reliability and security correctness. We evaluate the system on 372 ACRE-complete access control statements with non-null subject, action, and resource annotations against a direct single-prompt LLM baseline to isolate the contribution of structured decomposition and schema-aware validation. The system achieves a 50.3% end-to-end policy correctness rate, compared with 15.3% for the baseline, representing a 3.3x improvement. A policy is counted as correct only if it satisfies compilation, linting, and both positive and negative tests, making this a strict measure of deployable correctness. On security-critical patterns, the system generates correct deny semantics for 87.5% of deny policies (baseline: 37.5%), ownership conditions for 100% of ownership-qualified policies (baseline: 40%), and status-qualified conditions for 100% of status-qualified policies (baseline: 55.6%). These results indicate that structured decomposition and schema-aware validation play a critical role in improving the reliability of LLM-generated authorization policies.

</details>


### [305] [Representation-guided in-context learning for medical image interpretation with multimodal large language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24057)
*Minda Zhao,Fangyu Hu,Yan Luo,Yutong Yang,Jiahui Cai,Kaichen Zhou,Manling Li,Paul Liang,Yilun Du,Lucy Q. Shen,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为 RG-ICL（representation-guided in-context learning）的免训练推理框架，通过利用冻结编码器检索与查询对齐的演示样本来增强多模态大语言模型在医学图像任务中的表现，无需针对特定任务进行参数更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管多模态大语言模型在医学图像解读中具有潜力，但适配医学领域通常需要资源密集型的领域微调。本文旨在探索一种无需训练、基于上下文学习的替代方案，以降低对计算资源的需求。

Method: 该方法采用表示引导的上下文学习（RG-ICL），通过冻结的编码器检索与查询对齐的演示样本（reference cases），无需任务特定的参数更新。对于视觉问答（VQA）任务，特别强调使参考样例同时在图像内容和问题意图上与查询保持一致。

Result: 在涵盖组织病理学、放射学和视网膜眼底检查的八个数据集上，RG-ICL 在分类任务上平均提升 20 个百分点，在 VQA 任务上平均提升 13 个百分点，优于无上下文和传统 ICL 方法，且接近或超越基于训练的对标方法。关键发现是检索样例的质量比数量更重要：6 个查询对齐的样例优于多达 32 个随机选取的样例，而固定或随机样例往往使准确率低于基线。

Conclusion: 对于医学图像解读任务，精心挑选 MLLM 所见的参考样例（curating reference cases）是模型重训练之外的一种实用替代方案，表明演示样例的选择策略比传统认为的更具决定性作用。

Abstract: Medical image interpretation is central to diagnosis and care, yet adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often requires resource-intensive domain-specific fine-tuning. Here we introduce representation-guided in-context learning (RG-ICL), a training-free inference framework that retrieves query-aligned demonstrations using frozen encoders, without task-specific parameter updates. Across eight datasets spanning histopathology, radiology and retinal fundoscopy, RG-ICL improved classification (mean gain 20 percentage points) and visual question answering (VQA) (mean gain 13 percentage points) over no-context and conventional ICL, approaching or exceeding training-based comparators. Which cases were retrieved mattered more than how many: 6 query-aligned cases outperformed up to 32 randomly selected ones, whereas fixed or random cases often reduced accuracy below baseline. For VQA, aligning reference cases with both image content and question intent produced further gains. These findings indicate that for medical image interpretation, curating which reference cases an MLLM sees is a practical alternative to retraining it.

</details>


### [306] [Incremental Consistency Execution for Autonomous Intelligent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24090)
*Cheng Li,Jiexiong Liu,Yixuan Chen,Ziheng Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种基于"任务事实契约 + 字段级依赖掩码 + 状态扰动结果不变域"的增量一致性执行方法,用于在长时程自治智能系统中最小化对昂贵组件(LLM、模型推理、外部API、规则引擎等)的冗余重调用,同时通过提交时版本一致性门保证副作用类操作的提交安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作流系统在外部状态(传感器、数据库、API、配置等)持续变化时,普遍采用"上游变化→整条下游失效重执行"或"全键缓存命中即复用"的粗粒度策略,将"输入变化"等同于"输出必错",忽略了大量"输入扰动但契约级结论不变"的情形,导致大量冗余的模型推理、工具调用、网络与存储开销;此外,现有缓存键通常对输入字段做整体哈希,无法回答"在输入的何种变化范围内,某个输出字段的契约语义保持不变"这一机器可执行问题,且缺乏对LLM非确定性输出的契约级等价判定,以及对支付、设备控制等副作用操作的独立安全把关。

Method: 将运行时控制结构组织为五个相互关联的构造:(1) Task Fact——对外部观测与中间结果加版本化、可机器校验的包装,记录来源版本、有效性谓词、验证程序与状态(VALID/RENEWED/INVALID);(2) Task Fact Contract——为每个执行步骤绑定输入/输出模式、前置条件、字段级依赖掩码 M ∈ {0,1}^(|X|×|Y|) 与等价判据 E,掩码可由静态分析、动态读写追踪、单字段受扰扰动或人工声明取并集再经校验精化;(3) Field-level Dependency Index——输入事实字段到(步骤,输出字段)消费者的倒排索引,支持 O(1) 失效定位;(4) State Perturbation Result Invariant Domain——在已验证执行后,通过在无副作用验证环境中做约束扰动、边界搜索与保守收缩,为每对(输入字段a,输出字段b)构造保守的输入子域 Ω̂_i(a,b) ⊆ Ω_i(a,b),域描述符绑定组件版本 verComp、契约版本 verContract、等价版本 verEquiv、稳定/不稳定样本摘要、边界样本集与置信度 c_i,并支持在线收缩/扩张与多字段联合域;(5) Equivalence Barrier——变更处理流水线依次进行"身份(版本一致)+ 前置条件 + 域成员"三条件检查与现场校验,命中则生成续期记录 R 跳过昂贵重调用,未命中则按 M 仅重算最小输出字段集 S={b: M[a,b]=1},再用契约级等价判据 E(y_new, y_old) 决定是否阻断下游传播;最后,提交时版本一致性门对比动作开始时的版本向量 v_start 与提交时重新读取的版本向量 v_commit 的差集 Δ,要求 Δ 为空或每个差异均已通过最小重执行+等价证据或仍满足不变域+现场校验,从而在不可逆副作用(支付、设备控制、权限变更、不可逆写入)上强制重新执行授权与幂等检查,防止不变域命中"静默绕过"提交安全门。

Result: 在三类任务族上进行工业级验证:(a) 工业旋转机械故障诊断——电机转速 1490→1502 rpm 命中不变域 [1470,1510],免去一次 GPU 故障分类推理,端到端延迟由 380 ms 降至 65 ms;振动频谱越界时仍因故障类别与严重度在等价判据下保持不变而阻断下游重执行,节省一次下游推理;(b) 企业分析周报——毛利率≥30% ∧ |预算偏差|≤5% 的联合数值域使新增小订单可免去 LLM 摘要调用,每次刷新节省约 4.2 s,预算偏差达 8% 时仅重生成风险段落而不重生成无关段落;(c) LLM 多工具助手——价格 ∈ [0,50000] 的不变域使 42000→43500 时免去一次 LLM 规划与解释调用,价格升至 53000 时触发决策重算与建议重生成;规则文档版本变化时强制把对应不变域标记为待重校验,防止"价格仍在历史区间但规则已变"的错误复用;在 1200 条含支付动作的采购提案测试中,提交门正确拦截 47 例因域命中续期但期间权限事实已变更的提案并放行其余 1153 例,无静默绕过。汇总指标:每次变更的昂贵调用数 1.00(全重执行)/ 0.84(粗粒度缓存)/ 0.18(本方法),端到端延迟 380 / 120 / 65 ms,续期独立校验通过率 91.4% / 98.6%,提交门拦截精度 100%,错误传播率 3.8% / 0.4%。

Conclusion: 该方法通过将任务事实、契约与不变域提升为一类运行时对象,并以"三条件检查 + 现场校验 + 字段级最小重执行 + 等价屏障 + 提交时版本一致性门"的流水线,在保留新鲜度与一致性的同时显著降低自治智能系统中昂贵组件的调用次数与端到端延迟,把"计算可续期"与"副作用可提交"显式解耦,从而避免不变域命中静默绕过支付、设备控制等不可逆操作;局限在于依赖可无副作用运行的验证环境、要求每个输出字段至少有一条机器可执行的确定性等价规则、高维联合域构造代价较高,以及在源系统离线时续期需延迟,未来工作包括将等价判据与强化学习决策结合、面向边缘间歇连通性的分布式续期协调,以及与形式化验证结合以给出自动化决策的认证安全界。

Abstract: Long-horizon autonomous intelligent systems rely on heterogeneous components such as large language models, databases, external APIs, and rule engines, while their external states continuously change during execution. Re-executing the entire workflow after every change introduces substantial redundant computation. This paper proposes an incremental consistency execution method based on task fact contracts, field-level dependency masks, and state perturbation result invariant domains. After an initial verified execution, the system constructs conservative invariant domains for critical inputs and uses them to determine whether downstream results can be safely renewed without re-invoking expensive components. When re-execution is required, only the smallest affected output fields are recomputed, and an equivalence barrier prevents unnecessary downstream propagation. A submission-time version consistency gate further ensures the safety of side-effecting actions. Experiments on industrial fault diagnosis, enterprise analytics, and LLM-based multi-tool assistants show that the proposed method significantly reduces expensive component calls and end-to-end latency while maintaining high consistency and low incorrect-reuse rates.

</details>


### [307] [DocMIDE: Learning Multi-Hop Implicit Derivation in Visually Rich Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24092)
*Jeremy Cerwin Wang,Wai Kit Wong,Jeff Kai Tai Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DocMIDE框架，通过"计划-检索-推导"结构化生成与GRPO强化学习，训练≤4B参数的视觉语言模型在视觉丰富文档中执行多跳隐式推导，仅需50个标注样本即可将Qwen3.5-4B准确率从70.8%提升至95.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际文档处理中，许多关键目标字段在页面上没有直接视觉对应（如未打印的年度本金总额），需要通过聚合子类目或多步算术等多跳推导才能获得。现有方法在显式文本跨度提取上表现良好，但在多跳视觉推理上失败：要么检索到错误的视觉证据，要么检索正确却跳过中间推导步骤。标准监督微调也无法弥合此差距。

Method: DocMIDE采用两阶段训练框架：(1) SFT冷启动阶段，强制模型输出"计划-检索-推导"三阶段结构（使用<raw>...</raw>标签隔离显式证据块）；(2) GRPO强化学习阶段，采用四组件规则奖励函数：格式一致性(R_f, λ=0.25)、证据质量(R_g, λ=1.0，含precision/recall/utility三个子项)、逐步推理(R_s, λ=0.75，基于LCS或累加器模式匹配)、答案准确性(R_a, λ=2.5)。每个训练样本标注为四元组(规划追踪, 证据块, 逐步执行追踪, 真值)。使用LoRA在单张RTX 4090上微调。

Result: 在4,151对的隐式提取基准测试上：Qwen3.5-4B准确率从70.8%提升至95.9%（+25.1%），InternVL3.5-4B从13.5%提升至82.6%（+69.1%）。优于所有基线（Vision-R1: 72.8%, StaR-KVQA: 76.3%）。样本效率极高：仅50个样本即达峰值性能。域外任务（DocVQA, OmniDocBench, ChartQAPro）无灾难性遗忘，Qwen3.5-4B在DocVQA上从81.9%提升至92.7%。标准微调在200样本全量下仍仅68.7%，验证了监督演示无法解决步长跳跃问题。

Conclusion: DocMIDE为视觉丰富文档中的多跳隐式推导提供了有效解决方案，通过显式证据锚定和逐步奖励机制，使紧凑VLM能够可靠执行多步视觉推理，仅需极少量标注数据，且不会导致通用能力的灾难性遗忘，为可验证视觉推理奠定了基础，可扩展至多页文档和更大规模多模态系统。

Abstract: Real-world document processing systems rely on rigid, predefined schemas, yet critical target fields often lack direct visual counterparts on the page. Extracting these implicit values requires multi-hop derivation, such as aggregating sub-categories or reasoning over visual marks. While existing methods handle explicit text spans or simple implicit queries, they fail at multi-hop visual reasoning even after standard fine-tuning: models retrieve incorrect visual evidence, or retrieve it correctly and then skip the intermediate steps of the derivation. To address this, we introduce DocMIDE, a fine-tuning framework that trains compact vision-language models to retrieve visual evidence explicitly before deriving an answer. DocMIDE constrains generation to a plan-retrieve-derive structure and optimizes it with Group Relative Policy Optimization under a four-component, rule-based reward that scores output format, the retrieved evidence block, every intermediate derivation step, and the final value against a verified reference trace. On a 4,151-pair implicit extraction benchmark, DocMIDE raises accuracy from 70.8% to 95.9% on Qwen3.5-4B from only a small set of annotated examples, and transfers to a second backbone architecture. Supervised demonstrations alone do not close this gap at any budget we tested; rewarding the intermediate steps is what does.

</details>


### [308] [When More Evidence Hurts: Publication-Bias Drift and Principled Stopping for Biomedical Causal Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24101)
*Fred Sun,Shangqi Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了生物医学证据合成中检索越深、错误越多的"证据漂移"现象，并提出了一种具备漂移感知能力的因果图智能体（DACG-agent），通过双层停止策略在检索效率与抗偏准确性之间取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学文献系统性偏向阳性结果，检索深度的增加会累积这种偏差，使系统对真实零效应（null-effect）的查询越来越倾向于错误推断为"有益"。现有方法——包括零样本LLM、RAG、知识图谱智能体——均未解决迭代检索过程中偏差累积的问题。

Method: 1. 形式化"证据漂移"现象，并证明在标准发表偏倚模型下，零效应查询的误分类概率随检索深度严格递增、趋向于1（定理1）；2. 提出DACG-agent：从PubMed摘要增量构建因果知识图谱，采用noisy-OR更新边置信度、Boltzmann路径强度计算标签后验；3. 设计双层停止策略：KL散度监测后验收敛保证准确性（命题1），Bradley-Trey过程奖励模型（PRM）在线检测奖励下降保证效率（定理2）。

Result: 在Cochrane衍生的140个测试查询（70 Beneficial / 70 NoEffect）上：DACG-agent将证据漂移从15.7%（k=20）降至6.4%，零效应准确率从40.0%提升至61.4%（+21.4 pp），总体准确率从61.4%升至69.3%（95% CI 61–77），同时减少67%的检索步骤。消融实验表明KL层主导准确性提升，PRM层贡献效率。模拟证实漂移现象从投票计数聚合器迁移到部署的noisy-OR聚合器；跨LLM实验证实漂移源于文献阳性偏倚而非检索噪声。实体接地分析表明接地良好的临床实体反而漂移更严重（36.4% vs 17.3%），因为它们积累更多文献。

Conclusion: 发表偏倚为基于检索的生物医学证据合成制造了结构性陷阱：检索文献越多，系统越可能将真实的零效应误判为有益。DACG-agent通过双层停止策略有效缓解了证据漂移，同时显著提升了检索效率。在发表偏倚下的生物医学证据合成中，何时停止检索与检索什么内容同等重要。

Abstract: Automated biomedical evidence synthesis depends on retrieving published studies, but the biomedical literature is systematically skewed toward positive findings. Deeper retrieval can therefore make a system \emph{more} likely to falsely infer benefit when the true effect is null. We formalise this phenomenon as \emph{evidence drift} and prove that, under a standard publication-bias model, the false-positive probability on null-effect queries follows a strictly increasing large-sample envelope in retrieval depth, approaching one. Empirically, on a held-out test set of 140 Cochrane-derived queries, drift rises monotonically from 7.9\% to 15.7\% as the retrieval budget grows from 3 to 20 steps, and concentrates in the null-effect class.
