Abstract: For a fixed integer $r\geq4$, the $K_r-e$-free graph sandwich problem asks whether, given graphs $G_1\subseteq G_2$ on the same vertex set, there is an induced-$K_r-e$-free graph $H$ between them. We give a deterministic algorithm taking $O(n+\alpha(G_2)^{r-3}m_2)$ time and space, where $m_2=|E(G_2)|$ and $\alpha(G_2)$ is the arboricity of $G_2$. In particular, the diamond-free case takes $O(n+\alpha(G_2)m_2)$ time. This improves the direct $O(n^r m_2)$ implementation of the previously known forced-edge closure. Our implementation maintains components of common neighborhoods indexed by $(r-3)$-cliques. A filtered frontier supports their merges within the clique-listing bound, while completion events avoid repeatedly searching for affected cliques. On feasible instances the output is contained in every feasible sandwich, independently of processing order. Applying the closure to $(G,K_n)$ gives an $O(n^{r-1})$-time bound for partitioned and nonpartitioned probe $K_r-e$-free recognition, improving the $O(n^{r+2})$ bound obtained from the direct sandwich closure. We also describe a direct static recognizer based on the same local characterization.

### [366] [Single-Pass Estimation of the Clustering Coefficient Distribution in Graph Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23489)
*Cristian Boldrin,C. Seshadhri*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Triangle counting is one of the most fundamental problems in network analysis. Given the massive sizes of real-world graphs, there is a long history of small-space streaming algorithms providing accurate estimates for this problem. However, most of the results focus on estimating the total triangle count or the number of triangles incident to individual nodes. In practice, one often wants fine-grained information to understand how triangles are distributed, as captured by clustering coefficients. In particular, a standard network analysis task requires computing the binned degree-wise clustering coefficient distribution, which provides a rich and informative summary of the structure of the graph. In this work we present BOLIDE, the first efficient and practical algorithm for estimating binned degree-wise clustering coefficients in streaming. Our algorithm makes a single pass over the edge stream, and is allowed to store only a small fraction of the total number of edges. BOLIDE carefully combines different sampling strategies to efficiently gather degree and triangle information across sets of nodes. As a result, our algorithm provably approximates the binned degree-wise clustering coefficients, and provides guarantees on the amount of memory used. Our experimental evaluation shows that BOLIDE accurately estimates clustering coefficient distributions while efficiently processing large datasets with billions of edges and triangles.

### [367] [Vector Balancing in Polynomial Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23540)
*Shengtao Guo,Ethan X. Fang,Junwei Lu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We present a spectral signing algorithm solving the Komlós problem with a constant discrepancy in polynomial time. Given a matrix $A\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ whose columns have Euclidean norm at most $1$, the algorithm finds a vector $\varepsilon\in\{-1,1\}^n$ satisfying $\|A\varepsilon\|_\infty\le C$, where $C$ is an absolute constant. By minimizing a cubic spectral potential, our spectral signing algorithm updates the fractional coloring toward Boolean signs with time complexity $O((mn^9+n^{10})\log(2+m+n))$.

### [368] [Budget-Independent Influence Maximization in Nearly Linear Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23604)
*Zhijie Zhang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Influence maximization asks for $k$ seed vertices that maximize the expected spread of a diffusion process in a network. Standard near-optimal-time algorithms based on reverse-reachable sampling achieve a $(1-1/e-\varepsilon)$ approximation, but their worst-case running-time bounds grow linearly with the seed budget $k$. We remove this multiplicative dependence: for the independent cascade model, our algorithm succeeds with probability at least $1-\delta$ in $O((m+n)\varepsilon^{-3}\log(2n/\delta))$ expected time. The result extends to triggering models with explicitly charged local sampling costs. We reserve $O(\varepsilon k)$ seed positions for cost-weighted random vertices, allowing reverse-reachable searches to stop as soon as they encounter a reserved seed. An independent sample-count estimation phase uses a statistic that also controls the expected search cost. Matching these quantities eliminates the multiplicative dependence on $k$ while preserving the approximation guarantee.

### [369] [A Polynomial Kernel for Planar Directed Feedback Vertex Set](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23669)
*Zimo Sheng,Mingyu Xiao*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The Directed Feedback Vertex Set problem (DFVS) asks whether a digraph can be made acyclic by deleting at most $k$ vertices. Whether DFVS admits a polynomial kernel parameterized by $k$ is a major open problem in kernelization, even for planar digraphs. We resolve the planar case by giving a deterministic kernel with $O(k^{66}\log^2 k)$ vertices and arcs. Our algorithm proceeds in three stages. First, we apply structural reduction rules to the input digraph, bounding the number of directed faces and some special vertices. Second, we pass to the planar dual, where vertex deletion corresponds to adding groups of reverse arcs to make each weakly connected component strongly connected. The structural bounds in the first stage yield a small retained vertex set in the dual. We then compress the dual instance by identifying vertices with the same distance records from this retained vertex set. The main technical contribution is a directed-cut argument showing that this identification preserves feasibility. Finally, we transform the polynomial-size dual instance back into an instance of Planar Directed Feedback Vertex Set via a $3$-CNF encoding and a planar graph construction.

### [370] [A general counting and sampling Lovász local lemma](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23671)
*Vishesh Jain,Clayton Mizgerd,Huy Tuan Pham*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Consider a constraint satisfaction problem $\mathbf{C}$ on finitely many independent random variables with dependency graph $G$. Let $p_a$ be the violation probability of a constraint $a\in \mathbf{C}$ and $N_G^2 (a)$ the set of constraints at distance one or two from $a$ in $G$. Suppose that, there exists $x\in (0,1)^{\mathbf{C}}$ such that, for a sufficiently small universal constant $c > 0$, and for all $a \in \mathbf{C}$, \[ p_a \leq c \cdot x_a \prod_{b\in N_G^2(a)}(1-x_b). \] Under the above analog of the asymmetric Lovász Local Lemma, we give an FPRAS for the probability that all constraints are satisfied, and an approximate sampler, running in polynomial expected time, for the product distribution conditioned on this event. The degree of the polynomial in the running time is independent of the domain sizes, constraint sizes, or degree of the dependency graph. Up to the choice of the constant $c$, our condition on $p_a$ matches known hardness results. Our work builds on the method of Liu, Wang, Yin, Zhang, and Zhou, who obtained an FPRAS for the probability of satisfaction in the setting of the symmetric Lovász Local Lemma. Our sampling result is new even in this special case.

### [371] [A Simpler and Faster Min-Cost Flow Solver via Min-Ratio Cycles from Distance Oracles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23852)
*Rasmus Kyng,Simon Meierhans,Maximilian Probst Gutenberg,Aurelio Sulser*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The first almost-linear time maximum and minimum cost flow algorithm of Chen-Kyng-Liu-Peng-Probst Gutenberg-Sachdeva (FOCS 2022), reduced these flow objectives to a sequence of min-ratio cycle problems. Solving this core primitive requires approximately minimizing the ratio of a linear gradient term and an undirected length term. In Chen-Kyng-Liu-Peng-Probst Gutenberg-Sachdeva (FOCS 2022) and the subsequent work of Chen-Kyng-Liu-Meierhans-Probst Gutenberg (STOC 2024), intricate data structures were given to solve the min-ratio problem. We show that such a cycle can be extracted directly from the dynamic distance oracle of Kyng-Meierhans-Probst Gutenberg (STOC 2024) using linearity. This simplifies previous algorithms that relied on multiple additional steps to extract the cycle, and can be seen as evidence that solving the min-ratio cycle problem really is all about distances. As a result, we obtain a faster primal maxflow and min-cost flow solver that also extends to incremental graphs.

### [372] [Kadison--Singer partitions and Bilu--Linial graph signings in polynomial time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23855)
*Ali Jadbabaie,Amin Saberi,Suvrit Sra*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We prove two main algorithmic results in spectral discrepancy. First, we give a deterministic polynomial-time rounding theorem for rational positive semidefinite matrices of arbitrary rank. The algorithm starts from any rational fractional signing and assigns one sign per original matrix. Its discrepancy is less than $3.37\,\|\sum_i \mathrm{Tr}(A_i)A_i\|^{1/2}$. This yields Kadison--Singer half-partitions with error below $1.69\sqrt{\varepsilon}$, as well as deterministic graph signings that control signed adjacency and signed degrees simultaneously. The proof builds on the spectral-potential method of Ezeunala and Jiang (2026) and introduces a new way to choose rounding directions. We prove polynomial bit complexity for the rounding procedure. Second, we give a Las Vegas algorithm for the Bilu--Linial signing problem on an arbitrary prescribed graph. If $G$ has $n$ vertices and maximum degree $\Delta\ge3$, the algorithm terminates almost surely. It uses fewer than $100n^3$ insertion attempts in expectation and returns a signing with $\|A_s\|<2\sqrt{2(\Delta-1)}$. For bipartite graphs its one-sided form gives the sharp universal bound $\|A_s\|<2\sqrt{\Delta-1}$. The algorithm builds the signing by inserting vertices and recursively deleting and restoring neighbors after rejected insertions. In the analysis, the $\sqrt2$ gap to the Bilu--Linial conjecture comes from a factor of two in the bound for vertex deletions in the two-sided case. On a $d$-regular bipartite Ramanujan base the same signing produces a Ramanujan $2$-lift of that prescribed base.

### [373] [Optimal Analysis of Greedy for Stochastic Online Euclidean Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23947)
*Mingwei Yang,Sophie H. Yu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study Greedy for online metric matching with $n$ servers and $n$ requests sampled independently and uniformly from $[0,1]^d$. Servers are available initially, and Greedy irrevocably matches each arriving request to its closest available server, incurring a cost of their distance. We prove that Greedy has competitive ratio $O(1)$ for every fixed $d\ne2$, and $\Theta(\sqrt{\log n})$ for $d=2$. Previously, constant competitiveness was shown for $d = 1$ [BFP23], and no non-trivial results for this setting were known for higher dimensions. Our proof first analyzes Greedy on the flat torus and then transfers the estimates back to the cube.

### [374] [On Deterministically Computing Total Variation Distance via Zonotope Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24235)
*Yucheng Fu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study deterministic relative approximation of the total variation distance between high-dimensional distributions given by succinct descriptions. We develop an abstract deterministic approximation framework based on representing the total variation distance as a support function of a low-dimensional zonotope. As applications, we obtain FPTASs for several models. Given two mixtures of product distributions over $[q]^n$ with a total of $K$ component distributions, our algorithm approximates their TV-distance within a factor of $1+\varepsilon$ in time $\widetilde O_K(nq(n/\varepsilon)^{2K})$. We also give an FPTAS for mixtures of $n$-step Markov chains over $[q]^n$ with a total of $K$ component distributions, with running time $\widetilde O_K(nq^2(n/\varepsilon)^{2K})$. Finally, for two latent-tree Ising models with the same underlying tree topology, we give an FPTAS for the TV-distance between their leaf marginals in time $O(|V|^{13}\varepsilon^{-12})$.

### [375] [Vertex Cover Interdiction in Bipartite Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24624)
*Takehiro Ito,Naonori Kakimura,Naoyuki Kamiyama,Yusuke Kobayashi,Yoshio Okamoto*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In the vertex cover interdiction problem, we are given an undirected graph $G=(V,E)$, two integers $t$ and $k$ and a vertex subset $B\subseteq V$, and we are asked to find a set $X \subseteq B$ with $|X|\leq t$ such that $X$ hits (i.e., intersects) all the vertex covers of $G$ of size at most $k$. Recently, Grüne and Wulf proved that the problem is $\Sigma_2^p$-complete. However, their reduction relied on the fact that the vertex cover problem is NP-complete. This, in turn, means that we do not know the complexity status of the vertex cover interdiction problem when the input graph is restricted to a bipartite graph since the vertex cover problem can be solved in polynomial time for bipartite graphs. One of our main results shows that the vertex cover interdiction problem is NP-complete for bipartite graphs. In contrast, when $k$ is restricted to the minimum vertex cover size, i.e., we are only required to hit all the minimum vertex covers, we show that the vertex cover interdiction problem can be solved in polynomial time for bipartite graphs. This motivates us to study the parameterized complexity of the vertex cover interdiction problem for bipartite graphs when the difference of $k$ and the minimum vertex cover size is taken as a parameter. With this parameter, we show that the problem is $\mathrm{W}[1]$-hard, but can be solved in polynomial time when the parameter is constant (i.e., in XP time). We also show that the problem is fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by $k$.

### [376] [Improved polynomial-time algorithms for detecting and recovering planted $Θ(\sqrt{n})$-cliques](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24780)
*Dmitriy Kunisky,Songtao Mao*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In the planted clique problem, one observes either an Erdős--Rényi graph on $n$ vertices or such a graph with a clique added to $k = k(n)$ vertices, and seeks to detect or recover the clique. It is widely believed that $k = \Theta(\sqrt{n})$ is the smallest clique size for which polynomial-time algorithms exist for these tasks. We develop new algorithms in this regime using color-coding to estimate signed subgraph counts, further accelerated with fast matrix multiplication. We first show that, for each $t \geq 1$, for $c(t)$ a constant associated to the order of growth of the number of connected graphs of treewidth at most $t$, cliques of size $k = \lambda\sqrt{n}$ planted in a random location with $\lambda > 1 / \sqrt{c(t)}$ can be detected and recovered in time $n^{t + 1 + o(1)}$. For instance, since $c(1) = e$, this recovers by counting signed trees the performance of the $\widetilde{O}(n^2)$-time message-passing algorithm of Deshpande--Montanari (2015) that succeeds when $\lambda > 1 / \sqrt{e} \approx 0.6066$. For $t \geq 3$, the exact value of $c(t)$ is not known, but lower bounds on it give a hierarchy of slower polynomial-time algorithms that succeed for smaller $\lambda$. We further show that the above algorithm for $t = 2$ can be implemented in time $n^{\omega + o(1)}$ for $\omega$ the constant of square matrix multiplication and succeeds when $\lambda > 0.3320$; under the folklore conjecture that $\omega = 2$, this runs in the nearly-linear time of the algorithm of Deshpande--Montanari while finding smaller cliques. Second, we show that the above algorithm for $t = 1$ can be combined with the boosting scheme of Alon--Krivelevich--Sudakov (1998) using rectangular matrix multiplication, giving improved runtimes for smaller $\lambda$. Taken together, our results achieve the best known tradeoff between runtime and signal strength $\lambda$.

We develop new algorithms in this regime using color-coding to estimate signed subgraph counts, further accelerated with fast matrix multiplication. We first show that, for each $t \geq 1$, for $c(t)$ a constant associated to the order of growth of the number of connected graphs of treewidth at most $t$, cliques of size $k = \lambda\sqrt{n}$ planted in a random location with $\lambda > 1 / \sqrt{c(t)}$ can be detected and recovered in time $n^{t + 1 + o(1)}$. For instance, since $c(1) = e$, this recovers by counting signed trees the performance of the $\widetilde{O}(n^2)$-time message-passing algorithm of Deshpande--Montanari (2015) that succeeds when $\lambda > 1 / \sqrt{e} \approx 0.6066$. For $t \geq 3$, the exact value of $c(t)$ is not known, but lower bounds on it give a hierarchy of slower polynomial-time algorithms that succeed for smaller $\lambda$. We further show that the above algorithm for $t = 2$ can be implemented in time $n^{\omega + o(1)}$ for $\omega$ the constant of square matrix multiplication and succeeds when $\lambda > 0.3320$; under the folklore conjecture that $\omega = 2$, this runs in the nearly-linear time of the algorithm of Deshpande--Montanari while finding smaller cliques. Second, we show that the above algorithm for $t = 1$ can be combined with the boosting scheme of Alon--Krivelevich--Sudakov (1998) using rectangular matrix multiplication, giving improved runtimes for smaller $\lambda$. Taken together, our results achieve the best known tradeoff between runtime and signal strength $\lambda$.

</details>


### [377] [FPT Isomorphism Test for $F$-Free Tournaments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24804)
*Daniel Neuen*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We show that isomorphism of $F$-free tournaments can be solved in FPT time $f(k) \cdot n^{O(1)}$, where $k$ denotes the size of $F$, and $n$ denotes the size of the input tournaments. Our result extends on a previous FPT isomorphism test for tournaments of bounded twin-width [Grohe, Neuen 2024], as well as XP isomorphism tests parameterized by the VC dimension or the chromatic number [Raßmann, Schweitzer 2026]. It also implies that every non-trivial hereditary class of tournaments admits a polynomial-time isomorphism test. Our algorithm builds on a novel combination of spectral, geometric, combinatorial and group-theoretic tools.

### [378] [Parameter-Free Triangle Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24829)
*Asaf Etgar,Anna Gilbert,Quanquan Liu,Andrew McGregor*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Given an undirected, unweighted graph $G = (V,E)$ with $n$ vertices and $m$ edges, the triangle counting problem seeks the number of three-cycles in it. Triangle and subgraph counting are classical problems in graph algorithms, central to applications such as community detection, computing the clustering coefficient, motif discovery in protein networks, and social network analysis. In many of these applications, the graph datasets are so voluminous that we model them as streams of updates to an underlying graph. There are a number of foundational results for streaming triangle counting, both theoretical and practical. There is, however, one major drawback to all previous sublinear-space algorithms: to achieve both a constant factor approximation and the sublinear space guarantees, one needs to know a priori a constant factor approximation of the triangle count $T$, an inherently circular requirement. We initiate the study of parameter-free streaming triangle counting, without any a priori knowledge of $T$ or any quantities depending on $T$, provided $m$, the length of the stream. We describe a family of $O(p)$ pass parameter-free triangle counting algorithms that guarantee a mixed multiplicative and additive approximation of $T$ and use $\widetilde{O}(\frac{m+T}{\sqrt{T}})$ expected space. Moreover, this family leads to an $O(\log\log(n))$ pass algorithm that gives a $(1+\eps)$ multiplicative approximation of $T$ with the same space complexity. These algorithms rely on the notion of a \emph{verified} parametrized algorithm: an algorithm parametrized by $\tau$ that either provides an approximation of $T$ when $\tau \le T$, or declares that $T < \tau$. Furthermore, we prove a lower bound: any parameter-free algorithm that provides a multiplicative approximation for all values of $T$ must use $\Theta(m)$ space, even on streams where the triangle count is moderately large.

### [379] [A Proof of the Most Informative Boolean Function Conjecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24931)
*Zijie Chen,Amin Gohari,Adel Javanmard,Honghao Lin,Vahab Mirrokni,Chandra Nair,David P. Woodruff*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Let $X$ be uniform on $\{-1,1\}^n$, let $Y$ be obtained by passing its coordinates independently through a binary symmetric channel with crossover probability $p$, and let $g:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ be a Boolean function. We give a computer-assisted proof of the Courtade--Kumar conjecture $I(g(X);Y)\le1-H_2(p)$, where $H_2$ is binary entropy, with equality attained by dictator functions. The present work builds on the differential-equation method, itself a limiting form of the auxiliary-receiver approach in network information theory using a continuum of degraded receivers. The proof proceeds from a local inequality to a dimension-independent bound on entropy production. Differentiation along the Boolean noise semigroup expresses entropy production as an average of edge costs. The key estimate is therefore an unrestricted Bellman inequality with two mean constraints and two entropy constraints, allowing arbitrary couplings of the edge variables. This paper and its supplement provide the proofs and computational verification records. The document is lengthy because it is designed to be entirely self-contained, deriving all proofs from first principles and reproducing the proofs of cited results. The supplementary material supporting the computer-assisted parts of the proof are available online.

### [380] [The Facility Advantage in the One-Round Discrete Voronoi Game on a Line](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24936)
*Tamal Maharaj*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In the one-round discrete Voronoi game a multiset $V$ of $n$ voters on a line is given; player P places $k$ facilities, player Q then places $\ell$, and each voter is won by the nearer facility, ties going to P. P wins if it keeps at least $n/2$ voters. In the vocabulary of competitive location this is the absolute $(\ell|k)$-centroid problem on a path with unit demands, and the responder's problem is the $(\ell|X_k)$-medianoid, whose closed form on a path -- the sum of the $\ell$ largest of at most $2k$ explicit marginals -- is due to Spoerhase and Wirth. We record this structure, with complete proofs, and draw two consequences that we believe are new. First, we compute the value of the game against a single responding facility, $\Gamma_{k,1}(V)$, together with an optimal strategy for P, in $O(n\log n)$ time for arbitrary positive real demands and every $k$. This improves the $O(kn\log^2 n)$ bound of Lazar and Tamir for the absolute $(1|k)$-centroid on a path. Second, we study the facility advantage $k^*(\ell)$, the least $k$ for which P wins every instance against $\ell$ facilities. We prove $k^*(\ell)\le 2\ell-1$, exhibit instances proving $k^*(\ell)\ge\ell+1$ for $2\le\ell\le6$ (an exact, computer-assisted proof resting on a half-integer discretisation), determine $k^*(1)=1$ and $k^*(2)=3$, and show that on uniform instances $k=\ell$ already suffices, so the extremal instances are weighted and Q wins them by a single voter. We conjecture $k^*(\ell)=\ell+1$ for all $\ell\ge2$.

### [381] [Approximating Prize-Collecting TSP below 1.556](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24944)
*Hong Li*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The prize-collecting traveling salesperson problem is a variant of the metric traveling salesperson problem in which vertices may be left unvisited by paying their associated penalties. The objective is to minimize the length of the tour plus the total penalty of the unvisited vertices. Blauth, Klein, and Nägele gave the previously best-known LP-relative $1.599$-approximation. We show that a simpler version of their algorithm, obtained by omitting the splitting-off preprocessing before the tree decomposition, has an LP-relative approximation ratio of $1.555761$. The improvement comes from a stronger analysis of the parity-correction step.

### [382] [Concurrency-Aware Process Model Forecasting with Causal Nets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22614)
*Yongbo Yu,Jari Peeperkorn,Johannes De Smedt,Jochen De Weerdt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将过程模型预测（PMF）从直接跟随图（DFG）扩展到能够显式表达并发的因果网（causal net）。通过将Fodina发现算法分解为三类关系（活动、直接后继、长度二环路）以及输入/输出绑定的日度计数序列，并采用前缀包含子日志避免信息泄露，再使用Chronos-2基础模型进行零样本时间序列预测，最后依据Fodina构造规则重建带AND/XOR语义的因果网。作者还提出了一套处理部分轨迹的评估协议（包含完整轨迹回放、τ约简和面向Petri网的熵相关性扩展），并在四个事件日志（BPI2017、BPI2019、Sepsis、医院计费）上验证：预测模型在符合度上接近从未来窗口实际计数重挖掘的参考模型，并优于静态发现基线（后者在三个日志上精度损失严重）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PMF方法仅预测直接跟随图（DFG），而DFG缺乏过程语义，无法显式区分并发执行与交叉选择。这限制了PMF在需要表达并发结构的场景下的应用，因此作者提出将PMF扩展到语义更丰富的因果网表示。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：（1）将Fodina因果网发现分解为活动计数A、直接后继计数AB、长度二环路计数ABA、输入绑定IB和输出绑定OB的日度时间序列；（2）通过前缀包含子日志（prefix-inclusion sub-logs）在无信息泄露前提下挖掘绑定序列，输入绑定按锚任务发生日记录，输出绑定按首次识别非空后继模式的日期记录且后续不再更新；（3）使用Chronos-2基础模型在滚动起点零样本设置下预测每条序列，取窗口总数预测中位数后按Fodina规则（含连通性修复）重建因果网。评估端：转换为频率标注的工作流网后进行τ约简，采用完整轨迹回放减少截断惩罚，扩展熵相关性（ER）到频率标注网，并对比Forecast、Re-mined、Direct-mined、Static四种参考模型。

Result: 在四个日志上，Forecast模型在τ_PAT=0.0默认绑定过滤下的符合度接近Re-mined参考模型，且在三个日志上精度更高、模型更精简（任务和弧数更少），体现预测的正则化效应。Static基线在结构稳定的BPI2017上保持高精度，但在其他三个日志上出现严重精度损失（如Sepsis上token precision从0.94降至0.12）。τ_PAT过滤提升了多数符合度指标并改善计算可处理性，但同时几乎消除了多成员绑定（AND绑定），将并发替换为单例选择。评估成本远高于预测成本：模型生成仅需7–71分钟（GPU），而评估消耗了大部分计算资源。

Conclusion: 并发感知的过程模型预测在技术上是可行的：因果网可通过预测其发现算法所使用的计数序列进行端到端预测，预测模型在符合度上接近未来窗口重挖掘参考。两点更具普遍性的发现是：（1）产生并发预测成本低，但评估其质量成本高，因此评估协议本身是重要贡献；（2）提升符合度的绑定过滤器同时移除了模型旨在表达的并发结构，现有指标评估完整网的行为但无法直接判断单个绑定是否正确表示并发。未来工作需要绑定感知的评估方法、不同的日志与挖掘器、合成日志验证，以及在窗口自适应配置和层次化模型方向上进一步探索。

Abstract: Process model forecasting (PMF) aims to predict the process model that will characterize a future period, thereby providing a process-level view of how behavior is expected to evolve. Existing PMF methods, however, forecast directly-follows graphs, which cannot explicitly represent concurrency. We extend PMF to causal nets by forecasting time series of relation and binding counts and using these forecasts to reconstruct future process models with AND/XOR semantics. To evaluate the resulting models, we introduce a protocol that accounts for partial traces and constructs the workflow nets required for conformance checking. Experiments on four event logs show that the forecasted models achieve conformance levels close to those of models re-mined from observations in the corresponding future windows. They also outperform static discovery baselines, which retain high precision on the structurally stable log but exhibit substantial precision losses on the other three logs. Filtering infrequent bindings improves most conformance metrics, although it also removes much of the concurrent behavior captured by the models.

</details>


### [383] [Multiple latent orderings better predict language model preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22170)
*Aviral Chawla,William H.W. Thompson,Jean-Gabriel Young*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出大语言模型（LLM）的偏好不一致性不应被视为单一潜在排序的噪声，而应理解为多个潜在内部一致排序的聚合效应（即"思维议会"假说）。作者通过在7个LLM、4个任务上的强制成对偏好实验，证明现有的随机效用模型（含Bradley-Terry模型）无法解释观察到的非传递性循环，并提出了噪声增强混合Bradley-Terry（MBT）模型来推断这些潜在偏好分量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM偏好建模方法将观察到的非传递性视为单一潜在排序周围的采样噪声。然而，社会选择理论早已表明，个体一致的偏好在聚合后可能产生循环。本文旨在探索LLM偏好的非传递性是否反映了多种潜在价值观系统的聚合，而非简单的随机噪声。

Method: 1. 通过7个开源LLM在4个任务（事实型：美国城市人口、原子半衰期；主观型：笑话审美、Moral Machine道德困境）上的强制成对偏好抽取，控制提示词、呈现顺序和标签偏差。2. 使用基于Borda计数的非参数零假设检验（强随机传递性违反），证明任何单一排序加独立噪声模型都无法解释观察到的非传递性。3. 提出混合Bradley-Terry（MBT）模型，结合噪声增强（处理随机弃权）和Dirichlet过程先验（自动选择混合分量数）。4. 通过5折交叉验证比较MBT与标准Bradley-Terry基线的预测性能。5. 在合成数据上验证MBT的参数恢复能力。

Result: 1. 结构化噪声：在控制提示和顺序偏差后，所有模型和数据集上均显著违反强随机传递性，拒绝了"单一排序+噪声"的零假设。2. 预测提升：MBT在多数模型-任务对上优于单分量Bradley-Terry基线，尤其在Moral Machine和Half-lives任务上提升最大，且这些任务恰好是合适的"潜在偏好"具有多种价值观系统的任务。3. 误导性聚合：两个模型可能在聚合层级相似但分量层级分歧，或反之。Moral Machine案例分析显示，聚合相似度可掩盖对齐和不一致的潜在分量。4. 多元偏好来源：价值负载任务中的多模态反映价值观多元（社会选择解释），而事实任务中的多模态反映特定项的结构化混淆而非均匀噪声。5. 合成数据验证表明MBT在最多4个分量时参数恢复良好，5个分量时退化。

Conclusion: LLM偏好并非来自单一潜在排序，而是反映了多个潜在偏好排序的聚合（"思维议会"假说）。MBT模型通过推断多个潜在一致排序，能更好地解释和预测LLM偏好的非传递性。聚合评估（如排行榜、奖励模型）会掩盖这种异质性，不同用户可能认同不同的潜在偏好分量。对齐和评估流程若将LLM偏好视为单一函数，将面临平均掉用户可能不同认同的一致排序的风险。对齐应被视为一种治理问题，而非简单地拟合单一奖励函数。

Abstract: Language models are frequently employed in settings where they are asked to make value judgments and choices. These observed choices often exhibit intransitivity: A model may prefer item $A$ to $B$ and $B$ to $C$, while also preferring $C$ to $A$. Existing work that models LLM preferences treats such inconsistencies as sampling noise around a single latent ordering. We instead propose that intransitivity reflects the aggregation of multiple latent, internally consistent orderings. We first show that observed inconsistencies cannot be explained by a single ordering under any monotone link function. We then introduce a noise-augmented mixture Bradley-Terry (MBT) model that infers latent preference components from repeated pairwise comparisons. Across seven models and four tasks, a mixture of orderings often explains structural inconsistencies better than single-utility models. We find that aggregate preferences often hide underlying preference heterogeneity. A case study on Moral Machine dilemmas shows that models which disagree on aggregate orderings can still share latent components. Together, these results suggest that LLMs reflect plural preferences. Alignment and evaluation pipelines that treat LLM preferences as a single function, therefore, risk averaging over coherent orderings that different users may endorse differently.

</details>


### [384] [Contrastive World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22175)
*Bonnie Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Contrastive World Models（CWM），在Dreamer框架中用基于Deep InfoMax的互信息最大化目标替代像素重建损失，完全移除像素解码器，在视觉干扰增多的环境下显著优于像素重建和动量预测基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于像素重建的世界模型在视觉复杂环境中容易被无关视觉信息主导目标函数，分散模型对规划与控制相关信息的注意力；作者希望通过对比学习目标学习更鲁棒的潜状态表征。

Method: 基于Dreamer的RSSM架构，移除像素解码器O；引入Deep InfoMax式下界，最大化状态-动作序列与未来观测局部patch特征之间的互信息（InfoNCE损失，对batch内其他序列作为负样本），同时保留奖励预测和KL转移正则项。

Result: 在DeepMind Control Suite三个任务（finger-spin、cheetah-run、walker-walk）上评估三种视觉难度：默认设置下CWM与Dreamer及动量预测基线性能相当；加入简单移动干扰物或Kinetics自然视频背景后，CWM显著优于两个基线；同时因无需像素解码器，训练效率更高。

Conclusion: 对比式互信息最大化是构建对视觉干扰因素鲁棒的世界模型的有原则且有前景的方向，特别有利于将基于模型的RL智能体从仿真迁移到真实世界；但仍局限于基于旧RSSM架构的小规模实验，未来工作应扩展到Transformer架构、大规模域及无标签视频预训练。

Abstract: World models trained via pixel reconstruction can struggle in visually complex environments, where irrelevant information dominates the objective and distract the model from information relevant to planning and control. We present Contrastive World Models, an approach for learning latent dynamics models without pixel reconstruction. Building on Dreamer, we replace observation reconstruction in the standard world model objective with a Deep InfoMax-like lower bound that maximizes the mutual information between state-action sequences and local patch features of future observations, encouraging state representations to retain information that is predictive of the future without requiring the model to reconstruct visually irrelevant details. We evaluate our approach in small-scale experiments across three settings of increasing visual complexity. Our method matches Dreamer and a momentum prediction baseline in the default setting, and substantially outperforms both once distractors or natural video backgrounds are introduced, while also training more efficiently by removing the pixel decoder entirely. Our approach is general and makes minimal assumptions beyond access to state-action sequences and future observations. These results suggest that contrastive, infomax-based objectives are a principled and promising direction for building world models that are robust to visual nuisance factors, a property particularly relevant for transferring model-based RL agents to the real world.

</details>


### [385] [Beyond Task Completion: Training Capable and Safe Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22178)
*Zeyu Kang,Zhenyun Yin,Yang Zhang,Shan He,Shanzhe Lei,Yanjiu Zhong,Xinquan Chen,Yuhong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出SCOPE框架，通过联合训练使计算机使用代理（CUAs）同时具备任务执行能力和安全决策能力，并构建了配套的数据合成流水线SCOPE-Gen和轨迹数据集SATraj-OS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CUA的后训练主要关注任务成功率，缺乏对安全风险识别能力的培养。一个可靠的CUA应当根据风险状态采取不同策略：正常任务应执行、存在环境风险但有安全路径时应规避并继续、目标本身有害或无安全路径时应拒绝。

Method: 1) SCOPE-Gen自动化流水线：四个LLM依次生成任务指令、初始状态、程序化评估器和反事实状态，经确定性验证引擎确认后存入能力任务库；然后注入五类环境风险（弹窗攻击、诱导文本攻击、钓鱼网站攻击、凭证注入、笔记攻击）生成配对的安全任务，保持原始目标和评估器不变。2) SATraj-OS数据集：包含能力演示、安全延续和显式拒绝三类轨迹。3) 两阶段后训练：第一阶段对三类轨迹混合进行监督微调，第二阶段使用GRPO进行能力导向的在线强化学习。4) 上下文高效的多模态轨迹处理：通过结构化消息窗口和图像前缀折叠控制上下文长度。

Result: 基于Qwen3.5-9B，SCOPE-RL在OSWorld上达到54.17%任务成功率，在OS-BLIND上达到64.30%攻击规避率，能力-安全调和均值58.80%，为所有评估代理中最佳。消融实验揭示：拒绝轨迹主要贡献于攻击规避提升，风险处理轨迹主要保留任务效用，两类安全监督呈现不对称但互补的角色。

Conclusion: 能力导向的CUA训练无法自发产生可靠安全行为。联合能力-安全训练是必要的：拒绝轨迹校准停止执行的边界，风险处理轨迹保留在安全路径下的任务完成能力。后续能力导向的强化学习可进一步提升任务表现同时保留大部分安全增益。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have made rapid progress in completing complex tasks through graphical user interfaces, yet post-training centered on task success alone does not induce reliable safety behavior. A reliable CUA must condition its execution on risk: it should complete ordinary benign tasks, avoid environmental hazards and continue when a safe completion path remains, and refuse when the goal is harmful or no safe path exists. To learn this conditional policy, we develop Safety and Capability Optimization for Policy Execution (SCOPE), which jointly post-trains a CUA for task-execution capability and safety-aware decision making. To provide aligned training data for this joint objective, we further introduce SCOPE-Gen, an automated pipeline that synthesizes verifiable capability tasks and converts them into paired environment-risk variants while preserving their original goals. Using the resulting tasks, we construct SATraj-OS, a trajectory dataset comprising capability demonstrations, safe continuations, and explicit refusals. SCOPE first learns from all three trajectory types through supervised fine-tuning and then further improves task completion through online reinforcement learning. Starting from Qwen3.5-9B, SCOPE-RL achieves a 54.17% task success rate on OSWorld and a 64.30% attack-avoidance rate on OS-BLIND, yielding the best aggregate capability--safety score of 58.80% among the evaluated agents. Ablations reveal asymmetric but complementary roles for the two forms of safety supervision: refusal trajectories account for most of the attack-avoidance gain, whereas risk-handling trajectories preserve greater task utility at comparable attack-avoidance levels.

</details>


### [386] [DPTM-DT: Dual-Pretrained Transformer Multitask Representation Learning for Drug-Target Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22184)
*Ge Kong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出DPTM-DT，一种双预训练Transformer多任务药物-靶标预测框架，结合GROVER分子图嵌入、ESM蛋白质语言模型嵌入和CTD理化描述符，通过双向跨模态注意力交换药物-靶标信息，并在共享对表示上同时进行连续亲和力回归、二元高亲和力分类和六类亲和力分级分类。在Davis和KIBA两个基准数据集上，DPTM-DT在回归、二元分类和多类分类三项任务中均优于DeepDTA、TEFDTA、MFR-DTA、GLCN-DTA和WideDTA等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有药物-靶标预测模型存在三个局限：(1)单一表征难以同时捕捉分子拓扑和蛋白质序列/理化信息；(2)简单拼接无法充分描述跨模态交互；(3)亲和力回归和交互分类作为同一药物-靶标对的密切关联视图，常被分开优化。论文旨在通过双预训练表征、跨模态Transformer交互和多任务预测统一解决这些问题。

Method: 方法包含三个核心模块：(1)双预训练表征模块——药物侧采用GROVER分子图嵌入(4800维)，靶标侧融合ESM-2蛋白质语言模型嵌入(960维)和CTD理化描述符(147维)，通过模态特定投影映射至256维共同空间，并使用门控融合自适应加权ESM与CTD特征；(2)跨模态联合交互模块(CJIM)——基于缩放点积注意力实现药物↔靶标的双向交叉注意力(2层、8头、256维、FF维度1024)，更新后的双模态向量拼接元素积和绝对差形成1024维对表示；(3)多任务预测头——共享MLP后分别输出回归(MSE)、二元分类(BCE，二值化阈值Davis pKd≥7.0/KIBA≥12.1)和六类亲和力分级(基于Elbow法K-means聚类，类索引按亲和力排序)。训练使用AdamW+warmup+cosine调度，模型选择按任务特定指标(MSE/AUPR/Macro-F1)。

Result: 在Davis和KIBA的随机80/20分割下：DPTM-DT回归任务MSE/CI为Davis 0.193/0.917、KIBA 0.120/0.918；二元分类AUPR/MCC为Davis 0.727/0.654、KIBA 0.798/0.689；六类分类Macro-F1/Top-2为Davis 0.800/0.932、KIBA 0.815/0.962。标准分割下趋势一致。在三个任务、两个数据集、两种分割协议的所有报告设置中，DPTM-DT均优于TEFDTA、MFR-DTA、GLCN-DTA、DeepDTA和WideDTA等基线。Davis 80/20消融实验表明：ESM-only优于CTD-only(0.199 vs 0.216 MSE)；完整模型(0.193)优于Concat(0.198)和No-cross-attn(0.200)，验证了双靶标表征、门控融合和跨模态注意力各自的贡献。

Conclusion: DPTM-DT提供了一种实用的多任务表征学习框架，可同时支持药物-靶标对的数值亲和力估计、高亲和力检索和亲和力分级判别，并在Davis和KIBA基准的回归、二元分类和多类分类任务中均取得最优综合性能。消融研究证实了双预训练表征、自适应门控融合和显式跨模态交换三个组件各自的必要性。该框架可扩展至更广泛的靶标家族和模型行为分析。论文局限在于评估主要基于两个常见的激酶-抑制剂基准和两种分割设置，未来可在更多靶标家族和独立测试场景上进一步验证。

Abstract: Drug-target relation prediction supports candidate screening, drug repositioning, and mechanism analysis. Existing models often use incomplete drug or protein representations, model cross-modal interactions shallowly, or train affinity regression and interaction classification separately, although these tasks describe closely related views of the same drug-target pair. This paper presents DPTM-DT, a dual-pretrained Transformer framework for multitask drug-target prediction. DPTM-DT combines GROVER molecular graph embeddings, ESM protein language-model embeddings, and CTD physicochemical descriptors, then exchanges drug-target information through bidirectional cross-modal attention. A shared pair representation is used for continuous affinity regression, high-affinity binary classification, and six-level affinity classification. Experiments on Davis and KIBA cover random 80/20 and DeepDTA-style standard splits. On the random 80/20 split, DPTM-DT achieves MSE/CI values of 0.193/0.917 on Davis and 0.120/0.918 on KIBA. It also reports binary AUPR/MCC values of 0.727/0.654 and 0.798/0.689, and six-class Macro-F1/Top-2 values of 0.800/0.932 and 0.815/0.962 on Davis and KIBA, respectively. Across the reported regression, binary classification, and multiclass classification settings, DPTM-DT achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods. Results under the standard split show the same relative trend. Ablations indicate that dual target representation, gated fusion, and cross-modal attention each contribute to the final performance. Code and supplementary materials are available at: this http URL .

</details>


### [387] [SegTSim: A Big Data Driven Segmented Temporal Simulation Framework for Heterogeneous Multivariate Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22192)
*Xinhang Li,Chenxi Geng,Yujia Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SegTSim提出了一种面向异构多变量时序系统的大数据驱动的分段时间仿真框架，整合段弹性建模、min-gating、动态生产迁移优化、多因子数据融合与汇率传导、以及深度集成验证，在美日汽车贸易数据上验证了25%关税扰动下日本进口下降20.4%且集成CV变化保持在3.5%以下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球汽车贸易系统具有显著的段异质非线性动态，传统ARIMA及整体性深度学习架构将系统视为同质，忽略了不同车型段、贸易伙伴及关税层级间的差异化响应，导致扰动分析与政策仿真精度受限。

Method: 四模块框架：段特定弹性OLS估计（α/β参数+min(τ,0.5)门控）+跨段替代弹性AIDS估计；多期NPV动态迁移优化；含汇率传导的多因子融合含固定theta/价传递系数回归（产品与年份固定效应）；5网络深度集成+自适应高斯扰动（σ_τ=0.08, σ_ε=0.05, σ_E=0.06, σ_I=0.10）的1000次并行推理验证。

Result: USITC 2015-2025约13000条记录上：25%扰动使日本进口从1.17降至0.93 Bn USD（-20.4%），10%/34%/50%扰动分别降至0.99/0.88/0.80 Bn USD；min-gating有效防止极端崩塌；迁移NPV在±20%成本扰动下均为正；日元贬值5.8%部分抵消关税负担；集成1000次推理CV=3.24%（<3.5%），95%CI [0.872, 0.991]。

Conclusion: 分段建模在异构多变量时序系统扰动分析中优于单体框架，集成验证确认数值鲁棒性；未来将扩展至电动车市场并融合时序融合Transformer与图模型。

Abstract: Heterogeneous multivariate time-series systems exhibit segment-specific nonlinear dynamics that challenge monolithic forecasting architectures. We propose SegTSim, a big-data-driven segmented temporal simulation framework that integrates segment-specific elasticity modeling with adaptive min-gating, dynamic production relocation optimization, multi-factor data fusion with exchange-rate propagation, and a deep ensemble validation pipeline. The framework is validated on US--Japan automotive trade data from USITC repositories spanning 2015 to 2025, comprising approximately 13000 annual records. Under a 25% perturbation scenario, Japanese import volume declines by 20.4% to 0.93 billion USD, while all output variables maintain coefficients of variation below 3.5% across 1000 ensemble inference runs.

</details>


### [388] [A Pinch of SFT, A Dash of RL: When Reinforcement Learning Helps Long-Horizon Advertising Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22194)
*Aakash Kolekar,Sahika Genc,Bunyamin Sisman,Shahriar Shariat,Shree Vandana Kachroo,Avishek Saha,Qianli Wu,Ari Singer,Benoit Dumoulin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在企业级广告分析智能体的长horizon工具使用任务中，如何在监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）之间进行合理分配，提出基于"教师支持度"和"奖励可观测空间"的三种训练机制（Imitation/Lift/Discovery）及前瞻性路由诊断，在GPT-OSS 120B上以更少计算实现更优性能并显著提升敏感信息披露安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长horizon智能体任务中，RL盲目应用可能损害SFT已校准的技能；同时纯RL冷启动在长horizon广告技能上会因rollout大量失败而崩溃。因此需要在有限rollout预算下回答"SFT与RL应如何分配"这一核心问题。

Method: 1) 教师蒸馏SFT（带工具响应mask的工具调用轨迹训练）+ Toucan-1.5M OOD正则化；2) 基于"教师支持度Tk"和"奖励可观测空间Hk"的前瞻性诊断规则将特征路由到SFT only / SFT→RL / 增加RL / 环境改进；3) 仅在有奖励可区分headroom的特征上使用GRPO，配合KL锚定π_SFT、非对称policy clipping、token级TIS；4) 技能感知jury奖励（DeepSeek-R1 + Qwen3-235B-A22B集成）；5) 长上下文MoE RL基础设施（Megatron + SGLang解耦、专家权重重打包、context-parallel、token预算批处理）。

Result: 前瞻性诊断在18次特征实验中预测15/18条轨迹；GPT-OSS 120B上SFT+RL相比前沿Control在7/8项广告技能上为正点估计，5项95% CI不含0；非披露技能最大增益+11.27分（CI [+9.72, +12.82]）；SME审计显示标准泄漏11.8%→2.9%、对抗泄漏22.9%→6.8%，可操作性基本不变（86.2%→85.7%）；匹配对比中定向分配以少43%增量RL算力将7项技能均值Δ从+1.62提升到+3.57。

Conclusion: 研究支持"分阶段分配"的后训练观：SFT用于建立领域能力，在投入RL预算前测量教师支持度和奖励可观测headroom，仅在探索可区分时选择性应用RL，并对安全关键增益独立进行人类验证。该方案在企业级广告智能体上以更少算力取得更优性能并通过所有9项离线发布就绪门槛。

Abstract: Enterprise analytics agents solve long-horizon tool-use problems over distributed business data, requiring retrieval, reasoning, API calls, code execution, and adaptation to intermediate observations. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) calibrates tool syntax and teacher-supported behavior, whereas reinforcement learning (RL) can explore reward-supported behaviors beyond demonstrations; applied uniformly, however, RL can perturb already-calibrated skills. We study how to balance SFT and RL under production-mirroring beta APIs. We observe that, in our controlled experiment, checkpoint trajectories retrospectively separated into three regimes: Imitation, where SFT captured reliable teacher behavior; Lift, where both stages helped; and Discovery, where useful reward-observable behavior lay outside reliable teacher support. We leverage this prospectively, using teacher support and reward-observable headroom to route features to SFT only, SFT then RL, increased RL allocation, or further environment development. Across 18 subsequent feature-specific experiments, the diagnostic predicted 15/18 observed trajectories. On GPT-OSS 120B, targeted SFT then RL produced positive point estimates on 7/8 advertiser skills relative to a frontier Control; five positive gains had paired 95% confidence intervals excluding zero, while one skill had a confidence-supported regression. The largest gain was non-disclosure (+11.27 points; 95% CI [+9.72, +12.82]). A separate SME audit surfaced that targeted RL reduces standard leakage from 11.8% to 2.9% and adversarial leakage from 22.9% to 6.8% relative to SFT while preserving actionability (86.2% to 85.7%). In a matched uniform-versus-targeted comparison with shared rewards and optimization, targeted RL improved the seven-skill mean delta from +1.62 to +3.57 while using 43% less incremental RL compute.

</details>


### [389] [EvoRank: LLM-Guided Evolution of Multi-Objective Learning-to-Rank Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22196)
*Rayhan Patel,Shabaz Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EvoRank 是一个基于 LLM 引导进化搜索的开源自动排序工程系统，用于在多目标电商搜索场景中自动发现完整的 Learning-to-Rank 流水线。该研究通过两个对照实验揭示了一个关键发现：当搜索空间的有效信号低于评估噪声时，进化循环只会选择噪声；只有当有效信号超过噪声阈值时，才能发现可迁移的优质流水线。作者提出了一个"headroom gate"作为前置检查机制，可在投入 LLM 成本前预判搜索是否值得进行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业界的 LLM 驱动排序系统（如 Meta 的 Ranking Engineer Agent）虽然成果显著但闭源，且公开文献中的结果普遍报告于循环内部用于挑选候选者的数据上，未经过迁移审计。在排序任务中，每次候选评估本质上带有噪声，"在噪声下选择"会让幸运候选胜出，循环看似稳步推进实则未发现任何可迁移的改进。作者旨在提供一份开源的、可审计的实验，阐明该模式在何时有效、何时静默失败，并提炼出可复用的边界条件与工具。

Method: 基于 SkyDiscover 框架（AlphaEvolve 家族）的 LLM 引导进化程序搜索，使用 AdaEvolve 控制器管理岛屿子种群与 Pareto 归档。核心方法包括：(1) 冻结的数据准备通道生成小型评分折叠（fitness fold, 8k 查询）和大型留出折叠（60k 查询）；(2) 进化循环每轮一次 LLM 调用，对 EVOLVE-BLOCK 标记的可变区域进行编辑；(3) 审计栈统一应用于所有实验，包括 headroom gate、配对查询自助法、等预算随机搜索对照、等预算调优、迁移审计（60k 查询）、三维 Pareto 前沿质量评估及组件移除测试；(4) 两个对照实验：Campaign 1 仅进化 LambdaMART 梯度函数（训练目标），Campaign 2 进化完整流水线（特征构造、模型/损失选择、集成策略）。

Result: Campaign 1（仅进化目标函数）：选择折叠上显示稳步提升，但迁移审计显示收益几乎完全是适应度噪声。最佳进化目标在留出集上仅比起点提升 +0.0002 NDCG@10（p=0.76），等预算随机搜索迁移效果与之相当甚至更优（p=0.03），所有方法都显著低于调优基线（p<0.001）。组件移除测试表明单一组件效应在 0.0005–0.008 NDCG@10 之间，多数低于选择折叠的 95% 置信区间半宽（±0.007–0.009），意味着挑选最优等同于挑选运气。将评估折叠从 1.6k 扩至 6k 查询可将该噪声减半并使迁移增益提升三倍，是唯一有效干预。Campaign 2（进化完整流水线）：三次独立运行在 50 次迭代内（约十美元）收敛到同一可解释核心结构（查询内百分位秩特征、计数编码、三成员 z-score 加权集成）。在 60k 留出查询上，最佳运行（s2）在三个目标上均击败调优基线（NDCG@10 +0.0057, p<0.0001；booking NDCG +0.0056, p<0.0001；收入 +0.0008 但在噪声内）。在全规模（280k 训练查询）下，以等容量两成员对比时在四项指标上全部胜出（NDCG@10 0.4619 vs 基线 0.4544）。在 Kaggle 原始竞赛隐藏测试集上一次提交获得 0.5196 私有 NDCG@38，位列 340 队第 20 名（前 6%）。

Conclusion: 两个对照实验仅在搜索空间这一变量上不同，相同循环在一个空间中仅选择噪声、在另一个空间中发现了经迁移审计验证的 Pareto 主导解。决定性量是可测量的事前量：可实现效应大小与适应度折叠噪声之比。作者将这一比值封装为 headroom gate，作为低成本事前 go/no-go 检查，并将迁移审计选择作为报告标准。研究建议团队的优先级为：评估器优先（折叠大小、防泄漏统计、可学习拒绝消息、gate、审计均在此层）、应用空间次之（头空间决定结果）、搜索算法最末（重校准的 AdaEvolve 与 EvoX 变体在双倍预算下落在原始三次运行的散布内，其内部信号被相同噪声淹没）。所有代码、配置、种子、日志、发现程序与审计脚本已在 https://github.com/shabazpatel/evorank 开源发布。

Abstract: We present EvoRank, an open autonomous ranking engineer: an LLM-guided evolutionary loop that discovers complete Learning-to-Rank pipelines (features, models, losses, ensembles) for multi-objective e-commerce search. On the Expedia ICDM 2013 dataset, with relevance, conversion, and revenue as competing objectives, three independent runs each converge within 50 iterations (about ten dollars) on interpretable pipelines that beat an Optuna-tuned LambdaMART on 60k held-out queries, an advantage that persists at full data scale and places in the top 6 percent of the original competition. A first campaign, evolving only training objectives, builds the central design rule: it appeared to work on its selection fold (the small dataset it uses to pick winners) while a transfer audit, re-scoring winners on held-out data, showed the gains were almost entirely fitness noise (the randomness of its own scoring), and neither seeded domain knowledge nor richer diagnostic feedback changed what transferred. The deciding quantity is measurable in advance: search-space headroom relative to fitness noise. We package this as a headroom gate that predicts, before any LLM spend, whether the loop will pay off, and we release the system, the auditing tools, and a catalog of failure modes with their guardrails, so teams can apply the procedure to their own ranking stacks.

</details>


### [390] [Dissecting Hierarchical Reasoning Models: A Mechanistic Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22197)
*Leo Raphael Rodrigues,Jian Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对层级推理模型（HRM）进行了系统的机制可解释性研究，通过在Sudoku、Maze和ARC-AGI-2任务上的因果干预、线性探测和稀疏自编码器（SAE）分析，揭示HRM本质上是在执行"约束感知的迭代细化"，其层级功能分配随任务变化，且计算以分布式方式存储于潜在空间中，不依赖于紧凑的因果特征集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HRM作为代表性的潜在空间层级推理模型，在仅有27M参数的情况下在多项推理任务中表现优异，但其内部工作机制不透明：无法判断其层级结构中高低模块的功能分工、可解码特征是否对应因果机制、以及是否存在紧凑的关键特征集。本研究旨在填补这一可解释性空白，验证探针和SAE等机制可解释性方法在此类递归潜在推理模型中的适用性。

Method: 研究方法涵盖四个层面：模型对比实验（将HRM与循环Transformer、通用Transformer、普通Transformer和GRU基线在Sudoku-Extreme上比较）；因果干预（对高层z_H和低层z_L状态进行消融、冻结、时间移植和跨谜题补丁）；表征分析（使用线性探测和MLP探测在Sudoku、Maze和ARC-AGI-2上解码任务变量，并对探测方向进行定向消融）；SAE分析（在不同字典大小和稀疏惩罚下训练稀疏自编码器，比较top-k特征与随机k特征的消融效果）；以及BPTT对照实验（比较单步梯度近似与完整时间反向传播训练的影响）。

Result: 核心发现包括：(1) 循环模型优于单遍基线，但单状态循环Transformer与HRM表现相当，层级结构本身并非性能关键；(2) 层级功能分配任务依赖性强——Sudoku中z_H承载渐进精化的解状态（逐级消融z_H在最终步骤导致-26.0pp精度下降），而Maze中z_L承载中间路径表示（捐赠者z_L补丁使有效路径率下降43-56%）；(3) 多个任务变量可从z_H和z_L中以约90%精度线性解码，但定向消融探测方向的效果与随机控制无显著差异；(4) SAE消融比探测方向消融产生更大行为变化，但top-50 SAE特征与50个随机特征的效果无统计显著差异（Sudoku p=0.43, Maze p=0.18），该模式在BPTT训练下依然存在（BPTT下两者均导致约-29.6%精度下降，p=0.93）；(5) 几何分析表明HRM的潜在推理结构未涉及语义特征化，特征在多个符号目标之间分布更为分散。

Conclusion: HRM实质上执行的是约束感知的迭代细化，其解状态在层级中灵活分配（任务依赖），并以分布式方式存储于潜在空间中。层级结构虽未提升性能，但提供了可独立干预的分离性，可作为可解释性的归纳偏置。线性可解码并不等于因果相关，探针研究可能高估特征相关性。HRM的单步梯度近似训练并非分布式计算的根本原因。这些发现凸显了开发更适合潜在空间递归推理模型的机制可解释性技术的必要性。

Abstract: We study Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM), a representative hierarchical Transformer-based latent reasoning model with many variants, on Sudoku, Maze, and ARC-AGI-2. We mechanistically understand how HRM reasons and what information it encodes. Our analyses compare HRM against Transformer baselines with and without recurrent modules, apply causal interventions on recurrent states, and utilize linear probes against random-direction ablations, as well as sparse autoencoders with feature ablations. Our results reveal several key findings: recurrent models outperform one-pass baselines, while single-state recurrent Transformers are comparable to HRM. State interventions further show that the causal contributions of the high- and low-level states vary across task-specific checkpoints and inference stages. Selected task variables are linearly decodable from the recurrent states in HRM, yet ablating probe directions produce effects comparable to random controls. SAE ablations yield larger behavioral changes than probe-direction ablations. However, top-ranked SAE features show no stable advantage over size-matched random subsets at larger ablation sizes or across tasks; the same pattern persists in a Sudoku control with within-step BPTT. Together, we characterize that HRM is essentially implementing constraint-aware iterative refinement on a puzzle-specific solution state, in which the functional contributions of components at different levels vary without relying on a compact, causally important feature set. These results highlight the necessity of studying the different working mechanisms and the importance of developing mechanistic interpretability techniques better suited for latent-space, recursive reasoning models.

</details>


### [391] [Improving Parameter Utilization by Sharing Neural Experts Across Layers in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22199)
*Dian Jiao,Jiaxin Duan,Shuai Zhao,Jiabing Leng,Yiran Zhang,Feng Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CS-MoE 架构，通过全局专家共享机制打破传统 MoE 的层间隔离，在仅激活 55% 参数的情况下实现更低的困惑度和更优的下游任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 Transformer LLM 存在层间参数冗余问题，不同深度的专家学习到相似的功能变换；标准 MoE 架构由于层隔离设计无法利用这种跨层功能复用，导致参数利用率低下。

Method: CS-MoE 采用双路径混合架构：1) Fixed Path：每层无条件激活少量层独立专家（Independent Experts）以捕获深度特定特征；2) Dynamic Path：通过层特定路由器从全局共享专家池（Shared Expert Pool）中稀疏选择 Top-K 专家，所有层均可访问；引入层间辅助负载均衡损失防止专家坍塌；提出专家利用率（EUR）指标衡量参数复用程度。

Result: 在 0.6B-12B 参数规模、基于 Qwen3 架构的实验中，CS-MoE 在各规模上均优于同等规模 Dense 基线（8B 时 55% 激活参数即超越 Dense 基线，PPL 9.55 vs 9.75）；性能随激活专家数 K 单调提升；8B 规模 4.5T token 全量预训练后，在 BBH（+0.4640）、CMMLU（+0.0525）、ARC（+0.0425）等基准上显著优于 Dense 基线；在 BBH（0.7507）等推理基准上绝对性能大幅领先；专家缓存优化后推理延迟接近 Dense 模型。

Conclusion: CS-MoE 通过跨层专家共享机制有效打破了 MoE 的层间参数隔离，在保持计算效率的同时显著提升参数利用率，在参数效率、可扩展性和计算-容量帕累托前沿方面均展现出优势，为计算受限场景提供了高效的替代方案。

Abstract: Transformer-based large language models often suffer from inter-layer parameter redundancy, where functional transformations are redundantly learned across network depths. We propose CS-MoE, a novel Transformer architecture featuring cross-layer expert sharing to address this inefficiency. Deviating from the widely used Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture that terminates each Transformer block with layer-isolated experts, CS-MoE combines layer-independent experts with concurrent access to a centralized, globally shared expert pool. This \textit{Global Experts Sharing} mechanism enables elastic control over token-level parameter activation and computational consumption (FLOPs). Experiments demonstrate that CS-MoE achieves lower perplexity than equal-scale dense Transformers while activating only 55\% of parameters. Furthermore, its performance scales monotonically with an increased number of activated experts and approaches MoE counterparts that consume more FLOPs by expanding the shared pool with a fixed FLOPs budget. CS-MoE also establishes a flexible Pareto frontier between computational cost and model capacity, offering an efficient alternative for computation-constrained environments.

</details>


### [392] [Toollery: Scaling LLM Agents to Thousands of Skills and Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22218)
*Xiangxi Tian,Ran Guan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Toollery提出了一种免训练的候选压缩框架，将LLM Agent的工具/技能选择从全库提示转化为基于"意图手册"的检索任务，通过离线为每个能力生成用户意图查询构建索引，在线检索紧凑top-k候选集交由最终LLM决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM Agent能力库扩展到数百乃至数万，全库提示面临token成本膨胀、延迟增加和分心项增多的部署瓶颈。普通检索方法直接对specification建索引，但用户请求与规格说明之间存在描述意图的失配鸿沟。

Method: 核心方法分三阶段：(1)离线构建手册：使用生成器LLM为每个能力（高级技能/MCP服务/原子工具/API函数统一抽象）从其规格说明生成N=3个用户意图查询，可选源能力恢复过滤剔除过宽或非区分性查询；(2)在线检索：BM25/稠密检索将用户请求与手册条目匹配，按能力聚合查询级证据（top-c=3均值+证据计数奖励）形成top-k候选集；(3)最终决策：仅将检索到的k≪M个候选规格说明传给最终LLM完成schema感知决策与参数填充。

Result: 在三个设置上验证：SkillRouter（~79K能力库）Recall@10从0.571提升至0.942，FullCoverage@10从0.413提升至0.853；BFCL-V4（443-457原子工具）在top-10预算下AST准确率维持可比（0.825→0.830非实时，0.834→0.837实时）；私有智能座舱数据集（220工具、3396请求）Recall@10从0.545提升至0.684，FullCoverage@10从0.224提升至0.381，端到端精确集准确率从0.163提升至0.268。token消耗从全库的4310万降至top-10的2.77万（三个数量级压缩）。但BFCL上端到端改进不显著，billed-input-cost优势依赖缓存状态。

Conclusion: Toollery将可扩展能力选择重构为候选压缩问题而非不断增长的全库提示，通过离线构建来源可追溯手册、在线检索紧凑候选集、交由最终LLM基于权威规格做决策。在库规模泛化场景下提升候选集覆盖率，在饱和检索设置下保持端到端质量不下降。局限在于生成查询的覆盖精度、离线维护成本，且实际成本节省依赖工作负载覆盖与提供商缓存策略。

Abstract: As LLM agents are exposed to hundreds to tens of thousands of skills, tools, and API functions, full-library prompting becomes costly, slow, and less reliable: each added candidate increases prompt tokens and latency, while longer candidate lists introduce more distractors for LLM selection. We present \textbf{Toollery}, a training-free candidate-compression framework for scalable LLM skill/tool selection. Following established document-side query expansion, Toollery generates user-intent queries from each skill/tool specification and builds a retrieval index that maps real user requests to compact candidate sets before final LLM decision-making. By treating high-level skills and atomic tools as selectable capabilities, Toollery can be applied to both skill libraries and tool registries. We evaluate Toollery on the roughly 79K-capability SkillRouter benchmark, BFCL-V4 with over 440 atomic tools, and 3,396 proprietary smart-cockpit requests over 220 tools. Across these settings, Toollery keeps online selection bounded to a compact top-$k$ candidate set and improves recall over ordinary specification retrieval. At a fixed top-10 budget, Toollery improves end-to-end selection on the cockpit dataset, and maintains comparable AST Accuracy on BFCL-V4. These results support Toollery as a practical candidate-compression framework for large and evolving agent capability libraries, while showing that quality and cost gains depend on workload coverage and provider caching.

</details>


### [393] [Can Coding Agents Reproduce Official Statistics? Metadata, Retry Budget and the Limits of Execution Feedback in a Controlled Eurostat Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22222)
*Sabina-Cristiana Necula*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究构建了一个包含30个自然语言任务的基准测试，评估大型语言模型生成代码以复现Eurostat官方统计结果的可靠性，考察元数据和执行反馈对结果可复现性的影响，并通过实验揭示评估标准设计的关键重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型在数据分析代码生成方面的能力提升，一个核心问题浮现：代码能成功执行并不意味着其结果符合官方统计标准。该研究旨在探究权威元数据和执行反馈能否提升编码智能体在Eurostat统计任务上的可复现性，并进一步分离出"执行反馈"本身（execution diagnostics）的独立贡献。

Method: 研究设计了30个跨7个领域、7个Eurostat数据集、4个难度等级的自然语言任务。在四种条件下进行对比实验：(A)仅任务描述；(B)任务加上冻结的数据集元数据卡；(C)元数据加上由净化执行反馈驱动的修复循环；(D)元数据加上相同的尝试预算但完全无诊断信息。使用Claude Sonnet 5通过Anthropic Messages API生成Python代码，进行三次独立重复实验，共产生360次任务运行。正确性标准要求成功执行、正确的数据集、筛选条件、输出形式、数值和单位。还设置了一个补充实验，在输出契约欠指定（未声明排名键和单位表示）的情况下运行，以揭示评估标准的影响。

Result: 关键发现是评估标准和输出契约的设计对测量结果有决定性影响。表面上的执行反馈贡献（23.4个百分点的低估）实际上反映了契约欠指定问题，而非反馈机制的真实效用。

Conclusion: 可靠的统计编码智能体需要三项关键要素：(1)基于冻结规范的语义验证；(2)完全指定的输出契约；(3)重试预算——而非执行诊断信息本身。该研究强调了在评估LLM生成统计代码时，严格的输出契约设计和语义验证比单纯的执行反馈更为重要。

Abstract: Large language models can generate executable data-analysis code, but successful execution is not equivalent to a valid official-statistics result. This study asks whether authoritative metadata and execution feedback improve the reproducibility of Eurostat answers produced by a coding agent, and isolates what execution feedback actually contributes. A benchmark of 30 natural-language tasks covering seven domains, seven Eurostat datasets and four difficulty tiers was run under four conditions: task only (A), task plus a frozen dataset metadata card (B), metadata plus a repair loop driven by sanitized execution feedback (C), and metadata plus the same attempt budget with no diagnostics of any kind (D). Claude Sonnet 5 generated Python through the Anthropic Messages API in three independent replicates, yielding 360 task-runs. Exact correctness required successful execution, the correct dataset, filters, output shape, values and unit. A companion experiment run under an under-specified output contract, in which the required ranking key and unit representation were never stated to the model, understated condition C by 23.4 points, showing that evaluator and contract design can dominate measured agent error. Reliable statistical coding agents need semantic validation against frozen specifications, a fully specified output contract, and a retry budget - not execution diagnostics.

</details>


### [394] [Not All Ranks Are Equal: Budget-Aware LoRA Merging Across Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22237)
*Avinash Amballa,Yashas Malur Saidutta,Wenbo Li,Lazar Valkov,Srinivas Chappidi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Net Utility（净效用）指标，通过对每个任务的LoRA进行SVD分解，在不增加计算量（无需数据、无需优化）的前提下，以数据无关（data-free）的方式在全局预算约束下贪心地为不同任务、不同层分配非均匀的秩预算（rank budget），从而显著缩小合并LoRA与单任务LoRA之间的性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LoRA合并方法普遍假设每一层以及每个任务享有相同的秩预算（uniform-budget），这一假设是合并后模型与单任务LoRA之间性能差距的主要来源。然而，LoRA更新的谱能量在不同层和不同任务间分布极不均匀，均匀分配会导致某些层欠表示、某些层过表示。此外，秩选择本身是一个NP难问题。

Method: 1) 对每个任务每个层的LoRA更新 ΔWi 进行SVD分解，得到所有秩为1的奇异方向；2) 利用Gram几何代理（无需任务数据，仅从适配器权重本身估计输入协方差）推导出每个方向的"净效用"分数 gj,k = 归一化的源任务保留收益（σ⁴/w）- λ×跨任务干扰（σ²·其他任务右奇异向量的加权内积平方）；3) 将所有层、所有任务的所有方向汇入全局池，按净效用分数从高到低排序，贪心地选取得分为正的Top-RG个方向；4) 用所选方向重构各任务适配器后送入任一现有合并算子（TA/TSV/DARE/TIES/Iso-C）。整体算法闭式、无需梯度、无需数据。

Result: 在ViT-B/32上的7个视觉任务和Qwen3-4B上的6个语言NLI任务上，将Net Utility应用于5种合并方法（TA/TSV/DARE/TIES/Iso-C）和3种合并空间（全空间/Core Space/KnOTS空间），在3种秩预算（R=16/32/64）下全面优于均匀秩分配基线：视觉任务平均+2.1%，语言任务平均+2.2%，最大单点增益达+3.8%。分析还显示：① 88%的视觉任务所选方向集并非按奇异值大小排列的前缀集，颠覆了现有SVD合并方法隐含的"前缀截断"假设；② 较晚层以及Value/Output投影矩阵被分配更多秩；③ 在Hendrycks MATH 7个子任务上，净效用与任务难度呈-0.78的负相关，揭示其可被解释为任务难度指标。

Conclusion: 均匀秩分配是合并LoRA性能不佳的关键瓶颈之一。论文提出的Net Utility作为一种轻量、数据无关、闭式的秩分配准则，可即插即用地叠加在多种现有合并方法与合并空间之上，一致性地带来显著性能提升，并揭示了"最优方向集不必是按奇异值排序的前缀"这一重要观察，为多任务LoRA合并提供了新的设计原则。局限在于：效用推导基于线性（任务算术）合并算子；超参数λ未做精细调节，若有验证集可进一步提升。

Abstract: Merging low-rank adapters (LoRAs) promises to eliminate the overhead of swapping task-specific weights at inference time. However, existing merging methods assume every layer needs the same rank budget. Further, some methods assume that rank budget needs to be split equally among the tasks too. We show this uniform-budget assumption is a major source of the performance gap between merged and per-task LoRAs. However, rank selection is an NP hard problem. To this end, we introduce Net Utility, a data free metric that first decomposes every task LoRA by its Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and scores each of those singular directions by its task utility and its interference with other tasks directions. Next, we globally pool these scores to select singular directions with the highest values with a constraint on the total number of directions selected. The proposed Net Utility metric is applied on top of five different merging methods across three different merging spaces. The merging is done over two sets of tasks, vision and language tasks. Net utility based rank allocation outperforms its counterparts without that allocation. On average, over vision tasks it achieves +2.1% improvement in performance, and +2.2% improvement over the language tasks.

</details>


### [395] [Universal Observatory Graphs for Distributed Sky Coverage and Artificial Intelligence Based Interplanetary Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22244)
*Mohammed Abdel Razek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于AI的分布式天文观测框架——通用观测台图（UOG），将太阳-行星L2拉格朗日点的天文台建模为加权图节点，将通信链路建模为具有多目标物理与运营度量的边。通过六台观测台（地球、火星、木星、土星、天王星、海王星）的仿真，评估瞬时天空覆盖率和通信路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着太阳系内分布式天文观测需求增长，需要一个统一的数学框架来建模多个自主天文台之间的协作观测网络，并解决由此产生的覆盖评估与多目标通信路由问题。当前缺乏可复现的基线方法对跨行星观测网络进行系统性分析与优化。

Method: 1. 将各L2点观测台建模为加权图节点，通信链路作为边；3. 使用200,000方向Fibonacci球面、2,000,000方向固定种子蒙特卡洛计算以及确定性球面积分评估瞬时覆盖；5. 将路由问题建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并采用表格Q-learning求解；7. 奖励函数综合考虑节点参与度、距离相关可靠性代理、距离光时延迟及距离平方传输功率代理；9. 在四跳约束下评估可行简单路径。

Result: 三种方法均得出完全网络联合覆盖率，六台观测台完全交集覆盖率约0.43%，平均成对Jaccard相似度约24.96%。学习得到的Earth-Saturn-Uranus-Neptune路由在四跳约束下41条可行简单路径中具有最高的折扣回报。

Conclusion: UOG框架为顺序覆盖评估和多目标路由提供了可复现的基线方法。然而，时变星历表、任务特定可见性、校准链路预算以及可扩展的图策略仍是未来工作的方向。

Abstract: This research proposes the Universal Observatory Graph (UOG), an AI-driven framework for distributed astronomical observation across the Solar System. The proposed architecture models autonomous observatories located at the Sun planet L2 Lagrange points as nodes in a weighted graph, while communication links are represented as graph edges characterized by multi-objective physical and operational metrics, including interplanetary distance, communication latency, transmission power, and link reliability. The resulting graph provides a unified mathematical representation of a cooperative interplanetary observatory network. This proposal examines a six-observatory Solar System configuration comprising Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune. Instantaneous sky coverage is evaluated independently using a 200,000 direction Fibonacci sphere, a 2,000,000 direction fixed seed Monte Carlo calculation and deterministic spherical integration. All three methods yield complete network union coverage, approximately 0.43% complete six observatory intersection and approximately 24.96% mean pairwise Jaccard similarity under the adopted pointing model. Communication routing is subsequently formulated as a finite horizon Markov decision process and solved using tabular Q-learning. The reward balances node participation and a distance dependent reliability proxy against distance, light time latency and a distance squared transmission power proxy. The learned Earth-Saturn-Uranus-Neptune route is also the highest discounted return route among all 41 feasible simple paths under the four hop constraint. The framework provides a reproducible baseline for sequential coverage assessment and multi objective routing; time dependent ephemerides, mission specific visibility, calibrated link budgets and scalable graph policies remain future work.

</details>


### [396] [CHART: A Harness-Rotation Curriculum for Harness-Robust Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22247)
*Xinlu Zhang,Ying-Chun Lin,Zhihan Zhang,Besnik Fetahu,Xi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对RL训练搜索智能体在生产环境中因系统提示(harness)更新导致行为丢失的问题，提出CHART（课程式harness轮转训练）。核心发现：固定harness训练使并行搜索行为变得harness-local；静态harness增强在小池上迅速饱和对比信号，大池上信号被稀释。CHART通过周期性"毕业"已掌握行为的harness并替换为仍可学习的harness来保持组内奖励对比信号，显著提升对未见harness的鲁棒性及对下游元harness搜索的增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL训练的智能体行为与其训练harness深度耦合：固定harness下训练出的并行搜索行为只是harness-local的——一旦系统提示被改写（即使任务不变），模型就退回到串行搜索。这暴露了后训练智能体的脆弱性，并使harness增强（直觉的修复方案）在所有池规模下都失败：小池耗尽对比信号，大池稀释信号。

Method: CHART（Curriculum HArness Rotation Training）：在大小为N的"轮转窗口"内维护活动harness；每20步进行一次轻量评估，将并行率PR%≥0.85的harness"毕业"并替换为来自同一池中PR%∈[0.40,0.80]区间的候选（即可学习但尚未覆盖）。关键设计：(1)通过GRPO的组内对比（同一问题的并行vs串行rollout奖励差）学习；(2)以"over-shoot至~0.95"确保行为巩固，而非EMA即时毕业；(3)从PR%中心c=0.60附近选择替换者，使其接近毕业但仍有可学量。

Result: CHART使并行搜索在100%训练harness上成为默认行为（静态增强最多48%），并在89%的未见harness上实现并行化（静态池最多5%）。在OOD购物任务与搜索环境上，pass@1比最佳静态池提升5.6pp。在元harness搜索中，CHART-3作为子模型使搜索在deep-research上达到0.535 pass@1（比base高12.6pp），在shopping上达到0.515（高10.0pp），且harness-loss landscape更平坦（行扩散从10.2pp降至2-4pp）。消融实验表明：轮转必须贯穿全程（vs早期stop停留在cue边界）、可学习带选择优于随机选择（随机填充比固定池还差12pp）、eval-only触发优于EMA即时触发（EMA毕业过快，行为未巩固）。

Conclusion: CHART是首个针对harness接口而非问题难度的课程学习方法；从同一harness池出发，仅通过时序组织就能将harness-local行为转化为跨未见harness风格、新QA分布和新搜索环境的鲁棒默认行为，且不牺牲准确率。鲁棒性也提升了智能体作为元harness搜索子模型的价值——更平坦的harness损失景观使自动搜索收敛到更好的harness。该工作的局限在于：仅在一种行为（轮内并行搜索）和一种基座模型（Qwen3-30B-A3B）上验证；未涵盖工具接口变化（如重命名或干扰工具）。

Abstract: Search agents are usually trained under a single harness. But once an agent is deployed in a real application, its harness is frequently updated (e.g., a rewritten system prompt) to fit production needs. This exposes a fragility of post-trained agents: because a learned behavior is entangled with its training harness, even a harness update that leaves the task unchanged can fail to elicit the behavior. We train a search agent to perform parallel search, a popular strategy for improving both search efficiency and performance. We find that training under a fixed harness makes the behavior harness-local, overfit to that harness's surface form: when the harness changes, the model falls back to serial search. An intuitive fix is harness augmentation, but simply training on more harnesses does not resolve the problem. GRPO learns from the reward gap between parallel and serial rollouts of the same question: a small harness pool saturates that gap early, while a large pool dilutes the per-harness signal too thinly for any harness to consolidate. We therefore propose Curriculum HArness Rotation Training (CHART), a rotating curriculum that lets a search agent gradually consolidate parallel search across harnesses. At each periodic evaluation, CHART "graduates" the harnesses whose expected behavior is learned and replaces them with still-learnable ones, keeping the reward gap alive throughout training. Starting from the same harness pool, CHART makes the model learn parallel search on all harnesses, whereas static augmentation succeeds on at most half of them. The behavior also carries to held-out harnesses: CHART parallelizes on 89% of held-out turns, against at most 5% for the static pools. It further transfers to a new QA task and search environment, improving pass@1 by 5.6pp over the best static pool. Finally, CHART-trained agents benefit more from meta-harness search than baselines.

</details>


### [397] [Predictors and Orchestrators: Parsimonious Machine Learning within an Agentic AI Harness for Multi-Horizon Karst Aquifer Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22251)
*Pramod Lekhak,Chetan Sharma,Hakan Başağaoğlu,F. Paul Bertetti,Debaditya Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对岩溶含水层非线性、事件驱动的补给特征，提出一种部署感知的1-12周预测框架，基于德州Edwards含水层约79年的水文气候数据，比较XGBoost、极端随机树、LSTM、CNN与Transformer五类模型，发现XGBoost在全预测时段表现最优（R²≥0.94），并嵌入五智能体操作架构实现自动化预报与阈值监测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 岩溶泉流量和地下水位预测受非线性、事件驱动和强异质性流径影响，传统深度学习模型在长预见期表现不稳定，亟需一种兼具模型可解释性、泄漏防控、决策阈值契合度与可审计自动化的预测框架，以支撑干旱预警和水资源管理。

Method: 采用统一时序评估设计，对79年水文气候数据进行多预见期（1-4周、5-8周、9-12周）滚动预测；以R²、Kling-Gupta效率、RMSE及业务干旱阈值一致性为评价指标，对比XGBoost、极端随机树、LSTM、CNN、Transformer五类模型；并设计数据采集–模型分配–阈值报告五智能体自动化架构。

Result: XGBoost在1-4周、5-8周、9-12周三个预见期R²分别≥0.97、0.96、0.94，前三级干旱关键阶段一致率>90%；深度模型在短预见期具有竞争力，但随预见期延长性能渐进退化并出现孤立失效；树模型优势源于与低维轴对齐水文气候预测因子的天然契合以及深度模型对极值平滑的倾向。

Conclusion: 研究构建了一种可迁移的部署感知预测框架，融合简约建模、泄漏防控的多预见期评估、决策相关阈值技巧及可审计智能体自动化，证明在岩溶含水层预测中树模型仍具显著优势，为业务化干旱预警提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Forecasting karst aquifer dynamics is difficult because recharge responses are nonlinear, event-driven, and governed by strongly heterogeneous flow paths. This study develops and evaluates a deployment-aware framework for 1-12-week-ahead prediction of spring discharge and groundwater level using approximately 79 years of hydroclimatic observations from the Edwards Aquifer, Texas. Five model families were compared under a common temporal evaluation design: extreme gradient boosting, extremely randomized trees, long short-term memory, convolutional neural networks, and Transformers. Predictions were evaluated using coefficient of determination, Kling-Gupta efficiency, root-mean-square error, and agreement with operational drought thresholds. Extreme gradient boosting was consistently most reliable, with R2 at least 0.97, 0.96, and 0.94 across 1-4-, 5-8-, and 9-12-week horizons, respectively, and greater than 90% critical-stage agreement at the first three drought stages across all horizons. Deep models were competitive at short horizons but degraded progressively and exhibited isolated failures at longer lead times. We attribute this contrast to an alignment between tree partitioning and low-dimensional, axis-aligned hydroclimatic predictors, together with the tendency of neural models to smooth irregular extremes. The validated models were embedded in a five-agent operational architecture that automates data acquisition, model assignment, deterministic prediction, threshold monitoring, prospective verification, literature retrieval, and reporting. The contribution is therefore a transferable framework joining parsimonious model selection, leakage-aware multi-horizon evaluation, decision-relevant threshold skill, and auditable agentic automation.

</details>


### [398] [CALM: A Calibrated LLM Choice Network Framework for Activity-Based Traveler Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22252)
*Yezhou Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了CALM框架,一个用于基于活动的出行者模拟的可复现混合系统。该框架集成了可选的大语言模型(LLM)活动规划器、经过校准的随机选择模型、共享网络反馈、记忆与习惯机制、类型化可行性检查和确定性离线回放功能。基于2024年纽约市全市出行调查数据(110,691次七模式出行),通过个体不相交的数据划分和训练集专属的特定选择常数(ASC)校准,将保持集模式Jensen-Shannon散度从0.15599降至0.00394,并通过匹配实验量化了LLM规划器在聚合拟合、时间拟合、行为持续性和可行性之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的活动出行模型校准困难,而新兴的LLM出行代理虽能生成流畅的出行叙事,但缺乏经验有效性验证:看似合理的移动叙事仍可能与空间、时间、OD分布不匹配。此外,LLM移动系统的评估普遍存在校准、可复现性和任务对齐验证不足的问题。因此需要一个将生成式规划器与经验校准、共享状态模拟和受控干预评估统一起来的可复现框架。

Method: CALM采用模块化闭环设计:规划器(固定/模拟/LLM)→可行性验证→随机选择(出发/方式/路径)→共享区域网络加载→记忆与习惯状态更新。出行者具备属性zi和类别条件化特质θi(时间、成本、可靠性、舒适性、环境、习惯、风险)。方式选择采用MNL模型,效用函数包含ASC和归一化旅行时间和成本等变量。训练集上拟合的七种方式ASC(相对地铁)在[-5,5]预设范围内。评估协议包含五个组件:(E2)使用十个种子的保持集校准;(E3)匹配式实时LLM消融实验,75位出行者×4个条件日(300出行者日/臂),使用gpt-4o-mini,温度0.2;(E5)受控干预压力测试(雨、延误、票价、停车阶梯);(E6)监督式MNL个体预测参考。数据采用个体ID哈希划分,确保训练集(2,382人/78,487次出行)与保持集(986人/32,204次出行)零重叠。所有LLM调用通过提示哈希键控,离线回放重用冻结的响应。

Result: E2校准结果:校准后选择在十个种子上的平均保持集模式JSD为0.00394(SD=0.00235),远优于未校准的0.15599(SD=0.01350),汇总差值为-0.15332,95%区间[-0.16577,-0.14057]。习惯臂提供0.01066的行为参考点。E3匹配实时LLM消融:所有LLM臂的首次通过可行性超过0.98,最终可行性达1.0;纯选择臂模式JSD最低(0.00111),但LLM臂显著降低出行者内换乘率(从0.69778降至0.32444)和改善出行时间W1/IQR;记忆机制进一步将换乘率从0.47111降至0.36889。900个出行者日均从冻结提示-响应对重新运行。E5干预响应:所有均值曲线遵循预设单调方向,验证选择和共享网络状态对干预的传导。E6监督比较:加权MNL个体预测准确率0.5928,显著优于训练份额先验的0.3970。

Conclusion: CALM建立了一个校准、可复现且模块化的框架,将LLM规划集成到基于活动的出行者模拟中。核心贡献在于:(1)模块化闭环架构容纳固定/模拟/LLM规划器;(2)通过训练专属ASC校准和冻结保持集评估建立个体不相交的经验锚点;(3)匹配评估协议分离聚合拟合、实时模块效应、受控应力和监督预测;(4)通过提示哈希、修订追踪和确定性修复实现可复现性。实证结论在13区受控网络和匹配目的-OD情境下成立,未来扩展方向包括内生活动链生成、经验校准网络条件、观察到的中断事件、交叉拟合的时空保持集和多城市验证。该框架将生成式出行规划从独立叙事生成器转变为可控、可追溯、可复现的模拟模块和任务对齐评估协议。

Abstract: We present CALM, a reproducible hybrid framework that integrates an optional large language model (LLM) activity planner with calibrated stochastic choice, shared network feedback, memory and habit, typed feasibility checks, and deterministic offline replay. Unlike trip-mode classifiers or diary-only generators, CALM executes a closed traveler-day loop and evaluates each generative module against an empirical, reproducible baseline. On the 2024 New York City Citywide Mobility Survey (CMS), 110,691 seven-mode trips are split by respondent into 78,487 training and 32,204 holdout trips. Training-only alternative-specific constant calibration reduces mean holdout mode Jensen-Shannon divergence from 0.15599 to 0.00394 across ten seeds. A matched live-LLM ablation then quantifies trade-offs among aggregate fit, temporal fit, behavioral persistence, and feasibility, while frozen prompt-response pairs support deterministic replay of downstream simulation. Controlled weather, delay, fare, and parking ladders further demonstrate consistent and interpretable responses under intervention. CALM contributes a reproducible protocol for integrating and evaluating generative planners in traveler simulation through person-disjoint calibration, matched module ablation, controlled stress testing, and end-to-end traceability.

</details>


### [399] [CAMFT: Conflict-Aware Mergeable Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22253)
*Jingang Zhou,Haiyang Guo,Yuan Ma,Han Zhu,Xu-Yao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAMFT提出了一种冲突感知的可合并微调方法，通过在SVD共享坐标系中探测任务间的梯度冲突，将多任务微调建模为稀疏坐标分配问题，从而在微调阶段而非后处理阶段缓解任务间的参数冲突，提升多任务模型合并性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型合并方法主要在微调后处理阶段解决参数冲突，忽略了训练阶段本身对跨任务兼容性的影响。独立微调不可避免地在重叠参数方向上写入不兼容信息，事后合并具有本质局限性。因此需要在微调阶段就考虑合并友好性，从根本上减少参数空间纠缠。

Method: 方法包含五个步骤：(1) 问题形式化，将多任务微调建模为参数更新冲突问题；(2) 构建共享SVD坐标系：对预训练权重矩阵进行SVD分解，冻结左右奇异向量，将每个任务的更新表示为该坐标系下的稀疏坐标矩阵；(3) 基于小规模探测集的梯度探测，估计每个坐标对任务的重要性I_{t,p}和带符号更新方向R_{t,p}，进而计算任务特异性D_{t,p}和坐标冲突分数C_p；(4) 冲突感知掩码分配：通过选择分数S_{t,p} = Ĩ_{t,p}(1+γD_{t,p})/(1+λC_p(1-D_{t,p}))为每个任务选择top-k稀疏坐标，并对高冲突坐标应用独占规则；(5) 掩码微调与合并：在分配的坐标上独立微调各任务，然后使用任意标准合并算法（如TIES）合并。

Result: 在TRACE 7任务基准（Llama-3.2-1B）上，合并后的宏平均得分达到0.464，超过MergOPT（0.442）和Full FT（0.418），合并率（合并后/单任务性能比）达83.3%。单任务性能与LoRA和MergOPT相当。在Qwen3-4B上一致验证：合并得分0.540，合并率88.7%。消融实验表明：移除冲突估计下降0.069，随机掩码下降0.088，非SVD空间重要性下降0.037。CAMFT在Average、Task Arithmetic、DARE、TIES四种合并算法上均优于Full FT和MergOPT。任务向量余弦相似度分析显示CAMFT显著降低跨任务参数干扰，且在所有16个Transformer块和七种投影类型上一致减少冲突。探测样本数约500即可达到稳定性能。

Conclusion: CAMFT成功将PEFT与模型合并桥接起来，通过在共享谱空间中实施坐标级冲突感知分配，产出内在合并友好的任务更新。该方法在保留单任务能力的同时，显著提升多任务合并性能，且与后处理合并算法互补。局限性在于依赖探测数据质量、固定坐标预算以及需要预知所有任务。

Abstract: Model merging has emerged as a promising paradigm for integrating multiple task-specific capabilities into a single large language model. However, existing methods predominantly focus on post-hoc processing of independently fine-tuned models, overlooking how the training phase itself impacts cross-task compatibility. Resolving parameter conflicts after fine-tuning is inherently sub-optimal. To address this, we propose CAMFT, a Conflict-Aware Mergeable Fine-Tuning method that makes task adaptation both efficient and mergeaware. CAMFT treats mergeability as a property shaped during fine-tuning, rather than only a problem to be solved after fine-tuning. By guiding each task to update sparse coordinates with lower cross-task conflict, CAMFT produces task updates that are efficient to train and more compatible for downstream model merging. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAMFT outperforms standard finetuning baselines in multi-task merging scenarios. Codes are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [400] [Teacher Should Think Ahead: Adaptive Continuations for Reliable On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22254)
*Jingang Zhou,Yuyi Zhou,Haiyang Guo,Xukai Wang,Shuai Feng,Sirui Gao,Jian Xu,Qingpei Guo,Xu-Yao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对在线策略蒸馏(OPD)中教师监督在低质量学生前缀上不可靠的问题,发现了"教师不确定性收缩(TUC)"现象,并提出了自适应续接的在线策略蒸馏方法 AC-OPD,通过在信息丰富的锚点位置附加有限长度的教师续接来提升监督质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 OPD 仅在学生生成的前缀处查询教师进行局部下一token监督,当学生前缀不完整或质量较低时,教师监督可能含噪或信号弱,导致训练不稳定。论文旨在探究是否可以通过多token教师续接提供更可靠的监督信号。

Method: 1) 发现 TUC 现象:教师沿自身续接路径的预测熵和Gini不纯度单调下降;2) 理论分析:通过教师分支梯度的方差-偏差分解,证明TUC降低监督方差但路径分歧增大偏差,最优续接长度有限(理论最优 ~√(A/Bκ));3) 提出 AC-OPD:用平方对数比分数选择K个信息最丰富的锚点,教师从锚点续接至多m_max个token,自适应选择有效监督长度h_i,通过最小化方差-偏差代理指标(教师Gini估计方差、累积KL估计偏差)决定截断点,与OPD主损失联合训练。

Result: 在 Qwen3 两组教师-学生配置(4B→1.7B-Base 和 32B→4B-Base)上,数学推理(Math Avg.)和代码生成(Code Avg.)均一致优于 OPD 基线:Setting 1 数学+4.37点、代码+3.50点;Setting 2 数学+2.60点、代码+1.05点。固定续接长度实验呈非单调曲线,峰值在 h=8,验证有限续接原则;平方对数比锚点选择优于均匀/随机选择;token预算匹配实验表明增益源于监督效率提升而非额外token。

Conclusion: 自适应教师续接是提升在线策略蒸馏可靠性的有效原则。TUC 现象揭示了多token教师监督的价值,但方差-偏差权衡要求续接长度有限且上下文相关。AC-OPD 通过理论指导的自适应续接机制,在不同模型规模下稳定提升蒸馏效果,为可靠的在线策略蒸馏提供了新范式。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach for transferring knowledge between language models, where a student receives dense token-level supervision along its own generated trajectories. However, teacher supervision can be unreliable when conditioned on incomplete or low-quality student prefixes. We identify Teacher Uncertainty Contraction (TUC), a systematic phenomenon whereby the teacher's predictive uncertainty decreases as it continues from a student-generated prefix. We theoretically characterize this trade-off through a variance-bias decomposition of teacher-branch gradients, showing that uncertainty contraction reduces variance while teacher-student path divergence increases bias, thereby favoring a finite continuation. Guided by this insight, we propose Adaptive-Continuations On-Policy Distillation (AC-OPD), which augments informative states along student rollouts with teacher continuations and adaptively selects their effective supervision horizons. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation across model scales demonstrate that AC-OPD consistently improves over standard OPD. Controlled-continuations and matched-budget analyses further validate the adaptive-continuations design, highlighting adaptive teacher continuations as an effective principle for reliable on-policy this http URL code will be made publicly available upon publication.

</details>


### [401] [Strategy Accumulation and Guided Execution for Automated LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22257)
*Haoran Zhao,Wei Du,Dingwen Yang,Jixuan Huang,Junlin Shang,Lingyong Fang,Ya Guo,Tao Gui,Qi Zhang,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SAGE 框架,通过累积 MCTS 探索经验实现自动 LLM 微调的知识复用,在 9 个未见任务上将平均相对改进从 3.2% 提升至 15.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动微调系统(如 TREX)无状态,每次搜索后丢弃发现的策略、数据集洞察和超参数结果,每个新任务都需从零开始进行数十轮昂贵的训练,造成效率瓶颈。人类专家依靠可复用策略知识处理相似任务,但如何将经验累积与选择性复用引入到耗时的 LLM 微调搜索中仍缺乏研究。

Method: 两阶段框架:Stage 1 通过适配 MCTS 的多智能体流水线(Planner/Executor/Reviewer/Critic/Distillation)进行策略探索,关键改造包括:无界动作空间(节点可重复扩展)、树全局感知(append-only 日志与兄弟摘要)、diverge-refine 权衡权重 w(v)、Parent-Adjusted Scale-Referenced (PaSR) 奖励函数(结合 baseline delta 与 parent delta,并乘以 GPU 效率因子);Distillation Agent 通过父子、兄弟、根到叶、全树四种 pass 将探索结果提炼为两层经验——任务级探索记录与置信度评分的跨任务洞察(置信度通过 useful/useless/harmful 三种 verdict 演化,有害结果以乘法衰减 γ=0.5 施加更重惩罚)。Stage 2 对新任务进行类别匹配记录检索,通过 gap 分析(比较基线/评估机制/提升空间)与条件检查(transfer-when / transfer-breaks)验证后直接执行单轮策略。任务按能力瓶颈分为 reasoning、knowledge、alignment 三类。

Result: 在 3 个 Stage 1 元任务(MATH500/HoC/IFEval)各 20 次扩展的基础上,Distillation Agent 产出 46 条保留的跨任务洞察(73 条中 25 条合并、2 条因置信度过低被剪枝)。Stage 2 在 9 个未见任务上:w/ SAGE 平均相对改进从 3.2% 提升至 15.6%(Avg@3),从 14.4% 提升至 29.2%(Best@3R),单轮执行提升 12.4 个百分点;在 LawBench 和 OpenFindata 上 w/o SAGE 出现低于基线的回归(分别 -6.1% 和 -11.3%),而 w/ SAGE 始终高于基线;跨类别任务(GPQA-Diamond/EconLogicQA/ACI-Bench)平均增益 10.2%,小于单类别任务的 13.5%;Category 外的英中翻译任务(WMT24PP、FLORES)上 w/ SAGE 在 Best@3R 下均超过基线,表明跨任务洞察具有一定跨类泛化能力;GPU 利用率平均从 0.213 提升至 0.338。

Conclusion: SAGE 验证了持久化、结构化经验能够有效指导自动 LLM 微调,通过将 MCTS 探索结果提炼为可检索、可验证的两层知识,显著降低新任务的搜索开销。局限性包括 Stage 1 探索规模有限、仅在 1.5B 模型上验证、任务类型覆盖不全(未涉及多模态/工具使用等),未来需扩展探索预算、模型规模与类别分类法。

Abstract: Producing task-specific large language models requires discovering effective training strategies through experimentation. Automated fine-tuning systems have made this experimentation feasible with far less manual effort. However, these systems are stateless: each search discards its discovered strategies, dataset insights, and hyperparameter findings once it ends. Every new task must then repeat this costly search from a cold start. To address this, we propose Strategy Accumulation and Guided Execution (SAGE), a two-stage framework that makes automated fine-tuning search cumulative. In the first stage, a multi-agent pipeline performs Monte Carlo Tree Search-based exploration.
